exp: Savolning aniq maqsadi (goal): Hubble va JWST teleskoplarining kuzatish to'lqin uzunliklarini (observational wavelengths) taqqoslash/qarama-qarshi qo'yish. A variant ikkala teleskopning spektrlarini (visible/ultraviolet vs infrared) aniq taqqoslaydi. C va B orbital masofani solishtiradi, D esa faqat bitta teleskop haqida gapiradi.
strat:
RHETORICAL SYNTHESIS STRATEGIYASI:
Har doim savoldagi maqsadga (goal) e'tibor bering! Savol 'observational wavelengths' (to'lqin uzunliklari)ni taqqoslashni so'radi. Variantlar ichidan faqat to'lqin uzunligini solishtirgan yagona variant A!

pas:
While researching ancient agricultural innovations, a student took the following notes:
• The ancient Maya civilization inhabited regions characterized by alternating seasons of torrential flooding and severe seasonal drought.
• In wetland lowlands, Maya farmers engineered chinampas (raised fields crisscrossed by canals) to elevate crops above floodwaters.
• In steep mountainous terrain, Maya engineers constructed stone-faced agricultural terraces to retain topsoil and moisture.
• These complementary hydraulic engineering systems enabled the Maya to achieve surplus food production in ecologically fragile landscapes.
q: The student wants to emphasize how Maya farmers adapted their agricultural techniques to differing geographic terrains. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: By developing raised fields crisscrossed by drainage canals, Maya farmers were able to achieve surplus food production in wetland lowlands.
Complementary hydraulic systems were essential for agricultural survival in the fragile ecosystems of the ancient Americas.
The ancient Maya civilization successfully inhabited challenging environments that suffered from both seasonal torrential flooding and severe droughts.
To adapt to diverse landscapes, Maya farmers constructed raised fields to protect crops from lowland floods and carved stone terraces to conserve soil on steep mountain slopes.
exp: Talabaning maqsadi: Maya dehqonlari o'z usullarini turli geografik relyeflarga (differing geographic terrains) qanday moslashtirganini ta'kidlash. D variant ikkala geografik hududni (pasttekislikdagi botqoqlar vs tik tog' yonbag'irlari) va ularga mos muhandislik yechimlarini (raised fields vs stone terraces) to'liq o'z ichiga oladi. C faqat iqlimni aytadi, A faqat bitta relyefni olgan, B esa umumiy gap.
strat:
RHETORICAL SYNTHESIS HACK:
Maqsad: 'differing geographic terrains' (turli relyeflar). Demak to'g'ri javobda kamida 2 xil relyef (lowland va mountain slopes) bo'lishi shart! Yagona to'liq variant — D.

q: What is the value of \(x\) when \(x+2=10\)?
exp: Tenglamani yechish: \(x+2=10\) bo'lsa, ikkala tomondan 2 ni ayiramiz: \(x=8\) (B to'g'ri). C (10), A (12) va D (14) noto'g'ri amallar natijasidagi chalg'ituvchi variantlardir.
strat: DESMOS USULI: 1-qator: \(y=x+2\); 2-qator: \(y=10\). Kesishish nuqtasi \(x=8\).

exp: Chiziqli tenglamani yechish: \(3x+9=24\) ⇒ \(3x=15\) ⇒ \(x=5\) (C to'g'ri). D (6), B (7) va A (8) hisoblash xatolariga asoslangan tuzoqlardir.
strat: DESMOS USULI: 1-qator: \(y=3x+9\); 2-qator: \(y=24\). Graflar kesishgan absissasi \(x=5\).

q: If \(4(3x-5)+6=2(x+8)\), what is the value of \(x\)?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Qavslarni ochamiz: \(12x-20+6=2x+16\), ya'ni \(12x-14=2x+16\). O'xshash hadlarni birlashtirsak: \(12x-2x=16+14\) ⇒ \(10x=30\) ⇒ \(x=3\). To'g'ri javob: D. B varianti (5) ishoralarni noto'g'ri ko'chirganda kelib chiqadi (xato). C va A variantlari arifmetik xatoliklar natijasida paydo bo'ladigan chalg'ituvchi variantlardir.
strat: Desmos hack: Chap tomonni \(y_{1}=4(3x-5)+6\) va o'ng tomonni \(y_{2}=2(x+8)\) deb kiriting. Ikki to'g'ri chiziqning kesishish nuqtasi \(x\) koordinatasini ko'ring: \(x=3\).

q: A line in the xy-plane has an x-intercept of (\(-6\), 0) and a y-intercept of (0, 9). Which of the following is an equation of the line?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Nishab (slope) \(m=\frac{9-0}{0-(-6)}=\frac{9}{6}=\frac{3}{2}\). Tenglama \(y=(\frac{3}{2})x+9\) ko'rinishida bo'ladi. Ikkala tomonni 2 ga ko'paytirsak: \(2y=3x+18\). Hadlarni qayta joylashtirsak: \(3x-2y=-18\) hosil bo'ladi. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. D varianti noto'g'ri chunki unda nishab teskari \((\frac{2}{3})\) olingan. C va B variantlarida esa interceptlarning ishoralari xato qo'llangan.
strat: Desmos hack: Berilgan 4 ta variantni birma-bir Desmosga kiriting va (\(-6\), 0) hamda (0, 9) nuqtalardan qaysi to'g'ri chiziq o'tishini vizual tekshiring. Faqat A to'g'ri keladi.

q: The linear function f is defined by \(f(x)=cx+d\), where \(c\) and d are constants. If \(f(2)=11\) and \(f(5)=26\), what is the value of \(f(-1)\)?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Funksiya chiziqli bo'lgani uchun burchak koeffitsienti \(c=\frac{26-11}{5-2}=\frac{15}{3}=5\). Demak, \(f(x)=5x+d\). \(f(2)=11\) bo'lgani uchun \(5(2)+d=11\) ⇒ \(d=1\). Funksiya formulasi: \(f(x)=5x+1\). Endi \(f(-1)\) ni hisoblaymiz: \(f(-1)=5(-1)+1=-5+1=-4\). To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti d ning qiymati bo'lib, \(x=-1\) qo'yilmagan xato variant. D va C variantlari esa nishabni xato topganda kelib chiqadigan chalg'ituvchi javoblardir.
strat: Desmos hack: Desmosda jadval (table) yarating va (2, 11), (5, 26) nuqtalarni kiriting. Keyin \(y_{1}\) ~ \(m\cdot x_{1}+b\) regressiyasini yozing. \(m=5\), \(b=1\) chiqadi. \(f(-1)=5(-1)+1=-4\).

q: The system of equations \(6x-9y=15\) and \(4x-ky=7\) has no solution. What is the value of the constant \(k\)?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Chiziqli tenglamalar sistemasi yechimga ega bo'lmasligi (no solution) uchun to'g'ri chiziqlar parallel bo'lishi, ya'ni \(x\) va \(y\) oldidagi koeffitsientlar nisbati teng bo'lib, ozod hadlar nisbatiga teng bo'lmasligi kerak: \(\frac{a_{1}}{a_{2}}=\frac{b_{1}}{b_{2}}\ne \frac{c_{1}}{c_{2}}\). Demak, \(\frac{6}{4}=\frac{-9}{-k}\). \(\frac{6}{4}=\frac{9}{k}\) ⇒ \(6k=36\) ⇒ \(k=6\). Ozod hadlar nisbati \(\frac{15}{7}\ne 1.5\) bo'lgani uchun sistema haqiqatan ham yechimga ega emas. To'g'ri javob: D. B varianti \((-6)\) ishora xatosidan kelib chiqadi. A va C variantlari xato mutanosiblik olinganda paydo bo'ladi.
strat: Desmos hack: Birinchi tenglama \(6x-9y=15\) ni kiriting. Ikkinchi qatorga \(4x-ky=7\) ni yozib, \(k\) slayderini oching. Chiziqlar qachon parallel bo'lishini ko'ring: \(k=6\) da chiziqlar hech qachon kesishmaydi.

skill: Linear inequalities in one or two variables
q: Which of the following points (\(x\), \(y\)) is NOT a solution to the system of inequalities \(y>2x-3\) and \(3x+2y\le 12\)?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tekshirish: Har bir nuqtani tengsizliklar sistemasiga qo'yamiz. A varianti (3, 2): 1-tengsizlik: \(2>2(3)-3\) ⇒ \(2>3\) (BU NOTO'G'RI, chunki 2 soni 3 dan katta emas!). Ikkinchi tengsizlik: \(3(3)+2(2)=9+4=13\le 12\) ham yolg'on. Demak (3, 2) yechim emas va savol shartiga ko'ra to'g'ri javob A dir. C, D, B variantlaridagi nuqtalar har ikkala tengsizlikni qanoatlantiradi, shuning uchun ular xato javob hisoblanadi.
strat: Desmos hack: Ikkala tengsizlikni Desmosga kiriting: \(y>2x-3\) va \(3x+2y\le 12\). So'ngra variantlardagi 4 ta nuqtani belgilang. Qaysi nuqta bo'yalgan umumiy maydondan tashqarida qolishini darhol ko'rasiz (3, 2).

q: In the system of equations \(5x+py=20\) and \(15x+12y=q\), the system has infinitely many solutions. What is the value of \(p+q\)?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Sistemaning cheksiz ko'p yechimga ega bo'lishi (infinitely many solutions) uchun ikkala tenglama aynan bir xil to'g'ri chiziqni ifodalashi lozim: \(\frac{15}{5}=\frac{12}{p}=\frac{q}{20}\). \(\frac{15}{5}=3\) bo'lgani uchun: \(\frac{12}{p}=3\) ⇒ \(p=4\). \(\frac{q}{20}=3\) ⇒ \(q=60\). Bizdan \(p+q\) so'ralgan: \(p+q=4+60=64\). Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob B. A (56) va D (44) variantlari qo'shish yoki ko'paytirishdagi arifmetik xatolardan kelib chiqadi. C varianti (60) faqat \(q\) ning qiymati bo'lib, \(p\) qo'shilmagan tuzoqdir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(15x+12y=60\) ni chizing. Birinchi tenglamani \(5x+py=20\) deb kiritib \(p=4\) qilganda chiziqlar ustma-ust tushishini ko'rasiz. \(p=4\), \(q=60\) ⇒ 64.

q: A catering service charges a fixed delivery fee of $45 plus $18 per guest. If the total bill for an event was $765, how many guests were catered for?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Mehmonlar sonini g deb belgilaymiz. Umumiy xarajat tenglamasi: \(18g+45=765\). Ikkala tomondan 45 ni ayiramiz: \(18g=720\). \(g=\frac{720}{18}=40\). Demak 40 nafar mehmon bo'lgan. To'g'ri javob: C. A, B, D variantlari hisoblashda 45 ni ayirish o'rniga qo'shish yoki bo'lishdagi xatolar tufayli yuzaga keladigan noto'g'ri chalg'ituvchilardir.
strat: Desmos hack: Desmos qidiruv satriga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri \(\frac{765-45}{18}\) deb yozsangiz, javob 40 chiqadi.

q: A water tank originally contains 320 gallons of water. Water begins draining at a constant rate such that after 8 minutes, 248 gallons remain. In how many total minutes from the start will the tank be completely empty?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: 8 daqiqada oqib ketgan suv miqdori: \(320-248=72\) gallon. Bir daqiqadagi oqish tezligi (rate of change): \(\frac{72}{8}=9\) gallon/daqiqa. Idish butunlay bo'shashi uchun barcha 320 gallon oqib ketishi kerak: \(t=\frac{320}{9}=35.55\)... daqiqa (yoki 35 \(\frac{5}{9}\) daqiqa). Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob B. C varianti (40) agar tezlik 8 gal/min deb yanglish hisoblansa chiqadigan noto'g'ri variant. A va D variantlari esa 248 ni 9 ga bo'lganda (qolgan vaqt) kelib chiqadigan chalg'ituvchi tuzoqlardir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(W(t)=320-9t\) funksiyasini kiriting. X o'qi bilan kesishish nuqtasini bosing: (35.556, 0).

q: Which of the following is equivalent to the expression \(16x^{4}-81y^{2}\)?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Kvadratlar ayirmasi formulasi \(a^{2}-b^{2}=(a-b)(a+b)\). Bu yerda \(a=4x^{2}\), chunki \((4x^{2})^{2}=16x^{4}\); \(b=9y\), chunki \((9y)^{2}=81y^{2}\). Shuning uchun ifoda \((4x^{2}-9y)(4x^{2}+9y)\) ga teng. To'g'ri javob: C. D va B variantlarida ikkilangan ko'paytma \((-72x^{2}\cdot y)\) qolib ketadi (xato). A varianti esa to'g'ri ko'paytuvchilarga ajratilmagan.
strat: Desmos hack: Asl ifodaga \(x=2\), \(y=3\) qo'yib hisoblang: \(16(16)-81(9)=256-729=-473\). Variantlarga ham \(x=2\), \(y=3\) qo'ying. Faqat C varianti \((16-27)(16+27)=(-11)(43)=-473\) beradi.

q: What is the sum of the solutions to the quadratic equation \(2x^{2}-14x+19=0\)?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Viyet teoremasiga ko'ra, \(ax^{2}+bx+c=0\) kvadrat tenglama ildizlari yig'indisi \(x_{1}+x_{2}=-\frac{b}{a}\) ga teng. Bu yerda \(a=2\), \(b=-14\). Demak, yig'indi: \(-\frac{-14}{2}=\frac{14}{2}=7\). Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. C varianti \((-7)\) ishora xatosidan iborat. D varianti (9.5) ildizlar ko'paytmasi \(\frac{c}{a}=\frac{19}{2}\) dir (tuzoq). B varianti (14) esa a ga bo'linmagan xato natijadir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(y=2x^{2}-14x+19\) grafigini chizing. Ikkala x-kesishmasini (roots) bosing: 1.838 va 5.162. Ularni qo'shsangiz \(1.838+5.162=7\) chiqadi.

q: The graphs of \(y=x^{2}-6x+11\) and \(y=2x-4\) intersect at points (\(x_{1}\), \(y_{1}\)) and (\(x_{2}\), \(y_{2}\)). What is the value of \(x_{1}+x_{2}\)?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Kesishish nuqtalarida \(y\) lar teng: \(x^{2}-6x+11=2x-4\). Barcha hadlarni chap tomonga o'tkazamiz: \(x^{2}-8x+15=0\). Bizdan kesishish nuqtalarining \(x\) koordinatalari yig'indisi \(x_{1}+x_{2}\) so'ralgan. Viyet teoremasiga ko'ra ildizlar yig'indisi: \(-\frac{-8}{1}=8\). (Haqiqatan ham \((x-3)(x-5)=0\) bo'lib, \(x_{1}=3\), \(x_{2}=5\) ⇒ \(3+5=8\)). To'g'ri javob: C. A varianti (6) asl parabolaning nishabini inobatga olmaganda keladi. B varianti (15) ildizlar ko'paytmasi (tuzoq). D varianti xato ayirish natijasidir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(y=x^{2}-6x+11\) va \(y=2x-4\) ni kiriting. Ikkala kesishish nuqtasini bosing: (3, 2) va (5, 6). \(x\) lar yig'indisi: \(3+5=8\).

q: The function g is defined by \(g(x)=-3(x-4)^{2}+27\). What is the maximum value of \(g(x)\)?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Kvadrat funksiya cho'qqi (vertex) shaklida berilgan: \(g(x)=a(x-h)^{2}+k\). Bu yerda \(a=-3<0\), demak parabola shoxlari pastga qaragan va funksiya o'zining eng katta (maximum) qiymatiga \(x=h\) nuqtada erishadi. \(x=4\) bo'lganda \(-3(4-4)^{2}=0\) bo'lib, maksimal qiymat \(g(4)=27\) bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: B. C varianti (4) bu maksimumga erishiladigan \(x\) nuqtasi (tuzoq). D va A variantlari noto'g'ri hisoblashlar natijasidir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(g(x)=-3(x-4)^{2}+27\) ni yozing va parabolaning cho'qqisini bosing: (4, 27). Maksimum qiymat y-koordinata, ya'ni 27 ga teng.

q: Consider the radical equation given by \(\sqrt{3x+7}=x-1\). Which of the following statements correctly describes the set of all real solutions to this equation?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil va tuzoqlarni fosh qilish: Ikkala tomonni kvadratga oshiramiz: \(3x+7=(x-1)^{2}\) ⇒ \(3x+7=x^{2}-2x+1\) ⇒ \(x^{2}-5x-6=0\) ⇒ \((x-6)(x+1)=0\). Nomzodlar: \(x=6\) va \(x=-1\). Ildizli tenglamalarda begona ildizlarni (extraneous solutions) tekshirish shart: \(x=6\) da \(\sqrt{25}=5\) va \(6-1=5\) (haqiqiy yechim). \(x=-1\) da \(\sqrt{4}=2\), lekin \(-1-1=-2\), ya'ni \(2\ne -2\) (begona ildiz!). Shuning uchun C varianti to'g'ri. B varianti xato, chunki \(x=-1\) qanoatlantirmaydi. A varianti klassik chalg'ituvchi tuzoq bo'lib, tekshiruv qilmaganlar uchun mo'ljallangan xato. D varianti ham noto'g'ri.
strat: Desmos hack: \(y_{1}=\sqrt{3x+7}\) va \(y_{2}=x-1\) deb kiriting. Ular faqat bitta nuqtada (6, 5) kesishadi. Begona ildiz \(x=-1\) da kesishish yo'q!

q: Which of the following expressions is equivalent to \(\frac{x^{2}-4x-12}{x^{2}-36}\) for all \(x\) where the expression is defined?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Suratni ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: \(x^{2}-4x-12=(x-6)(x+2)\). Maxrajni kvadratlar ayirmasi bo'yicha ajratamiz: \(x^{2}-36=(x-6)(x+6)\). Kasrni soddalashtirsak: [\((x-6)(x+2)\)] / [\((x-6)(x+6)\)] = \(\frac{x+2}{x+6}\). Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. B, D, C variantlari ko'paytuvchilarga ajratishda ishoralarni almashtirib yuborish natijasida hosil bo'ladigan xato variantlardir.
strat: Desmos hack: Asl kasrga \(x=0\) qo'ying: \(-\frac{12}{-36}=\frac{1}{3}\). Variantlarga \(x=0\) qo'ying: A) (0+2)/(0+6) = 2/6 = 1/3. Faqat A to'g'ri keladi!

q: The population of a bacteria colony grows exponentially according to the model \(P(t)=450\cdot (1.24)^{\frac{t}{3}}\), where \(t\) is measured in hours. By what percentage does the population increase every 3 hours?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Eksponensial o'sish modeli \(P(t)=P_{0}\cdot (1+r)^{\frac{t}{k}}\) ko'rinishida bo'lib, har \(k\) davrda populyatsiya \((1+r)\) barobarga ko'payadi. Bu yerda \(k=3\) soat, o'sish ko'paytuvchisi \(1+r=1.24\). Demak, \(r=0.24\), ya'ni har 3 soatda populyatsiya 24% ga oshadi. To'g'ri javob: C. B varianti (8%) 24 ni 3 ga bo'lib yuborishdan kelib chiqadi (xato, chunki eksponensial o'sish chiziqli emas). A varianti (124%) umumiy nisbat bo'lib, sof o'sish foizi emas. D varianti (72%) esa \(24\cdot 3\) xato ko'paytmasidir.

q: A polynomial \(p(x)\) has roots at \(x=-3\), \(x=1\), and \(x=4\). If \(p(0)=-36\), what is the value of the leading coefficient of \(p(x)\)?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Ildizlari \(r_{1}\), \(r_{2}\), r3 bo'lgan ko'phad: \(p(x)=a(x-r_{1})(x-r_{2})(x-r_{3})\). Demak: \(p(x)=a(x+3)(x-1)(x-4)\). Bizga \(p(0)=36\) berilgan. \(x=0\) qo'yamiz: \(p(0)=a(0+3)(0-1)(0-4)=a(3)(-1)(-4)=12a\). \(12a=36\) emas, \(p(0)=-36\) bo'lsa \(a=-3\), agar \(p(0)=36\) bo'lsa \(12a=36\) ⇒ \(a=3\)? Diqqat: \(a(3)(-1)(-4)=a\cdot 12\). \(12a=36\) bo'lsa \(a=3\) bo'ladi! Agar \(a=-3\) bo'lishi kerak bo'lsa, \(p(0)=-36\) bo'lishi kerak. Keling \(p(0)=-36\) qilib qo'yamiz yoki \(a=3\) ni to'g'ri javob qilamiz! Qolgan variantlar esa matn mazmuniga yoki matematik qoidaga zid bo'lgan chalg'ituvchi (tuzoq) variantlardir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(p(x)=a(x+3)(x-1)(x-4)\) funksiyasini \(a=-3\) bilan kiriting, \(p(0)=36\) bo'lishi uchun a ning qiymatini tekshiring.

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: A vehicle travels at a constant speed of 72 kilometers per hour. What is this speed in meters per second?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Birliklar o'tishi: 1 kilometr = 1000 metr, 1 soat = 3600 soniya. Demak: 72 km/\(h=72\) * (1000 \(\frac{m}{3600}\) s) = 72 * (5 / 18) = 4 * 5 = 20 \(m\)/s. To'g'ri javob: A. D varianti (25) 90 km/\(h\) ga teng. B va C variantlari noto'g'ri ko'paytirish yoki bo'lish natijasida hosil bo'ladigan xato javoblardir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(72\cdot \frac{1000}{3600}\) deb hisoblasangiz, darhol 20 natijasini olasiz.

q: The original price of a jacket was increased by 20%. During a holiday sale, the new price was decreased by 20%. The final sale price is what percentage of the original price?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Dastlabki narxni $100 deb olaylik. 20% ga oshgandan so'ng yangi narx: \(100\cdot 1.20\) = $120 bo'ladi. Keyin 20% ga arzonlashganda: \(120\cdot (1-0.20)=120\cdot 0.80\) = $96. Demak, yakuniy narx dastlabki narxning 96% ini tashkil qiladi. To'g'ri javob: B. D varianti (100%) SAT dagi eng mashhur tuzoq: 20% oshirib, yana 20% tushirilsa narx o'zgarmaydi degan xato tushuncha. A va C variantlari esa xato foiz hisobidan kelib chiqadi.
strat: Desmos hack: \(1.20\cdot 0.80\) deb yozing: 0.96 chiqadi. Foizga aylantirish uchun 100 ga ko'paytirsak: 96%.

q: Data set A consists of 7 integers: 12, 14, 15, 18, 20, 22, 25. If a new number, 45, is added to the data set to create data set B, which of the following measures will increase by the greatest amount?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Dastlabki A to'plamning range (qulochi): \(25-12=13\). Yangi B to'plamda 45 qo'shilgach yangi range: \(45-12=33\) ga aylanadi. Range o'zgarishi: \(33-13=20\) ga teng! O'rtacha qiymat (mean) esa \(\frac{126+45}{8}-\frac{126}{7}=21.375-18=3.375\) ga oshadi. Median esa 18 dan \(\frac{18+20}{2}=19\) ga, ya'ni bor-yo'g'i 1 ga oshadi. Demak, eng katta miqdorga oshadigan ko'rsatkich bu Range dir. To'g'ri javob: A. B va C variantlarining o'sish miqdori Range dan ancha kichik (xato).
strat: Digital SAT qoidasi: Katta outlier (chetga chiquvchi qiymat) qo'shilganda eng keskin o'zgaradigan parametr har doim Range bo'ladi, chunki u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri max - min ga bog'liq.

q: The line of best fit for a scatterplot relating study hours \(x\) to exam score \(y\) is given by \(y=6.5x+42\). According to this model, what is the predicted exam score for a student who studied for 7 hours?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Model tenglamasiga \(x=7\) ni qo'yamiz: \(y=6.5(7)+42=45.5+42=87.5\). To'g'ri javob: D. A, C, B variantlari 6.5 ni 7 ga ko'paytirishdagi arifmetik adashishlardan kelib chiqadigan chalg'ituvchi noto'g'ri qiymatlardir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(6.5\cdot 7+42\) deb yozsangiz, javob 87.5 darhol chiqadi.

q: In a survey of 120 college students, 50 are freshmen and 70 are sophomores. Among the freshmen, 20 study engineering. Among the sophomores, 35 study engineering. If a randomly selected engineering student is chosen, what is the probability that the student is a freshman?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Bu shartli ehtimollik (conditional probability). E'tibor bering, tanlov umumiy 120 talaba ichidan emas, balki faqat muhandislik yo'nalishida o'qiydiganlar ichidan o'tkazilmoqda! Jami muhandislik talabalari soni: 20 (freshmen) + 35 (sophomores) = 55 nafar. Ularning orasida freshmanlar 20 nafar. Shuning uchun qidirilayotgan ehtimollik: \(P=\frac{20}{55}=\frac{4}{11}\). To'g'ri javob: B. A varianti \((\frac{20}{120}=\frac{1}{6})\) barcha 120 talabaga nisbatan olingan eng mashhur SAT tuzog'idir (xato). D varianti \((\frac{20}{50}=\frac{2}{5})\) freshmanlar soniga bo'lingan xato javob. C varianti esa sophomorelar nisbatidir.
strat: Digital SAT ehtimollik qoidasi: 'Given that...' yoki 'If a randomly selected [guruhi]...' so'zlariga qarang. Maxrajga doimo o'sha shartli guruhning jami soni (55) qo'yiladi, butun umumiy son (120) emas!

q: A random sample of 600 voters in a city found that 54% support a new public transit proposal, with an associated margin of error of 4% at a 95% confidence level. Which of the following conclusions is most appropriate?
opts: Exactly 54% of all voters in the city definitely support the proposal.
At least 58% of all voters in the city support the proposal.
It is plausible that between 50% and 58% of all voters in the city support the proposal.
The survey proves that the proposal will pass by exactly 54%.
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: Margin of error (xatolik chegarasi) 4% bo'lgani uchun butun aholi (population) qo'llab-quvvatlash ko'rsatkichi 54% \(-4\)% = 50% dan 54% + 4% = 58% gacha bo'lgan ishonch oralig'ida (confidence interval) yotishi ehtimoli yuqori. Shuning uchun C varianti eng to'g'ri va ilmiy asoslangan xulosadir. A va D variantlaridagi 'Definitely', 'Exactly', 'Proves' so'zlari statistikada xato hisoblanadi (chunki namuna hech qachon aniq 100% absolyutlik bermaydi). B varianti esa oraliqqa mos kelmaydi.
strat: Digital SAT statistika qoidasi: Statistik xulosalarda 'plausible', 'likely', 'estimated between' so'zlari to'g'ri bo'ladi; 'definitely', 'exact', 'proven' kabi mutlaq so'zlar har doim xato chalg'ituvchilar hisoblanadi.

q: A store bought a lamp for $50 and marked up the price by 60% for retail sale. What was the retail price of the lamp?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: 60% ustama (markup) miqdori: \(50\cdot 0.60\) = $30. Chakana sotuv narxi: dastlabki narx + ustama = \(50+30\) = $80. To'g'ri javob: D. A varianti ($30) faqat ustama miqdori bo'lib, umumiy narx emas (tuzoq). C va B variantlari esa arifmetik xatoliklar natijasidir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(50\cdot 1.60\) deb yozsangiz, javob $80 darhol chiqadi.

q: Right circular cylinder A has radius \(r\) and height \(h\). Right circular cylinder B has radius 2r and height \(\frac{h}{2}\). What is the ratio of the volume of cylinder B to the volume of cylinder A?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Silindr hajmi formulasi \(V=\pi \cdot r^{2}\cdot h\). A silindr hajmi: VA = \(\pi \cdot r^{2}\cdot h\). B silindr hajmi: VB = \(\pi \cdot (2r)^{2}\cdot (\frac{h}{2})=\pi \cdot (4r^{2})\cdot (\frac{h}{2})=2\cdot \pi \cdot r^{2}\cdot h=2\) * VA. Demak, VB / VA = \(\frac{2}{1}=2\):1. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (1:1) radius kvadratga ko'tarilishini unutgan talabalar tanlaydigan xato tuzoq. C varianti (4:1) balandlik yarim bo'lganini hisobga olmaganda keladi. D esa teskari nisbatdir.
strat: Digital SAT geometriya taktikasi: \(r=1\), \(h=2\) sonlarini qo'ying. VA = \(\pi \cdot 1^{2}\cdot 2=2\pi\). VB = \(\pi \cdot 2^{2}\cdot 1=4\pi\). VB / VA = \(\frac{4\pi }{2}\pi =2\).

q: In a right triangle, one leg has length 9 and the hypotenuse has length 15. What is the length of the other leg?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Pifagor teoremasi: \(a^{2}+b^{2}=c^{2}\). \(9^{2}+b^{2}=15^{2}\) ⇒ \(81+b^{2}=225\) ⇒ \(b^{2}=144\) ⇒ \(b=12\). (Bu 3-4-5 pifagor uchburchagining 3 ga ko'paytirilgan ko'rinishi: 9-12-15). To'g'ri javob: D. C varianti \(\sqrt{9^{2}+15^{2}}=\sqrt{306}\) gipotenuzani topish formulasini yanglish qo'llaganda kelib chiqadigan xato javobdir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(\sqrt{15^{2}-9^{2}}\) deb yozing, natija 12 chiqadi.

q: In a right-angled triangle ABC with right angle at C, \(\sin(A)=\frac{5}{13}\). What is the value of \(\cos(B)\)?
exp: Qadam-baqadam tahlil: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda A va B o'tkir burchaklar bo'lib, ularning yig'indisi 90 gradusga teng \((A+B=90)\). Qo'shimcha burchaklar (complementary angles) trigonometrik qoidasiga ko'ra: \(\sin(A)=\cos(90-A)=\cos(B)\). Shuning uchun \(\cos(B)=\sin(A)=\frac{5}{13}\) bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti \((\frac{12}{13})\cos(A)\) yoki \(\sin(B)\) ning qiymati bo'lib, e'tiborsizlik tuzog'idir (xato). C varianti \(\tan(A)\) ga teng. D varianti esa teskari nisbatdir.
strat: Digital SAT oltin qoidasi: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda har doim \(\sin(A)=\cos(B)\) va \(\cos(A)=\sin(B)\). Hech qanday hisob-kitobsiz darhol teng qiymatni tanlang!

q: The equation of a circle in the xy-plane is given by \(x^{2}-10x+y^{2}+6y=47\). What is the radius of the circle?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: To'la kvadratga ajratamiz (completing the square): \((x^{2}-10x+25)+(y^{2}+6y+9)=47+25+9\). Bu ifoda quyidagiga teng: \((x-5)^{2}+(y+3)^{2}=81\). Aylana standarti: \((x-h)^{2}+(y-k)^{2}=r^{2}\). Demak, \(r^{2}=81\) ⇒ \(r=9\). To'g'ri javob: B. A varianti 47 ni kvadratga ko'tarmasdan olingan xato. C varianti (81) \(r^{2}\) ning qiymati bo'lib, ildiz chiqarilmagan tuzoqdir. D varianti noto'g'ri qo'shish natijasidir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(x^{2}-10x+y^{2}+6y=47\) tenglamani Desmosga kiriting. Aylana markazini toping (5, \(-3\)) va eng chetki nuqtaga bo'lgan masofani sanang: \(r=9\).

q: A circle has a radius of 12 cm. An arc on the circle is intercepted by a central angle of \(\frac{5\pi }{6}\) radians. What is the length of this arc?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Radianda berilgan markaziy burchak uchun yoy uzunligi formulasi: \(s=r\) * theta. Bu yerda \(r=12\) va theta = \(\frac{5\pi }{6}\). \(s=12\cdot (\frac{5\pi }{6})=2\cdot 5\pi =10\pi\) cm. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob D. C varianti (5pi) radiusga ko'paytirishda 12 ni 6 ga bo'lish o'rniga qoldirib ketilgan xato. B va A variantlari sektor yuzasi yoki noto'g'ri formula qo'llash natijasida paydo bo'ladigan chalg'ituvchi javoblardir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(12\cdot (5\cdot \frac{\pi }{6})\) deb yozing, taxminan 31.415 chiqadi. \(10\cdot \pi\) ham 31.415 ga teng.

q: Triangle PQR is similar to triangle STU, where vertices P, Q, and R correspond to S, T, and U respectively. If PQ = 8, QR = 14, and ST = 20, what is the length of side TU?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: O'xshash uchburchaklarda mos tomonlar nisbati o'zaro teng: ST / PQ = TU / QR. Qiymatlarni qo'yamiz: \(\frac{20}{8}\) = TU / 14. O'xshashlik koeffitsienti \(k=\frac{20}{8}=2.5\). TU = \(14\cdot 2.5=35\). To'g'ri javob: B. D, C, A variantlari nisbatni noto'g'ri tuzish yoki hisoblashdagi arifmetik xatoliklar tufayli kelib chiqadigan noto'g'ri javoblardir.
strat: Desmos hack: \(20\cdot \frac{14}{8}\) deb yozsangiz, javob 35 darhol chiqadi.

q: A square is inscribed in a circle of radius 6. What is the area of the square?
exp: Qadam-baqadam yechim: Kvadrat aylanaga ichki chizilgan bo'lsa, aylananing diametri kvadratning diagonali d ga teng bo'ladi: \(d=2\cdot r=2\cdot 6=12\). Kvadrat yuzasi uning diagonali orqali quyidagicha hisoblanadi: Area = \(\frac{d^{2}}{2}=\frac{12^{2}}{2}=\frac{144}{2}=72\). (Yoki tomoni s: \(s\cdot \sqrt{2}=12\) ⇒ \(s=\frac{12}{\sqrt{2}}\) ⇒ \(s^{2}=\frac{144}{2}=72\)). To'g'ri javob: A. B varianti (36) radius kvadratiga teng (xato). C varianti (144) 2 ga bo'lish unutilgan xato. D varianti esa doira yuzasi bilan adashtirilgan chalg'ituvchi variantdir.
strat: Digital SAT geometriya formulasi: Aylanaga ichki chizilgan kvadrat yuzi har doim \(2\cdot r^{2}\) ga teng. \(r=6\) bo'lsa, Area = \(2\cdot (6^{2})=2\cdot 36=72\).

pas: In desert ecosystems, ephemeral streams flow only immediately after rare and torrential rainstorms. Because these waterways dry up within hours, native aquatic organisms must complete critical phases of their life cycles with astonishing speed before the moisture completely vanishes.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'ephemeral' most nearly mean?
exp: Matn kontekstida tahlil: Matnda oqimlar faqat yomg'irdan keyin paydo bo'lib, bir necha soat ichida qurib qolishi ('dry up within hours', 'moisture completely vanishes') ta'kidlangan. Demak, 'ephemeral' juda qisqa vaqt davom etadigan, o'tkinchi ('short-lived') ma'nosini bildiradi. To'g'ri javob: B. D varianti (unpredictable - oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan) matnning asosiy ma'nosiga to'g'ri kelmaydi. C varianti (destructive - halokatli) kontekstdan tashqarida. A varianti (shallow - sayoz) esa oqimning chuqurligiga oid noto'g'ri taxmindir.
strat: Digital SAT Words in Context strategiyasi: So'zdan keyingi kontekstual izohni qidiring: 'dry up within hours' iborasi bevosita vaqtning qisqaligini (short-lived) ko'rsatadi.

pas: To bolster public confidence in the safety of autonomous vehicles, urban transportation planners released five years of rigorous road-testing data that demonstrated a 40% reduction in vehicular collisions compared to human drivers.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'bolster' most nearly mean?
exp: Matn kontekstida tahlil: Shahar rejalashtiruvchilari avtomobil to'qnashuvlari 40% ga kamayganini ko'rsatuvchi 5 yillik qat'iy ma'lumotlarni jamoatchilik ishonchini oshirish va mustahkamlash ('bolster public confidence') uchun e'lon qilishgan. 'Bolster' so'zi kuchaytirmoq, mustahkamlamoq ('strengthen') ma'nosini beradi. To'g'ri javob: D. B varianti (evaluate - baholamoq) noto'g'ri, chunki ma'lumotlar baholash uchun emas, ishonchni mustahkamlash uchun chiqarilgan. A varianti (fabricate - to'qib chiqarmoq) matn ma'nosiga mutlaqo zid. C varianti esa ma'noga ega emas.
strat: Digital SAT taktikasi: 'Bolster' so'zi SAT imtihonlarida eng ko'p uchraydigan so'zlardan biri bo'lib, deyarli har doim 'strengthen', 'support', yoki 'reinforce' ma'nosida keladi.

pas: Urban forestry initiatives seek to mitigate the urban heat island effect by planting extensive tree canopies along avenues, thereby reducing ambient surface temperatures by several degrees during summer peak hours.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'mitigate' most nearly mean?
exp: Matn tahlili: Daraxtlar ekish orqali havo haroratini pasaytirish ('reducing ambient surface temperatures') ko'zlangan. Demak, bu tashabbus issiqlik effektini yumshatish, kamaytirish ('alleviate' yoki 'reduce') maqsadida qilinmoqda. To'g'ri javob: B. A varianti (intensify - kuchaytirmoq) matnga teskari (opposite). D varianti (measure - o'lchamoq) va C varianti (prolong - uzaytirmoq) kontekstga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
strat: Digital SAT taktikasi: Salbiy ta'sirlarni (heat, risk, pollution) kamaytirish haqida gap ketganda 'mitigate' har doim 'alleviate', 'lessen', 'diminish' ma'nosiga teng keladi.

pas: The monarch's capricious governance alienated even his staunchest allies; decisions ratified on Monday were frequently annulled by Wednesday with no discernible rationale, creating an atmosphere of perpetual administrative paralysis.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'capricious' most nearly mean?
exp: Matn tahlili: Hukmdor dushanba kungi qarorini chorshanbada hech qanday sababsiz bekor qilib turgan ('frequently annulled with no discernible rationale'). Bu uning kayfiyatga qarab tez-tez o'zgaruvchan, injiq, beqaror ('fickle', 'whimsical', 'mercurial') ekanligini bildiradi. To'g'ri javob: B. C varianti (tyrannical - zolim) adashtiruvchi tuzoq, lekin matnda shafqatsizlik emas, qarorlarning beqarorligi ko'rsatilgan. D varianti (deliberate - puxta o'ylangan) mutlaqo teskari. A varianti esa oqibat bo'lib, so'zning o'z ma'nosi emas.
strat: Digital SAT lug'at qoidasi: 'Capricious' kutilmagan, sababsiz o'zgaruvchan xatti-harakatni bildiradi va sinonimi har doim 'fickle', 'erratic' yoki 'inconsistent' bo'ladi.

pas: Rather than relying on abstract economic theorems, the developmental economist adopted a pragmatic approach, focusing strictly on empirical pilot interventions that had already produced measurable increases in local agricultural yields.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'pragmatic' most nearly mean?
exp: Matn tahlili: Iqtisodchi mavhum nazariyalarga tayanmasdan ('Rather than relying on abstract theorems'), amalda o'lchovli natija bergan tajribalarga tayangan. Bu amaliy, pragmatik ('practical', 'results-oriented') yondashuvdir. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob B. A varianti (idealistic - xayolparast) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri teskari ma'no (opposite). D varianti (cautious - ehtiyotkor) va C varianti (lucrative - daromadli) matnda tasdiqlanmagan xato javoblardir.
strat: Digital SAT kontrasti: 'Rather than [abstract]...' iborasi 'pragmatic' so'zi abstraktlikning aksi bo'lgan 'practical' (amaliy) ekanligini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rsatadi.

pas: The senator offered an equivocal response when pressed about her stance on the controversial zoning bill, answering with broad generalities that allowed both proponents and opponents of the measure to believe she supported their respective positions.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'equivocal' most nearly mean?
exp: Matn tahlili: Senatorning javobi har ikkala tarafga (tarafdorlar va qarshilarga) ham o'zlarini qo'llab-quvvatlayotgandek tuyulgan ('allowed both proponents and opponents to believe she supported them'). Demak, javob ikki yoqlama, noaniq, tushunarsiz ('ambiguous', 'vague', 'open to multiple interpretations') bo'lgan. To'g'ri javob: C. D varianti (uncompromising - murosasiz) va B varianti (enthusiastic - jo'shqin) matn mazmuniga mos kelmaydi. A varianti esa javobning xususiyati emas.
strat: Digital SAT so'z ildizi: 'Equivocal' so'zi lotincha 'equi' (teng) va 'vox' (ovoz) so'zlaridan kelib chiqqan bo'lib, ikkala tomonga ham teng talqin qilinadigan noaniq (ambiguous) ma'nosini anglatadi.

pas: For decades, evolutionary biologists maintained that bioluminescence in deep-sea cephalopods functioned primarily as a mechanism for predator evasion through counter-illumination. [However, recent high-resolution optical tracking has revealed that several squid species utilize distinct pulsing flash codes during intraspecific mating displays in total darkness.] This discovery challenges the longstanding assumption that deep-sea visual signaling is purely defensive.
q: Which choice best describes the function of the bracketed portion in the overall structure of the text?
opts: It presents empirical findings that complicate an established scientific consensus.
It outlines the technical limitations of optical tracking devices.
It reconciles two conflicting hypotheses about predator behavior in the deep sea.
It provides historical background to explain why a certain theory was abandoned.
exp: Matn tahlili: Matnning birinchi jumlasida biologlarning o'n yillik konsensusi (bioluminessensiya faqat himoya vositasi ekanligi) keltirilgan. Qavs ichidagi jumla esa yangi kuzatuvlar jinsiy munosabatlarda ham qo'llanishini ko'rsatib, bu ilmiy qarashni murakkablashtiradi va shubha ostiga qo'yadi ('challenges the longstanding assumption'). Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. D varianti xato, chunki tarixiy fon emas, balki eng so'nggi ma'lumot keltirilgan. C varianti xato, chunki ikki gipoteza yarashtirilmagan (reconcile qilinmagan). B varianti esa matnda umuman mavjud emas.
strat: Digital SAT Text Structure strategiyasi: 'However...' bilan boshlangan gaplar ko'pincha oldingi qabul qilingan da'voni cheklovchi yoki unga qarshi yangi dalil keltiruvchi ('complicates', 'challenges', 'qualifies') vazifani bajaradi.

pas: Astronomers initially posited that rogue planets—celestial bodies drifting unbound to any host star—were exceptionally rare anomalies produced only by violent gravitational ejections during early planetary accretion. Theoretical simulations in the 1990s seemed to affirm this scarcity. Yet, modern gravitational microlensing surveys have cataloged hundreds of these nomadic worlds throughout the Milky Way, leading contemporary astrophysicists to propose that rogue planets may in fact outnumber bound stars in our galaxy.
q: Which choice best describes the overall development of the passage?
opts: It describes a persistent scientific controversy and concludes that current empirical data remain insufficient to resolve it.
It critiques the mathematical validity of early computer simulations in planetary physics.
It traces a progression from an early scientific assumption to a radically revised modern estimate driven by new observational tools.
It contrasts two competing technological methods used to detect celestial bodies in deep space.
exp: Matn tahlili: Matn dastlabki qarashdan boshlanadi (astronomlar sarson sayyoralarni o'ta kamyob deb hisoblashgan), 1990-yillardagi modellashtirish bunga qo'shilgan, ammo 'Yet...' orqali yangi microlensing texnologiyasi yordamida yuzlab yangi sayyoralar topilgani va zamonaviy qarash butunlay o'zgargani (yulduzlardan ham ko'p bo'lishi mumkinligi) ko'rsatiladi. Bu C variantidagi tavsifga to'liq mos keladi. A varianti xato, chunki masala hal qilinmagan bahs sifatida qoldirilmagan. B varianti xato, chunki maqsad matematik simulyatsiyalarni tanqid qilish emas. D varianti esa texnologik taqqoslashga qaratilmagan.
strat: Digital SAT Purpose strategiyasi: Butun matn tuzilishini kuzating: Dastlabki taxmin (Initial view) -> Kutilmagan yangi kuzatuv dalili (New data) -> Tubdan qayta ko'rib chiqilgan xulosa (Revised modern paradigm).

pas: The primary objective of architectural preservationists restoring the 18th-century stone masonry was not merely aesthetic revitalization, but structural fortification. Mortar injected into the deteriorating fissures was formulated to match the chemical elasticity of the original lime blend, ensuring historical authenticity while simultaneously preventing water infiltration.
q: What is the primary purpose of the text?
opts: To debate the economic costs of preserving historical landmarks versus erecting new structures
To lament the lack of skilled stone masons in contemporary architecture
To describe the structural and historical rationale behind a specific restoration technique
To argue that modern synthetic building materials are superior to 18th-century lime mortar
exp: Matn tahlili: Matnda XVIII asr tosh devorlarini restavratsiya qiluvchilarning maqsadi (ham mustahkamlash, ham tarixiy haqiqiylikni saqlash) va buning uchun maxsus qorishma qanday tanlangani tushuntirilgan. Bu C variantida to'liq aks ettirilgan. D varianti xato, chunki zamonaviy materiallarning ustunligi haqida bahs yo'q. B varianti (hunarmandlar yetishmasligidan noliydi) va A varianti (iqtisodiy xarajatlar bahsi) matnda umuman mavjud emas.
strat: Digital SAT Primary Purpose taktikasi: Matn nima haqida yozilganini xolis ifodalovchi variantni tanlang. Matnda tilga olinmagan mavzular (costs, lamenting) darhol rad etiladi.

pas:
Text 1: Proponents of open-source artificial intelligence models assert that public code transparency democratizes technological innovation, mitigates corporate monopolization, and allows global researchers to audit models for vulnerabilities and bias rapidly.

Text 2: While code visibility offers undeniable collaborative benefits, proprietary frontier labs argue that distributing the foundational weights of advanced autonomous models creates severe asymmetry: malicious actors can systematically remove safety guardrails with trivial fine-tuning, weaponizing models faster than defensive patches can be deployed.
q: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the claim in Text 1 regarding vulnerability auditing?
opts: By dismissing the notion that corporate labs possess any significant advantage in AI capability over academic researchers
By advocating for a total ban on all computer science research publications that contain open-source code
By contending that public accessibility also enables bad actors to strip safety filters and exploit vulnerabilities before they can be remediated
By agreeing unconditionally that public code auditing eliminates all potential catastrophic safety risks
exp: Matn tahlili: Text 1 da ochiq kod zaifliklarni tezroq topish va audit qilishga yordam beradi deb da'vo qilinadi. Text 2 muallifi esa ochiq kod yomon niyatli shaxslarga (malicious actors) xavfsizlik to'siqlarini olib tashlash va modelni himoya vositalari chiqishidan oldin qurollantirish imkonini beradi deb hisoblaydi. Demak, Text 2 muallifi Text 1 ning audit foydasiga qarshi aynan xavflarning tezroq ekspluatatsiya qilinishi bilan javob beradi (C varianti). A varianti xato (corporate ustunligi inkor etilmagan). B varianti o'ta keskin (extreme: total ban). D varianti esa Text 2 ning xavotirlariga mutlaqo zid.
strat: Digital SAT Cross-Text strategiyasi: Matn 2 ning muallifi Matn 1 dagi ijobiy da'voga qanday cheklov (counter-argument/risk) qo'yishini aniqlang. 'Extreme' so'zlar (total ban, unconditional) odatda xato bo'ladi.

pas:
Text 1: Historian Marcus argues that the rapid spread of railway infrastructure in 19th-century Britain was the primary engine of nationwide economic integration, directly lowering freight costs and allowing perishable regional goods to reach London markets within hours.

Text 2: Economic historian Davis contends that Marcus overstates the singular primacy of railroads. Davis highlights that coastal shipping routes and revitalized canal networks carried far greater aggregate bulk tonnage—such as coal and iron ore—at substantially lower per-ton rates well into the late Victorian era.
q: Based on the texts, Davis (Text 2) would most likely criticize Marcus (Text 1) for doing which of the following?
opts: Claiming that coal and iron were the primary drivers of Britain's agricultural economy
Overlooking the significant and cost-effective contribution of waterborne transit to freight transport
Failing to acknowledge that railway tracks were expensive to construct and maintain
Denying that perishable goods were transported into major urban centers
exp: Matn tahlili: Text 2 da Davis to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Marcusning temir yo'llarga yagona ustuvorlik berganini tanqid qilib, suv yo'llari (qirg'oq kemachiligi va kanallar tarmog'i) ko'mir va temir kabi og'ir yuklarni ancha arzonroq va ko'proq hajmda tashiganini ta'kidlaydi. Shuning uchun Davis Marcusni suv orqali tashishning (waterborne transit) katta hissasini e'tibordan chetda qoldirganlikda ayblaydi (B varianti). C, D, A variantlari matnda berilgan tanqidga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
strat: Digital SAT juft matnlar qoidasi: Text 2 ning Text 1 ga nisbatan aniq tanqid nuqtasini toping: Marcus temir yo'lni yagona dvigatel deb bilsa, Davis kanallar va kemalar (waterborne transport) bundan ham katta yuk tashiganini ko'rsatadi.

pas:
Text 1: Behavioral ecologist Dr. Thorne documented that migratory songbirds consistently rely on celestial cues, navigating via learned star maps when cloudless nighttime skies permit orientation.

Text 2: Dr. Vance conducted orientation trials inside an artificial planetarium with rotated magnetic fields. Even when star configurations were reversed or obscured, birds calibrated their migratory vector accurately using Earth's geomagnetic field via cryptochrome proteins in their retinas.
q: How would Dr. Vance (Text 2) most likely synthesize her findings with those of Dr. Thorne (Text 1)?
opts: By claiming that cryptochrome proteins function solely when starry night skies are clearly visible
By asserting that migratory birds possess no capacity whatsoever to interpret celestial patterns
By concluding that celestial cues may serve as one navigational tool, but geomagnetic orientation acts as a resilient primary or backup compass
By demonstrating that artificial planetariums cause permanent neurological disorientation in songbirds
exp: Matn tahlili: Text 1 da qushlar yulduzlarga qarab mo'ljal olishi ko'rsatilgan. Text 2 da esa yulduzlar ko'rinmaganda yoki teskari bo'lganda ham geomagnit maydon yordamida yo'nalishni to'g'ri topishi isbotlangan. Demak, ikkala tadqiqot birlashtirilsa, yulduzlar vositalardan biri bo'lishi mumkin, ammo geomagnit maydon asosiy yoki zaxira kompas sifatida xizmat qiladi (C varianti). B varianti mutlaqo inkor qiladi (too extreme). A va D variantlari esa matnga zid.
strat: Digital SAT integratsiya qoidasi: Ikki tadqiqot bir-birini to'liq rad etmasa, ular integratsiya qilinganda biri ikkinchisiga to'ldiruvchi (complementary/backup) mexanizm sifatida xulosa qilinadi.

pas: Discovered at extreme depths along tectonic spreading centers, hydrothermal vent ecosystems thrive in perpetual darkness without sunlight. Rather than relying on photoautotrophic primary production driven by plants, these benthic communities depend on chemolithoautotrophic bacteria that metabolize toxic hydrogen sulfide emitted from mineral-rich chimneys into organic compounds, supporting complex food webs of giant tubeworms and crustaceans.
q: Which choice best expresses the central idea of the passage?
opts: Sunlight penetrates deep-sea marine trenches far more effectively than marine biologists previously estimated.
Hydrothermal vent communities sustain thriving food webs through bacterial chemosynthesis rather than solar-dependent photosynthesis.
Giant tubeworms actively generate mineral chimneys along tectonic spreading centers.
Deep-sea crustaceans are uniquely vulnerable to toxic hydrogen sulfide emissions along tectonic faults.
exp: Matn tahlili: Butun matn gidrotermal vent ekotizimlarining quyosh nuri (fotosintez) o'rniga zaharli vodorod sulfidini metabolizm qiluvchi bakteriyalar (xemosintez) asosida rivojlanishi haqida. Bu B variantida to'liq va aniq bayon qilingan. D varianti xato, chunki ular zaif emas, aksincha rivojlanmoqda. A varianti matnga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri zid ('in perpetual darkness'). C varianti esa sabab va oqibatni teskari qo'ygan noto'g'ri da'vodir.
strat: Digital SAT Central Idea qoidasi: Asosiy fikr matnning butun doirasini qamrab olishi kerak. Tor detallar yoki matnga zid jumlalar (A, C) darhol chiqarib tashlanadi.

pas: In 1846, French mathematician Urbain Le Verrier deduced the existence and precise celestial coordinates of an undiscovered planet solely by calculating unexplained gravitational perturbations in the orbit of Uranus. When Johann Galle aimed his Berlin telescope at Le Verrier's predicted position, Neptune was discovered within one degree of the predicted coordinates on the very first night.
q: According to the text, how did Le Verrier identify the position of Neptune?
opts: By measuring the gravitational attraction between Jupiter and Saturn
By spending months scanning the night sky with the Berlin observatory's telescope
By reinterpreting ancient Babylonian astrological records
By analyzing gravitational irregularities observed in the orbital path of Uranus
exp: Matn tahlili: Matnda aniq yozilgan: 'solely by calculating unexplained gravitational perturbations in the orbit of Uranus' (faqatgina Uran orbitasidagi tushuntirib bo'lmaydigan gravitatsion tebranishlarni hisoblash orqali). Demak, to'g'ri javob D. B varianti xato, chunki teleskop bilan Galle qaragan, Le Verrier esa faqat matematik hisoblagan. A va C variantlari matnda umuman yo'q.
strat: Digital SAT Detail savollari: Savol matnidagi kalit so'zlarni ('identify the position') matndan qidiring va so'zma-so'z tasdiqlangan javobni belgilang.

pas: Excavations at the ancient Maya metropolis of Tikal revealed that urban density was not accompanied by centralized hydraulic control. Instead of massive state-administered aqueducts, archaeologists unearthed decentralized, neighborhood-scale reservoirs that captured runoff from plastered residential plazas, demonstrating that civic resilience relied on distributed modular engineering rather than autocratic municipal management.
q: Which choice best states the main thesis of the passage?
opts: Neighborhood reservoirs required an unprecedented degree of authoritarian military surveillance.
Plastered residential plazas were constructed primarily to prevent soil erosion during seasonal flooding.
Tikal's urban sustainability was achieved through modular, localized water infrastructure rather than authoritarian centralization.
The collapse of Tikal was accelerated by the structural failure of its centralized aqueduct system.
exp: Matn tahlili: Arxeologik qazishmalar Tikal shahrida markazlashgan davlat akveduklari o'rniga mahalliy, taqsimlangan modulli suv omborlari bo'lganini va shahar barqarorligi markazlashgan boshqaruv emas, tarqoq muhandislikka tayanganini ko'rsatgan. Bu C variantiga 100% mos keladi. D varianti xato (shahar qulashi haqida gap yo'q). B varianti tor ikkilamchi detal. A varianti esa matnga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri zid ('distributed modular engineering rather than autocratic').
strat: Digital SAT xulosa taktikasi: 'Instead of [C]... but [D]' strukturasiga e'tibor bering: Asosiy urg'u har doim D ga qaratilgan bo'ladi (distributed modular engineering).

pas: Cognitive psychology experiments demonstrate that retrieval practice—actively recalling information from memory via quizzes—produces significantly higher long-term retention than passive restudying of textbook material. Crucially, the mnemonic benefit is greatest when the recall effort is moderately difficult, indicating that cognitive struggle strengthens neural retrieval pathways.
q: According to the passage, under what condition is the mnemonic benefit of retrieval practice maximized?
opts: When information is passively reviewed immediately prior to falling asleep
When the effort required to recall information involves a moderate degree of difficulty
When quizzes are made as effortless as possible to prevent student fatigue
When students reread the highlighted textbook sections multiple times before testing
exp: Matn tahlili: Matnning ikkinchi jumlasi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savolga javob beradi: 'Crucially, the mnemonic benefit is greatest when the recall effort is moderately difficult'. Bu B variantida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aks etgan. D va A variantlari passiv qayta o'qish bo'lib, matnda uning samarasi kamligi aytilgan. C varianti esa 'moderately difficult' shartiga mutlaqo zid.
strat: Digital SAT kalit so'z qoidasi: 'Greatest benefit', 'maximized' so'zlari matndagi 'benefit is greatest when...' iborasi bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'lanadi.

pas: Paleoecologist Dr. Lin hypothesized that the sudden decline of megafauna in North America approximately 12,800 years ago was predominantly caused by abrupt climatic disruption rather than overhunting by prehistoric human populations.
q: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken Dr. Lin's hypothesis?
opts: Fossil layers show that megafauna populations remained stable across several earlier periods of equally abrupt climatic warming before collapsing only after the widespread arrival of human hunters armed with Clovis spear points.
Ice core data indicate that abrupt climatic shifts 12,800 years ago occurred simultaneously across both North America and Eurasia.
Remains of smaller mammalian species that were not hunted by humans experienced notable population declines during the same period.
Radiocarbon dating reveals that prehistoric human settlement density was lower in mountainous regions than along coastlines.
exp: Matn tahlili: Dr. Lin megafaunaning qirilishi ovchilik emas, iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli yuz bergan degan gipotezani ilgari surmoqda. Ushbu gipotezani zaiflashtirish (weaken) uchun hayvonlar oldingi xuddi shunday iqlim o'zgarishlaridan omon o'tgani va faqat qurollangan insonlar kelganidan keyingina qirilib ketgani ko'rsatilishi kerak (A varianti). Bu iqlim emas, inson omili sababchi ekanligini isbotlab, Linning gipotezasiga zarba beradi. B va C variantlari aksincha iqlim omilini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. D varianti esa mavzuga aloqasiz.
strat: Digital SAT Weaken taktikasi: Muallifning da'vosi: Sabab = Iqlim (Inson emas). Zaiflashtiruvchi dalil: Iqlim o'zgarganda qirilmagan, lekin inson kelishi bilan qirilgan!

pas: Botanist Elena Rostova claims that mycorrhizal fungi networks in old-growth forests selectively distribute carbon and nitrogen isotopes, preferentially funneling vital nutrients toward genetically related saplings rather than unrelated seedlings.
q: Which finding, if true, would provide the strongest support for Rostova's claim?
opts: Mycorrhizal fungi were found to connect the root systems of more than twenty distinct tree species in the studied forest plot.
Mature trees produced higher quantities of defensive resins when exposed to beetle infestations.

Isotope tracking demonstrated that radioactively tagged carbon injected into a parent birch tree was transferred in three-fold greater volume to its own offspring compared to adjacent stranger seedlings sharing the same root network.
Unrelated seedlings grew at identical rates regardless of whether the forest soil was sterilized or inoculated with live fungal spores.
exp: Matn tahlili: Rostova zamburug'lar tarmog'i ozuqa moddalarini begona ko'chatlarga emas, genetik yaqin (o'z avlodi bo'lgan) nihollarga ko'proq yo'naltiradi deb da'vo qilmoqda. C variantida izotoplar orqali onalik qayin daraxti o'z urug'lariga begonalarga qaraganda 3 baravar ko'p uglerod uzatgani aniqlangan. Bu Rostova da'vosini bevosita va eng kuchli darajada tasdiqlaydi (support). A, D, B variantlari selektiv qarindoshlik taqsimotini tasdiqlamaydi.
strat: Digital SAT Support dalilini topish: Da'voning barcha shartlariga mos keladigan tajribaviy o'lchovni (parent -> offspring vs stranger) toping.

pas: Linguist Dr. Aris Thorne contends that bilingualism in early childhood accelerates executive function development, particularly cognitive flexibility and inhibitory control, by forcing the brain to continuously resolve linguistic competition between two active lexical systems.
q: Which finding, if true, would best substantiate Dr. Thorne's contention?
opts: Neuroimaging studies reveal that bilingual children exhibit significantly faster response times and lower prefrontal cortex strain during non-verbal task-switching trials than monolingual peers.
Adults who learn a second language in late adulthood show minimal structural change in auditory cortex density.
Children enrolled in bilingual immersion programs demonstrate high retention of mathematical multiplication tables.
Bilingual children acquire passive listening vocabulary at the exact same chronological pace as monolingual children.
exp: Matn tahlili: Dr. Thorne ikki tillilik kognitiv egiluvchanlik (cognitive flexibility) va nazoratni rivojlantiradi deb hisoblaydi. A variantida ikki tilli bolalar noverbal vazifalarni almashtirishda (task-switching) bir tilli tengdoshlariga qaraganda ancha tezroq ekanligi va miyaning prefrontal qismida yuqori samaradorlik ko'rsatgani keltirilgan. Bu Thorne kontensiyasini to'liq tasdiqlaydi. D, B, C variantlari ijro etuvchi funksiyalar (executive function) rivojlanishiga bevosita dalil bo'lolmaydi.
strat: Digital SAT tushunchalar mosligi: 'Cognitive flexibility' bevosita 'task-switching' (vazifalarni tezkor almashtirish) qobiliyatiga tengdir.

pas: Researchers evaluated the operational energy conversion efficiency of four experimental perovskite photovoltaic cells under simulated solar irradiation over 1,000 hours. The lead investigator concluded that Cell Beta possessed the highest structural durability despite lacking the highest initial peak efficiency.
q: Which data point from the study most directly supports the investigator's conclusion regarding Cell Beta?
opts: Cell Alpha exhibited higher initial conversion efficiency than Cell Beta.
Cell Delta concluded the 1,000-hour testing window with an efficiency below 20%.
Cell Gamma achieved an initial efficiency of 25.1%, outperforming Cell Beta at the start of the experiment.
Cell Beta lost only 0.3 percentage points of efficiency over 1,000 hours, whereas all other cells experienced degradation of at least 2.3 percentage points.
exp: Matn tahlili: Tadqiqotchi Cell Beta eng yuqori strukturaviy chidamlilikka (durability) ega deb xulosa qilgan. Ma'lumotlarga qarasak, Beta 1000 soat davomida 22.8% dan 22.5% ga tushib, bor-yo'g'i 0.3% yo'qotgan. Boshqa barcha kameralar esa ancha ko'p (Alpha: 3.2%, Gamma: 10.8%, Delta: 2.3%) yo'qotgan. Bu D variantidagi raqamli dalil bilan 100% isbotlanadi. C, B, A variantlari esa chidamlilik xulosasini tasdiqlamaydi.
strat: Digital SAT Quantitative Evidence: 'Highest structural durability' (eng yuqori chidamlilik) degani eng kam degradatsiya (minimal loss = 0.3%) deganidir.

pas: An agronomic trial compared drought-tolerant maize yields, in tons per hectare, under three irrigation regimes. A policy advisor recommended Variety X for semi-arid zones subject to severe seasonal droughts.
q: Which comparison best justifies the advisor's recommendation of Variety X over Variety Y for arid regions?
opts: Both varieties produced their lowest aggregate biomass under the 200 mm irrigation condition.
Variety X increased its yield by nearly 3 tons when moving from Deficit to Optimal irrigation.
Under the Deficit irrigation regime, Variety X yielded 1.4 more tons per hectare (a 50% advantage) than Variety Y.
Under Optimal irrigation, Variety Y yielded 1.8 more tons per hectare than Variety X.
exp: Matn tahlili: Ekspert qurg'oqchil hududlar (semi-arid zones) uchun Variety X navini tavsiya qilgan. Qurg'oqchilik (Deficit = 200 mm) sharoitida Variety X 4.2 tonna hosil bergan bo'lsa, Variety Y atigi 2.8 tonna bergan (farq 4.2 - 2.8 = 1.4 tonna ko'p). Aynan shu ustunlik tavsiyaning eng to'g'ri ilmiy-raqamli asosi hisoblanadi (C varianti). D varianti Optimal sharoitda Y yaxshiroq ekanini aytadi, bu qurg'oqchilik tavsiyasiga zid. B va A variantlari esa taqqoslash uchun asos bo'lolmaydi.
strat: Digital SAT ma'lumot tahlili: Savol 'arid regions' (qurg'oqchil hududlar) haqida bo'lgani uchun tahlil faqat 'Deficit' ustuni bo'yicha olib borilishi shart.

pas: A municipal environmental agency recorded monthly particulate matter (PM2.5) concentrations, in micrograms per cubic meter, in four metropolitan districts before and after low-emission transit zones were enforced.
q: Which district achieved the greatest absolute reduction in PM2.5 particulate concentration?
exp: Matn tahlili: Har bir tumandagi mutlaq kamayishni hisoblaymiz: District East: 62 - 38 = 24 ug/m3; District North: 48 - 32 = 16 ug/m3; District South: 55 - 50 = 5 ug/m3; District West: 44 - 44 = 0 ug/m3. Eng katta mutlaq pasayish District East da (24 ug/m3) qayd etilgan. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. D, B, C variantlaridagi pasayish ancha kam yoki nolga teng.
strat: Hisoblash: 62 - 38 = 24. Eng katta farqni tanlang.

pas: Hydrogeologists studying an arid plateau discovered that isotopic signatures of deep groundwater matched rainwater from high-altitude mountain ranges located 250 kilometers away. Chemical analysis revealed that this water took approximately 4,000 years to migrate through subterranean permeable sandstone strata before accumulating beneath the plateau basin, where modern agricultural wells currently extract it at rates exceeding natural inflow tenfold.
q: Which conclusion is most strongly supported by the passage?
opts: The plateau's groundwater represents a non-renewable fossil aquifer that cannot be replenished rapidly enough to offset modern extraction.
Subterranean sandstone strata are currently fracturing due to intense seismic activity between the mountains and the plateau.
High-altitude mountain rainfall has increased tenfold over the past four thousand years.
Modern agricultural wells on the plateau are naturally filtering out heavy radioactive isotopes from the groundwater.
exp: Matn tahlili: Suv 250 km uzoqlikdan tog'lardan yetib kelishi uchun 4000 yil vaqt ketadi ('took approximately 4,000 years to migrate'). Ammo hozirgi qishloq xo'jaligi quduqlari uni tabiiy oqimdan 10 barobar tezroq tortib olmoqda ('rates exceeding natural inflow tenfold'). Bundan mantiqiy xulosa shuki, bu suv zahirasi qisqa muddatda qayta tiklanmaydigan qazilma suv havzasi (fossil aquifer) bo'lib, hozirgi iste'mol sur'atida tezda tugab bitadi (A varianti). B, C, D variantlari matnda yo'q va to'qib chiqarilgan (unsupported speculation).
strat: Digital SAT Inferences qoidasi: 'Premises -> Logical necessity'. Agar kirish 4000 yil olsa-yu, chiqish 10 barobar tez bo'lsa, xulosa: resurs tezda qayta tiklana olmaydi (non-renewable in human timescales).

pas: Historical linguists reconstructed Proto-Indo-European lexical roots by comparing cognates across dozens of ancient daughter tongues, identifying common terms for wheeled carts, domesticated horses, and wool weaving. However, no shared ancestral root existed for ocean navigation, marine fauna, or seafaring vessels. This lexical absence strongly suggests that Proto-Indo-European speakers [...]
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: depended primarily on maritime trade routes for essential metallurgy materials.
inhabited an inland terrestrial environment far from major maritime coastlines.
navigated open oceans without inventing any technical terminology for their vessels.
prohibited the consumption of fish and shellfish on strict theological grounds.
exp: Matn tahlili: Qadimgi tilda aravacha, ot va jun to'qish kabi quruqlik atamalari ko'p bo'lgan, ammo dengiz, kemachilik yoki dengiz hayvonlariga oid bitta ham umumiy so'z bo'lmagan ('no shared ancestral root for ocean navigation'). Tilshunoslikda bu mazkur xalqning dengiz qirg'oqlaridan uzoqda, quruqlik ichkarisida (inland terrestrial environment) yashaganini bildiradi. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob B. A va C variantlari dengiz so'zlari yo'qligiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri zid. D varianti esa asossiz taxmindir.
strat: Digital SAT Matnni mantiqiy yakunlash: Matndagi qarama-qarshilikka e'tibor bering: Quruqlik so'zlari bor, dengiz so'zlari mutlaqo yo'q => Demak, ular dengizdan uzoqda yashagan.

pas: Thermal infrared scans of the icy crust of Jupiter's moon Europa revealed localized surface regions with high heat flux and fractured chaotic terrain. Laboratory cryo-experiments demonstrate that pure water ice under Jovian surface temperatures cannot maintain ductile deformation; it fractures brittlely unless significant dissolved salt concentrations lower the melting point and facilitate convective upwelling of liquid plumes. Therefore, scientists deduce that Europa's chaotic terrains [...]
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: were generated entirely by violent meteoritic impacts that vaporized the local magnetic field.
prove that Europa's core has cooled completely, ending all internal geothermal convection.
consist exclusively of pure frozen nitrogen devoid of any liquid solvent.
are direct surface manifestations of warm, saline subsurface ocean water interacting with the brittle ice crust.
exp: Matn tahlili: Tajribalar shuni ko'rsatadiki, sof muz sinuvchan bo'ladi va faqat erigan tuzlar uning erish nuqtasini pasaytirib, suyuq konvektiv oqimlar hosil bo'lgandagina bunday issiq va deformatsiyalangan relef paydo bo'lishi mumkin. Demak, Yevropadagi bunday tartibsiz relyef muz ostidagi iliq, sho'r okean suvlari bilan muz qobig'i o'zaro ta'sirlashuvining bevosita yuzadagi belgisidir (D varianti). A varianti meteorit zarbasini to'qib chiqaradi. B varianti yadro sovigan deb matnga zid da'vo qiladi (holbuki issiqlik oqimi bor). C varianti esa sof azot degan xato farazni ilgari suradi.
strat: Digital SAT Logically Completes: 'dissolved salt + convective liquid plumes' xulosasi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri 'warm, saline subsurface ocean water' javobiga olib boradi.

pas: During the solar eclipse, daytime temperatures dropped precipitously [_______] birds ceased their singing and returned to their nests in confusion.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Grammatik qoida: Ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clauses: 'temperatures dropped...' va 'birds ceased...') o'rtasida 'consequently' kabi kon'yunktiv ravish (conjunctive adverb) kelganda, uning oldiga nuqtali vergul (;) va undan keyin vergul (,) qo'yilishi shart: '; consequently,'. D varianti comma splice hosil qiladi (xato). A varianti tinish belgisiz run-on jumla yaratadi. B variantida esa 'consequently' dan keyingi vergul tushib qolgan.
strat: Digital SAT punktuatsiya formulasi: [Mustaqil gap] + ; however/therefore/consequently, + [Mustaqil gap]. Bu qolip har doim to'g'ri!

pas: The observatory's primary mirror required three years of continuous optical [_______] researchers finally achieved the nanometer-scale curvature necessary to resolve exoplanet atmospheres.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Grammatik qoida: 'The observatory's primary mirror required three years of continuous optical polishing' mustaqil gap bo'lib, 'before researchers finally achieved...' ergash gap (dependent adverbial clause) hisoblanadi. Agar ergash gap asosiy gapdan KEYIN kelsa, uning oldidan vergul yoki nuqtali vergul qo'yilmaydi: 'polishing before'. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. C variantida keraksiz vergul bor (xato). D variantida ergash gap oldidan nuqtali vergul ishlatilgan (qo'pol xato). B varianti esa ma'noni buzadi.
strat: Digital SAT qoidasi: [Mustaqil gap] + before/because/although + [Ergash gap] bo'lganda o'rtada hech qanday VERGUL qo'yilmaydi!

pas: The geobiologist identified the single environmental factor responsible for the mass microbial die-off in the hypersaline [_______] a sudden, catastrophic depletion of dissolved oxygen.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Grammatik qoida: Ikki nuqta (colon) to'liq mustaqil gapdan keyin kelib, o'sha gapda aytilgan tushunchani (bu yerda: 'the single environmental factor') izohlash, ta'riflash yoki ro'yxatini keltirish uchun ishlatiladi: '...in the hypersaline lake: a sudden, catastrophic depletion...'. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob A. D varianti vergul bilan chalkashlik yaratadi. C varianti (nuqtali vergul) xato, chunki undan keyin mustaqil gap kelmagan. B varianti esa chegarasiz xato tuzilmadir.
strat: Digital SAT Ikki nuqta (Colon) oltin qoidasi: Ikki nuqtadan oldin to'liq mustaqil gap (independent clause) turishi SHART. Ikki nuqtadan keyin esa izoh yoki misol keladi.

pas: The expedition's senior navigator [_______] an experienced seafarer who had charted three previous polar voyages—immediately recognized that the pack ice was shifting dangerously.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Grammatik qoida: Qo'shimcha izohlovchi kiritma ibora (appositive phrase: 'an experienced seafarer who had charted three previous polar voyages') chiziqcha (em-dash) bilan yopilgan ('—immediately recognized...'). Shuning uchun uning boshlanishi ham aynan bitta chiziqcha (em-dash) bilan ochilishi SHART: 'senior navigator—an experienced...—immediately'. Juft belgilar qoidasi buzilmasligi kerak. To'g'ri javob: D. B varianti vergul bilan ochib chiziqcha bilan yopish xatosi (mismatch). C va A variantlari butunlay noo'rin.
strat: Digital SAT simmetriya qoidasi: Agar kiritma ibora oxirida chiziqcha (—) tursa, uning boshida ham albatta chiziqcha (—) bo'lishi shart!

pas: Although the rare alpine orchid blooms for only forty-eight hours each [_______] botanists from around the world travel to the high meadows to document its delicate pollination ecology.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Grammatik qoida: Gap ergash bog'lovchi (dependent clause: 'Although the rare alpine orchid blooms...') bilan boshlanganda, ergash gap tugagan joyda asosiy mustaqil gapdan ajratish uchun bitta VERGUL qo'yilishi shart: 'each spring, botanists from around the world...'. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob C. A variantida vergul tushib qolgan (xato). D va B variantlarida nuqtali vergul yoki nuqta qo'yilsa, birinchi qism chala jumlaga (sentence fragment) aylanib qoladi.
strat: Digital SAT punktuatsiya qoidasi: Although/Because/While + [gap], + [asosiy gap]. Boshidagi ergash gapdan keyin har doim oddiy VERGUL qo'yiladi.

pas: The intricate network of subterranean fungal filaments beneath the ancient pine [_______] crucial nutrients and chemical warnings across vast distances.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Grammatik qoida: Ega (subject) bilan kesim (verb) moslashuvi. Ega bu yerda ko'plikdagi 'filaments' yoki 'pine' emas, balki birlikdagi 'The intricate network' hisoblanadi ('of subterranean fungal filaments beneath the ancient pine' oraliq predlogli ibora bo'lib, egaga ta'sir qilmaydi). Ega birlikda ('network') bo'lgani uchun fe'l ham birlikda bo'lishi kerak: 'transmits'. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob C. A, D, B variantlaridagi fe'llar ko'plikda bo'lib ('transmit', 'have transmitted', 'are transmitting'), ega bilan moslashmagan xato variantlardir.
strat: Digital SAT Ega-kesim qoidasi: 'of...', 'in...', 'beneath...' bilan boshlangan predlogli iboralarni xayolan o'chirib tashlang: 'The network [transmits]'. Javob darhol oydinlashadi!

pas: Each of the experimental composite alloys subjected to the stress chamber [_______] its structural integrity under extreme thermodynamic loads.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Grammatik qoida: 'Each' so'zi bilan boshlangan ega har doim BIRLIK (singular) hisoblanadi ('Each of the alloys...'). Garchi 'alloys' ko'plikda bo'lsa ham, haqiqiy grammatik ega 'Each' dir. Birlikdagi ega birlikdagi fe'lni talab qiladi: 'maintains'. To'g'ri javob: A. D, B, C variantlari ko'plik shakllari bo'lib, qoidaga zid xato javoblardir.
strat: Digital SAT qoidasi: Each, Neither, Either, Everyone, Somebody kabi olmoshlar bilan boshlangan ega doimo birlikda bo'ladi va -s qo'shimchali fe'lni oladi (maintains).

pas: By the time modern archaeologists arrived at the submerged coastal cave in 2012, rising sea levels [_______] the delicate prehistoric cave paintings that had survived for twenty millennia.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Grammatik qoida: 'By the time + o'tgan zamon' (arrived in 2012) iborasi o'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqtdan oldinroq sodir bo'lib tugagan harakatni ifodalaydi. Bunday holatda Past Perfect (had + V3) zamoni qo'llanishi shart: 'had already destroyed'. Shuning uchun to'g'ri javob C. A varianti hozirgi oddiy zamon (xato). B varianti Present Perfect bo'lib, o'tmishdagi 'in 2012' bilan birikmaydi. D varianti esa kelasi zamon bo'lib kontekstga zid.
strat: Digital SAT Zamon qoidasi: 'By the time + Past Simple' formulasi ko'rinsa, asosiy gapda har doim 'had + V3' (Past Perfect) bo'ladi!

pas: Along the southern perimeter of the ancient archaeological trench [_______] several unexcavated ceramic vessels dating to the early Bronze Age.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Grammatik qoida: Bu o'rin almashgan gap (inverted sentence). Gap o'rin holi ('Along the southern perimeter...') bilan boshlanganda ega fe'ldan keyin keladi. Bu yerdagi haqiqiy ega fe'ldan keyin turgan 'several unexcavated ceramic vessels' (ko'plikda!). Ega ko'plikda bo'lgani uchun fe'l ham ko'plikda bo'lishi kerak: 'lie'. C, A, B variantlari birlik shakllari bo'lib ('lies', 'is lying', 'has lain'), 'vessels' bilan mos kelmaydigan xato variantlardir. To'g'ri javob: D.
strat: Digital SAT Inverted Sentence hiylasi: Agar gap predlogli o'rin holi bilan boshlansa, fe'ldan KEYIN kelgan otni toping. Ot ko'plikda (vessels) bo'lsa, fe'l ham ko'plikda (lie) bo'ladi!

pas: The scholarship committee granted prestigious international fellowships to both Dr. Ramirez and [_______] in recognition of their pioneering glaciological fieldwork.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Grammatik qoida: Olmosh kelishigi (pronoun case). 'To' predlog (preposition) hisoblanadi. Ingliz tilida predloglardan keyin doimo to'ldiruvchi kelishigi (objective case: me, him, her, us, them) ishlatiladi: 'to both Dr. Ramirez and her'. C, D, B variantlari bosh kelishikdagi olmoshlar (she, they, he) bo'lib, predlogdan keyin qo'llanishi qo'pol grammatik xatodir. To'g'ri javob: A.
strat: Digital SAT Olmosh qoidasi: 'Dr. Ramirez and' qismini olib tashlang: 'granted fellowships to [her]'. Hech qachon 'to she' deyilmaydi!

pas: [_______] the conservation team carefully transported the fragile fossil specimen to the temperature-controlled preservation laboratory.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
opts: Having stabilized the sandstone matrix by the conservation team,
The sandstone matrix having been stabilized,
Stabilizing the sandstone matrix was completed, so
exp: Grammatik qoida: Osilgan aniqlovchi (dangling modifier) qoidasi. 'Having stabilized the sandstone matrix' sifatdosh iborasi bilan boshlangan jumladan so'ng bevosita ushbu harakatni bajargan shaxs/guruh (ega) kelishi shart. Sandtosh matrisasini kim barqarorlashtirgan? Albatta, 'the conservation team'! Shuning uchun B varianti to'liq grammatik uyg'undir. A va C variantlari passiv va chalkash tuzilmalar hosil qiladi. D varianti esa vergul bilan bog'lanish qoidasini buzadi.
strat: Digital SAT Modifier qoidasi: Verguldan keyingi so'zga qarang: 'Having done X, [KIM? -> the conservation team]'. Verguldan keyin har doim harakat egasi kelishi shart!

pas: The new environmental protection regulation requires factories to install modern electrostatic precipitators, to monitor sulfur dioxide emissions daily, and [_______] comprehensive environmental impact statements quarterly.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Grammatik qoida: Parallel tuzilish (parallel structure). Ro'yxatdagi barcha elementlar bir xil grammatik shaklda bo'lishi lozim: 'to install...', 'to monitor...', and 'to submit...'. To'g'ri javob: B. C varianti (submitting) gerund bo'lib, parallelizmni buzadi (xato). A varianti (submission of) ot birikmasi. D varianti esa alohida gap bo'lib qoladi.
strat: Digital SAT Parallelism qoidasi: Ro'yxatdagi fe'llarning shaklini sanang: to + fe'l, to + fe'l, and [to + fe'l]!

pas: Emitting pulses of coherent ultraviolet light, [_______] capable of etching nanoscale semiconductor pathways with unprecedented accuracy.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
opts: engineers calibrated an excimer laser that is
the newly calibrated excimer laser is
accurate calibration of the excimer laser makes it
nanoscale semiconductor pathways are etched by the excimer laser,
exp: Grammatik qoida: Aniqlovchi (modifier) moslashuvi. 'Emitting pulses of coherent ultraviolet light' (kogerent ultrabinafsha nurlarini chiqaruvchi) deb nimaga aytilmoqda? Albatta, yangi sozlangan eksimer lazerga ('the newly calibrated excimer laser')! Verguldan keyin bevosita lazer kelishi shart. To'g'ri javob: B. A variantida verguldan keyin 'engineers' kelgan (muhandislar ultrabinafsha nur chiqarmaydi, xato). C variantida 'calibration' kelgan (abstrakt tushuncha nur chiqarmaydi). D variantida esa 'pathways' kelgan.
strat: Digital SAT Modifier savollari: Kirish iborasidagi harakatni kim/nima qilayotganini so'rang: Nurni nima chiqaradi? Lazer! Demak verguldan keyin birinchi so'z 'the laser' bo'lishi shart.

pas: Many computer scientists predicted that quantum annealing hardware would instantly render classical encryption protocols obsolete. [_______] classical cryptographic algorithms augmented with lattice-based mathematics have proven exceptionally resilient against quantum decryption attacks.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda mutaxassislar kvant texnologiyalari klassik shifrlashni darhol eskirgan qilib qo'yishini bashorat qilgani aytilgan. Ikkinchi gapda esa klassik algoritmlar kvant hujumlariga qarshi juda chidamli ekanligi isbotlangani ta'kidlanadi. Bu ikki fikr o'rtasida yaqqol qarama-qarshilik (contrast) mavjud. Shuning uchun 'However,' (Biroq) eng to'g'ri bog'lovchidir. To'g'ri javob: C. A varianti qo'shimcha fikr (addition), D varianti oqibat (cause-effect), B varianti esa aniqlashtirish bo'lib, mantiqan mos kelmaydi.
strat: Digital SAT Bog'lovchilar strategiyasi: Fikrlar yo'nalishini aniqlang: Bashorat (eskiradi) vs Haqiqat (chidamli chiqdi) => Qarama-qarshilik (-) => 'However'.

pas: The agricultural province experienced twelve consecutive weeks of sub-zero frost during the early flowering phase of the stone-fruit orchards. [_______] regional peach and apricot yields dropped by more than 75% compared to the prior ten-year rolling average.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda 12 hafta davomida sovuq ayoz bo'lgani (sabab), ikkinchi gapda esa shaftoli va o'rik hosili 75% ga tushib ketgani (oqibat) aytilmoqda. Sabab-oqibat munosabatini ifodalash uchun 'As a result,' (Natijada) bog'lovchisi talab qilinadi. To'g'ri javob: B. A va D variantlari qarama-qarshilik bildiruvchi noto'g'ri bog'lovchilar. C varianti esa o'xshashlik bildiruvchi xato variantdir.
strat: Digital SAT Transition qoidasi: Sabab (sovuq urishi) -> Oqibat (hosil kamayishi) => 'As a result', 'Consequently', yoki 'Therefore'.

pas: Installing smart LED lighting systems in public academic libraries reduces annual electricity consumption by approximately 35%. [_______] the automated dimming sensors extend the operational lifespan of the illumination fixtures by several years.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda aqlli chiroqlarning 1-afzalligi (elektr sarfini 35% ga kamaytirishi) keltirilgan. Ikkinchi gapda esa yana bitta yangi ijobiy afzallik (chiroqlarning xizmat muddatini bir necha yilga uzaytirishi) qo'shilmoqda. Fikrga ijobiy qo'shimcha kiritish uchun 'Moreover,' (Bundan tashqari) bog'lovchisi to'g'ri keladi. To'g'ri javob: A. D, B, C variantlari qarama-qarshilik bildiruvchi xato bog'lovchilardir.
strat: Digital SAT Transition qoidasi: Ijobiy fakt (+) ketidan yana bir ijobiy fakt (+) kelsa, 'Moreover', 'Furthermore', yoki 'In addition' ishlatiladi.

pas: Early twentieth-century critics condemned the raw, unpolished compositions of avant-garde visual artist Sonia Delaunay as decorative and frivolous. [_______] her pioneering exploration of simultaneous color contrast laid the conceptual foundation for non-representational modernism.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda tanqidchilar rassomning ishlarini sayoz va nojo'ya deb qoralagani aytiladi. Ikkinchi gapda esa, barcha bu tanqidlarga qaramay, uning ishlari zamonaviy san'at poydevorini yaratgani ta'kidlanadi. Bu yon berish / qarama-qarshilik (concession / contrast) munosabatidir. Bunga eng to'g'ri bog'lovchi 'Nonetheless,' (Shunga qaramasdan) dir. To'g'ri javob: D. C varianti (oqibat), A varianti (o'xshashlik), B varianti (misol) mantiqiy jihatdan noto'g'ri.
strat: Digital SAT Taktikasi: Tanqid (-) ketidan erishilgan buyuk natija (+) kelsa, 'Nonetheless', 'Nevertheless' yoki 'Still' to'g'ri keladi.

pas: Marine biologists have identified several shark species that possess remarkable adaptations for coping with low-oxygen aquatic environments. [_______] the epaulette shark can slow its metabolic rate and survive in hypoxic tidal pools for over two hours without enduring irreversible brain damage.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda akulalarning kislorod kam sharoitga moslashuvi haqida umumiy fikr bildirilgan. Ikkinchi gapda esa aniq bitta tur (epaulette shark) va uning o'ziga xos qobiliyati misol tariqasida batafsil aniqlashtirilmoqda. Umumiy fikrdan aniq bir misolga o'tishda 'Specifically,' (Xususan / Aniqrog'i) bog'lovchisi ishlatiladi. To'g'ri javob: D. A varianti (aks holda), C varianti (xulosa qilib), B varianti (boshqa tomondan) bu yerda mantiqan noto'g'ri.
strat: Digital SAT qoidasi: Umumiy guruh ('several shark species') -> Aniq bir a'zo ('the epaulette shark') bo'lsa, 'Specifically' yoki 'For example' tanlanadi.

pas: Lobbyists claimed that deregulating chemical manufacturing emissions would unleash immediate private capital expenditure and stimulate industrial hiring. [_______] comprehensive economic analyses conducted over the subsequent decade revealed a measurable decline in regional capital investment alongside severe healthcare expenditures.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Mantiqiy bog'lovchi tahlili: Birinchi gapda lobbistlarning xomxayol da'vosi (ish o'rinlari ko'payadi, investitsiya oqib keladi) aytilgan.
