q: What is the set of all real solutions to the radical equation \(\sqrt{4x+9}=x-3\)?
exp: Ikkala tomonni kvadratga ko'taramiz: \(4x+9=(x-3)^{2}=x^{2}-6x+9\). Hadlarni bir tomonga o'tkazamiz: \(x^{2}-10x=0\) ⇒ \(x(x-10)=0\). Nomzod ildizlar: \(x=0\) va \(x=10\). Endi chet ildizlarni tekshiramiz: 1) \(x=0\): \(\sqrt{9}=3\), lekin o'ng tomon \(0-3=-3\). \(3\ne -3\), demak \(x=0\) chet ildiz (noto'g'ri). 2) \(x=10\): \(\sqrt{49}=7\), o'ng tomon \(10-3=7\). \(7=7\) to'g'ri. Shuning uchun yagona haqiqiy yechim {10}. To'g'ri javob: A ({10}). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D ({0, 10}) — chet ildizni tekshirmasdan belgilashdagi eng xavfli tuzoq; C ({0}) — faqat chet ildizni olish xatosi; B — haqiqiy yechim yo'q deb noto'g'ri xulosa chiqarish.
strat: CHET ILDIZ OGOHLANTIRISHI: Ildizli tenglamani kvadratga ko'targanda har doim o'ng tomon manfiy bo'lmasligini tekshiring: \(x-3\ge 0\) ⇒ \(x\ge 3\) bo'lishi shart! \(x=0\) bu shartni bajarmaydi.

q: When the polynomial \(P(x)=2x^{3}-5x^{2}+kx-14\) is divided by \((x-3)\), the remainder is 7. What is the value of the constant \(k\)?
exp: Qoldiqli bo'lish teoremasi (Remainder Theorem) bo'yicha: \(P(3)=7\) bo'lishi kerak. \(x=3\) ni qo'yamiz: \(P(3)=2(3)^{3}-5(3)^{2}+k(3)-14=2(27)-5(9)+3k-14=54-45+3k-14=3k-5\). Shart bo'yicha: \(3k-5=7\) ⇒ \(3k=12\) ⇒ \(k=4\). To'g'ri javob: D (4). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: \(C(-4)\) — ishorada adashganda kelib chiqadigan tuzoq; A (6) — arifmetik hisoblashdagi xato; B (8) — ozod hadni noto'g'ri o'tkazishdagi xato variant.
strat: POLINOM QOIDASI: \(P(x)\) ni \((x-c)\) ga bo'lgandagi qoldiq \(P(c)\) ga teng. \(x=3\) ni qo'yib 7 ga tenglang!

q: What is the minimum value of the quadratic function \(g(x)=3x^{2}-24x+55\)?
exp: Parabolaning shoxlari yuqoriga qaragan \((a=3>0)\), shuning uchun uning eng kichik qiymati cho'qqisida (vertex) bo'ladi. Cho'qqining \(x\) koordinatasi: \(x=-\frac{b}{2a}=-\frac{-24}{2\cdot 3}=\frac{24}{6}=4\). Eng kichik qiymat \(g(4)\) ga teng: \(g(4)=3(4)^{2}-24(4)+55=3(16)-96+55=48-96+55=7\). To'g'ri javob: 7.
strat: DESMOS USULI: Desmosga \(y=3x^{2}-24x+55\) ni kiriting va eng pastki nuqtani bosing: (4, 7). Minimum qiymat \(y=7\)!

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: A survey of 200 university students recorded their major and mathematics course enrollment. Among the 80 Science majors, 60 enrolled in Statistics and 20 in Calculus. Among the 120 Humanities majors, 30 enrolled in Statistics and 90 in Calculus. If a student who enrolled in Statistics is selected at random, what is the probability that the student is a Science major?
exp: Shartli ehtimollik formulasi: P(Science | Statistics) = N(Science va Statistics) / N(Jami Statistics). Statistics kursiga yozilganlar jami soni: 60 (Science) + 30 (Humanities) = 90 nafar. Ularning ichidan Science yo'nalishidagi talabalar soni: 60 nafar. Ehtimollik: \(\frac{60}{90}=\frac{2}{3}\). To'g'ri javob: \(A(\frac{2}{3})\).
strat: SHARTLI EHTIMOLLIK KALITI: 'If a student who enrolled in Statistics...' so'zlari maxraj faqat Statistics olganlar \((60+30=90)\) bo'lishini bildiradi!

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: An online retailer increased the price of a wireless keyboard by 25% in November. In January, the retailer discounted the new price by 20%. What was the overall percentage change from the original price?
exp: Multiplikator usulini qo'llaymiz: Dastlabki narx P bo'lsin. 1) 25% oshish: \(P\cdot 1.25\). 2) 20% arzonlashish: yangi narx * \((1-0.20)=P\cdot 1.25\cdot 0.80\). Ko'paytiramiz: \(1.25\cdot 0.80=1.00\). Demak yakuniy narx \(1.00\cdot P\) ga teng, ya'ni narx o'zgarmagan (0% o'zgarish). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C (5% increase) — 25% \(-20\)% = +5% deb foizlarni oddiy ayirib yuboradigan eng mashhur SAT tuzog'i; D (5% decrease) — adashgan yo'nalish; B — noo'rin yaxlitlashdagi xato variant.
strat: QULAY SON TANLASH: Dastlabki narxni $100 deb oling: 25% oshsa $125 bo'ladi. $125 ning 20%i = $25. $125 - $25 = $100. Qaytib o'ziga keldi (0%)!

q: A research institute surveyed a random sample of 1,200 registered voters in a metropolitan area regarding a new transit tax. The survey found that 58% supported the tax, with a margin of error of 2.8% at a 95% confidence level. Which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion?
opts: It is plausible that the true proportion of all registered voters in the metropolitan area who support the tax is between 55.2% and 60.8%.
The true proportion of voters supporting the tax cannot be greater than 58%.
95% of all registered voters in the metropolitan area support the tax.
Exactly 58% of all registered voters in the metropolitan area support the tax.
exp: Ishonch oralig'i (confidence interval) hisoblanadi: 58% +\(-2.8\)%, ya'ni [55.2%, 60.8%]. Bu butun populyatsiyadagi haqiqiy ulush ushbu oraliqda bo'lishi asosli (plausible) ekanligini bildiradi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D — tanlanma natijasini butun aholi uchun qat'iy 'aynan 58%' deb e'lon qilish statistikaga zid tuzoq; C — 95% ishonchlilik darajasini qo'llab-quvvatlovchilar ulushi deb adashtirish xatosi; B — oraliq yuqori chegarasi 60.8% gacha borishini inkor etuvchi xato variant.
strat: SAT STATISTIKA QOIDASI: 'Margin of error' har doim interval beradi (58 - 2.8 dan \(58+2.8\) gacha). 'Exactly' yoki 'cannot' so'zlari bo'lgan variantlar deyarli har doim noto'g'ri!

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: A solid metal alloy block has a volume of 450 cubic centimeters. The density of the alloy is 7.8 grams per cubic centimeter. What is the mass of the block in kilograms? (1 kilogram = 1,000 grams)
exp: Massa formulasi: \(m\) = Zichlik * Hajm = 7.8 g/cm^\(3\cdot 450\) cm^\(3=3510\) gramm. Grammdan kilogrammga o'tkazamiz: \(\frac{3510}{1000}=3.51\) kg. To'g'ri javob: 3.51.

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: A scatterplot displays the weekly practice hours \(x\) and test scores \(y\) for 20 students. The line of best fit is given by \(\hat{y}=6.5x+48\). One student practiced for 6 hours and achieved an actual score of 92. What is the residual (actual score minus predicted score) for this student?
exp: 1) Bashorat qilingan ballni hisoblaymiz: \(\hat{y}=6.5(6)+48=39+48=87\). 2) Qoldiq (residual) = Haqiqiy ball - Bashorat qilingan ball = \(92-87=+5\). To'g'ri javob: \(C(+5)\).
strat: RESIDUAL QOIDASI: Residual = Actual - Predicted (\(y-y\)_hat). Nuqta chiziqdan yuqorida bo'lsa, musbat qoldiq bo'ladi!

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: A dataset contains 9 test scores: 72, 74, 76, 78, 80, 82, 84, 86, 88. An outlier with a score of 20 is added to the dataset. Which statement correctly compares the median and mean of the new 10-score dataset with the original 9-score dataset?
opts: Both the mean and the median decrease, but the median decreases by a greater amount.
Both the mean and the median decrease, but the mean decreases by a greater amount.
The mean remains unchanged, while the median decreases.
The median remains unchanged, while the mean decreases.
exp: Dastlabki 9 ta son simmetrik: mediana = 80, o'rtacha qiymat (mean) = 80. Yangi ro'yxat: 20, 72, 74, 76, 78, 80, 82, 84, 86, 88. 1) Yangi mediana = \(\frac{78+80}{2}=79\) (1 ga kamaydi). 2) Yangi o'rtacha qiymat = \(\frac{720+20}{10}=74\) (6 ga kamaydi). Ikkalasi ham kamayadi, lekin o'rtacha qiymat ancha ko'proq kamayadi (\(-6\) ga qarshi \(-1\)). To'g'ri javob: B. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A — medianani kutilmagan ko'rsatkichlarga ta'sirchan deb o'ylash xatosi; D va C — o'zgarishsiz qoladi deb noto'g'ri hisoblash tuzoqlari.
strat: SAT KONSEPSIYASI: O'rtacha qiymat (mean) anomal qiymatlarga (outliers) nihoyatda sezgir, mediana esa ancha mustahkam (resistant) turadi!

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: Account A starts with $1,000 and earns 8% interest compounded annually. Account B starts with $1,500 and earns $100 simple interest each year. After 15 years, which account has the greater total balance, and by approximately how much?
exp: 1) Account A (murakkab foiz): \(1000\cdot (1+0.08)^{15}=1000\cdot (1.08)^{15}\). \(1.08^{15}\) taxminan 3.17217 ga teng ⇒ Balans = $3,172. 2) Account B (oddiy foiz): \(1500+15\cdot 100=1500+1500\) = $3,000. Account A ko'proq: $3,172 - $3,000 = $172. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — Account B katta deb xato tanlash; C — dastlabki farqni $300 deb o'ylash tuzog'i; D — tenglashadi deb yanglishishdagi xato variant.
strat: DESMOS USULI: Desmosga \(1000\cdot 1.08^{15}\) va \(1500+15\cdot 100\) ni yozing. 3172.17 va 3000 chiqadi. Ayirmasi 172.17!

q: In the xy-plane, what is the radius of the circle defined by the equation \(x^{2}+y^{2}-8x+6y-11=0\)?
exp: To'la kvadratga ajratamiz: \((x^{2}-8x+16)+(y^{2}+6y+9)=11+16+9\). \((x-4)^{2}+(y+3)^{2}=36\). Aylananing standart tenglamasi: \((x-h)^{2}+(y-k)^{2}=r^{2}\). \(r^{2}=36\) bo'lgani uchun radius \(r=\sqrt{36}=6\). To'g'ri javob: 6.
strat: RADUS TEZKOR FORMULASI: \(r=\sqrt{\left(\frac{d}{2}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{e}{2}\right)^{2}-f}=\sqrt{4^{2}+(-3)^{2}-(-11)}=\sqrt{16+9+11}=\sqrt{36}=6\).

q: A circular community garden has a diameter of 20 meters. A triangular floral sector formed by central radii OA and OB subtends a central angle of 72 degrees. What is the area of this sector, in square meters?
exp: Diametr 20 metr bo'lsa, radius \(r=\frac{20}{2}=10\) metr bo'ladi. To'liq aylananing yuzi: S_doira = \(\pi \cdot r^{2}=\pi \cdot (10)^{2}=100\pi\). 72 gradusli sektorning to'liq doiradagi ulushi: \(\frac{72}{360}=\frac{1}{5}\) qism. Sektor yuzi: S_sektor = \((\frac{1}{5})\cdot 100\pi =20\pi\) \(m^{2}\). To'g'ri javob: C (20pi). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (40pi) — radius o'rniga diametrni (20) qo'yib yuborish tuzog'i; B (10pi) — yuzani noto'g'ri bo'lishdagi xato; A (80pi) — \(\frac{400\pi }{5}\) deb diametr bilan xato hisoblashdagi variant.
strat: TEZKOR NISBAT: \(\frac{72^{\circ}}{360}^{\circ}=\frac{1}{5}\). Doira yuzi \(\pi \cdot 10^{2}=100\pi\). \(\frac{100\pi }{5}=20\pi\)!

q: In right triangle ABC, the measure of angle C is 90 degrees. If \(\sin(A)=\frac{7}{25}\), what is the value of \(\cos(B)\)?
exp: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda o'tkir burchaklar yig'indisi 90 gradus: \(A+B=90\). Qo'shimcha burchaklar trigonometrik qoidasi (cofunction identity): \(\sin(A)=\cos(90-A)=\cos(B)\). Shuning uchun \(\cos(B)\) ham aynan \(\frac{7}{25}\) ga teng bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: \(A(\frac{7}{25})\). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: \(B(\frac{24}{25})\) — \(\sin(B)\) yoki \(\cos(A)\) ni hisoblab qo'yish tuzog'i; \(C(\frac{25}{7})\) — kasrni to'ntarib qo'yish xatosi; \(D(\frac{7}{24})\) — tangens qiymati bilan adashtirishdagi xato variant.
strat: SAT COFUNCTION QOIDASI: Har qanday to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda \(\sin(A)=\cos(B)\) doimo tengdir!

q: Triangle PQR is similar to triangle XYZ, where vertices P, Q, and R correspond to X, Y, and Z, respectively. The length of side PQ is 6, and the length of corresponding side XY is 15. If the area of triangle PQR is 24 square centimeters, what is the area of triangle XYZ, in square centimeters?
exp: O'xshashlik koeffitsiyenti \(k\) = XY / PQ = \(\frac{15}{6}=\frac{5}{2}=2.5\). O'xshash figuralarning maydonlari nisbati o'xshashlik koeffitsiyentining kvadratiga teng \((k^{2})\): Area(XYZ) = Area(PQR) * \(k^{2}=24\cdot \left(\frac{5}{2}\right)^{2}=24\cdot (\frac{25}{4})=6\cdot 25=150\) sm^2. To'g'ri javob: C (150). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (60) — maydonni \(k\) ga (kvadratsiz) ko'paytirib qo'yishdagi klassik tuzoq \((24\cdot 2.5=60)\); A (120) va D (240) — noto'g'ri ko'paytirishdagi chalg'ituvchi xato variantlar.
strat: MAYDON VA HAJM QOIDASI: Chiziqli o'lcham \(k\) marta kattalashsa, maydon \(k^{2}\) marta, hajm esa \(k^{3}\) marta ortadi!

q: A cylindrical water storage tank has a base diameter of 8 meters and a height of 10 meters. What is the total volume of the tank, in cubic meters?
exp: Asos diametri \(d=8\) \(m\) bo'lsa, radiusi \(r=\frac{d}{2}=4\) \(m\) bo'ladi. Silindr hajmi formulasi: \(V=\pi \cdot r^{2}\cdot h=\pi \cdot (4)^{2}\cdot 10=\pi \cdot 16\cdot 10=160\pi\) \(m^{3}\). To'g'ri javob: A (160pi). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (640pi) — radius o'rniga diametrni \((8^{2}=64)\) qo'yib yuborish tuzog'i; C (80pi) — formuladagi \(r^{2}\) o'rniga \(r\cdot h\) deb adashish xatosi; B (40pi) — konus formulasini (\(\frac{1}{3}\) yoki \(\frac{1}{4}\)) noo'rin qo'llashdagi xato variant.
strat: DIQQAT: Diametr berilganda doimo birinchi ish uni 2 ga bo'lib radiusni \((r=4)\) topishdir!

q: In an equilateral triangle DEF, each side has a length of 14. What is the exact length of the altitude of triangle DEF?
exp: Teng tomonli uchburchakning balandligi uni ikkita 30-60-90 to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakka ajratadi. Gipotenuza = 14, 30 gradus qarshisidagi katet (asosning yarmi) = 7. 60 gradus qarshisidagi balandlik: \(h\) = asos_kateti * \(\sqrt{3}=7\cdot \sqrt{3}\). To'g'ri javob: D. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — 45-45-90 uchburchak bilan adashtirib \(\sqrt{2}\) olish xatosi; A (7) — faqat asosning yarmini belgilash tuzog'i; C — gipotenuzaga \(\sqrt{3}\) ni ko'paytirib qo'yishdagi xato variant.
strat: FORMULA: Tomoni s bo'lgan muntazam uchburchak balandligi \(h=s\cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=14\cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=7\cdot \sqrt{3}\).

pas: In her critical appraisal of the nineteenth-century realist novel, literary scholar Elena Vance noted that the protagonist's outward submission to societal norms was merely a pragmatic concession; beneath this compliant exterior lay a fierce and uncompromising commitment to personal autonomy.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'concession' most nearly mean?
exp: Matnda bosh qahramonning jamiyat qoidalariga tashqaridan bo'ysunishi shunchaki 'pragmatic concession' (amaliy yon berish, murosaga kelish) ekani aytilmoqda, uning ichida esa avtonomiyaga qat'iy sadoqat bor edi. 'Concession' bu yerda murosaga kelish (compromise / yielding) ma'nosini bildiradi. To'g'ri javob: B. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C (privilege - imtiyoz) — kontekstdagi yon berish ma'nosiga zid; D (rebate - chegirma) — tijoriy ma'no; A (admittance - kirishga ruxsat) — noo'rin leksik chalg'ituvchi variantlardir.
strat: KONTEKSTUAL QARAMA-QARSHILIK: 'outward submission' va 'uncompromising commitment' orasidagi muvozanat 'compromise' (murosa) ekanini aniqlab beradi.

pas: The desert dwelling architecture of the Ancestral Puebloans was strikingly austere, characterized by unadorned sandstone masonry and compact cliffside layouts that maximized thermal retention while minimizing material waste.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'austere' most nearly mean?
exp: Matnda me'morchilik 'unadorned sandstone masonry' (bezaksiz qumtosh terimi) va ixcham loyihalar bilan tasvirlangan. Bu 'austere' so'zining oddiy, dabdabasiz va bezaksiz (simple and unornamented) ma'nosini to'liq ochib beradi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (xavfli) — sahro muhitiga qarab adashiladigan tuzoq; C (mo'rt) — tosh terim mustahkam bo'lgani sababli matnga zid; B (hashamatli) — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri antonim bo'lgan xato variant.
strat: KALIT SO'ZLAR: 'unadorned' (bezaksiz) so'zi 'austere'ning to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sinonimik izohidir.

pas: Dr. Aris Thorne took scrupulous care to verify every spectral measurement, refusing to publish the planetary discovery until multiple independent observatories confirmed the precise orbital perturbations.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'scrupulous' most nearly mean?
exp: Olim har bir o'lchovni sinchiklab tekshirgani ('verify every measurement') va bir nechta mustaqil rasadxonalar tasdiqlamaguncha nashr qilmagani uning favqulodda puxta va ehtiyotkor (meticulous and thorough) yondashganini ko'rsatadi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (ikkilanuvchi) — ilmiy ehtiyotkorlik ikkilanish emas; C (shoshqaloq) — matn mantiqiga mutlaqo zid; B (dushmanona) — ilmiy auditni salbiy his-tuyg'u bilan adashtiruvchi xato variant.
strat: SIFAT-HARAKAT MOSLIGI: 'verify every... refusing to publish until confirmed' harakati kishining 'meticulous' (o'ta sinchkov) ekanini bildiradi.

pas: Because the alpine ecosystem endures such ephemeral growing seasons—sometimes lasting fewer than six weeks—high-altitude flora must initiate rapid flowering immediately after the snowpack recedes.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'ephemeral' most nearly mean?
exp: Tirelar orasidagi izohga e'tibor bering: 'sometimes lasting fewer than six weeks' (ba'zan olti haftadan ham kam davom etadi). Bu o'sish mavsumining juda qisqa muddatli va o'tkinchi (short-lived / transient) ekanini aniq ko'rsatadi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (oldindan aytib bo'ladigan) — mavsum uzunligi bilan bog'liq emas; C (shiddatli) — o'simliklar harakatini mavsumga taalluqli deb adashish; B (halokatli) — matnga zid chalg'ituvchi variant.
strat: PUNKTUATSIYA SIGNALI: Matndagi tirelar (—lasting fewer than six weeks—) qiyin so'zning to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ta'rifini beradi!

pas:
Text 1:
Historical ecologist Jeremy Miller argues that total fire exclusion policies in western pine forests have disrupted natural regenerative cycles. By preventing low-intensity understory blazes, these policies allow combustible organic debris to accumulate, inadvertently priming forests for catastrophic, uncontrollable mega-fires.

Text 2:
Conservation specialist Maya Patel cautions against aggressive prescribed burning programs, noting that changing climate regimes have made previously predictable ignition windows perilous. Low-intensity burns frequently escape containment boundaries due to unexpected drought winds, inflicting severe mortality on mature canopy trees.
q: Based on the texts, how would Maya Patel (Text 2) most likely respond to Jeremy Miller's perspective (Text 1)?
opts: By emphasizing that attempting to reintroduce fires carries substantial modern risks that may outweigh the theoretical ecological benefits
By arguing that low-intensity understory burns have never played a historical role in forest regeneration
By asserting that prescribed fires are consistently easier to control during severe drought conditions
By agreeing that total fire exclusion has completely eliminated the threat of catastrophic canopy mega-fires
exp: Text 1 muallifi past intensivlikdagi yong'inlar o'rmonni katta ofatlardan saqlaydi deb yong'inga ruxsat berishni yoqlaydi. Ammo Text 2 muallifi Maya Patel iqlim o'zgarishi sababli bunday nazoratli yong'inlar shamol tufayli chegaradan chiqib ketayotganini va xavfi juda yuqoriligini ta'kidlaydi. Demak u Millerga zamonaviy xatarlar kutilayotgan ekologik foydadan ustun kelishi mumkinligini aytib javob beradi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D — Text 1 ga to'liq qo'shilish deb yanglishish; B — Patel tarixiy rolni inkor etmaydi, zamonaviy xatarni aytadi; C — Patelning fikriga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri zid xato variant.
strat: IKKITA MATN QIYOSI: Har doim ikkala muallifning 'to'qnashuv nuqtasi'ni toping: Miller = 'yong'in kerak', Patel = 'hozir uni yoqish o'ta xavfli'.

pas: Biologists long presumed that deep-sea vent tubeworms derived nutrition exclusively by filtering organic detritus falling from the photic zone. However, Colleen Cavanaugh demonstrated in 1981 that the worms harbor sulfur-oxidizing bacteria in a specialized organ called a trophosome. This symbiotic relationship allows the worms to thrive on toxic hydrothermal chemical emissions, upending traditional understandings of oceanic energy webs.
q: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
opts: It outlines an unresolved biological controversy and proposes a novel experimental method to settle it.
It chronicles the lifelong academic career of an oceanographer and catalogues her various publications.
It describes a peculiar marine organism and argues that it represents an evolutionary dead end.
It presents a longstanding scientific consensus, introduces groundbreaking research that refuted it, and notes the broader implications of that discovery.
exp: Matn avval uzoq vaqt hukm surgan qarashni taqdim etadi ('Biologists long presumed...'), so'ngra 'However' burilishi bilan Cavanaughning yangi kashfiyotini keltiradi ('demonstrated that...'), va oxirida buning keng qamrovli oqibatini xulosa qiladi ('upending traditional understandings...'). Bu tuzilma D variantga 100% mos keladi. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A — bahs hal etilmagan deyilmagan (hal etilgan); B — olimning butun umri xronikasi berilmagan; C — organizmni 'evolyutsion boshi berk ko'cha' deb noo'rin xulosalash xatosi.
strat: RETORIK STRUKTURA: 'Long presumed... However, [Scientist] demonstrated... upending understandings' = Consensus -> Refutation -> Broader Impact.

pas:
Text 1:
Economist Liam Vance argues that the rapid automation of routine warehousing tasks inevitably benefits regional economies by reducing supply-chain bottlenecks, lowering shipping consumer prices, and driving capital investment into higher-margin technical design sectors.

Text 2:
Sociologist Nadia Ortiz points out that while aggregate regional GDP metrics may rise following automation, the benefits are heavily skewed toward capital owners. Displaced warehouse workers rarely transition into technical design roles; instead, they face prolonged wage stagnation or involuntary transition into precarious, low-wage service jobs.
q: Based on the texts, how does Nadia Ortiz (Text 2) view the economic outcome described by Liam Vance (Text 1)?
opts: She wholly rejects Vance's claim that automated supply chains achieve lower operating expenses.
She maintains that automated warehouses will eventually return to manual labor due to technical unreliability.
She contends that aggregate macroeconomic gains obscure severe distributional inequalities and employment hardships for displaced workers.
She enthusiastically supports Vance's projection that low-skill laborers effortlessly shift into high-margin engineering positions.
exp: Text 1 makroiqtisodiy yutuqlar (arzon narxlar, investitsiya) haqida gapiradi. Text 2 muallifi Ortiz esa umumiy YaIM o'sishi ortida daromadlarning faqat sarmoyadorlarga o'tishi va oddiy ishchilarning ishsizlik va maosh tushishiga uchrashi yashiringanini ta'kidlaydi ('benefits heavily skewed... displaced workers face wage stagnation'). Shuning uchun Ortiz umumiy yutuqlar jiddiy tengsizlikni yashirib qo'yadi deb hisoblaydi (C to'g'ri). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A — xarajatlar tushishini inkor qilmaydi; B — qo'l mehnatiga qaytadi demaydi; D — matnga mutlaqo zid xato variant.
strat: ASOSIY FARQ: Vance makro darajadagi foydani, Ortiz esa ishchilar darajasidagi tengsizlikni (distributional inequality) ko'rsatadi.

pas: To understand how geckos adhere to vertical glass without secretions, Kellar Autumn examined the microscopic structure of their toe pads. Electron microscopy revealed millions of microscopic setae, each branching into hundreds of nanoscale spatulae. Autumn calculated that the collective van der Waals forces between these spatulae and the surface generate sufficient electromagnetic attraction to suspend the lizard's weight.
q: Which choice best states the primary purpose of the text?
opts: To compare the adhesion efficiency of geckos with synthetic chemical glues
To explain the physical mechanism that enables geckos to climb smooth surfaces without liquids
To argue that geckos are the only animals capable of vertical locomotion
To dispute the existence of van der Waals forces in terrestrial animals
exp: Matn boshidanoq gekkonlarning suyuqliksiz silliq oynaga qanday yopishishini tushuntirish maqsadini qo'yadi va mikroskopik tukchalar hamda van-der-Vaals kuchlari mexanizmini bayon qiladi. Demak, asosiy maqsad bu fizik mexanizmni tushuntirishdir (B to'g'ri). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A — sun'iy yelimlar bilan solishtirilmagan; D — van-der-Vaals kuchlarini rad etmaydi, aksincha tasdiqlaydi; C — faqat gekkonlar chiqa oladi degan haddan tashqari umumlashtiruvchi xato variant.
strat: MATN MAQSADI: Matn nima uchun yozilgan? Birinchi gap: 'To understand how geckos adhere...'. Javob B to'g'ridan-to'g'ri shuni aks ettiradi.

pas: While the board members publicly praised the interim director's ambitious restructuring proposals, their private correspondence revealed a tacit consensus that none of the disruptive initiatives would ever be enacted.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'tacit' most nearly mean?
exp: Matnda rasman omma oldida maqtashsa-da, o'zaro shaxsiy munosabatlarda bu rejalarni amalga oshirmaslik bo'yicha og'zaki aytilmagan, lekin bir-birini tushungan kelishuv ('tacit consensus') bo'lgani aytilmoqda. 'Tacit' so'zi so'zsiz anglashilgan, bildirilmagan (unspoken / implied) degan ma'noni beradi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (hujjatlashtirilgan) — tacit so'zining tabiatiga zid; D (qonuniy) — norasmiy kelishuv; C (janjalli) — qarama-qarshilikni so'z ma'nosiga noo'rin yuklash xatosi.
strat: LUG'AT HACK: 'Tacit' = so'zsiz tushunilgan (unspoken, implied, understood without being stated).

pas: In 1828, Friedrich Wöhler heated ammonium cyanate—an inorganic salt—and unexpectedly produced urea, an organic compound previously believed to arise only through the biological 'vital force' of living organisms. Wöhler's accidental synthesis effectively bridged organic and inorganic chemistry, proving that biological molecules obey identical physical laws as inanimate matter.
q: Which choice best describes the function of the second sentence in the text as a whole?
opts: It explains the historical and theoretical significance of the experimental result described in the first sentence.
It introduces a conflicting perspective from contemporary organic chemists.
It questions the methodological rigor of the scientist's laboratory procedures.
It provides biographical context regarding the scientist's early academic education.
exp: Birinchi gapda Wöhlerning tajribasi va u tasodifan mochevina olgani aytilgan. Ikkinchi gap esa bu natijaning kimyo fanidagi ulkan tarixiy va nazariy ahamiyatini ('effectively bridged... proving that biological molecules obey identical physical laws') tushuntirib beradi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C — metodologik xatolik haqida gap yo'q; B — boshqa olimlarning zid fikri kiritilmagan; D — tarjimai hol yoki bolaligi haqida ma'lumot berilmagan.
strat: GAPLAR ALOQASI: 1-gap tajriba faktini beradi, 2-gap uning fanga ta'sirini (significance) tushuntiradi.

pas: Mycorrhizal fungal networks weave through forest soils, connecting the root systems of geographically separated trees. Ecologists have discovered that these subterranean networks actively redistribute carbon, nitrogen, and phosphorus from thriving canopy trees to light-deprived saplings. Furthermore, when mature trees suffer insect herbivory, they transmit biochemical warning cues through the mycelium, prompting neighboring trees to preemptively synthesize chemical pest defenses.
q: Which choice best summarizes the central idea of the text?
opts: Forest soils lack sufficient inorganic minerals without direct artificial nutrient supplementation.
Light-deprived saplings routinely outcompete mature canopy trees by parasitizing fungal root colonies.
Insects intentionally sever mycorrhizal fungal threads to prevent trees from manufacturing defensive chemicals.
Underground fungal networks function as dynamic conduits that facilitate both nutrient distribution and biochemical communication among forest trees.
exp: Matnda mikoriza qo'ziqorin tarmoqlari daraxtlar orasida ozuqa moddalarini (uglerod, azot, fosfor) taqsimlashi hamda zararkunandalar hujumi paytida biokimyoviy ogohlantirish signallarini uzatishi bayon etilgan. Bu D variantdagi 'dynamic conduits for nutrient distribution and biochemical communication' jumlasida to'liq aks etgan. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — yosh nihollar katta daraxtlarni yengadi degan da'vo matnda yo'q; C — hasharotlar tarmoqni uzib tashlashi aytilmagan; A — sun'iy o'g'it haqida hech narsa deyilmagan.
strat: ASOSIY G'OYA: Matndagi ikkita asosiy dalilni (1: ozuqa taqsimoti, 2: ogohlantirish signali) bitta gapda birlashtirgan variantni tanlang!

pas: In studying ancient maritime commerce in the Baltic Sea, historian Henrik Lund hypothesized that the fourteenth-century expansion of the Hanseatic League was driven more by monopolistic legal privileges granted by regional monarchs than by superior merchant naval technology. To substantiate this hypothesis, Lund must identify historical evidence demonstrating that rival non-Hanseatic merchants possessed vessels of equivalent maritime capability but were excluded through statutory barriers.
q: Which finding, if true, would most directly support Lund's hypothesis?
opts: Hanseatic shipwrights engineered innovative double-hulled vessels that withstood northern storms far better than any contemporary European craft.
Non-Hanseatic merchants willingly abandoned Baltic shipping routes due to widespread domestic textile shortages in Flanders.

Dutch merchant cogs matched Hanseatic ships in cargo capacity and navigational range but were barred from Baltic ports under royal charter agreements that granted exclusive trading monopolies to Hanseatic guilds.
Regional monarchs continuously raised customs duties equally on all foreign merchant vessels regardless of their guild affiliations.
exp: Lundning farazi: Ganza ligasining ustunligi kema texnologiyasidan emas, balki qirollar bergan monopol huquqiy imtiyozlardan kelib chiqqan. Buning uchun raqib kemalar texnik jihatdan teng bo'lsa-da, qonuniy to'siqlar tufayli portlarga kiritilmaganini isbotlash kerak. C variant aynan shuni ko'rsatadi: golland kemalari sig'imi va masofasi bo'yicha teng bo'lgan, biroq qirollik shartnomalari tufayli portlardan chiqarib qo'yilgan. To'g'ri javob: C. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A — texnologik ustunlikni aytib, gipotezaga qarshi ishlaydi; D — barcha savdogarlardan teng boj olingan bo'lsa, monopol imtiyoz gipotezasi puchga chiqadi; B — texnologiya yoki qonuniy to'siqqa aloqasi yo'q xato variant.
strat: GIPOTEZANI TASDIQLASH: Gipoteza 'Texnologiya emas, qonuniy to'siq' degan. Demak, javobda 'Texnologiya bir xil, lekin qonun bilan taqiqlangan' dalili bo'lishi shart!

pas: Energy engineers conducted a 500-cycle degradation trial evaluating four utility-scale battery chemistries. They recorded initial capacity retention and internal resistance increases. Lithium iron phosphate (LFP) retained 94% capacity with a 6% resistance gain; nickel manganese cobalt (NMC) retained 88% capacity with a 14% resistance gain; sodium-ion retained 82% capacity with a 18% resistance gain; and lead-carbon retained 71% capacity with a 29% resistance gain. The researchers concluded that LFP demonstrates the greatest electrochemical stability under repeated cycling.
q: Which choice best uses data from the passage to support the researchers' conclusion?
opts: NMC batteries retained more capacity than LFP batteries throughout the 500-cycle trial.
All four battery chemistries maintained capacity retention above 85% after 500 cycles.
LFP achieved the highest capacity retention (94%) and the lowest internal resistance increase (6%) among all four tested chemistries.
Lead-carbon batteries exhibited lower internal resistance increases than sodium-ion batteries.
exp: Tadqiqotchilar LFP kimyosi eng barqaror deb xulosa qilishgan. Buni matndagi raqamlar bilan tasdiqlash uchun LFP ning ko'rsatkichlari eng yaxshi ekanini ko'rsatish kerak: u eng yuqori sig'im saqlashga (94%) va eng kam ichki qarshilik o'sishiga (6%) ega bo'ldi. To'g'ri javob: C. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D — matnga zid (qo'rg'oshin 29%, natriy 18%); A — matnga zid (NMC 88% < LFP 94%); B — matnga zid (faqat LFP va NMC 85% dan yuqori, qolganlari 82% va 71%).
strat: RAQAMLARNI SOLISHTIRISH: Matndagi jadval ma'lumotlarini qat'iy tekshiring va 'superlativ' (eng yuqori/eng past) ko'rsatkichga e'tibor bering.

pas: Many deep-sea organisms utilize bioluminescent counterillumination to evade predators hunting from below. By emitting downward-directed light from ventral photophores that matches the intensity and wavelength of downwelling sunlight, these creatures disguise their silhouettes. Marine ecologist Sarah Hirst observed that when mesopelagic squids encounter artificial water turbidity that scatters sunlight irregularly, their photophore adjustments become mismatched with ambient light, suggesting that ______
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: their counterillumination camouflage relies on uniform ambient light fields to effectively obscure their silhouettes.
ventral photophores generate light through external bacterial digestion rather than biochemical reactions.
mesopelagic squids migrate into shallower waters when oceanic turbidity increases.
turbid waters provide superior camouflage protection compared to clear oceanic zones.
exp: Matnda kalmarlarning pastga yo'naltirilgan nuri tushayotgan quyosh nuriga moslashib siluetni yashirishi aytilgan. Biroq loyqa suv yorug'likni notekis tarqatganda kalmarlarning nuri atrof-muhitga mos kelmay qolgan. Bundan mantiqiy xulosa: ularning bu kamuflyaji samarali ishlashi uchun bir tekis (uniform) yorug'lik maydoniga tayanadi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D — loyqa suv yaxshiroq himoya beradi degan matnga teskari da'vo; C — sayoz suvga ko'chib o'tadi degan asossiz taxmin; B — bakterial hazm haqida matnda hech qanday ma'lumot yo'q.
strat: MANTIQIY DAVOM: Sabab-oqibat zanjiri: loyqalik nur muvozanatini buzdi -> demak tizim bir tekis yorug'likka bog'liq!

pas: Obsidian, a naturally occurring volcanic glass, was among the most prized materials in Neolithic tool manufacturing. Because each volcanic deposit possesses a unique chemical fingerprint of trace elements, modern archaeologists can use X-ray fluorescence spectrometry to trace obsidian blades discovered at distant settlement sites back to their precise quarry of origin, thereby reconstructing trade networks that spanned thousands of kilometers across prehistoric Anatolia.
q: According to the text, why are modern archaeologists able to identify the geographic origins of ancient obsidian blades?
opts: Ancient trade treaties detailing raw material shipments were preserved in Anatolian archives.
Neolithic toolmakers inscribed distinctive geographical symbols onto every blade.
Obsidian blades change physical color based on the geographical distance they travel.
Each volcanic source has a distinct chemical composition of trace elements that can be detected through spectrometry.
exp: Matnda ochiq-oydin aytilgan: 'Because each volcanic deposit possesses a unique chemical fingerprint of trace elements, modern archaeologists can use X-ray fluorescence spectrometry to trace obsidian blades... back to their precise quarry of origin'. Bu D variantga to'liq mos keladi. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — pichoqlarga geografik belgilar yozilgani haqida gap yo'q; A — arxivalar saqlangani aytilmagan; C — masofaga qarab rang o'zgarishi kabi ilmiy bo'lmagan chalg'ituvchi variant.
strat: TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI MATN ASOSI: 'Because each volcanic deposit possesses a unique chemical fingerprint...' so'zlarini javob bilan solishtiring.

pas: Linguists investigating phonological acquisition have debated whether infants identify word boundaries primarily by tracking statistical transitional probabilities between syllables or by responding to acoustic stress patterns. To demonstrate that statistical learning operates independently of acoustic stress, researcher Marcus Gable presented eight-month-old infants with a stream of synthesized speech in which all syllables were uttered with identical pitch, duration, and volume, but with specific syllable pairs occurring in predictable sequences.
q: Which finding from Gable's experiment, if true, would most strongly support the statistical learning hypothesis?
opts: The infants struggled to perceive individual syllables when background white noise was eliminated.
The infants showed no measurable reaction to any syllable sequence unless pitch and volume varied noticeably.
The infants displayed significantly greater listening interest in novel syllable combinations than in the predictable syllable pairs from the stream.
The infants recognized words only when the synthesized voices resembled their primary caregivers' voices.
exp: Kognitiv psixologiyada chaqaloqlar o'rgangan narsasidan ko'ra yangi narsaga ko'proq e'tibor qaratadi (novelty preference). Agar chaqaloqlar bir xil ohang va balandlikdagi oqimdan so'ng yangi kombinatsiyalarga ko'proq quloq solsa, bu ularning statistik ketma-ketlikni eslab qolganini va yangisini farqlay olganini isbotlaydi. To'g'ri javob: C. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — ohangsiz hech narsani sezmadi desa gipotezani rad etgan bo'ladi; D — ona ovozi sharti matnda sinovdan chiqarilgan; A — oq shovqin haqida matnda ma'lumot yo'q.
strat: CHAQALOQLAR PSIXOLOGIYASI TESTI: O'rganilgan so'zlarni tanish chaqaloqning 'novel' (yangi) so'zlarga uzoqroq quloq solishi (preferential listening) orqali o'lchanadi.

pas: In cognitive psychology, retrieval-induced forgetting occurs when the act of practicing the recall of certain items from memory causes the temporary suppression of related, unpracticed items. For instance, repeatedly reviewing the word pair 'Fruit-Apple' impairs subsequent recall of 'Fruit-Banana.' Neuroimaging indicates that this suppression is driven by prefrontal inhibitory control mechanisms that resolve competition during memory access. Thus, retrieval-induced forgetting demonstrates that ______
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: practicing recall is generally harmful to academic test preparation.
all memory retrieval is unmediated by prefrontal neurological circuits.
forgetting is not merely a passive decay of information, but can result from active cognitive mechanisms that suppress competing memories.
human memory has a rigid, finite capacity that permanently deletes older memories to store new data.
exp: Matnda miyadagi tormozlash mexanizmi (inhibitory control) raqobatdosh xotiralarni faol ravishda bosib turishi (suppress) ko'rsatilgan. Bundan mantiqiy xulosa shuki, unutish shunchaki xotiraning o'z-o'zidan passiv o'chib ketishi (passive decay) emas, balki miyaning faol boshqaruv mexanizmi natijasidir. To'g'ri javob: C. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D — xotira ma'lumotni butunlay o'chirib tashlaydi degan noto'g'ri da'vo (matnda 'temporary suppression' deyilgan); A — takrorlash o'qishga zarar degan mantiqsiz umumlashtirish; B — neyron zanjirlarga aloqador emas degan matnga teskari xato variant.
strat: MATN XULOSASI: 'active suppression by inhibitory control' = xotira passiv yo'qolmaydi, faol tormozlanadi.

pas: Botanist Linda Perez investigated whether urban plants adapt to elevated ground-level ozone by altering stomatal conductance. In a controlled greenhouse study, she exposed common plantain (Plantago major) seedlings from both rural roadside populations and dense inner-city populations to identical ozone concentrations (80 ppb) for four weeks. Perez observed that inner-city plants exhibited significantly lower stomatal conductance and accumulated 40% less cellular oxidative damage than rural specimens.
q: Which statement is best supported by Perez's findings?
opts: Inner-city populations of Plantago major possess adaptive traits that limit ozone uptake and subsequent oxidative damage.
Elevated ozone exposure consistently increases stomatal conductance across all plant species.
Rural plants are better suited to withstand high ozone concentrations than urban varieties.
Plantago major is incapable of surviving in environments with ground-level ozone levels above 40 ppb.
exp: Shaharda o'sgan o'simliklar qishloqdagilarga nisbatan kamroq og'izcha o'tkazuvchanligiga ega bo'lib, 40% kamroq oksidlanish zarari ko'rgan. Bu ularning shahar muhitida ozon gazining kirishini cheklaydigan moslashuvchan (adaptive) xususiyatlarga ega ekanini to'liq tasdiqlaydi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C — qishloq o'simliklari bardoshliroq degan matnga teskari da'vo; B — barcha turlarda o'tkazuvchanlik oshadi degan xato; D — 40 ppb dan yuqorida yashay olmaydi degan asossiz cheklov.
strat: DALILNI MOSLASHTIRISH: Kamroq zarar ko'rgan (40% less damage) = yaxshiroq moslashgan (possess adaptive traits).

pas: Astronomers surveying debris disks around mature G-type stars noted that secondary gas emissions—principally carbon monoxide—are replenished through volatile-rich comet collisions rather than surviving from the primordial protoplanetary nebula. Because carbon monoxide is rapidly photodissociated by stellar ultraviolet radiation within a few thousand years, its persistent presence in multi-billion-year-old stellar systems implies that ______
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: primordial gas nebulae are completely immune to stellar ultraviolet photodissociation.
mature G-type stars gradually stop emitting ultraviolet radiation as they age.
planetary formation is physically impossible in systems containing carbon monoxide debris disks.
cometary collision rates remain sufficiently frequent in these systems to continuously regenerate the dissipated gas.
exp: Agar CO gazi yulduz nurlari ta'sirida bir necha ming yilda yo'qolib ketsa-yu, lekin milliard yillik qadimgi yulduz tizimlarida hamon mavjud bo'lsa, bu yangi gaz doimiy ravishda kometa to'qnashuvlari orqali qayta ishlab chiqarilayotganini bildiradi. To'g'ri javob: D. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A — gaz nurlanishga chidamli degan matnga teskari gap (matnda 'rapidly photodissociated' deyilgan); B — yulduzlar ultrabinafsha nurlanishni to'xtatadi degan asossiz faraz; C — sayyora paydo bo'lishi mumkin emas degan xato radikal xulosa.
strat: MANTIQIY TENGSIZLIK: Gaz tez yo'qoladi + lekin hali ham bor = yangi gaz muntazam paydo bo'lyapti (continuously regenerated)!

pas: Before the advent of reliable refrigeration in the nineteenth century, harvesting natural ice from northern ponds and rivers was a vital global industry. Entrepreneurs like Frederic Tudor harvested frozen blocks in New England, insulated them in double-walled holds packed with sawdust, and successfully shipped thousands of tons of ice to tropical destinations such as Havana, Kingston, and Calcutta with remarkably little melt loss.
q: Which choice best describes how Frederic Tudor minimized melt loss during maritime ice transportation?
opts: By stowing the ice blocks in double-walled holds insulated with sawdust
By chemically treating the pond water prior to freezing
By compressing the ice blocks into airtight vacuum chambers
By transporting ice exclusively during the mid-winter months on steamships
exp: Matnda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rsatilgan: 'insulated them in double-walled holds packed with sawdust' (qipiq bilan to'ldirilgan ikki qavatli devorli xonalarda saqlagan). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — muzlashdan oldin kimyoviy ishlov berish aytilmagan; D — faqat qishda bug'li kemalarda tashigan deyilmagan; C — vakuum kamerasiga qisish degan noto'g'ri fantastik variant.
strat: MATN DETALI: Matndagi 'insulated them in double-walled holds packed with sawdust' iborasini qidiring.

pas: The archival research team uncovered three previously unpublished letters by author Mary ______ were meticulous reflections on the social turbulence of early Victorian England.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Bu yerda ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clauses) mavjud: 1) 'The archival research team uncovered three previously unpublished letters by author Mary Shelley' va 2) 'all of them were meticulous reflections...'. Ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lovchisiz faqat vergul bilan ajratish 'comma splice' xatosidir (A xato). Nuqta-vergul (;) ikkita mustaqil gapni grammatik to'g'ri bog'laydi. To'g'ri javob: C. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A — vergul xatosi (comma splice); B — tinish belgisiz qo'shib yuborish (run-on); D — nuqta-verguldan keyin 'which' qo'yib gapni chala qoldirish (fragment).
strat: SAT GRAMMATIKA: Mustaqil gap + mustaqil gap = Nuqta-vergul (;) yoki Vergul + FANBOYS. Faqat vergul bo'lsa xato!

pas: A team of structural engineers inspected the suspension bridge's primary cable ______ discovering extensive corrosion along the western anchoring vault, they recommended immediate tension reduction.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Tuzilishga qaraymiz: Birinchi mustaqil gap: 'A team... inspected the suspension bridge's primary cable bands'. Ikkinchi mustaqil gap: 'after discovering extensive corrosion..., they recommended immediate tension reduction'. Bu ikkala mustaqil gapni nuqta-vergul (;) bilan ajratish kerak. (Eslatma: A variantda 'bands. After' ham mustaqil gaplarni ajratadi, ammo bu yerda B variant bitta yaxlit fikriy bog'liqlikni nuqta-vergul bilan me'yoriy bog'laydi). Keling, variantlarni ko'rib chiqamiz: B da 'bands; after' ikkita mustaqil fikrni bog'laydi. D vergul xatosi (comma splice); C tinish belgisiz bog'lanish (run-on). To'g'ri javob: B.
strat: MUSTAQIL GAPLAR: Ikkita gap o'rtasidagi chegara: [Mustaqil gap] ; [Dependent clause + Mustaqil gap].

pas: The collection of rare Mesoamerican jade artifacts that was recovered from underwater cenotes in the Yucatán Peninsula ______ currently undergoing non-destructive laser spectroscopy in Mexico City.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Gapning haqiqiy egasi (subject) — birlikdagi 'The collection' so'zidir. 'of rare Mesoamerican jade artifacts that was recovered...' oraliqdagi aniqlovchi birikma (prepositional phrase) bo'lib, egaga ta'sir qilmaydi. 'The collection' birlikda bo'lgani uchun fe'l ham birlikda bo'lishi shart: 'is'. To'g'ri javob: B (is). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (are), C (were) va A (have been) ko'plikdagi fe'llar bo'lib, 'artifacts' so'ziga adashib moslashtirilgan klassik SAT tuzoqlaridir.
strat: EGA VA FE'L MOSLIGI: Oraliqdagi 'of artifacts...' so'zlarini qavsga olib tashlang: 'The collection [of...] IS undergoing'.

pas: Analyzing satellite radar telemetry from Antarctic ice shelves, ______
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
opts: the rapid expansion of subglacial meltwater channels became evident to glaciologist Marcus Rivera.
glaciologist Marcus Rivera identified a previously undetected network of subglacial meltwater channels.
radar telemetry revealed a previously undetected network of subglacial meltwater channels to researchers.
a previously undetected network of subglacial meltwater channels was identified by glaciologist Marcus Rivera.
exp: Gap boshidagi ravishdoshli birikmaga qarang: 'Analyzing satellite radar telemetry...' (Yo'ldosh radar ma'lumotlarini tahlil qilar ekan,...). Kim tahlil qilgan? Tahlil qiluvchi shaxs bo'lishi shart! Agar verguldan keyin 'a network' (D), 'the rapid expansion' (A) yoki 'radar telemetry' (C) kelsa, tahlilni go'yo kanallar yoki radar o'zi qilgandek 'dangling modifier' (osilib qolgan aniqlovchi) xatosi yuzaga keladi. Verguldan keyin darhol harakatni bajargan shaxs ('glaciologist Marcus Rivera') kelishi shart. To'g'ri javob: B.
strat: DANGLING MODIFIER QOIDASI: Boshdagi '-ing' bilan boshlangan harakatni kim bajargan bo'lsa, verguldan keyin aynan o'sha shaxs turishi shart!

pas: The Kepler space observatory, which discovered more than 2,600 verified exoplanets during its nine-year ______ finally exhausted its onboard thruster propellant in October 2018.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: 'which discovered more than 2,600 verified exoplanets during its nine-year mission' — bu qo'shimcha kiritma gap (non-essential relative clause). U 'which' dan oldin vergul bilan boshlangan, shuning uchun 'mission' so'zidan keyin ham vergul bilan yopilishi shart (paired commas). To'g'ri javob: D. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A (mission;) — kiritmani nuqta-vergul bilan yopish grammatik qo'pol xato; C (mission) — kiritmani ochiq qoldirib tinish belgisini qo'ymaslik xatosi; B (mission—) — bir tomoni vergul, ikkinchi tomoni tire bo'lishi mumkin emas.
strat: JUFT VERGULLAR: Agar kiritma vergul bilan ochilgan bo'lsa (..., which...), u vergul bilan yopilishi shart (...mission,).

pas: Neither the senior aerospace engineers nor the lead project manager ______ able to determine the root cause of the telemetry transmission anomaly during the preliminary debrief.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: 'Neither... nor...' bog'lovchisida fe'l o'ziga eng yaqin turgan egaga moslashadi (Rule of Proximity). Bu yerda 'nor' dan keyin 'the lead project manager' (birlik) turibdi. Shuning uchun fe'l birlikda bo'lishi shart: 'was'. To'g'ri javob: D (was). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C (were), B (are) va A (have been) ko'plikdagi fe'llar bo'lib, ular 'engineers' so'ziga adashib qaraganda tushiladigan tuzoqlardir.
strat: NEITHER/NOR QOIDASI: 'nor' dan keyingi otga qarang: 'manager' (birlik) bo'lsa -> 'was'.

pas: During the archaeological survey of the Roman villa, researchers catalogued hundreds of well-preserved everyday ______ bronze oil lamps, terracotta cookware, and carved ivory hairpins.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Ikki nuqta (colon) to'liq mustaqil gapdan keyin ro'yxat, izoh yoki misollarni keltirish uchun ishlatiladi: '...catalogued hundreds of well-preserved everyday items' — bu to'liq mustaqil gap. Undan keyin sanab o'tilgan buyumlar ro'yxati kelgan. Shuning uchun ikki nuqta (:) to'g'ri tanlov. To'g'ri javob: C. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (vergul) — ro'yxatni ochishda bo'linish noaniqligini keltirib chiqaradi; A (nuqta-vergul) — faqat mustaqil gaplarni bog'laydi, ro'yxat kiritmaydi; D — tinish belgisiz qo'shib yuborish xatosi.
strat: IKKI NUQTA (:) QOIDASI: [To'liq mustaqil gap] : [Ro'yxat yoki izoh].

pas: Unlike the ornate frescoes produced by his Italian contemporaries, the seventeenth-century Dutch painter Johannes Vermeer ______ scenes of quiet domesticity, depicting solitary figures engaged in routine household tasks.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Gapning grammatik asosini tahlil qilamiz: 'Johannes Vermeer' bu yerda ega (subject). Gapda boshqa hech qanday asosiy kesim (finite verb) yo'q. Shuning uchun Vermeer dan keyin o'tgan zamondagi to'liq kesim 'favored' kelishi shart. A ('favoring'), D ('having favored') va B ('to favor') sifatdosh va infinitiv bo'lib, mustaqil kesim bo'la olmaydi va gapni grammatik nuqsonga (fragment) aylantiradi. To'g'ri javob: C.
strat: FINITE VERB TALABI: Har bir gapda albatta to'liq tuslangan zamon fe'li (kesim) bo'lishi shart! '-ing' yoki 'to...' yolg'iz o'zi kesim bo'lolmaydi.

pas: Neurobiologist Elena Rostova spent decades investigating synaptic ______ her pioneering work on hippocampal long-term potentiation fundamentally transformed contemporary models of memory formation.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Bu yerda ikkita to'liq mustaqil gap bor: 1) 'Neurobiologist Elena Rostova spent decades investigating synaptic plasticity' va 2) 'her pioneering work... fundamentally transformed contemporary models...'. Ikkita mustaqil gapni ajratish uchun nuqta-vergul (;) talab qilinadi. To'g'ri javob: C. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (vergul) — comma splice xatosi; A — run-on xatosi; B ('and,') — vergul noo'rin qo'yilgan xato variant.
strat: COMMA SPLICE TESTI: Ikkita gap o'rtasiga nuqta qo'yib ko'ring: ikkisi ham mustaqil tura olsa, ularning orasiga faqat vergul qo'yish taqiqlanadi!

pas: Every autumn, millions of monarch butterflies embark on a 3,000-mile migration from eastern North America to central Mexico, where ______ congregate in the high-altitude fir forests of Michoacán.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Olmosh o'zi almashtirayotgan otga mos kelishi kerak (pronoun-antecedent agreement). Gapda gap 'millions of monarch butterflies' (ko'plik) haqida ketmoqda. Shuning uchun ko'plik olmoshi 'they' ishlatilishi shart. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ('it'), C ('one'), D ('this') birlikdagi olmoshlar bo'lib, ko'plikdagi 'butterflies' ga mos kelmaydi.
strat: OLMOSH MOSLIGI: 'butterflies' (ko'plik) -> 'they'.

pas: For decades, materials scientists sought to replicate the remarkable tensile strength of natural spider silk using synthetic petrochemical polymers. ______, by utilizing genetically engineered silkworms expressing transgenic arachnid proteins, contemporary bioengineers finally produced fibers matching the elasticity of natural dragline silk.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Matnda olimlarning o'nlab yillar davomida harakat qilgani ('For decades... sought') va oxir-oqibat genetik muhandislik orqali yakuniy muvaffaqiyatga erishgani ('contemporary bioengineers finally produced...') bayon qilingan. Bu uzoq jarayonning yakuniy yechimini ko'rsatuvchi 'Ultimately' (oxir-oqibat, pirovardida) o'tish so'zini talab qiladi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C ('For instance') — o'tgan harakatlarga misol emas, natija; D ('Similarly') — o'xshashlik emas; B ('In other words') — boshqacha qilib aytganda emas, yangi yakuniy natija.
strat: VAQT VA NATIJA: 'For decades... finally...' juftligi 'Ultimately' (oxir-oqibat) o'tishini bildiradi.

pas: Traditional silicon photovoltaic panels experience significant efficiency losses as ambient operating temperatures rise above 25°C. ______, newly formulated perovskite-silicon tandem cells demonstrate superior thermal stability, maintaining peak electrical conversion efficiency even in desert climates.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Birinchi gapda an'anaviy silikon panellarning issiqda samaradorlikni yo'qotishi ('efficiency losses'), ikkinchi gapda esa yangi tandem elementlarning issiqda ham yuqori barqarorlikni saqlab qolishi ('superior thermal stability') aytilgan. Bu ikki holat o'rtasida yaqqol qarama-qarshilik (contrast) mavjud. Shuning uchun 'In contrast' (A) eng mantiqiy bog'lovchidir. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ('Consequently' - natijada) — ikkinchisi birinchisining oqibati emas; C ('Furthermore' - bundan tashqari) — bir xil yo'nalishdagi fikrlar uchun; D ('Specifically') — umumiy fikrni aniqlashtirmayapti.
strat: KONTRAST QIDIRISH: Salbiy xususiyat (losses) vs Ijobiy xususiyat (superior stability) = 'In contrast'.

pas: Urban rooftop gardens insulate buildings against extreme winter cold and summer heat, dramatically reducing HVAC power consumption. ______, their vegetation absorbs stormwater runoff, preventing municipal sewer overflows during intense cloudbursts.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Birinchi gap tom bog'larining energiya tejashdagi birinchi foydasini ko'rsatadi. Ikkinchi gap esa yomg'ir suvlarini yutishdagi yana bir qo'shimcha foydasini keltiradi. Bu fikrni qo'shimcha boyitish (additive) munosabatidir. Shuning uchun 'Additionally' (Bundan tashqari) to'g'ri bog'lovchi. To'g'ri javob: C. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B ('Nevertheless' - shunga qaramay), A ('Conversely' - aksincha) va D ('Instead' - o'rniga) barchasi qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchilari bo'lib, ikkita ijobiy foydani bog'lashda xatodir.
strat: FOYDA + FOYDA = ADDITIVE: Foyda 1 + 'Additionally' + Foyda 2.

pas: Agricultural runoff introduces excess nitrogen and phosphorus into freshwater estuaries, fueling massive blooms of microscopic algae. As these algal mats die and decompose, microbial respiration depletes dissolved oxygen levels. ______, hypoxic 'dead zones' form where fish and shellfish cannot survive.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Matnda sabab-oqibat zanjiri keltirilgan: O'g'itlar suvga tushadi -> suvo'tlar ko'payadi -> parchalanishda kislorod tugaydi -> BARCHA SHU SABABLARNING OQIBATI O'LAROQ ('As a result') baliqlar yashay olmaydigan o'lik zonalar paydo bo'ladi. Sabab-oqibatni bog'lash uchun 'As a result' to'g'ri tanlov. To'g'ri javob: C. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D ('In comparison') — taqqoslash yo'q; A ('Meanwhile') — parallel vaqt munosabati emas, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri oqibat; B ('Regardless') — qaramasdan emas.
strat: SABAB-OQIBAT ZANJIRI: Kislorod tugashi -> Baliqlar o'lishi = 'As a result' (Natijada).

pas: Medieval scribes produced parchment manuscripts through labor-intensive manual curing and stretching of animal hides, rendering books luxury commodities accessible solely to religious institutions and aristocrats. Johannes Gutenberg's fifteenth-century invention of movable type printing press completely revolutionized text production. ______, the technological transition did not occur instantaneously; scribe guilds fiercely opposed printing shops across central Europe for decades.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Gutenberg matbaa mashinasi kitob chop etishni inqilobiy o'zgartirgani aytildi. Lekin keyingi gap bu o'tish birdaniga silliq bo'lmaganini, xattotlar gildiyalari o'nlab yillar qarshilik ko'rsatganini aytib, kutilgan tezkor g'alabaga zid cheklov (concession / contrast) kiritmoqda. Shuning uchun 'However' (Biroq) eng to'g'ri bog'lovchi. To'g'ri javob: B. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D ('Accordingly' - mos ravishda) — sabab-oqibat emas; C ('Furthermore') — davomiy qo'shimcha emas; A ('Likewise') — o'xshashlik emas.
strat: BURILISH NUQTASI: 'revolutionized... [However], the transition did not occur instantaneously'.

pas:
While researching aviation history, a student took the following notes:
- In 1932, Amelia Earhart became the first woman to complete a solo nonstop transatlantic flight.
- She flew a modified Lockheed Vega 5B from Harbour Grace, Newfoundland, to Londonderry, Northern Ireland.
- The flight took approximately 14 hours and 56 minutes under harsh icing and fatigue conditions.
- Her achievement challenged prevailing societal skepticism regarding women's endurance in long-distance aviation.
q: The student wants to emphasize the historical significance of Earhart's transatlantic flight. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?
opts: The flight across the Atlantic took Earhart exactly 14 hours and 56 minutes despite difficult weather conditions.
By completing her grueling 1932 solo flight across the Atlantic, Amelia Earhart shattered contemporary skepticism about women's capability in long-distance aviation.
Amelia Earhart's 1932 flight in a modified Lockheed Vega 5B departed from Harbour Grace and ended in Northern Ireland.
In 1932, a modified Lockheed Vega 5B was used by Amelia Earhart for long-distance flight testing.
exp: Talabaning aniq maqsadi: 'emphasize the historical significance' (tarixiy ahamiyatini ta'kidlash). B variantda Earhartning parvozi o'sha davrdagi jamiyatning ayollarning uzoq masofaga ucha olishiga bo'lgan shubhalarini sindirgani ('shattered contemporary skepticism') aniq ta'kidlangan, bu uning asosiy tarixiy ahamiyatidir. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C — faqat marshrutni aytadi; A — faqat vaqtni aytadi; D — kema modelini aytadi; ularning hech biri tarixiy ahamiyatni ochib bermaydi.
strat: MAQSADNI O'QISH: 'emphasize the historical significance' -> Javobda jamiyatga ta'siri (shattered skepticism) bo'lishi shart!

pas:
While researching architecture, a student took the following notes:
- The High Line in New York City is a 1.45-mile elevated public park built on a disused historic freight rail line.
- It opened in stages between 2009 and 2014, designed by landscape architecture firm James Corner Field Operations.
- The park features native perennial plantings, open lawns, and pedestrian walkways elevated 30 feet above street traffic.
- Since its opening, the High Line has spurred over $2 billion in surrounding real estate development and attracts millions of visitors annually.
q: The student wants to highlight the economic and urban revival impact of the High Line project. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?
opts: Designed by James Corner Field Operations, the High Line park opened in stages between 2009 and 2014.
The High Line is an elevated public park in New York City featuring native perennial plantings and open lawns 30 feet above the street.
Beyond transforming an abandoned industrial rail line into an elevated public park, the High Line has catalyzed over $2 billion in surrounding development and drawn millions of visitors.
Historic freight rail lines in New York City were originally constructed 30 feet above street traffic.
exp: Talabaning maqsadi: 'highlight the economic and urban revival impact' (iqtisodiy va shahar jonlanishi ta'sirini ko'rsatish). C variant 2 milliard dollarlik rivojlanish va millionlab sayyohlar jalb qilinganini hamda tashlandiq hudud shahar parkiga aylanganini aniq ko'rsatadi. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A — faqat arxitektura firmasi va sanani aytadi; B — faqat o'simlik turlarini aytadi; D — tarixiy temir yo'l balandligini aytadi; ularda iqtisodiy ta'sir yo'q.
strat: KALIT SO'ZLAR: 'economic impact' -> $2 billion in surrounding development!

pas:
While researching marine biology, a student took the following notes:
- The Greenland shark (Somniosus microcephalus) inhabits cold, deep waters of the Arctic and North Atlantic.
- In 2016, marine biologists used radiocarbon dating of eye lens crystalline proteins to estimate their lifespans.
- The study determined that Greenland sharks can live for at least 272 years, with some specimens possibly exceeding 400 years.
- They are currently recognized as the longest-lived vertebrate species on Earth.
q: The student wants to introduce the Greenland shark's exceptional longevity to a new audience. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?
opts: Inhabiting Arctic waters, the Greenland shark holds the distinction of being the longest-lived vertebrate on Earth, with lifespans documented to reach at least 272 years.
The Greenland shark, or Somniosus microcephalus, is a marine animal that resides in deep, cold northern oceans.
Radiocarbon dating is an effective technique commonly employed to measure organic specimens in marine research.
Marine biologists in 2016 utilized radiocarbon dating on eye lens crystalline proteins during an Arctic expedition.
exp: Maqsad: 'introduce the Greenland shark's exceptional longevity to a new audience' (Grenlandiya akulasining favqulodda uzoq umr ko'rishini yangi auditoriyaga tanishtirish). A variant akulaning kimligini tanishtiradi va uning 272 yildan ortiq yashaydigan yer yuzidagi eng uzoq umr ko'ruvchi umurtqali hayvon ekanini aniq bayon qiladi. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D — faqat 2016 yilgi usulni aytadi; B — uzoq umr ko'rishini aytmaydi; C — faqat radiouglerod usulini umumiy ta'riflaydi.
strat: AUDITORIYAGA TANISHTIRISH: Jonivorning nomi + uning favqulodda rekordi (exceptional longevity: 272+ years) = Variant A.

pas:
While researching renewable energy materials, a student took the following notes:
- Solar cell efficiency depends significantly on bandgap energy, measured in electron-volts (eV).
- Silicon has a bandgap of 1.1 eV, capturing infrared and visible light but losing high-energy photons to heat.
- Perovskite semiconductors can be engineered with adjustable bandgaps ranging from 1.2 to 2.3 eV.
- By stacking a wide-bandgap perovskite layer on top of silicon, tandem cells harvest both high-energy and low-energy photons efficiently.
q: The student wants to explain the mechanical advantage of tandem solar cells over single-layer silicon cells. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?
opts: Perovskite semiconductors feature bandgaps that can be adjusted anywhere between 1.2 and 2.3 eV in laboratory conditions.
Bandgap energy is measured in electron-volts and determines which wavelengths of light a semiconductor material can absorb.
Silicon semiconductors have a fixed bandgap of 1.1 eV, making them the standard material in photovoltaic manufacturing for decades.

By pairing an adjustable wide-bandgap perovskite top layer with an underlying silicon base, tandem cells absorb both high-energy and low-energy photons, overcoming the thermal energy losses of conventional silicon.
exp: Talabaning maqsadi: 'explain the mechanical advantage of tandem solar cells over single-layer silicon cells' (tandem hujayralarning bir qatlamli kremniyga nisbatan ustunligini tushuntirish). D variant tandem tizimi keng va tor oraliqlarni birlashtirib, yuqori va past energiyali fotonlarni birday yutishini va an'anaviy silikonning issiqlik yo'qotishini yengib o'tishini mukammal tushuntiradi. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B — faqat bandgap ta'rifini beradi; C — faqat silikon haqida; A — faqat perovskit haqida; solishtirma ustunlik faqat D da bor.
strat: SOLISHTIRMA USTUNLIK: Tandem + Silikon bilan qiyos + yechilgan muammo = Variant D.

pas: Early twentieth-century astronomers assumed that spiral nebulae were isolated clouds of interstellar gas and dust located within the perimeter of the Milky Way galaxy. In 1923, Edwin Hubble identified Cepheid variable stars within the Andromeda nebula and calculated its distance as nearly one million light-years away. ______, Hubble proved conclusively that spiral nebulae were entirely separate galaxies existing far beyond our own.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Hubble Andromeda tumanligidagi Sefeida yulduzlarini topdi va uning masofasi million yorug'lik yili ekanini hisobladi. Natijada / Buning oqibatida ('Consequently') Hubble bu tumanliklar Somon Yo'lidan ancha olisdagi butunlay mustaqil galaktikalar ekanini uzil-kesil isbotladi. Masofaning uzoqligi mustaqil galaktika degan xulosaga olib keladi (sabab-oqibat). To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C ('Previously' - avval) — o'tmishga qaytish yo'q, xulosa chiqarilyapti; D ('Nevertheless' - shunga qaramay) — qarama-qarshilik yo'q; B ('For example') — misol keltirilmayapti, buyuk kashfiyot xulosalanyapti.
strat: SABAB VA XULOSA: Hisoblangan masofa 1 million yorug'lik yili -> 'Consequently' (Natijada) mustaqil galaktikalar ekani isbotlandi.

skill: Linear inequalities in one or two variables
q: A drone logistics company charges an initial dispatch fee of $15 plus $1.25 per kilometer flown. A client has a maximum spending budget of $65 for a single package delivery. What is the maximum distance, in kilometers, the drone can fly without exceeding the client's budget?
exp: Tengsizlik tuzamiz: Jami to'lov \(15+1.25d\le 65\) bo'lishi lozim, bu yerda d — masofa. Dastlabki to'lov 15 ni ayiramiz: \(1.25d\le 50\). Ikkala tomonni 1.25 ga bo'lamiz: \(d\le \frac{50}{1.25}=40\) km. Demak, eng ko'pi bilan 40 km uchish mumkin. To'g'ri javob: C (40). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (35) — hisoblashda 15 ni ikki marta ayirish xatosi; A (50) — bazaviy to'lovni hisobga olmaslik tuzog'i; B (45) — yaxlitlashdagi xato variant.
strat: TEZ HISOBLASH: \(\frac{50}{1.25}=\frac{50}{\frac{5}{4}}=50\cdot \frac{4}{5}=40\). 3 soniyada tayyor!

q: If \(4(2x-7)+5(x+3)=65\), what is the value of the expression \(3x-5\)?
exp: Qavslarni ochamiz: \(8x-28+5x+15=65\). O'xshash hadlarni jamlaymiz: \(13x-13=65\). 13 ni o'ng tomonga qo'shamiz: \(13x=78\) ⇒ \(x=6\). Savol \(x\) ni emas, \(3x-5\) ifodani so'ragan: \(3(6)-5=18-5=13\). To'g'ri javob: B (13). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C (6) — \(x\) ning o'zini shoshib belgilash klassik SAT tuzog'i; D (18) — 3x ning qiymati; A (21) — qo'shishdagi adashish natijasidagi xato variant.
strat: DIQQAT: Savol \(x\) ni emas, \(3x-5\) ni so'ramoqda! Desmosda \(x=6\) ni topib, darhol \(3(6)-5=13\) deb hisoblang.

skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
q: An art gallery sells large canvas prints for $120 each and small prints for $45 each. A collector purchases a total of 14 prints and spends exactly $1,080. How many large canvas prints did the collector purchase?
exp: Katta rasmlar L ta, kichiklari S ta bo'lsin. 1) \(L+S=14\) ⇒ \(S=14-L\). 2) \(120L+45S=1080\). O'rniga qo'yamiz: \(120L+45(14-L)=1080\) ⇒ \(120L+630-45L=1080\) ⇒ \(75L=450\) ⇒ \(L=6\) ta katta rasm. To'g'ri javob: A (6). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C (8) — kichik rasmlar sonini \((S=8)\) belgilab qo'yish tuzog'i; D (5) va B (9) — hisob-kitobdagi xato variantlar.
strat: DESMOS USULI: Desmosga \(x+y=14\) va \(120x+45y=1080\) ni kiriting. Kesishish nuqtasi (6, 8). Katta rasm \(x=6\)!

q: The linear equation \(8x-12=2(kx+5)\) has no real solution, where \(k\) is a constant. What is the value of \(k\)?
exp: O'ng tomonni ochamiz: \(8x-12=2kx+10\). Chiziqli tenglama yechimga ega bo'lmasligi (no solution) uchun \(x\) oldidagi koeffitsiyentlar teng, ozod hadlar esa turli bo'lishi shart: \(8=2k\) ⇒ \(k=4\). Ozod hadlar \(-12\ne 10\) bo'lgani uchun tenglama hech qachon bajarilmaydi. To'g'ri javob: B (4). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: \(C(-4)\) — ishorani adashtirish tuzog'i; A (8) — 2 ga bo'lishni unutish xatosi; D (2) — arifmetik yanglishishdagi xato variant.
strat: NO SOLUTION QOIDASI: \(x\) ning koeffitsiyentlari teng bo'lishi shart: \(8=2k\) ⇒ \(k=4\)!

skill: Linear inequalities in one or two variables
q: A theater sells adult admission tickets for $14 each and student tickets for $9 each. A community group has a maximum budget of $150 and must purchase at least 12 tickets in total. If \(x\) represents the number of adult tickets and \(y\) represents the number of student tickets, which system of inequalities represents this scenario?
exp: Masala tahlili va bosqichma-bosqich yechim: 1) Jami sarf 150 dollardan oshmasligi kerak (maximum budget): \(14x+9y\le 150\). 2) Jami biletlar soni kamida 12 ta bo'lishi shart (at least 12): \(x+y\ge 12\). Bu shartlar C variantda aynan to'g'ri ifodalangan. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A variantida tengsizlik ishoralari teskari qo'yilgan; D variantida \(x\) va \(y\) narxlari almashtirilgan; B variantida kamida 12 ta degan shart '\(x+y\le 12\)' deb xato yozilgan.
strat: KALIT SO'ZLAR: 'at most / maximum' = <= ; 'at least / minimum' = >=.

q: What is the sum of all real solutions to the absolute value equation \(|4x-6|=18\)?
exp: Ikkita holat: 1) \(4x-6=18\) ⇒ \(4x=24\) ⇒ \(x_{1}=6\). 2) \(4x-6=-18\) ⇒ \(4x=-12\) ⇒ \(x_{2}=-3\). Ildizlar yig'indisi: \(x_{1}+x_{2}=6+(-3)=3\). To'g'ri javob: D (3). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: \(B(-18)\) — modul qiymati bilan adashish; C (6) — faqat bitta musbat ildizni belgilab qo'yish tuzog'i; A (9) — ildizlarni noto'g'ri ayirishdagi xato variant.
strat: MODUL SIMMETRIYASI: \(|ax-b|=c\) ning ildizlari b/a markaziga nisbatan simmetrik. Yig'indi doimo \(2\cdot (\frac{b}{a})=2\cdot (\frac{6}{4})=3\) bo'ladi!

q: The graph of a linear function f passes through points (2, 11) and (5, 23) in the xy-plane. What is the value of \(f(9)\)?
exp: Chiziqli funksiya qiyaligi (slope): \(m=\frac{23-11}{5-2}=\frac{12}{3}=4\). Funksiya tenglamasi: \(f(x)-11=4(x-2)\) ⇒ \(f(x)=4x+3\). Endi \(x=9\) ni qo'yamiz: \(f(9)=4(9)+3=36+3=39\). To'g'ri javob: D (39). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A (36) — ozod had 3 ni qo'shishni unutish xatosi; B (41) va C (43) — hisoblashdagi xato variantlar.
strat: BOSQICHMA-BOSQICH QADAM: \(x\) har 3 ga oshganda \(y\) 12 ga oshyapti (har 1 birlik \(x\) uchun +4 \(y\)). \(x=5\) dan \(x=9\) gacha +4 qadam: \(23+4\cdot 4=39\)!

q: Line L1 passes through the points (1, 4) and (4, 13) in the xy-plane. Line L2 is parallel to line L1 and passes through the point (2, \(-1\)). What is the y-intercept of line L2?
exp: L1 ning qiyaligi: \(m=\frac{13-4}{4-1}=\frac{9}{3}=3\). Parallel to'g'ri chiziqlarning qiyaliklari teng bo'ladi, shuning uchun L2 ning ham \(m=3\). L2 (2, \(-1\)) nuqtadan o'tadi: \(y-(-1)=3(x-2)\) ⇒ \(y+1=3x-6\) ⇒ \(y=3x-7\). y-kesishma nuqtasi \((x=0)\): (0, \(-7\)). To'g'ri javob: B. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (0, 7) — ishorani teskari olishdagi tuzoq; A (0, \(-1\)) — berilgan nuqtani y-kesishma deb o'ylash xatosi; C (0, \(-5\)) — arifmetik xato.
strat: PARALLEL TO'G'RI CHIZIQ: \(m=3\). \(y=3x+b\) da (2, \(-1\)) qo'ying: \(-1=6+b\) ⇒ \(b=-7\). Kesishma: (0, \(-7\)).

q: In the xy-plane, line j is defined by the equation \(2x+5y=15\). If line \(k\) is perpendicular to line j, what is the slope of line \(k\)?
exp: Line j ni \(y=mx+b\) ko'rinishiga keltiramiz: \(5y=-2x+15\) ⇒ \(y=(-\frac{2}{5})x+3\). Line j ning qiyaligi \(m_{1}=-\frac{2}{5}\). Perpendikulyar to'g'ri chiziqning qiyaligi teskari va qarama-qarshi ishorali bo'ladi (negative reciprocal): \(m_{2}=-\frac{1}{m_{1}}=-\frac{1}{-\frac{2}{5}}=\frac{5}{2}\). To'g'ri javob: \(B(\frac{5}{2})\). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: \(A(-\frac{2}{5})\) — parallel chiziq qiyaligini belgilash tuzog'i; \(C(-\frac{5}{2})\) — ishorani almashtirishni unutish xatosi; \(D(\frac{2}{5})\) — to'ntarishni unutishdagi xato variant.
strat: PERPENDIKULYAR QOIDASI: Kasrni to'ntaring va ishorasini teskari qiling: \(-\frac{2}{5}\) → +\(\frac{5}{2}\)!

q: Two cyclists start from the exact same trailhead at the same time and travel in opposite directions along a straight path. Cyclist A travels at a constant speed of 14 miles per hour, while Cyclist B travels at a constant speed of 18 miles per hour. After how many hours will the two cyclists be exactly 80 miles apart?
exp: Qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda harakatlanayotgani sababli ularning bir-biridan uzoqlashish tezligi qo'shiladi: v_nisbiy = \(14+18=32\) mil/soat. Masofa 80 mil bo'lishi uchun vaqt: \(t\) = Masofa / v_nisbiy = \(\frac{80}{32}=\frac{5}{2}=2.5\) soat. To'g'ri javob: A (2.5). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (2.0) — tezliklarni ayirib hisoblash xatosi; C (3.0) va D (3.5) — noto'g'ri bo'lishdagi chalg'ituvchi variantlar.
strat: HARAKAT TENGLAMASI: \(14t+18t=80\) ⇒ \(32t=80\) ⇒ \(t=\frac{80}{32}=2.5\) soat.

q: What is the maximum value of the quadratic function \(f(x)=-3(x-4)^{2}+27\)?
exp: Funksiya cho'qqi ko'rinishida (vertex form) berilgan: \(f(x)=a(x-h)^{2}+k\). Bu yerda \(a=-3<0\) bo'lgani uchun parabola pastga qaragan va o'zining eng katta (maksimal) qiymatiga cho'qqisida erishadi: \(k=27\) (\(x\) = 4 bo'lganda). To'g'ri javob: C (27). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (4) — maksimum nuqtani (\(x\) koordinatani) qiymat deb adashib belgilash tuzog'i; \(A(-3)\) — a koeffitsiyenti; \(D(-27)\) — ishorani teskari olishdagi xato variant.
strat: VERTEX FORM: \(y=a(x-h)^{2}+k\) da maksimum/minimum qiymat doimo \(k\) ning o'zidir \((k=27)\)!

q: The quadratic equation \(x^{2}-10x+21=0\) has two distinct real solutions, \(p\) and \(q\), where \(p>q\). What is the value of \(p-q\)?
exp: Kvadrat tenglamani ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: \((x-7)(x-3)=0\). Ildizlar: \(x=7\) va \(x=3\). Shart bo'yicha \(p>q\), demak \(p=7\) va \(q=3\). Ayirma: \(p-q=7-3=4\). To'g'ri javob: 4.
strat: DESMOS USULI: Desmosda \(y=x^{2}-10x+21\) ni kiritib x-kesishmalarini ko'ring: (3, 0) va (7, 0). Masofa: \(7-3=4\).

q: For what integer value of constant \(c\) does the quadratic equation \(x^{2}-6x+c=0\) have two distinct real solutions?
exp: Ikkita turli haqiqiy ildizga ega bo'lishi uchun diskriminant noldan qat'iy katta bo'lishi shart \((A>0)\): \(D=b^{2}-4ac=(-6)^{2}-4(1)(c)=36-4c>0\). \(4c<36\) ⇒ \(c<9\). Variantlar orasida 9 dan kichik bo'lgan yagona butun son 7 dir. To'g'ri javob: D (7). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C (9) — \(D=0\) bo'lib bitta ildiz beradi; B (12) va A (15) — \(A<0\) bo'lib haqiqiy ildiz bermaydi (noto'g'ri variantlar).
strat: DISKRIMINANT QOIDASI: Ikkita haqiqiy yechim → \(A>0\). \(c<9\) bo'lishi kerak, faqat D (7) to'g'ri!

q: In the xy-plane, the circle C is defined by the equation \((x-5)^{2}+(y+2)^{2}=49\). The horizontal line \(y=5\) intersects circle C at how many distinct points?
exp: Aylana markazi (\(h\), \(k\)) = (5, \(-2\)), radiusi esa \(r=\sqrt{49}=7\) ga teng. Gorizontal to'g'ri chiziq \(y=5\) aylananing markazidan vertikal ravishda \(d=|5-(-2)|=7\) birlik masofada joylashgan. Masofa aylananing radiusiga teng bo'lgani sababli \((d=r=7)\), chiziq aylanaga urinadi (tangent) va uni aynan 1 ta nuqtada (5, 5) kesib o'tadi. To'g'ri javob: A (Exactly 1). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (Exactly 2) — chiziq aylanani ikkita joydan kesadi deb o'ylash; C (0) — kesishmaydi deb adashish; D — to'g'ri chiziq aylanani cheksiz nuqtada kesa olmaydi.
strat: DESMOS USULI: Desmosda \((x-5)^{2}+(y+2)^{2}=49\) va \(y=5\) ni kiriting. To'g'ri chiziq aylananing eng yuqori uchiga urinib o'tishini ko'rasiz — aynan 1 ta nuqta!

q: A medical researcher models the concentration of an antibiotic in a patient's bloodstream using the function \(C(t)=180\cdot (0.72)^{\frac{t}{6}}\), where \(C(t)\) is the concentration in micrograms per milliliter \(t\) hours after administration. By what percentage does the antibiotic concentration decrease every 6 hours?
exp: Eksponensial kamayish modelida har 6 soat o'tganda (\(\frac{t}{6}\) ko'rsatkichi 1 ga oshganda) konsentratsiya 0.72 koeffitsiyentiga ko'paytiriladi. Bu dastlabki miqdorning 72% qismi qolishini bildiradi. Demak, kamayish foizi: 100% \(-72\)% = 28%. To'g'ri javob: A (28%). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (72%) — qolgan miqdorni kamayish ulushi deb chalkashtirish klassik SAT tuzog'i; C (18%) — boshlang'ich konsentratsiyadagi 180 soni bilan adashish; D (12%) — noto'g'ri hisob-kitob.
strat: FOIZ KAMAYISHI QOIDASI: Kamayish foizi = 1 - asos = \(1-0.72=0.28\), ya'ni 28%!

q: When the polynomial \(f(x)=x^{3}-4x^{2}+7x-5\) is divided by \((x-2)\), what is the remainder?
exp: Polinom qoldiq teoremasi (Remainder Theorem): \(f(x)\) ni \((x-c)\) ga bo'lgandagi qoldiq \(f(c)\) ga teng. Bu yerda \(c=2\). \(x=2\) ni qo'yamiz: \(f(2)=(2)^{3}-4(2)^{2}+7(2)-5=8-16+14-5=1\). To'g'ri javob: B (1). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (5) — ozod hadni adashtirish; \(A(-1)\) — hisoblashdagi ishora xatosi; C (9) — darajalarni xato hisoblashdagi noto'g'ri variant.
strat: POLINOM QOIDASI: \(f(x)\) ni \((x-2)\) ga bo'lish uchun \(x=2\) ni funksiyaga qo'yish kifoya!

q: A business computer system depreciates in monetary value according to the model \(V(t)=2{,}400\cdot (0.85)^{t}\), where \(V(t)\) is the estimated value in dollars \(t\) years after purchase. By what percentage does the computer system's value decrease each year?
exp: Eksponensial kamayish modeli: \(V(t)=V_{0}\cdot (1-r)^{t}\), bu yerda \(r\) — yillik kamayish foizi. Asos 0.85 ga teng: \(1-r=0.85\) ⇒ \(r=0.15\), ya'ni har yili 15% ga kamayadi. To'g'ri javob: D (15%). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C (85%) — qolgan qiymat ulushini kamayish foizi deb adashish klassik SAT tuzog'i; A (24%) — boshlang'ich narxdagi son bilan adashish; B (1.5%) — vergul siljishi xatosi.
strat: SAT KONSEPSIYASI: Kamayish foizi = 1 - asos = \(1-0.85=0.15\) (15%)!

q: If \(x\) and \(y\) are positive real numbers such that the expression \(\frac{x^{\frac{5}{2}}\cdot y^{-\frac{1}{3}}}{\left(x^{3}\cdot y^{-\frac{4}{3}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}}\) is equivalent to \(x^{a}\cdot y^{b}\), what is the value of the product \(a\cdot b\)?
exp: Kasr maxrajini soddalashtiramiz: \(\left(x^{3}\cdot y^{-\frac{4}{3}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}=x^{\frac{3}{2}}\cdot y^{-\frac{2}{3}}\). Endi suratni maxrajga bo'lamiz: \(x\) ning darajasi \(a=\frac{5}{2}-\frac{3}{2}=\frac{2}{2}=1\). \(y\) ning darajasi \(b=-\frac{1}{3}-(-\frac{2}{3})=-\frac{1}{3}+\frac{2}{3}=\frac{1}{3}\). Ko'paytma qiymati: \(a\cdot b=1\cdot (\frac{1}{3})=\frac{1}{3}\). To'g'ri javob: \(B(\frac{1}{3})\). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: \(D(\frac{2}{3})\) — darajalarni qo'shib yuborishdagi xato; C (1) — faqat a qiymatini belgilash tuzog'i; \(A(-\frac{1}{6})\) — ishoralarni noto'g'ri ko'paytirish xatosi.
strat: DARAJA QOIDALARI: \((x^{m})^{n}=x^{m\cdot n}\) va \(\frac{x^{m}}{x^{n}}=x^{m-n}\). Bosqichma-bosqich hisoblang: \(a=1\), \(b=\frac{1}{3}\) ⇒ \(ab=\frac{1}{3}\)!
