q: A civil engineer models the parabolic cable of a suspension footbridge using the function \(h(x)=0.04(x-25)^{2}+8\), where \(h(x)\) is the height of the cable in meters above the water and \(x\) is the horizontal distance in meters from the western anchorage \((0\le x\le 50)\). What is the minimum height, in meters, of the cable above the water?
exp: Parabola cho'qqi formulasida (vertex form) berilgan: \(h(x)=a(x-h)^{2}+k\). Bu yerda \(a=0.04>0\) bo'lgani sababli parabolaning shoxlari yuqoriga qaragan va kabel o'zining eng past (minimum) balandligiga cho'qqi nuqtasida erishadi: \(k=8\) metr (\(x=25\) metr masofada). To'g'ri javob: 8.
strat: VERTEX SHAKLI: \(h(x)=a(x-25)^{2}+8\) da eng kichik qiymat to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ozod had \(k=8\) bo'ladi!

q: In the xy-plane, what is the minimum point of the parabola defined by the function \(h(x)=x^{2}+8x+23\)?
exp: To'la kvadratga ajratamiz: \(h(x)=(x^{2}+8x+16)+23-16=(x+4)^{2}+7\). Parabolaning cho'qqisi: (\(-4\), 7). Parabola yuqoriga qaragan \((a=1>0)\), shuning uchun cho'qqi minimum nuqtadir. To'g'ri javob: B ((-4, 7)). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A ((4, 7)) — ishorani adashtirish klassik tuzog'i; C ((-4, 23)) — y-koordinatani to'g'rilamaslik xatosi; D — koeffitsiyentlarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri olishdagi xato variant.
strat: DESMOS: \(y=x^{2}+8x+23\) ni kiriting va eng pastki nuqtani bosing: (\(-4\), 7).

q: For all positive values of \(x\), which of the following expressions is equivalent to \(\frac{x^{\frac{3}{4}}\cdot x^{\frac{1}{2}}}{x^{\frac{1}{4}}}\)?
exp: Daraja qoidalarini qo'llaymiz: Bir xil asosli sonlar ko'paytirilganda darajalar qo'shiladi, bo'linganda ayiriladi: Daraja = \(\frac{3}{4}+\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{4}=\frac{3}{4}+\frac{2}{4}-\frac{1}{4}=\frac{4}{4}=1\). Demak \(x^{1}=x\). To'g'ri javob: D (\(x\)). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: \(A(x^{2})\) — qo'shishda xato qilish; \(B(x^{\frac{3}{8}})\) — darajalarni ko'paytirib yuborishdagi qo'pol xato; \(C(x^{\frac{5}{4}})\) — maxrajdagi darajani ayirishni unutish tuzog'i.
strat: DARAJA QOIDASI: \(x^{a}\cdot \frac{x^{b}}{x^{c}}=x^{a+b-c}\). \(\frac{3}{4}+\frac{2}{4}-\frac{1}{4}=1\).

q: The polynomial function \(p\) is defined by \(p(x)=x^{3}-5x^{2}-4x+20\). Which of the following is NOT an x-intercept of the graph of \(p\) in the xy-plane?
exp: Guruhlash usuli bilan ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: \(p(x)=x^{2}(x-5)-4(x-5)=(x^{2}-4)(x-5)=(x-2)(x+2)(x-5)\). Funksiyaning nollari (x-kesishmalari): \(x=2\), \(x=-2\) va \(x=5\). Demak (2, 0), (\(-2\), 0) va (5, 0) kesishmalar hisoblanadi. (4, 0) esa kesishma emas \((p(4)=64-80-16+20=-12\ne 0)\). To'g'ri javob: D ((4, 0)). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A, B va C haqiqiy kesishmalar bo'lgani sababli savol shartiga ('NOT an x-intercept') mos kelmaydi.
strat: VARIANTLARNI QO'YIB KO'RISH: \(p(4)=4^{3}-5(16)-4(4)+20=64-80-16+20=-12\ne 0\). Demak (4, 0) x-kesishma emas!

q: A clinical trial evaluated a therapeutic drug on 100 participants. Among the 50 participants receiving the drug (Group A), 35 improved and 15 did not. Among the 50 participants receiving a placebo (Group B), 20 improved and 30 did not. If a participant who improved is chosen at random, what is the probability that this participant received the drug (Group A)?
exp: Shartli ehtimollik: 'If a participant who improved is chosen at random...' sharti maxraj faqat yaxshilanganlar soni bo'lishini bildiradi: Jami yaxshilanganlar = 35 (Group A) + 20 (Group B) = 55. Ularning ichidan preparat qabul qilganlar soni = 35. Ehtimollik = \(\frac{35}{55}=\frac{7}{11}\). To'g'ri javob: \(A(\frac{7}{11})\). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: \(B(\frac{35}{50})\) — Group A ning jami soniga bo'lish xatosi; \(C(\frac{35}{100})\) — barcha 100 qatnashchiga bo'lish tuzog'i; \(D(\frac{1}{2})\) — guruhlarni teng deb yanglishish.
strat: SHARTLI EHTIMOLLIK: 'Given that...' yoki 'If a participant who improved...' so'zlari maxrajni faqat yaxshilanganlar \((35+20=55)\) ga cheklaydi!

q: An investment fund gained 30% in its first fiscal year and subsequently declined by 10% in its second fiscal year. What was the overall percentage change of the fund across the two-year period?
exp: Multiplikator usuli: 1) 30% o'sish: 1.30. 2) 10% pasayish: \(1-0.10=0.90\). Yakuniy multiplikator: \(1.30\cdot 0.90=1.17\). 1.17 bu dastlabki qiymatga nisbatan 17% o'sish demakdir \((1.17-1=0.17)\). To'g'ri javob: C (17% increase). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (20% increase) — 30% \(-10\)% = 20% deb foizlarni shunchaki ayirib yuborishdagi eng mashhur SAT tuzog'i; A (23%) va B (15%) — hisoblashdagi xato variantlar.
strat: 100 QOIDASI: Dastlab $100 bo'lsa: 30% oshgach $130 bo'ladi. $130 ning 10%i = $13. $130 - $13 = $117. Jami o'sish: 17%!

q: A small software startup employs 8 engineers with salaries ranging from $40,000 to $60,000. When a new chief executive officer is hired with an annual salary of $350,000, which summary statistic of the employee compensation dataset increases by the greatest percentage?
exp: O'rtacha arifmetik qiymat (mean) anomal katta qiymatga (outlier $350,000) favqulodda sezgir va keskin ko'tariladi. Mediana esa o'rtadagi 1-2 ta qiymatning o'rniga qaraydi va juda kam miqdorda siljiydi. Shuning uchun eng katta foizli o'sish o'rtacha qiymatda (mean) ro'y beradi. To'g'ri javob: A. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D — medianani sezgir deb yanglishish tuzog'i; B va C — statistik parametrlarning xususiyatlariga zid xato variantlar.
strat: SAT STATISTIKA QOIDASI: Ekstremal anomal qiymatlar (outliers) har doim o'rtacha qiymatni (mean) medianaga nisbatan ancha kuchli siljitadi!

q: A researcher conducts a public opinion survey and determines a margin of error of 4% at a 95% confidence level. If the researcher wants to conduct a follow-up survey of the same population with a margin of error of 2% at the same confidence level, by what factor must the sample size be multiplied?
exp: Xatolik chegarasi (margin of error) tanlanma hajmining kvadrat ildiziga teskari proportsional: ME = \(z\cdot \sqrt{\frac{p(1-p)}{n}}\). Xatolikni 2 barobar kamaytirish uchun (4% dan 2% ga) tanlanma hajmi \(n\) roppa-rosa \(2^{2}=4\) barobarga oshirilishi shart. To'g'ri javob: 4.
strat: SAMPLE SIZE FORMULASI: Xatolikni \(k\) marta kamaytirish uchun tanlanma sonini \(k^{2}\) marta oshirish kerak: \(2^{2}=4\) marta!

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: A municipal water pump operates at a steady flow rate of 180 liters per minute. What is the flow rate of the pump in milliliters per second? (1 liter = 1,000 milliliters, 1 minute = 60 seconds)
exp: Birliklarni bosqichma-bosqich o'zgartiramiz: 180 litr / minut = (\(180\cdot 1{,}000\) ml) / (60 soniya) = 180,000 ml / 60 soniya = 3,000 ml/soniya. To'g'ri javob: D (3,000). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C (18,000) — 60 o'rniga 10 ga bo'lish xatosi; B (300) — 1,000 o'rniga 100 ga ko'paytirish tuzog'i; A (10,800) — bo'lish o'rniga 60 ga ko'paytirib yuborishdagi xato variant.
strat: BIRLIKLAR ZANJIRI: (180 \(\frac{L}{1}\) min) * (1000 mL / 1 L) * (1 min / 60 s) = 180000 / 60 = 3000 mL/s.

q: A pediatric study calculates a linear correlation coefficient of \(r=-0.89\) between daily recreational screen hours and nighttime sleep duration in adolescents. Which of the following is the most valid interpretation of this statistic?
opts: There is a weak positive linear association between the two variables.
Exactly 89% of adolescents experience inadequate sleep duration.
There is a strong negative linear association between daily screen time and sleep duration.
Daily screen time causes adolescents to experience lower sleep duration.
exp: \(r=-0.89\) qiymati noldan ancha uzoq va \(-1\) ga yaqin bo'lgani uchun bu kuchli manfiy chiziqli bog'liqlikni (strong negative linear association) anglatadi. To'g'ri javob: C. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D — korrelyatsiya sabab-oqibatni (causation) isbotlamaydi, shuning uchun 'causes' so'zi statistik jihatdan xato; A — musbat emas, manfiy; B — 89% o'smirlar degan raqamli foiz matnga aloqador emas.
strat: SAT KONSEPSIYASI: 'Correlation does NOT imply causation' (Korrelyatsiya sababiyatni anglatmaydi). 'Causes' so'zi bo'lgan variantlar deyarli har doim noto'g'ri!

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: In a school science laboratory, the ratio of test tubes to glass beakers is 7 to 4. If the laboratory contains 84 test tubes, how many glass beakers are in the laboratory?
exp: Proporsiya tuzamiz: Prozkalar / Menzurkalar = \(\frac{7}{4}\). \(\frac{84}{B}=\frac{7}{4}\). Birlikka to'g'ri keluvchi miqdor: \(\frac{84}{7}=12\). Demak menzurkalar soni: \(12\cdot 4=48\) ta. To'g'ri javob: B (48). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (56) — noto'g'ri proporsiya; C (36) — 84 ni 7 ga emas, 9 ga bo'lish xatosi; A (64) — hisob-kitobdagi adashish natijasidagi xato variant.
strat: PROPORSIONALLIK: 7 qism = 84 bo'lsa, 1 qism = 12. 4 qism = \(4\cdot 12=48\)!

q: A student's course grade is calculated using a weighted average: Homework is weighted at 20%, the Midterm Exam at 30%, and the Final Exam at 50%. If the student earns 90 on Homework, 80 on the Midterm Exam, and 86 on the Final Exam, what is the student's final weighted course score?
exp: Vaznli o'rtacha qiymatni hisoblaymiz: Jami ball = \((0.20\cdot 90)+(0.30\cdot 80)+(0.50\cdot 86)=18+24+43=85\) ball. To'g'ri javob: D (85). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (86) — ballarning oddiy arifmetik o'rtachasini olishga yaqin adashish; C (84) va A (88) — vaznlarni ko'paytirishdagi hisoblash xatolari.

q: In a college cohort, 60% of students live in university dormitory halls. Of those students residing in dormitories, 45% participate in campus club sports. What percentage of the entire college cohort lives in dormitories AND participates in club sports?
exp: Foizning foizini hisoblaymiz: Jami talabalarning 60% yotoqxonada yashaydi (0.60). Ularning 45%i sport bilan shug'ullanadi (0.45). Jami ulush: \(0.60\cdot 0.45=0.27\), ya'ni 27%. To'g'ri javob: D (27%). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (52.5%) — foizlarni qo'shib 2 ga bo'lish xatosi; C (15%) — 60% dan 45% ni ayirib qo'yishdagi qo'pol tuzoq; A (30%) — noo'rin yaxlitlashdagi xato variant.
strat: FOIZNING FOIZI: \(0.60\cdot 0.45=0.27\) (27%). Ko'paytirish orqali darhol topiladi!

q: The relationship between daily maximum temperature \(x\), in degrees Celsius, and bottled iced tea sales \(y\), in bottles, at an amusement park is modeled by the line of best fit \(\hat{y}=1.8x+14.5\). Based on this model, what is the predicted number of iced tea bottles sold on a day when the maximum temperature reaches 30 degrees Celsius?
exp: Model formulasiga \(x=30\) ni qo'yamiz: \(\hat{y}=1.8(30)+14.5=54+14.5=68.5\) shisha. To'g'ri javob: B (68.5). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A (54.0) — ozod had 14.5 ni qo'shishni unutish xatosi; C (65.0) va D (72.5) — 1.8 ga noto'g'ri ko'paytirishdagi chalg'ituvchi xato variantlar.
strat: HISOBLASH: \(1.8\cdot 30=54\). \(54+14.5=68.5\). 5 soniyada tayyor!

q: In the xy-plane, what are the center coordinates and radius of the circle defined by the equation \((x-5)^{2}+(y+2)^{2}=49\)?
exp: Aylananing standart tenglamasi: \((x-h)^{2}+(y-k)^{2}=r^{2}\). Bu yerda \(h=5\), \(k=-2\) bo'lgani uchun markaz (5, \(-2\)) da joylashgan. \(r^{2}=49\) bo'lgani sababli radius \(r=\sqrt{49}=7\) bo'ladi. To'g'ri javob: C. Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: A — markaz koordinatalarining ishoralarini teskari olish klassik tuzog'i; B va D — \(r^{2}\) ni radius deb adashish xatosi.
strat: ISHORA VA RADIUS: \((x-h)\) da markaz +\(h\), \((y+k)\) da markaz \(-k\) bo'ladi. Radius esa \(\sqrt{49}=7\)!

q: A circle has a radius of 8 centimeters. A sector on the circle subtends a central angle of \(\frac{3\pi }{4}\) radians. What is the area of this sector, in square centimeters?
exp: Sektor yuzi formulasi (radianlarda): Area = \((\frac{1}{2})\cdot r^{2}\) * theta. Bu yerda \(r=8\) va theta = \(\frac{3\pi }{4}\). Area = \((\frac{1}{2})\cdot (8)^{2}\cdot (\frac{3\pi }{4})=(\frac{1}{2})\cdot 64\cdot (\frac{3\pi }{4})=32\cdot (\frac{3\pi }{4})=8\cdot 3\pi =24\pi\) sm^2. To'g'ri javob: D (24pi). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C (48pi) — \(\frac{1}{2}\) koeffitsiyentini unutish xatosi; B (12pi) — radiusni kvadratga ko'tarmaslik tuzog'i; A (64pi) — butun doira yuzasini belgilashdagi xato variant.
strat: SEKTOR YUZI FORMULASI: Area = \(0.5\cdot r^{2}\) * theta = \(0.5\cdot 64\cdot (\frac{3\pi }{4})=24\pi\).

q: In an isosceles right triangle, the length of the hypotenuse is \(16\cdot \sqrt{2}\). What is the length of each leg?
exp: Teng yonli to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak \((45-45-90)\) qoidasiga ko'ra, gipotenuza katetdan \(\sqrt{2}\) barobar katta: Gipotenuza = Katet * \(\sqrt{2}\). Demak, Katet = Gipotenuza / \(\sqrt{2}=\frac{16\cdot \sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{2}}=16\). To'g'ri javob: 16.
strat: 45-45-90 UCHBURCHAK QOIDASI: Tomonlar nisbati 1 : 1 : \(\sqrt{2}\). Gipotenuza \(16\cdot \sqrt{2}\) bo'lsa, katetlar 16 ga teng!

q: In right triangle XYZ, angle Z measures 90 degrees. The length of the side opposite angle X is 15, and the length of the side adjacent to angle X is 8. What is the value of \(\tan(X)\)?
exp: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda tangens ta'rifi: \(\tan(X)\) = Qarama-qarshi katet / Yopishgan katet (Opposite / Adjacent). Bu yerda Opposite = 15 va Adjacent = 8. Shuning uchun \(\tan(X)=\frac{15}{8}\). To'g'ri javob: \(C(\frac{15}{8})\). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: \(D(\frac{8}{15})\) — kasrni to'ntarib kotangensni belgilash tuzog'i; \(B(\frac{15}{17})\) — \(\sin(X)\) ning qiymati (Opposite / Hypotenuse); \(A(\frac{8}{17})\) — \(\cos(X)\) ning qiymati.
strat: SOH CAH TOA: TOA → Tan = Opposite / Adjacent = \(\frac{15}{8}\)!

q: A solid rectangular storage container has a base length of 12 centimeters, a base width of 5 centimeters, and a vertical height of 8 centimeters. What is the total volume of the container in cubic centimeters?
exp: To'g'ri burchakli parallelepiped hajmi formulasi: V = Uzunlik * Kenglik * Balandlik = \(12\cdot 5\cdot 8=60\cdot 8=480\) sm^3. To'g'ri javob: D (480). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: C (240) — piramida formulasi deb adashib 2 ga bo'lish xatosi; A (392) — to'liq sirt maydoni (surface area) bilan adashtirish klassik tuzog'i; B (520) — ko'paytirishdagi arifmetik xato.
strat: HAJM: \(V=l\cdot w\cdot h=12\cdot 5\cdot 8=480\).

q: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF, where vertices A, B, and C correspond to D, E, and F, respectively. Side AB has a length of 9, and corresponding side DE has a length of 21. If the area of triangle ABC is 36 square units, what is the area of triangle DEF in square units?
exp: O'xshashlik koeffitsiyenti: \(k\) = DE / AB = \(\frac{21}{9}=\frac{7}{3}\). O'xshash figuralarning maydonlari nisbati o'xshashlik koeffitsiyentining kvadratiga teng \((k^{2})\): Area(DEF) = Area(ABC) * \(k^{2}=36\cdot \left(\frac{7}{3}\right)^{2}=36\cdot (\frac{49}{9})=4\cdot 49=196\) kvadrat birlik. To'g'ri javob: A (196). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: B (84) — maydonni \(k\) ga (kvadratsiz) ko'paytirib qo'yish tuzog'\(i(36\cdot \frac{7}{3}=84)\); C (144) va D (252) — noto'g'ri hisoblashdagi xato variantlar.
strat: MAYDON NISBATI: Tomonlar nisbati \(\frac{7}{3}\) bo'lsa, maydonlar nisbati \(\left(\frac{7}{3}\right)^{2}=\frac{49}{9}\). \(36\cdot \frac{49}{9}=4\cdot 49=196\)!

q: In a circle, an inscribed angle intercepts an arc measuring 130 degrees. What is the measure, in degrees, of the inscribed angle?
exp: Aylanaga ichki chizilgan burchak (inscribed angle) o'zi tiralgan yoy o'lchovining yarmiga teng: Burchak = Yoy / \(2=\frac{130}{2}=65\) gradus. To'g'ri javob: A (65). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (130) — markaziy burchak bilan adashtirish klassik tuzog'i; B (260) — 2 ga ko'paytirib yuborish xatosi; C (50) — 180 dan ayirishdagi noto'g'ri variant.
strat: ICHKI CHIZILGAN BURCHAK: Ichki chizilgan burchak = Yoy / \(2=\frac{130}{2}=65^{\circ}\). Markaziy burchak esa yoyga teng bo'ladi!

q: A right circular cone has a base radius of 6 centimeters and a vertical height of 10 centimeters. What is the total volume of the cone, in cubic centimeters?
exp: Konus hajmi formulasi: \(V=(\frac{1}{3})\cdot \pi \cdot r^{2}\cdot h\). Bu yerda \(r=6\) va \(h=10\). \(V=(\frac{1}{3})\cdot \pi \cdot (6)^{2}\cdot 10=(\frac{1}{3})\cdot \pi \cdot 36\cdot 10=12\cdot 10\cdot \pi =120\pi\) sm^3. To'g'ri javob: A (120pi). Noto'g'ri variantlar tahlili: D (360pi) — silindr deb adashib \(\frac{1}{3}\) koeffitsiyentini unutish tuzog'i; B (60pi) — radiusni kvadratga ko'tarmaslik xatosi; C (40pi) — arifmetik xato variant.
strat: KONUS HAJMI: \(V=(\frac{1}{3})\cdot \pi \cdot r^{2}\cdot h=(\frac{1}{3})\cdot \pi \cdot 36\cdot 10=120\pi\).

pas: For decades, the standard narrative in paleoclimatology held that the Younger Dryas cooling event was triggered exclusively by a catastrophic glacial meltwater outburst. Recent sediment cores, however, reveal a far more ______ picture, suggesting that atmospheric circulation shifts and volcanic aerosols played equally decisive roles.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A (nuanced).

Matn tahlili:
Matnda avval Younger Dryas sovuqlashuv davri faqat bitta sabab ('exclusively by a catastrophic meltwater outburst') bilan izohlangani, biroq yangi cho'kindi jinslar qatlamlari ('Recent sediment cores, however...') ko'plab omillar (atmosfera oqimlari, vulqon aerozollari) teng rol o'ynaganini ko'rsatayotgani aytilmoqda. Demak, yangi manzara bir yoqlama emas, balki murakkabroq, ko'p qirrali ('nuanced') hisoblanadi.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) nuanced - nozik qirralari ko'p, murakkab va batafsil (to'g'ri).
C) redundant - ortiqcha, keraksiz takrorlanuvchi (kontekstga mos emas).
B) precarious - xavfli, beqaror (manzaraning beqarorligi haqida gap ketmayapti).
D) prosaic - oddiy, jo'n, zerikarli (ko'p omilli murakkab rasm jo'n bo'la olmaydi).
strat: READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

pas: While the novelist's earlier works were celebrated for their sprawling plots and effusive prose, her latest novella is remarkably ______; every sentence is stripped of ornamentation, delivering emotional impact through stark austerity.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C (laconic).

Matn tahlili:
Muallifning oldingi asarlari so'zamol, keng qamrovli ('sprawling plots and effusive prose') bo'lgan bo'lsa, 'while' qarshilantiruvchi bog'lovchisi orqali yangi qissasi buning aksi ekani aytilmoqda: har bir jumla bezaklardan xoli ('stripped of ornamentation') va qat'iy vazminlik ('stark austerity') orqali ta'sir ko'rsatadi. Bu ixcham, kamso'z va lo'nda ma'nosidagi 'laconic' so'ziga to'liq mos keladi.

Variantlar tahlili:
C) laconic - lo'nda, qisqa va mazmunli (to'g'ri).
A) derivative - birovdan ko'chirilgan, o'ziga xos bo'lmagan.
B) ostentatious - ko'z-ko'z qiluvchi, dabdabali (effusive bilan sinonim bo'lib, ziddiyat hosil qilmaydi).
D) erratic - tartibsiz, oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan.
strat: READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

pas: Biomimetic engineers frequently look to marine organisms for inspiration; the hydrodynamic efficiency of the boxfish, for instance, has ______ automotive designers seeking to reduce aerodynamic drag in fuel-efficient vehicles.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A (guided).

Matn tahlili:
Muhandislar dengiz jonzotlaridan ilhom oladi ('look to marine organisms for inspiration'). Masalan, qutichali baliqning gidrodinamik samaradorligi avtomobil konstruktorlariga aerodinamik qarshilikni kamaytirishda yo'l ko'rsatgan / turtki bergan ('guided').

Variantlar tahlili:
A) guided - yo'naltirgan, ilhom bergan (to'g'ri).
B) deterred - to'sqinlik qilgan, qaytargan (qarama-qarshi ma'no).
D) obscured - qorong'ilashtirgan, yashirgan.
C) reproached - ayblagan, tanbeh bergan.
strat: READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

pas: The anthropologist cautioned that attempting to reconstruct ancient kinship networks exclusively from mortuary arrangements is fundamentally ______; funerary rituals often express idealized aspirations rather than mirror mundane social realities.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C (tenuous).

Matn tahlili:
Antropolog qabrlarni dafn etish odatlaridan qadimiy qarindoshlik tizimini tiklash xatarli/mo'rt ekanidan ogohlantirmoqda, chunki dafn marosimlari kundalik ijtimoiy haqiqatni emas, balki ideallashtirilgan niyatlarni ifodalaydi. Shuning uchun bunday xulosalar zaif, asossiz yoki omonat ('tenuous') bo'ladi.

Variantlar tahlili:
C) tenuous - zaif, mo'rt, yetarlicha asoslanmagan (to'g'ri).
D) imperious - buyruqboz, takabbur.
A) unimpeachable - shubhasiz, mukammal (kontekstga teskari).
B) salutary - foydali, shifobaxsh.
strat: READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

pas: Rather than clinging rigidly to outdated behavioral models, contemporary evolutionary psychologists acknowledge that cognitive adaptations are highly ______: their developmental expression can shift dynamically depending on socioecological cues.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D (plastic).

Matn tahlili:
Qattiq qolipga yopishmasdan ('Rather than clinging rigidly...'), zamonaviy tadqiqotchilar kognitiv moslashuvlarning o'zgaruvchan, moslashuvchan ekanini ('shift dynamically depending on socioecological cues') tan olishadi. Biologiya va psixologiyada muhitga qarab moslashuvchanlik xususiyati 'plastic' (plastiklik, egiluvchanlik) atamasi bilan ifodalanadi.

Variantlar tahlili:
D) plastic - moslashuvchan, o'zgaruvchan (to'g'ri).
A) intractable - bo'ysunmas, qaysar, o'zgarmas.
C) obsolete - eskirgan, o'z kuchini yo'qotgan.
B) dogmatic - qotib qolgan aqidaparast.
strat: READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

pas: Although the treaty was ______ celebrated as a watershed moment for international conservation, independent observers noted that it lacked enforceable mechanisms to penalize noncompliant signatories.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A (ostensibly).

Matn tahlili:
Shartnoma tashqi ko'rinishidan / rasmiy ravishda yuksak burilish nuqtasi deb nishonlangan ('celebrated as a watershed moment') bo'lsa-da, 'Although' va 'lacked enforceable mechanisms' iboralari aslida unda majburlovchi vositalar yo'qligini fosh qiladi. Demak, bu nishonlash faqat yuzaki yoki ko'rinishdagina ('ostensibly') bo'lgan.

Variantlar tahlili:
A) ostensibly - ko'rinishidan, zohiran (to'g'ri).
B) inadvertently - bilmasdan, tasodifan.
C) reluctantly - istamaygina, majburlikdan.
D) scrupulously - o'ta sinchkovlik va vijdonan.
strat: READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

pas: The computational chemist argued that the new quantum simulation algorithm does not entirely replace empirical spectroscopy; instead, it serves a ______ purpose, validating theoretical bond geometries that physical instruments cannot directly resolve.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D (complementary).

Matn tahlili:
Algoritm empirik spektroskopiyaning o'rnini to'liq bosmaydi ('does not entirely replace'), balki jismoniy asboblar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'lchay olmaydigan sohalarni to'ldiradi va tekshiradi ('validating theoretical bond geometries that physical instruments cannot directly resolve'). Ya'ni u spektroskopiyani to'ldiruvchi ('complementary') vazifani bajaradi.

Variantlar tahlili:
D) complementary - bir-birini to'ldiruvchi (to'g'ri).
C) superfluous - ortiqcha, keraksiz.
B) contentious - bahsli, janjalli.
A) rudimentary - boshlang'ich, ibtidoiy.
strat: READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

pas: Urban planners observed that introducing pedestrianized corridors not only eased automotive congestion but also ______ commercial activity, as foot traffic along storefronts surged by over 40 percent.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D (bolstered).

Matn tahlili:
Piyodalar yo'lagi avtomobil tirbandligini kamaytirdi hamda do'konlar oldidagi odamlar oqimini 40 foizga oshirib, savdo faolligini kuchaytirdi / jonlantirdi ('bolstered').

Variantlar tahlili:
D) bolstered - kuchaytirgan, qo'llab-quvvatlagan (to'g'ri).
B) suppressed - bostirgan, pasaytirgan.
C) preempted - oldini olgan, bartaraf etgan.
A) regulated - tartibga solgan (surged - ko'tarildi bilan mos kelmaydi).
strat: READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

pas: Because early deep-sea submersibles possessed only limited battery life and crude imaging sensors, deep benthic ecosystems remained largely ______ to marine biologists until autonomous robotic gliders were deployed in the late 1990s.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C (inaccessible).

Matn tahlili:
Dastlabki suvosti apparatlari cheklangan quvvatga va oddiy datchiklarga ega bo'lgani sababli, chuqur suv tubi ekotizimlari 1990-yillarning oxirigacha biologlar uchun yetib borib o'rganib bo'lmaydigan ('inaccessible') bo'lib qolgan edi.

Variantlar tahlili:
C) inaccessible - kirish qiyin, yetib bo'lmas (to'g'ri).
D) ubiquitous - hamma joyda uchraydigan.
A) transparent - shaffof, ochiq-oydin.
B) perilous - xavf-xatarga to'la.
strat: READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

pas: Critics of the proposed economic deregulation argued that the agency's relaxed reporting requirements would ______ corporate transparency, allowing shadow accounting practices to flourish unchecked.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D (undermine).

Matn tahlili:
Iqtisodiy qoidalarni yengillashtirish tanqidchilari hisobot talablarining yumshatilishi korporativ shaffoflikka putur yetkazadi ('undermine') va yashirin buxgalteriya amaliyotlarining nazoratsiz rivojlanishiga yo'l ochadi deb da'vo qilishmoqda.

Variantlar tahlili:
D) undermine - putur yetkazmoq, zaiflashtirmoq (to'g'ri).
A) explicate - batafsil tushuntirib bermoq.
B) reconcile - yarashtirmoq, muvofiqlashtirmoq.
C) reinforce - mustahkamlamoq (kontekstga butunlay teskari).
strat: READING STRATEGIYASI: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi qarama-qarshilik (contrast) yoki qo'shimcha belgilarni toping va matndan kelib chiqing.

pas: Historically, historians divided the painter's career into two discordant phases: his austere monochromatic portraits of the 1950s and his vibrant, chaotic collages of the 1970s. Curator Elena Vance's current exhibition, however, recontextualizes this supposed rupture. By showcasing previously unexhibited studio sketches from the intervening decade, the gallery reveals a systematic, deliberate transition—demonstrating that the later expressive masterworks evolved directly from the rigorous spatial geometry of the early portraits.
q: Which choice best describes the overall function of the text?
opts: It argues that the artist's sketches are aesthetically superior to his finished paintings.
It explains how a current exhibition challenges a longstanding biographical consensus.
It details how an artist responded to commercial criticism throughout his career.
It outlines the chronological development of mid-century abstract portraiture techniques.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B.

Matn tahlili:
Matn an'anaviy qarash ('Historically, historians divided...') bilan boshlanadi: rassomning ijodi ikki qarama-qarshi bosqichga ajratilgan deb hisoblangan. So'ngra 'however' orqali kurator Elena Vance'ning ko'rgazmasi bu eski konsensusni o'zgartirayotgani ('recontextualizes this supposed rupture') va 1960-yillardagi eskizlar orqali uzluksiz rivojlanishni isbotlayotgani bayon qilinadi. Bu aynan B variantdagi 'ko'rgazma uzoq vaqt mavjud bo'lgan biografik konsensusga e'tiroz bildirishini tushuntiradi' fikrini aks ettiradi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Eskizlar tugallangan rasmlardan ko'ra go'zalroq deb taqqoslanmagan.
D) Umuman mavhum portret san'ati xronologiyasi haqida emas, bitta rassom ko'rgazmasi haqida.
C) Rassom tanqidlarga qanday javob bergani haqida ma'lumot yo'q.
strat: STRUKTURA TAKTIKASI: Matn qismlari o'rtasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni (dalil, inkor, izoh) aniqlab, umumiy maqsadni belgilang.

pas: In avian ecology, the 'dear enemy' effect predicts that territorial songbirds will display lower levels of aggression toward familiar territorial neighbors than toward unfamiliar intruders, conserving energy for genuine competitive threats. In a 2023 study of savannah sparrows, however, ecologist Noah Diaz discovered an unexpected inversion: birds nesting in high-density scrublands exhibited significantly heightened territorial singing and threat displays toward long-standing neighbors. Diaz hypothesizes that when territory sizes fall below a critical threshold, neighboring birds become continuous resource competitors rather than stable partners in boundary maintenance.
q: Which choice best states the primary purpose of the text?
opts: To present experimental findings that delineate a boundary condition of an established ecological hypothesis.
To demonstrate that savannah sparrows lack the cognitive capacity to distinguish familiar birds from strangers.
To resolve a historical debate regarding the evolutionary origin of avian song repertoires.
To propose that territorial behaviors in songbirds are determined entirely by auditory vocalization pitch.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Matnda avval qushlar ekologiyasidagi mashhur 'dear enemy' gipotezasi keltiriladi (qushlar qo'shnilarga nisbatan begonalarga ko'ra kamroq tajovuzkor bo'lishi). Keyin Noah Diaz'ning tadqiqoti zich hududlarda bu qoidaning teskarisi sodir bo'lishini ko'rsatadi (inversion). Diaz hudud o'lchami kritik nuqtadan pastga tushganda gipoteza ishlamay qolishini tushuntiradi. Demak, maqsad mavjud gipotezaning qaysi chegara sharoitida (boundary condition) ishlamay qolishini ko'rsatishdir (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Qushlar tanish qushlarni taniy olmasligi aytilmagan, aksincha ularni taniydi.
D) Qo'shiq balandligi (pitch) haqida hech narsa deyilmagan.
C) Qushlar sayrash repertuarining evolyutsion kelib chiqishi bahsi hal qilinmayapti.
strat: STRUKTURA TAKTIKASI: Matn qismlari o'rtasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni (dalil, inkor, izoh) aniqlab, umumiy maqsadni belgilang.

pas: Volcanic lightning has fascinated observers since Pliny the Younger documented the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 CE. For centuries, this spectacular phenomenon was thought to result solely from triboelectric friction—magma fragments rubbing against one another during violent ascent. Yet recent high-speed cinematography reveals a second mechanism: radioactive decay of radon gas within the ash plume ionizes surrounding air molecules, producing the high electric potential required for electrical discharge.
q: Which choice best describes the relationship between the two parts of the text?
opts: The first part describes an ancient belief, and the second part confirms its scientific accuracy.
The first part introduces an engineering invention, and the second part critiques its efficiency.
The first part introduces a traditional explanation, and the second part presents an additional mechanism.
The first part describes a natural disaster, and the second part evaluates emergency evacuation protocols.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C.

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi qismda asrlar davomida vulqon chaqmoqlari faqat ishqalanish (triboelectric friction) oqibatida sodir bo'ladi deb hisoblangani ('traditional explanation') aytiladi. Ikkinchi qismda esa ('Yet recent high-speed cinematography reveals a second mechanism...') unga qo'shimcha mexanizm (radon gazining parchalanishi) topilgani ko'rsatiladi. Bu aynan C variantga to'liq mos keladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Ikkinchi qism birinchi qismdagi qarashning yagona to'g'riligini tasdiqlamaydi, balki yangi omil qo'shadi.
D) Evakuatsiya choralari haqida gap yo'q.
B) Muhandislik ixtirosi emas, tabiiy hodisa o'rganilmoqda.
strat: STRUKTURA TAKTIKASI: Matn qismlari o'rtasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni (dalil, inkor, izoh) aniqlab, umumiy maqsadni belgilang.

pas: In standard macroeconomic models, central bank interest rate hikes are assumed to transmit predictably to mortgage lending rates within weeks. Economists analyzing the 2022–2023 tightening cycle, however, documented an unusual divergence: while short-term commercial paper tracked policy rates seamlessly, 30-year fixed mortgages exhibited unprecedented volatility and lagged transmission. The researchers attributed this decoupling to quantitative tightening, which removed a major price-insensitive buyer from the sovereign debt market and amplified secondary market liquidity premiums.
q: In the text, the statement about quantitative tightening primarily serves to:
opts: summarize the historical origins of fixed-rate mortgage contracts.
dismiss the empirical validity of the economists' dataset.
argue that central banks should eliminate all mortgage interest rate targets.
provide an explanatory hypothesis for an observed anomaly.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D.

Matn tahlili:
Matnda avval kutilgan qonuniyat, so'ngra 2022-2023 yillarda kuzatilgan kutilmagan tafovut/anomaliya ('unusual divergence', 'decoupling') bayon etilgan. Belgilangan jumla aynan nima sababdan bu anomaliya yuz berganini tushuntiruvchi sababni ('attributed this decoupling to...') keltiradi. Demak, uning vazifasi kuzatilgan anomaliya uchun izohlovchi gipotezani taqdim etishdir (D variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Iqtisodchilarning ma'lumotlar to'plamini rad etmaydi, balki tasdiqlaydi.
C) Markaziy bank barcha foiz maqsadlarini yo'qotishi kerak degan da'vo yo'q.
A) Ipoteka shartnomalarining tarixiy kelib chiqishi bayon qilinmagan.
strat: STRUKTURA TAKTIKASI: Matn qismlari o'rtasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni (dalil, inkor, izoh) aniqlab, umumiy maqsadni belgilang.

pas: Philosopher of science Karl Popper famously held that scientific theories can never be verified, only falsified. If a theory survives strenuous attempts to refute it, Popper asserted, it acquires 'corroboration' but remains perpetually tentative. Yet practicing laboratory scientists rarely abandon foundational paradigms at the first sign of conflicting empirical data; instead, they routinely suspect faulty calibration, impurities in samples, or auxiliary assumptions before discarding their primary framework.
q: Which choice best reflects the author's overarching organizational strategy?
opts: Advocating for the total replacement of theoretical models with pure observational empiricism.
Contrasting a prescriptive philosophical principle with the practical realities of scientific investigation.
Tracing the historical progression of laboratory methodologies from the Renaissance to the modern era.
Defending Popperian epistemology against accusations of internal logical inconsistency.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B.

Matn tahlili:
Muallif avval Popperning nazariy falsafiy tamoyilini (nazariyani faqat inkor etish mumkin, tasdiqlab bo'lmaydi) keltiradi. So'ng 'Yet practicing laboratory scientists rarely abandon...' jumlasi orqali haqiqiy amaliyotdagi laboratoriya olimlarining kundalik realligi Popper aytganidek bo'lmasligini, ular darhol nazariyani tashlamasdan, asbob xatosini tekshirishini ko'rsatadi. Bu esa 'me'yoriy falsafiy tamoyilni amaliy ilmiy tadqiqot voqeligi bilan taqqoslash/qarshilantirish' (B variant) strategiyasidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
C) Uyg'onish davridan to hozirgacha bo'lgan tarixiy bosqichlar keltirilmagan.
D) Popper falsafasini mantiqiy nomutanosiblikdan himoya qilmayapti.
A) Nazariy modellarni to'liq tashlab, faqat kuzatuvga o'tishni targ'ib qilmayapti.
strat: STRUKTURA TAKTIKASI: Matn qismlari o'rtasidagi mantiqiy bog'lanishni (dalil, inkor, izoh) aniqlab, umumiy maqsadni belgilang.

pas:
Text 1
Many cognitive ethologists maintain that tool manufacture among nonhuman primates demonstrates foresight and mental representation. When wild chimpanzees select branches, strip foliage, and trim the tips hours before visiting termite mounds, their sequential preparation suggests a pre-planned goal rather than trial-and-error associative conditioning.

Text 2
Skeptics argue that complex behavioral sequences in animals can emerge entirely through cumulative reinforcement without requiring abstract forethought. If individual actions within a sequence—such as snapping off side-twigs—have been reinforced independently through accidental tactile satisfaction or social imitation, the entire chain can appear goal-directed while relying strictly on low-level motor habits.
q: Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the chimpanzee example in Text 1?
opts: By contending that the twig-stripping behaviors may be explained by chained conditioning rather than mental foresight.
By maintaining that chimpanzees only fabricate tools when human observers directly prompt them.
By arguing that the observed tool preparation was fabricated by biased field researchers.
By conceding that chimpanzees possess cognitive faculties identical to human strategic planning.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matnlar tahlili:
1-matnda shimpanzelarning shoxlarni oldindan tozalab, tayyorlab qo'yishi ularda oldindan rejalashtirish ('foresight and mental representation') borligini ko'rsatadi deyiladi.
2-matndagi skeptiklar esa bunday murakkab zanjirlar mavhum rejasiz, oddiy mustahkamlangan odatlar va ketma-ket shartlanish ('cumulative reinforcement', 'low-level motor habits') orqali vujudga kelishi mumkinligini ta'kidlaydi.
Shu sababli, 2-matn muallifi 1-matndagi misolga 'shoxlarni tozalash harakati oldindan o'ylangan reja emas, balki zanjirli shartlanish (chained conditioning) bilan tushuntirilishi mumkin' deb javob beradi (A variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
D) Shimpanzelar inson bilan bir xil qobiliyatga ega deb tan olmaydi.
C) Kuzatuvlar tadqiqotchilar tomonidan soxtalashtirilgan degan da'vo yo'q.
B) Odamlar bevosita undaganida asbob yasaydi degan gap yo'q.
strat: MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

pas:
Text 1
Astronomer Alan Stern asserts that the definition of a planet adopted by the International Astronomical Union (IAU) in 2006 is fundamentally flawed. By requiring a celestial body to have 'cleared the neighborhood around its orbit,' the IAU criterion ties planetary status to dynamic orbital distance rather than intrinsic physical properties. Under this definition, an Earth-mass object placed in the Kuiper Belt would fail to qualify as a planet simply because its orbital zone is too vast to clear.

Text 2
Astronomer Michael Brown defends the IAU dynamical classification, emphasizing that orbital clearing marks a profound qualitative evolutionary threshold in solar system formation. Objects that clear their orbits contain more than 99 percent of the remaining mass in their orbital zones, allowing them to govern the trajectories of all surrounding debris. Focusing solely on intrinsic geophysics ignores the defining gravitational role that true planets play in sculpting planetary architecture.
q: On which point would Stern (Text 1) and Brown (Text 2) most likely agree?
opts: Planetary definitions should prioritize historical cultural nomenclature over astrophysical metrics.
The IAU's 'clearing the neighborhood' criterion is dependent on an object's orbital environment rather than its internal physical attributes alone.
An object with the mass of Earth in the Kuiper Belt would successfully clear all nearby asteroids.
Pluto possesses sufficient gravitational dominance to dictate the orbital stability of Neptune.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B.

Matnlar tahlili:
Text 1 muallifi Stern IAU mezonini aynan orbital muhitga bog'liq bo'lib qolgani ('ties planetary status to dynamic orbital distance rather than intrinsic physical properties') uchun tanqid qiladi.
Text 2 muallifi Brown esa bu mezon orbital muhit va tortishish kuchi bilan atrofni boshqarishiga asoslanganini tasdiqlaydi ('orbital clearing marks a profound... gravitational role in sculpting planetary architecture') va buni to'g'ri deb himoya qiladi.
Demak, har ikki olim ham IAU ning 'orbitani tozalash' mezoni ichki jismoniy xususiyatlarga emas, orbital muhit va dinamikaga bog'liq ekanligiga birdek rozi bo'lishadi (B variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
D) Pluton Neptun barqarorligini belgilaydi degan fikr yo'q.
A) Madaniy/tarixiy nomlanishni astrofizikadan ustun qo'yish kerak deyilmagan.
C) Stern aynan Kuiper belbog'idagi Yer massasidagi jism orbitani tozalay olmasligini aytadi, Brown bunga qarshi chiqmaydi.
strat: MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

pas:
Text 1
Advocates of degrowth argue that perpetual GDP expansion on a finite planet is an ecological impossibility. They maintain that reducing aggregate throughput—the physical extraction and consumption of raw materials—is the only viable strategy to avert climate destabilization and resource exhaustion.

Text 2
Ecomodernists counter that decoupling economic value from material consumption is not only theoretically possible but already underway in industrialized nations. Through digitization, energy-efficiency gains, and advanced nuclear power, economies can continue expanding their financial and human development indicators while drastically contracting their net carbon footprints.
q: Which choice best describes the central point of disagreement between the authors?
opts: Whether industrialized nations currently consume more resources than developing nations.
Whether GDP accurately reflects the subjective well-being of national populations.
Whether nuclear energy produces zero greenhouse gas emissions during operation.
Whether sustained economic growth can be reconciled with ecological sustainability.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D.

Matnlar tahlili:
1-matn muallifi cheklangan sayyorada iqtisodiy o'sishni davom ettirish ekologik jihatdan imkonsiz ekanini ('ecological impossibility') aytadi.
2-matn muallifi esa yangi texnologiyalar orqali iqtisodiyot o'sishda davom etishi va shu bilan birga ekologiyaga ta'sirni kamaytirishi mumkinligini ('decoupling... is not only theoretically possible but already underway') ta'kidlaydi.
Demak, ularning asosiy bahs nuqtasi: barqaror iqtisodiy o'sishni ekologik barqarorlik bilan uyg'unlashtirish mumkinmi yoki yo'qmi (D variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
C) Yadro energiyasi emissiyasi bo'yicha alohida bahs yo'q.
A) Rivojlangan va rivojlanayotgan davlatlar iste'moli taqqoslanmagan.
B) YaIM subyektiv baxtni o'lchay oladimi degan savol ko'tarilmagan.
strat: MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

pas:
Text 1
In historical linguistics, the comparative method reconstructs proto-languages by identifying systematic phonetic correspondences across descendant tongues. Proponents assert that regular sound laws operate mechanically without exceptions, allowing researchers to establish genealogical language family trees with mathematical rigor.

Text 2
Dialectologists emphasizing areal linguistics note that languages frequently borrow grammatical structures, lexical items, and phonological features across genetic boundaries via sustained trade and geographical proximity. This phenomenon of convergence, or 'wave propagation,' frequently blurs phylogenetic boundaries, rendering tree models misleading representations of linguistic history.
q: Based on the texts, the author of Text 2 would most likely characterize the 'mathematical rigor' claimed in Text 1 as:
opts: an oversimplified metric that obscures the messy reality of cross-linguistic borrowing.
a valuable approach that is solely applicable to written alphabetic languages.
a proven framework that successfully accounts for all dialect contact phenomena.
an outdated relic that has been completely discarded by all modern linguists.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matnlar tahlili:
1-matn fonetik qonunlar qat'iy mexanik va istisnosiz ishlaydi deb da'vo qiladi, bu esa 'matematik aniqlik' (mathematical rigor) bilan til oilasi daraxtini qurishga imkon beradi.
2-matn esa tillar o'zaro qo'shnichilik va savdo orqali qardosh bo'lmagan holda ham grammatika va so'zlarni o'zlashtirishini ('cross genetic boundaries'), bu esa shajarali daraxt modellarini chalg'ituvchi (misleading) qilib qo'yishini ta'kidlaydi.
Demak, 2-matn muallifi 1-matndagi 'matematik aniqlik'ni tillar o'rtasidagi chalkash o'zlashtirish jarayonlarini e'tibordan chetda qoldiruvchi haddan tashqari soddalashtirilgan o'lchov (A variant) deb hisoblaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
C) Kontakt fenomenlarini hisobga oluvchi isbotlangan model deb maqtamaydi.
D) Butunlay barcha zamonaviy tilshunoslar tomonidan tashlab yuborilgan deb rad etilmagan.
B) Faqat yozma alifboli tillarga tegishli degan cheklov aytilmagan.
strat: MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

pas:
Text 1
Laboratory experiments demonstrate that cultivating plants under blue-enriched light-emitting diodes (LEDs) stimulates stomatal opening and enhances photosynthetic gas exchange, resulting in faster leaf expansion during initial vegetative development.

Text 2
While horticulturalists acknowledge the positive vegetative effects of blue LEDs, commercial greenhouse trials demonstrate that prolonged exclusive exposure to blue wavelengths causes photomorphogenic dwarfism, producing stout stems but severely stunting overall biomass accumulation.
q: Which choice best summarizes the shared topic of both texts?
opts: The impact of ambient humidity on stomatal conductance in flowering plants.
The developmental consequences of blue LED illumination on plant physiology.
The cost efficiency of LED fixtures compared to traditional sodium lamps.
The genetic modification of agricultural crops to survive low-light environments.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B.

Matnlar tahlili:
Har ikkala matnda ham ko'k spektrdagi LED yoritgichlarning o'simliklarning rivojlanishiga (fotosintez, barg kengayishi, poya bo'yi va biomassa) ta'siri haqida so'z boradi. Demak, ularning umumiy mavzusi ko'k LED yorug'ligining o'simlik fiziologiyasiga ko'rsatadigan ta'siridir (B variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
C) Natriy lampalari bilan xarajat samaradorligi taqqoslanmagan.
D) Genetik modifikatsiya haqida gap yo'q.
A) Havoning namligi ta'siri haqida emas.
strat: MATNLAR ARO TAKTIKA: Har ikkala muallifning markaziy da'vosini aniqlang va 2-matn 1-matnga qanday munosabat bildirishini qidiring.

pas: In the arid Atacama Desert of Chile, certain hypolithic cyanobacteria survive not by drawing water from the parched soil, but by colonizing the undersides of translucent quartz pebbles. During early morning fog events, water vapor condenses preferentially along the cooler mineral surfaces. Concurrently, the quartz acts as a natural optical filter: it scatters intense ultraviolet radiation while transmitting sufficient photosynthetically active radiation for metabolic survival.
q: According to the text, which dual function does the translucent quartz serve for the hypolithic cyanobacteria?
opts: It absorbs ambient carbon monoxide and releases essential subterranean nutrients.
It collects condensed moisture and provides radiation shielding while permitting photosynthesis.
It warms the surrounding soil during freezing nights and stores solar heat.
It reflects all incoming solar light to prevent cellular dehydration.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B.

Matn tahlili:
Matnda kvars toshlari ikki xil vazifani bajarishi ochiq bayon qilingan:
1) 'water vapor condenses preferentially along the cooler mineral surfaces' (namlikni kondensatsiyalash / yig'ish);
2) 'scatters intense ultraviolet radiation while transmitting sufficient photosynthetically active radiation' (zararli ultrabinafsha nurlanishdan himoya qilish va fotosintez uchun yetarli yorug'lik o'tkazish).
Bu ikki vazifa B variantda aniq umumlashtirilgan.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Is gazi (carbon monoxide) yoki yer osti moddalari haqida gap yo'q.
C) Tuproqni isitish va issiqlik saqlash aytilmagan.
D) Barcha quyosh nurini qaytarmaydi, aksincha fotosintez nurlarini o'tkazadi.
strat: ASOSIY FIKR STRATEGIYASI: Xulosaviy jumla va asosiy dalilni toping; matndan tashqari qo'shimcha fikrlardan qoching.

pas: The development of steam-powered rotary printing presses in the mid-nineteenth century revolutionized publishing economics. By replacing manual lever presses that produced fewer than 250 sheets per hour with mechanized rollers capable of printing upwards of 10,000 sheets hourly, printers dramatically lowered unit production costs. Consequently, newspapers transformed from expensive subscriptions reserved for mercantile elites into affordable daily broadsheets accessible to the urban working class.
q: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
opts: Manual lever presses remained popular among rural printers due to their superior typographic quality.
Steam power primarily benefited nineteenth-century book publishers rather than newspaper syndicates.
Mechanized rotary presses slashed newspaper printing costs, democratizing access to daily news.
Working-class literacy rates were the sole driving factor behind mechanical printing innovations.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C.

Matn tahlili:
Matn bug'li aylanma bosmaxona stanoklari soatiga 250 varaqdan 10,000 varaqqa oshirgani, bu esa tannarxni keskin tushirgani va natijada gazetalarni elita mulkidan oddiy ishchilar o'qiy oladigan arzon nashrga aylantirgani haqida. Bu aynan C variantdagi 'mexanizatsiyalashgan stanoklar bosma xarajatlarni qisqartirdi va kundalik yangiliklardan foydalanishni ommalashtirdi/demokratlashtirdi' degan bosh g'oyadir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Qo'l stanoklari qishloqda ommabop bo'lib qolgani aytilmagan.
B) Asosan kitob nashriyotlariga foyda keltirdi deyilmagan (gazetalar misol keltirilgan).
D) Ishchilarning savodxonligi yagona harakatlantiruvchi kuch bo'lgan degan da'vo yo'q.
strat: ASOSIY FIKR STRATEGIYASI: Xulosaviy jumla va asosiy dalilni toping; matndan tashqari qo'shimcha fikrlardan qoching.

pas: Sociologist Pierre Bourdieu proposed the concept of 'cultural capital' to explain how social stratification reproduces across generations without explicit legal coercion. Bourdieu argued that elite families endow their offspring with tacit linguistic fluency, aesthetic sensibilities, and credentialed educational credentials that are subtly recognized and rewarded by academic institutions. Because schools mistakenly treat these socially transmitted dispositions as innate intellectual merit, children from disadvantaged backgrounds are systematically marginalized under the guise of an objective meritocracy.
q: According to Bourdieu's theory as outlined in the text, why do educational institutions reinforce existing class divisions?
opts: They enforce explicit legal quotas that restrict university enrollment by social caste.
They prioritize financial donations from wealthy alumni over standardized exam performance.
They misattribute cultivated cultural dispositions to innate scholarly capability.
They reject conventional testing methodologies in favor of subjective vocational assessments.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C.

Matn tahlili:
Matndagi asosiy jumlaga e'tibor qaratamiz: 'Because schools mistakenly treat these socially transmitted dispositions as innate intellectual merit, children from disadvantaged backgrounds are systematically marginalized...'.
Ya'ni maktablar oiladan o'tgan madaniy ko'nikmalarni tug'ma aqliy iqtidor deb xato baholaydi va shu tariqa mavjud tabaqalanishni mustahkamlaydi. Bu to'g'ridan-to'g'ri C variantga to'g'ri keladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Matnda 'without explicit legal coercion' deyilgan, ochiq qonuniy kvotalar yo'q.
D) Kasbiy baholash usullari haqida aytilmagan.
B) Homiy xayriyalari haqida gap bormayapti.
strat: ASOSIY FIKR STRATEGIYASI: Xulosaviy jumla va asosiy dalilni toping; matndan tashqari qo'shimcha fikrlardan qoching.

pas: Unlike mammalian red blood cells, which eject their nuclei and mitochondria during maturation to maximize hemoglobin packing efficiency, avian erythrocytes retain functional nuclei and mitochondria throughout their circulatory lifespans. Biologists hypothesize that the persistence of mitochondria in bird erythrocytes supports the immense aerobic metabolic demands of prolonged powered flight, supplying localized ATP during intense endurance exercise.
q: Which finding regarding avian erythrocytes is explicitly stated in the text?
opts: They are generated exclusively in the lung tissues rather than in the bone marrow.
They maintain operational mitochondria and cell nuclei as mature circulating cells.
They lack the ability to synthesize ATP under low-oxygen atmospheric conditions.
They carry significantly less total oxygen per volume than any mammalian red blood cells.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B.

Matn tahlili:
Matnda aniq aytilgan: 'avian erythrocytes retain functional nuclei and mitochondria throughout their circulatory lifespans' (qushlarning qizil qon tanachalari o'zlarining butun qon aylanish davrida ishchi yadro va mitoxondriyalarni saqlab qoladi). Bu aynan B variantda takrorlangan.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
D) Sut emizuvchilardan kamroq kislorod tashiydi degan fakt yo'q.
C) Past kislorodda ATF sintez qila olmaydi deyilmagan.
A) O'pkada hosil bo'lishi haqida gap yo'q.
strat: ASOSIY FIKR STRATEGIYASI: Xulosaviy jumla va asosiy dalilni toping; matndan tashqari qo'shimcha fikrlardan qoching.

pas: A team of neurobiologists investigated whether enriched olfactory environments could retard age-related neurodegeneration in laboratory mice. The researchers placed 18-month-old mice in cages infused with four novel natural fragrances daily for 12 weeks, while a control group remained in standard odorless air. At the conclusion of the trial, fragrance-exposed mice exhibited a 35 percent increase in hippocampal neurogenesis and significantly higher scores on spatial memory maze tests compared to controls.
q: Which finding, if true, would most directly bolster the researchers' conclusion that the olfactory stimulation itself caused the cognitive improvements?
opts: Control mice and fragrance-exposed mice engaged in identical amounts of physical wheel running and food consumption.
Fragrance compounds were detected in trace quantities inside the digestive tracts of the test subjects.
Fragrance-exposed mice showed increased levels of aggressive social interaction compared to baseline measurements.
Mice naturally lose their sense of smell completely within the first six months of adulthood.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Tadqiqotchilar hidlar (olfactory stimulation) sichqonlarda xotira va neyrogenezni yaxshilagan deb xulosa qilishmoqda. Bu xulosani mustahkamlash uchun alternativ tushuntirishlarni (masalan, tajriba guruhidagi sichqonlar hidlar sababli ko'proq yugurgan yoki ko'proq ovqatlangan bo'lishi mumkinligi) istisno qilish kerak. Agar ikki guruhdagi sichqonlarning jismoniy mashg'uloti va ovqatlanishi mutlaqo bir xil bo'lgan bo'lsa (A variant), yaxshilanish aynan hidlar ta'sirida bo'lgani qat'iy isbotlanadi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
C) Agressivlikning oshishi kognitiv sabab-oqibatni isbotlamaydi.
B) Oshqozonda hid birikmalarining bo'lishi miyadagi ta'sirni isbotlamaydi.
D) Sichqonlar 6 oyligida hid bilishni yo'qotsa, 18 oylik sichqonlar hidni umuman sezmagan bo'lib chiqadi va tadqiqot asossiz bo'lib qoladi.
strat: DALIL TANLASH QOIDASI: Gipotezani bevosita qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan yoki inkor etadigan eng aniq empirik faktni qidiring.

pas: Archaeologists studying the collapse of the Classic Maya center of Copán hypothesized that widespread deforestation on upland slopes caused severe soil erosion, which filled agricultural valley floors with infertile sediments and triggered systemic famine. To evaluate this hypothesis, a geoarchaeologist analyzed sequential sedimentary layers from oxbow lakes in the Copán Valley.
q: Which finding from the sediment analysis, if true, would most strongly challenge the researchers' hypothesis?
opts: The mineral composition of valley floor sediments matched the sandstone bedrock of surrounding deforested hillsides.
Terraced agricultural retaining walls were constructed on hillside contours throughout the Classic Period.
Pollen grains from pine trees vanished entirely from lake core samples during the terminal phase of the settlement.
The thickest layers of sterile slope sediments were deposited over a century before population levels and agricultural output at Copán reached their zenith.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D.

Matn tahlili:
Gipoteza: o'rmonlarning kesilishi tuproq eroziyasini keltirib chiqardi, samarasiz cho'kindilar vodiylarni bosdi va ocharchilik orqali Copán ning qulashiga sabab bo'ldi.
Bu gipotezaga eng kuchli zarba (challenge): agar o'sha qalin unumsiz cho'kindi qatlamlari Copán aholisi va qishloq xo'jaligi o'zining eng cho'qqisiga (zenith) chiqishidan bir asr avvalroq to'plangan bo'lsa (D variant), demak bu eroziya shaharning gullab-yashnashiga to'sqinlik qilmagan va qulashning sababi bo'la olmaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
C) Qarag'ay gulchangining yo'qolishi o'rmon kesilganini tasdiqlaydi (gipotezani quvvatlaydi).
A) Cho'kindining tepalik jinslariga mos kelishi tepalikdan tuproq tushganini tasdiqlaydi (gipotezani quvvatlaydi).
B) Qishloq xo'jaligi devorlari bo'lgani eroziya qulashga olib kelmaganini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri inkor etmaydi.
strat: DALIL TANLASH QOIDASI: Gipotezani bevosita qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan yoki inkor etadigan eng aniq empirik faktni qidiring.

pas: Economists studying online consumer habits noticed that offering free shipping thresholds (such as 'free delivery on orders over $50') reliably increases average basket size. They claim that consumers perceive shipping fees as pure loss and are eager to add secondary items to their carts to cross the qualifying threshold.
q: Which piece of evidence would most directly support the economists' claim?
opts: Online shoppers with initial carts totaling $45 routinely purchase an additional $8 item rather than pay a $6 delivery fee.
Customers consistently select standard ground delivery over expedited express courier options.
Online retailers spend more on social media advertising than on warehouse automation.
Consumers who enroll in annual premium delivery subscriptions make fewer total purchases than non-subscribers.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Matn tahlili:
Iqtisodchilarning da'vosi: xaridorlar yetkazib berish haqini yo'qotish deb biladi va bepul yetkazish chegarasidan (masalan $50) o'tish uchun savatga qo'shimcha mahsulot qo'shishadi. A variantda aytilishicha, $45 lik xaridor $6 yetkazib berish pulini to'lash o'rniga, $8 lik mahsulot qo'shib $50 dan oshirib bepul yetkazishni tanlaydi. Bu iqtisodchilar da'vosini 100% to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tasdiqlaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Oddiy yetkazishni tanlash savat hajmini oshirish da'vosini isbotlamaydi.
D) Premium a'zolarning kamroq xarid qilishi da'voga aloqador emas.
C) Reklama xarajatlari xaridorlarning savat to'ldirish harakatini tushuntirmaydi.
strat: DALIL TANLASH QOIDASI: Gipotezani bevosita qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan yoki inkor etadigan eng aniq empirik faktni qidiring.

pas: Deep-sea hydrothermal vent worms (Riftia pachyptila) completely lack a digestive tract, mouth, and anus. Instead, they rely on an internal organ called a trophosome, which is densely packed with symbiotic sulfur-oxidizing bacteria. The worm's vascular system transports toxic hydrogen sulfide and dissolved oxygen absorbed from the surrounding thermal plume directly to the trophosome, where the bacteria convert inorganic carbon into glucose. Consequently, if hydrothermal venting ceases in a localized region, the tube worms will ______
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: develop rudimentary oral cavities and transition to active predatory feeding on benthic crustaceans.
inevitably perish from energetic starvation once their endosymbionts lose the chemical substrates necessary for synthesis.
undergo cellular fission to form smaller, mobile bacterial filaments.
migrate across abyssal plains to locate adjacent active vents by swimming through water columns.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B.

Matn tahlili:
Chuqur suv qurtlarida og'iz, hazm qilish tizimi yo'q; ular energiyani faqat gidrotermal buloqlardagi vodorod sulfid orqali bakteriyalar sintez qiladigan glyukozadan oladi. Agar hududda gidrotermal oqim to'xtasa, ularning bakteriyalari kerakli xomashyosiz (kimyoviy substratsiz) qoladi va qurtlar ovqatsiz qolib muqarrar halok bo'ladi ('inevitably perish from energetic starvation').

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Qurtlarda to'satdan og'iz paydo bo'lib, qisqichbaqalarni ovlashga o'ta olmaydi.
D) Qurtlar o'troq organizmlar bo'lib, suv tubidan suzib yangi buloqqa ko'cha olmaydi.
C) Ko'p hujayrali jonzotlar bakterial ipchalarga aylanib bo'linib ketmaydi.
strat: XULOSA CHIQARISH: Matndagi mantiqiy sabab-oqibat zanjirini davom ettiring; matndan tashqariga chiqib ketmang.

pas: In terrestrial plant communities, primary succession on newly exposed volcanic basalt typically begins with lichens and mosses that physically crack stone and generate rudimentary humic matter. Subsequent colonization by nitrogen-fixing shrubs further elevates soil fertility, facilitating the arrival of climax canopy hardwoods. However, if hyper-acidic precipitation continually leaches nitrogen and phosphorus from the fledgling soil profile faster than pioneering biota can fix them, ______
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: the climax hardwood trees will accelerate their root penetration to utilize unweathered deep bedrock.
herbivorous mammals will completely abandon browsing on the available pioneer shrubbery.
the ecological succession will stall, preventing the establishment of nutrient-demanding canopy species.
the lichen communities will mutate to perform anoxygenic photosynthesis independent of moisture.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C.

Matn tahlili:
Matnda o'rmon hosil bo'lish (suktsessiya) zanjiri ko'rsatilgan: lishayniklar toshni yoradi -> butalar azot to'playdi va unumdorlikni oshiradi -> eng yuqori qatlam (hardwoods) daraxtlar yetib keladi. 'However' orqali ziddiyat kiritilmoqda: agar o'ta kislotali yomg'ir tuproqdan azot va fosforni o'simliklar to'plaganidan tezroq yuvib ketsa, tuproqda unumdorlik shakllanmaydi, natijada ekologik suktsessiya to'xtab qoladi va ko'p ozuqa talab qiluvchi daraxtlar o'sa olmaydi (C variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) O'g'ir sharoitda katta daraxtlar ildiz otishni tezlashtira olmaydi, chunki ular umuman unib chiqa olmaydi.
D) Lishayniklar to'satdan anoksigen fotosintezga mutatsiya qila olmaydi.
B) O'txo'r hayvonlar haqida matnda umuman gapirilmagan.
strat: XULOSA CHIQARISH: Matndagi mantiqiy sabab-oqibat zanjirini davom ettiring; matndan tashqariga chiqib ketmang.

pas: Solar photovoltaic panels operate with peak energetic conversion efficiency when ambient temperatures remain around 25 degrees Celsius. For every degree Celsius increase above this baseline, standard silicon semiconductor cells lose approximately 0.5 percent of their operational electrical output. Therefore, an arid desert solar installation operating under midday temperatures of 45 degrees Celsius would be expected to ______
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: consume more stored grid electricity than it supplies to regional transmission lines.
permanently melt the silicone seals holding the tempered glass casing intact.
generate substantially more total voltage than during cooler morning conditions.
produce roughly 10 percent less electrical power than its nominal laboratory rating predicts.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D.

Matn tahlili:
Har 1 gradus 25°C dan oshganda quyosh paneli 0.5% samaradorlikni yo'qotadi.
45°C da harorat 25°C dan 20 gradusga yuqori (45 - 25 = 20).
Yo'qotish miqdori: 20 * 0.5% = 10%.
Demak, panel o'zining laboratoriya nominal quvvatidan taxminan 10 foizga kamroq elektr quvvati ishlab chiqarishi kutiladi (D variant).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
C) Ko'proq volt ishlab chiqarmaydi, aksincha kamayadi.
B) 45 darajada oynani ushlab turgan germetiklar butunlay erib ketmaydi.
A) Panel elektr tarmog'idan ko'proq energiya yeb qo'yishi haqida hech qanday asos yo'q.
strat: XULOSA CHIQARISH: Matndagi mantiqiy sabab-oqibat zanjirini davom ettiring; matndan tashqariga chiqib ketmang.

pas: During the solar eclipse of May 1919, British astrophysicist Arthur Eddington traveled to the island of Príncipe to photograph star positions near the eclipsed ______ his optical measurements directly confirmed Albert Einstein's prediction that massive objects curve spacetime.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A (Sun, and).

Grammatik qoida:
Gapda ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clause) mavjud:
1-gap: 'During the solar eclipse of May 1919, British astrophysicist Arthur Eddington traveled to the island of Príncipe to photograph star positions near the eclipsed Sun'
2-gap: 'his optical measurements directly confirmed Albert Einstein's prediction that massive objects curve spacetime.'

Ingliz tili qoidasiga ko'ra, ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lash uchun vergul va teng bog'lovchi (comma + coordinating conjunction, FANBOYS: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so) ishlatiladi: ', and'.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
C) Nuqtali verguldan keyin 'and' kelishi ortiqcha (nokorrekt punktuatsiya).
B) Faqat vergulning o'zi 'comma splice' xatosini keltirib chiqaradi.
D) Tinish belgisiz ulanish 'run-on / fused sentence' xatosidir.
strat: GRAMMATIKA CHEGARALARI: Ikkita mustaqil gapni (FANBOYS + vergul) yoki nuqtali vergul bilan bog'lang; comma splice xatosidan saqlaning.

pas: Architect Zaha Hadid transformed contemporary structural design with her trademark kinetic ______ soaring cantilevers, fluid geometric curves, and fragmented interior volumes that defied conventional orthogonal rigidity.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A (aesthetics:).

Grammatik qoida:
Ikki nuqta (colon) to'liq mustaqil gapdan (independent clause) keyin kelib, undan keyingi tushuntirish, tafsilot yoki ro'yxatni kiritish uchun ishlatiladi.
'Architect Zaha Hadid transformed contemporary structural design with her trademark kinetic aesthetics' - to'liq mustaqil gap. Undan keyin uning estetikasiga kiruvchi uchta xususiyat ro'yxati keltirilgan ('soaring cantilevers, fluid geometric curves, and fragmented interior volumes...'). Shuning uchun ikki nuqta (:) eng to'g'ri belgidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
C) Nuqtali vergul (;) ikkita to'liq mustaqil gap o'rtasida qo'yiladi; bu yerda ro'yxat gap emas.
D) Oddiy vergul ro'yxat ichidagi vergullar bilan aralashib, chegarani noaniq qiladi.
B) Tinish belgisiz qoldirib bo'lmaydi.
strat: IKKI NUQTA QOIDASI: Ikki nuqtadan (:) oldin albatta to'liq mustaqil gap kelishi shart, keyin esa ro'yxat yoki izoh keladi.

pas: While searching the cave sediments of Denisova Cave in the Altai Mountains, paleoanthropologists discovered a tiny hominin finger ______ subsequent genomic sequencing revealed it belonged to an entirely distinct human lineage.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B (bone; subsequent).

Grammatik qoida:
'While searching the cave sediments... paleoanthropologists discovered a tiny hominin finger bone' - birinchi mustaqil gap.
'subsequent genomic sequencing revealed it belonged to an entirely distinct human lineage' - ikkinchi mustaqil gap.
Ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lovchisiz ajratish uchun nuqtali vergul (semicolon ;) talab qilinadi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Vergul bilan ajratish 'comma splice' xatosidir.
D) Hech qanday belgisiz qoldirish 'fused sentence' xatosidir.
C) 'bone, and subsequent' - bu yerda 'subsequent' sifat, agar 'and subsequent genomic sequencing...' bo'lsa, ma'no o'zgarmasligi mumkin, lekin nuqtali vergul ikki to'liq fikrni eng aniq ajratuvchi standart SAT vositasidir.
strat: NUQTALI VERGUL: Ikkita to'liq gapni hech qanday bog'lovchisiz ajratishda faqat nuqtali vergul (;) to'g'ri hisoblanadi.

pas: The marine iguana of the Galápagos Islands is the world's only sea-going ______ it feeds almost exclusively on intertidal algae submerged beneath rocky coastal surf.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A (lizard;).

Grammatik qoida:
1-gap: 'The marine iguana of the Galápagos Islands is the world's only sea-going lizard'
2-gap: 'it feeds almost exclusively on intertidal algae submerged beneath rocky coastal surf.'
Ikkita to'liq mustaqil gap hech qanday koordinatsion bog'lovchisiz kelganda ular o'rtasiga nuqtali vergul (semicolon ;) qo'yiladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
D) 'lizard, for' - bu yerda sabab ma'nosi sun'iy va uslub jihatidan noqulay.
B) Tinish belgisiz - run-on xatosi.
C) 'lizard, and' - ikkinchi gap birinchisiga qo'shimcha fikr emas, birinchi gapdagi xususiyatni tushuntiruvchi alohida fakt.
strat: MUSTAQIL GAPLAR: Ikkala tomonda to'liq ega va kesim bo'lsa, ularni ajratish uchun nuqtali vergul qo'ying.

pas: Three key factors contributed to the sudden revival of the historical rail ______ low municipal fuel surcharges, widespread suburban housing sprawl, and targeted federal infrastructure subsidies.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C (corridor:).

Grammatik qoida:
Jumla to'liq mustaqil gap bilan tugaydi ('Three key factors contributed to the sudden revival of the historical rail corridor') va undan keyin uchta omil sanab o'tiladi. SAT qoidalariga ko'ra, to'liq jumlaga ergashib keladigan ro'yxat yoki tushuntirish oldidan ikki nuqta (colon :) qo'yilishi shart.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
D) Nuqtali vergul (;) faqat to'liq gaplarni ajratadi, ro'yxat oldidan qo'yilmaydi.
B) Vergul (,) ro'yxat ichidagi vergullar bilan qorishib ketadi va grammatik jihatdan noo'rin.
A) Belgisiz qoldirish xato.
strat: RO'YXAT VA IKKI NUQTA: Mustaqil gap orqasidan ro'yxat kelsa, uning oldiga ikki nuqta (:) qo'yiladi.

pas: Renowned biochemist Jennifer Doudna—along with French microbiologist Emmanuelle ______ received the 2020 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for pioneering the CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing technology.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D (Charpentier—).

Grammatik qoida:
Jumla o'rtasida kirish bo'lak (parenthetical phrase) kelganda, agar u tire (em-dash —) bilan ochilgan bo'lsa ('—along with French microbiologist Emmanuelle Charpentier'), u albatta mos keluvchi ikkinchi tire bilan yopilishi shart: 'Charpentier—'.
Tire bilan ochib, vergul yoki boshqa belgi bilan yopib bo'lmaydi (unpaired punctuation xatosi).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Vergul - tire juftligi buziladi.
A) Nuqtali vergul - jumlani noo'rin ikkiga bo'lib yuboradi.
C) Belgisiz qoldirilsa, tire yopilmay qoladi.
strat: TIRE JUFTLIGI: Agar kirish bo'lak tire (—) bilan ochilgan bo'lsa, uni albatta tire (—) bilan yopish shart!

pas: The excavation site yielded thousands of Roman bronze ______ however, only a handful of silver denarii were recovered from the deepest strata.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C (coins;).

Grammatik qoida:
Ikkita mustaqil gap o'rtasida 'however', 'therefore', 'furthermore' kabi bog'lovchi ravishlar (conjunctive adverbs) kelganda, ularning oldiga nuqtali vergul (;), orqasiga esa vergul (,) qo'yiladi:
'...Roman bronze coins; however, only a handful...'

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
D) 'coins, however,' - comma splice xatosi (faqat vergul bilan bog'lab bo'lmaydi).
B) Belgisiz - run-on xatosi.
A) Ikki nuqta (:) bu yerda mantiqan to'g'ri kelmaydi, chunki keyingi gap ro'yxat yoki izoh emas, ziddiyatli mustaqil gap.
strat: BOG'LOVCHI RAVISHLAR: [Gap 1]; however, [Gap 2]. Nuqtali vergul oldinda, oddiy vergul keyinda!

pas: The intricate mosaic of freshwater wetlands, tidal salt marshes, and barrier islands that ______ coastal Louisiana against seasonal hurricane storm surges has suffered catastrophic degradation over the past century.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A (protects).

Grammatik qoida:
Ega-kesim moslashuvi (Subject-Verb Agreement).
Nisbiy olmosh 'that' oldidagi ot guruhiga e'tibor qaratamiz: 'The intricate mosaic of freshwater wetlands, tidal salt marshes, and barrier islands'.
Bu yerda asosiy ega (head noun) - 'mosaic' (birlikda). Oraliqdagi to'ldiruvchilar ('of freshwater wetlands...') ko'plikda bo'lsa-da, ega 'mosaic' birlikda bo'lgani sababli, fe'l ham birlikda bo'lishi kerak: 'protects'.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) protect - ko'plik fe'l shakli (xato).
C) have protected - ko'plik fe'l shakli (xato).
D) are protecting - ko'plik fe'l shakli (xato).
strat: ASOSIY OTNI TOPING: 'mosaic of [ko'plik otlar]' da ega faqat 'mosaic' (birlik). Fe'l ham birlikda bo'ladi: protects!

pas: Originating in the high Andean snowfields, ______ flowing over four thousand miles before emptying into the Atlantic Ocean.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
opts: runoff is gathered by the Amazon River from hundreds of tributaries,
the Atlantic basin absorbs the Amazon River after it gathers runoff,
hundreds of glacial tributaries feed the Amazon River,
the Amazon River gathers runoff from hundreds of glacial tributaries,
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D (the Amazon River gathers runoff from hundreds of glacial tributaries,).

Grammatik qoida:
Dangling modifier (osilib qolgan sifatdosh qurilma) qoidasi.
Jumla sifatdoshli ibora bilan boshlanmoqda: 'Originating in the high Andean snowfields...'. Ushbu xatti-harakatni bevosita bajarayotgan subyekt verguldan keyin darhol kelishi shart. And qorli tog'laridan boshlanadigan narsa bu — 'the Amazon River' (Amazonka daryosi).

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
C) 'hundreds of glacial tributaries' - barcha irmoqlar baland And tog'laridan boshlanmaydi, balki daryo o'zi.
A) 'runoff' (oqim) baland tog'lardan boshlanadi deb kelsa, modifier ma'nosi chalkashadi va passiv qurilma uslubni buzadi.
B) 'the Atlantic basin' (Atlantika havzasi) And tog'laridan boshlanmaydi.
strat: DANGLING MODIFIER: Verguldan keyingi birinchi so'z kirishdagi harakatni bevosita bajaruvchi bo'lishi shart!

pas: A team of behavioral economists conducted a multi-city field experiment to examine whether receiving text message reminders ______ household energy conservation during peak summer demand hours.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A (influences).

Grammatik qoida:
Ergash gapdagi ega (gerund phrase): 'receiving text message reminders'. Gerund (harakat nomi) doimo birlik hisoblanadi ('receiving... influences'). Garchi 'reminders' ko'plikda bo'lsa ham, ega uning o'zi emas, balki eslatmalarni qabul qilish ('receiving') harakatidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) influence - ko'plik shakli.
C) were influencing - ko'plik shakli.
D) have influenced - ko'plik shakli.
strat: GERUND HARAKAT NOMI: 'receiving ... reminders' da ega 'receiving' bo'lib doimo birlik hisoblanadi (influences)!

pas: Neither the lead engineer nor the laboratory technicians ______ able to calibrate the spectrophotometer before the overnight testing cycle commenced.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A (were).

Grammatik qoida:
'Neither... nor...' qurilmasida fe'l o'ziga eng yaqin turgan ot (proximity rule) bilan moslashadi.
Bu yerda 'nor'dan keyin 'the laboratory technicians' (ko'plik) kelgan. Shuningdek, 'before the overnight testing cycle commenced' o'tgan zamon ekanini ko'rsatmoqda. Demak, o'tgan zamon ko'plik shakli: 'were'.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) was - birlik shakli.
D) is - hozirgi zamon birlik.
C) are - hozirgi zamon ko'plik.
strat: NEITHER/NOR MOSLASHUVI: Fe'l 'nor'dan keyin turgan otga moslashadi: technicians (ko'plik) + o'tgan zamon = were!

pas: The historical archive contains hundreds of handwritten letters from nineteenth-century abolitionists, each of which ______ meticulously preserved in climate-controlled acid-free folders.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C (is).

Grammatik qoida:
'each of which' birikmasida 'each' (har biri) doimo grammatik jihatdan birlik (singular) hisoblanadi. Shuning uchun fe'l birlikda bo'lishi kerak: 'each of which is meticulously preserved'.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
D) are - ko'plik shakli.
A) were - ko'plik shakli.
B) have been - ko'plik shakli.
strat: 'EACH OF...' QOIDASI: 'Each' doimo birlik (singular) fe'lni talab qiladi: each is!

pas: To qualify for the regional symphony orchestra, candidates must demonstrate not only technical virtuosity on their chosen instrument ______ an intuitive sensitivity to ensemble tempo changes.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B (but also).

Grammatik qoida:
Bog'lovchilar juftligi (Correlative Conjunctions).
Ingliz tilida 'not only' iborasi doimo 'but also' (yoki shunchaki 'but') bilan juftlashadi: 'not only X but also Y'. Boshqa birikmalar ('and also', 'as well as') grammatik jihatdan qabul qilinmaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
D) and also - noto'g'ri idiom.
A) as well as - 'not only' bilan juftlashmaydi.
C) along with - grammatik xato.
strat: BOG'LOVCHILAR JUFTI: 'Not only' ko'rdingizmi, jufti albatta 'but also' bo'ladi!

pas: By the time the James Webb Space Telescope reached its observational orbit at Lagrange Point 2 in January 2022, mission controllers ______ thousands of simulation maneuvers to ensure flawless primary mirror deployment.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C (had executed).

Grammatik qoida:
Zamonlar moslashuvi (Past Perfect Tense).
'By the time + Past Simple' (reached its observational orbit...) formulasi o'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqtdan oldinroq tugallangan harakatni ifodalaydi. Shuning uchun bosh gapda Past Perfect ('had executed') ishlatilishi shart.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) have executed - Present Perfect (o'tgan zamondagi 'reached' bilan mos kelmaydi).
D) will execute - kelasi zamon.
A) execute - hozirgi zamon.
strat: BY THE TIME + PAST: 'By the time ... reached' kelsa, ikkinchi qismda had + V3 (had executed) bo'ladi!

pas: The culinary instructor reminded the apprentices that searing meat at high temperatures requires patience, focus, and ______ with extreme caution.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B (handling sharp knives).

Grammatik qoida:
Parallel tuzilma (Parallelism).
