Ro'yxatdagi elementlar grammatik jihatdan bir xil turda bo'lishi kerak: 'requires patience [ot], focus [ot], and handling sharp knives [gerund/ot ibora]'. Bu yerda harakatlar 'patience, focus, and handling...' tarzida parallel tuziladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
D) sharp knives handled - sifatdoshli noto'g'ri struktura.
A) to handle knives - infinitiv (oldingi otlar bilan parallel emas).
C) knives being handled - ortiqcha passiv konstruksiya.
strat: PARALLELLIK QOIDASI: Ro'yxatdagi barcha bo'laklar bir xil grammatik shaklda bo'lishi shart!

pas: Electric arc furnaces recycle scrap steel using roughly one-seventh of the energy required by traditional blast furnaces. ______, transitioning the entire domestic steel sector to electric arc technology will require massive upgrades to regional high-voltage electrical grids.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D (Nevertheless).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi jumla elektr pechlarining ulkan afzalligini aytadi: ular an'anaviy pechlarga qaraganda 7 barobar kam energiya sarflaydi (ijobiy fakt). Ikkinchi jumla esa butun po'lat sanoatini ushbu texnologiyaga o'tkazish uchun elektr tarmoqlarini ulkan miqyosda modernizatsiya qilish talab etilishini, ya'ni jiddiy qiyinchilik borligini ko'rsatadi (qarama-qarshi/chegaralovchi fakt). Shuning uchun ziddiyat bildiruvchi 'Nevertheless' (shunga qaramay) eng mos bog'lovchidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Furthermore - fikrni davom ettirish/qo'shish (ziddiyatni ifodalamaydi).
A) Consequently - natija (elektr tarmoqlarini yangilash kam energiya sarflashining bevosita oqibati emas).
C) Similarly - o'xshatish (bu yerda o'xshashlik yo'q).
strat: ZIDDIYAT BOG'LOVCHISI: Ijobiy fakt (+ kam energiya) va qiyinchilik (- tarmoqni yangilash) o'rtasida 'Nevertheless' ishlatiladi.

pas: In polymer synthesis, adding carbon nanotubes increases tensile strength and thermal dissipation. ______, excessive nanotube concentrations cause agglomeration within the matrix, introducing microscopic shear planes that paradoxically weaken the composite.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C (However).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gapda uglerod nanotrubkalarining mustahkamlikni oshirishi aytiladi (ijobiy). Ikkinchi gapda esa haddan tashqari ko'p qo'shilsa to'planib qolib, paradoksal ravishda materialni zaiflashtirishi ta'kidlanadi ('paradoxically weaken the composite'). Bu aniq ziddiyat (contrast) bo'lgani sababli 'However' to'g'ri tanlovdir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Therefore - xulosa/natija.
B) For instance - misol keltirish (bu yerda mustahkamlikka emas, aksincha zaiflashishga misol emas, ziddiyat keltirilmoqda).
D) In other words - boshqacha aytganda (qayta ifodalash).
strat: CONTRAST TRANZITSIYASI: Kuchayish (+) va zaiflashish (-) ziddiyatini 'However' bog'laydi.

pas: Urban green roofs absorb storm runoff, lower rooftop ambient temperatures, and provide crucial nesting habitat for migratory birds. ______, they reduce indoor building cooling costs by up to 25 percent during peak summer months.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B (In addition).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gap yashil tomlarning qator ijobiy afzalliklarini sanaydi (suvni yutadi, haroratni pasaytiradi, qushlarga makon bo'ladi). Ikkinchi gap yana bitta qo'shimcha afzallikni kiritadi: binolarning sovutish xarajatlarini 25% gacha qisqartiradi. Demak, qo'shimcha ma'lumot qo'shuvchi 'In addition' (bundan tashqari) to'g'ri javobdir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
C) Conversely - aksincha (ziddiyat yo'q).
D) Instead - o'rniga.
A) Otherwise - aks holda.
strat: QO'SHIMCHA MA'LUMOT: Ijobiy afzalliklarga yana yangi afzallik qo'shilganda 'In addition' ishlatiladi.

pas: Certain fungal endophytes produce alkaloid compounds that deter insect herbivores from feeding on host fescue grasses. ______, grasses colonized by these symbiotic fungi exhibit significantly higher survival rates in beetle-infested meadows.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B (Consequently).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gap sababni keltirmoqda: zamburug'lar hasharotlarni qo'rqituvchi moddalar ishlab chiqaradi. Ikkinchi gap esa uning tabiiy natijasini (oqibatini) bayon qilmoqda: shuning uchun ushbu zamburug'li o'tlar hasharotlar ko'p bo'lgan yaylovlarda yuqoriroq tirik qolish ko'rsatkichiga ega. Sabab-oqibat bog'liqligi uchun 'Consequently' (oqibatda / natijada) ishlatiladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
D) In contrast - taqqoslash/ziddiyat.
A) Meanwhile - ayni paytda (vaqt).
C) Earlier - ilgariroq.
strat: NATIJA BOG'LOVCHISI: Sababdan kelib chiquvchi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri natija uchun 'Consequently' tanlanadi.

pas: Geologists have long recognized that volcanic calderas collapse along ring fractures following massive explosive eruptions. ______, the precise subsurface magma withdrawal dynamics that trigger catastrophic caldera roof failure remain fiercely contested.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A (Still).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gap geologlar vulqon kalderalarining qulashini azaldan bilishini ('have long recognized...') aytadi. Ikkinchi gap esa qulashni keltirib chiqaruvchi aniq dinamika hamon qizg'in bahslarga sabab bo'layotganini ('remain fiercely contested') bildiradi. Biror narsa ma'lum bo'lishiga qaramay, boshqa jihati noaniq ekanini ifodalash uchun qarshilantiruvchi 'Still' (shunday bo'lsa-da / biroq) bog'lovchisi to'g'ri keladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Accordingly - shunga muvofiq (natija).
C) Likewise - xuddi shunday (o'xshashlik).
D) Thus - shu sababli.
strat: QARSHILIK BOG'LOVCHISI: 'Still' / 'Yet' — ma'lum faktga qaramay boshqa narsa noaniqligini ko'rsatadi.

pas: Before presenting their final financial audit, the accounting committee reviewed thousands of digital invoices. ______, they interviewed department managers to reconcile lingering budgetary discrepancies.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B (Subsequently).

Matn tahlili:
Bu yerda vaqt bo'yicha ketma-ketlik (chronological sequence) ifodalangan: hisobchilar avval minglab hisob-fakturalarni ko'rib chiqishgan, shundan so'ng / keyin ('Subsequently') noaniqliklarni hal qilish uchun bo'lim rahbarlari bilan suhbat o'tkazishgan.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
C) Conversely - aksincha.
A) Rather - aksincha / uning o'rniga.
D) Nevertheless - shunga qaramay.
strat: VAQT KETMA-KETLIGI: Bir harakatdan keyingi navbatdagi harakat uchun 'Subsequently' (keyinchalik / shundan so'ng) ishlatiladi.

pas: Deep convolutional neural networks excel at extracting complex statistical patterns from vast datasets. ______, they frequently struggle to generalize when confronted with inputs that fall outside their initial training distributions.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D (On the other hand).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gap neyrotarmoqlarning kuchli tomonini ta'kidlaydi ('excel at extracting complex statistical patterns'). Ikkinchi gap esa ularning asosiy kamchiligini ochib beradi ('struggle to generalize...'). Bu ikki tomonlama taqqoslash va ziddiyat bo'lgani sababli 'On the other hand' (boshqa tomondan) eng mantiqiy bog'lovchidir.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) In conclusion - xulosa (umumiy xulosa chiqarilmayapti).
B) For example - misol (birinchi gapdagi muvaffaqiyatga misol emas, kamchilik aytilmoqda).
C) Similarly - o'xshashlik.
strat: IKKI TOMONLAMA TAQQOSLASH: Ijobiy ustunlik va unga qarama-qarshi kamchilik uchun 'On the other hand' mos keladi.

pas: To minimize aerodynamic drag, modern high-speed passenger trains feature tapered noses and enclosed undercarriages. ______, Japan's Shinkansen Series E5 incorporates a 15-meter streamlined nose specifically engineered to prevent sonic micro-booms inside mountain tunnels.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D (Specifically).

Matn tahlili:
Birinchi gap poyezdlarda uchraydigan umumiy qoidani bayon qiladi ('modern high-speed passenger trains feature tapered noses...'). Ikkinchi gap esa ushbu umumiy qoidaning aniq va o'ziga xos bir misolini (Yaponiyaning Shinkansen Series E5 poyezdi 15 metrli burni) keltiradi. Umumiy qoidadan xususiy misolga o'tishda 'Specifically' (xususan / aynan aytganda) bog'lovchisi ishlatiladi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Regardless - baribir / e'tibor bermasdan.
C) Instead - o'rniga.
B) Ultimately - oxir-oqibat.
strat: UMUMIYDAN XUSUSIYGA: Umumiy qoidadan aniq bitta poyezd misoliga o'tishda 'Specifically' tanlanadi.

pas:
While researching an extinct carnivore, a student took the following notes:
- The thylacine, commonly called the Tasmanian tiger, was an apex carnivorous marsupial.
- It possessed a pouch for carrying young, characteristic of Australian marsupials.
- Despite being a marsupial, its skull and body shape converged remarkably with placental canids like wolves.
- This resemblance is a textbook example of convergent evolution: unrelated species evolving similar physical traits to fill identical ecological niches.
- The last known captive thylacine died in a Hobart zoo in 1936.
q: The student wants to explain the biological significance of the thylacine's physical appearance. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: Commonly called the Tasmanian tiger, the thylacine was an Australian carnivorous marsupial whose last known captive individual died in 1936.
Convergent evolution occurs when two species live in identical habitats, as demonstrated by the extinction of the thylacine in Tasmania.
The thylacine's striking physical resemblance to placental wolves illustrates convergent evolution, wherein unrelated species independently develop similar traits to fill equivalent niches.
Although the thylacine possessed a pouch like other marsupials, it was hunted to extinction in the early twentieth century.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: C.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'explain the biological significance of the thylacine's physical appearance' (tilatsin tashqi ko'rinishining biologik ahamiyatini tushuntirish).
C variantda uning bo'rilarga o'xshash tashqi ko'rinishi ('physical resemblance to placental wolves') konvergent evolutsiyaning biologik ahamiyatini ('illustrates convergent evolution, wherein unrelated species independently develop similar traits...') to'liq va aniq ochib bergan.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Tashqi ko'rinishning biologik ahamiyati emas, yo'qolib ketgan yili aytilgan.
D) O'ldirib yo'q qilingani haqida gapiradi, biologik ahamiyat yo'q.
B) Konvergensiyani noto'g'ri ta'riflaydi va uning o'limi bilan bog'laydi.
strat: RITORIK MAQSAD: Savoldagi 'explain biological significance of physical appearance' talabiga to'g'ri keluvchi yagona variantni belgilang.

pas:
While researching early cartography, a student took the following notes:
- The Waldseemüller Map, printed in 1507 by German cartographer Martin Waldseemüller, is a historic world map.
- It is famous for being the first map to depict and label the landmass 'America' in honor of explorer Amerigo Vespucci.
- It challenged Ptolemaic geography by showing the Americas separated from Asia by a vast western ocean.
- Only one original printed copy of the 1507 map survives today.
- In 2003, the Library of Congress acquired this sole surviving copy for $10 million.
q: The student wants to emphasize the revolutionary geographical claim made by the Waldseemüller Map. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: The Waldseemüller Map is an exceptionally rare cartographic artifact, with only a single original copy known to exist today.
Purchased by the Library of Congress for $10 million in 2003, the Waldseemüller Map is the only surviving printed copy from 1507.
Printed in 1507, the Waldseemüller Map was named after Martin Waldseemüller, who admired explorer Amerigo Vespucci.
The 1507 Waldseemüller Map broke with Ptolemaic geography by charting the Americas as a distinct continent separated from Asia by a vast ocean.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'emphasize the revolutionary geographical claim made by the Waldseemüller Map' (xaritadagi inqilobiy jo'g'rofiy da'voni ta'kidlash).
D variant aynan Ptolomey geografiyasidan voz kechib, Amerika qit'asini Osiyodan ulkan okean bilan ajralib turgan alohida qit'a sifatida ko'rsatgan inqilobiy da'voni aks ettiradi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) 10 million dollarga sotib olinganini ta'kidlaydi (iqtisodiy/nodirlik jihati).
C) Martin Waldseemüller nomi kelib chiqishini aytadi.
A) Faqat bitta nusxasi saqlanib qolganini ta'kidlaydi (kamyoblik jihati).
strat: MAQSAD: 'emphasize revolutionary geographical claim' -> Ptolomey qarashini inkor etib, yangi qit'a ekanini ko'rsatgan variant (D).

pas:
While researching renewable energy sources, a student took the following notes:
- Geothermal energy harnesses heat stored beneath the Earth's crust to generate electricity.
- Iceland generates over 25 percent of its total electricity and 90 percent of its home heating from geothermal resources.
- Geothermal power plants produce minimal greenhouse gas emissions during operation.
- Unlike wind and solar power, geothermal energy provides reliable baseload power unaffected by weather conditions.
q: The student wants to contrast geothermal energy with solar and wind energy. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: Iceland derives 25 percent of its electricity and 90 percent of its heating from clean geothermal resources.
Unlike solar and wind power, which fluctuate depending on weather conditions, geothermal energy supplies consistent, weather-independent baseload power.
By harnessing heat trapped beneath the Earth's crust, geothermal power plants generate electricity with minimal carbon emissions.
Geothermal, wind, and solar systems are all renewable energy alternatives that reduce reliance on fossil fuel combustion.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'contrast geothermal energy with solar and wind energy' (geotermal energiyani quyosh va shamol energiyasi bilan qarama-qarshi qo'yish / farqini ko'rsatish).
B variantda ob-havoga bog'liq bo'lgan quyosh va shamoldan farqli o'laroq ('Unlike solar and wind power...'), geotermal energiya ob-havoga bog'liq bo'lmagan barqaror quvvat berishi aniq qarama-qarshi qilib ko'rsatilgan.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) Faqat Islandiya statistikasini aytadi, taqqoslamaydi.
C) Geotermal energiya qanday hosil bo'lishini tushuntiradi, quyosh/shamol bilan taqqoslamaydi.
D) Ularni birlashtiradi, lekin farqini (contrast) ko'rsatmaydi.
strat: TAQQOSLASH (CONTRAST): 'contrast ... with solar and wind' -> 'Unlike solar and wind power...' bilan boshlanuvchi variant to'g'ri!

pas:
While researching deep-sea biodiversity, a student took the following notes:
- Deep-sea corals live in cold, dark oceanic waters at depths exceeding 200 meters.
- Unlike tropical reef corals, cold-water corals lack symbiotic photosynthetic algae (zooxanthellae).
- To obtain nutrients, they capture drifting zooplankton and organic particles directly from ocean currents using their tentacles.
- Lophelia pertusa is the most widespread cold-water reef-building coral species in the North Atlantic.
q: The student wants to highlight how cold-water corals nourish themselves without sunlight. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: Unlike shallow tropical reef systems, cold-water corals thrive in frigid temperatures across deep oceanic waters.
Lacking photosynthetic algae, cold-water corals like Lophelia pertusa sustain themselves by capturing drifting organic particles and zooplankton with their tentacles.
Cold-water corals inhabit aphotic marine environments deeper than 200 meters, where sunlight cannot penetrate the ocean depths.
Lophelia pertusa is a prominent cold-water coral species that forms extensive deep-water biogenic reefs throughout the North Atlantic.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: B.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'highlight how cold-water corals nourish themselves without sunlight' (sovuq suv marjonlari quyosh nurisiz qanday oziqlanishini ko'rsatish).
B variant fotosintez qiluvchi suvo'tlar yo'qligi sababli, ular organik zarralar va zooplanktonlarni paypaslagichlari (tentacles) bilan tutib oziqlanishini bevosita ochib beradi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
D) Shimoliy Atlantikada rif hosil qilishini aytadi, oziqlanishini emas.
C) 200 metrdan chuqurda yashashini aytadi, oziqlanish mexanizmini ko'rsatmaydi.
A) Harorat va chuqurlikni aytadi, oziqlanish usuli yo'q.
strat: MAQSAD: 'how corals nourish themselves without sunlight' -> 'sustain themselves by capturing ... with tentacles'.

pas:
While researching linguistic preservation, a student took the following notes:
- The Cherokee syllabary was invented by Cherokee polymath Sequoyah between 1809 and 1821.
- It represents spoken syllables rather than individual alphabetic phonemes, containing 85 distinct characters.
- Before its creation, Cherokee was an exclusively oral language with no writing system.
- Sequoyah was completely illiterate in English and other written languages when he developed the script.
- Within months of its introduction, the Cherokee Nation achieved a literacy rate exceeding 90 percent.
q: The student wants to emphasize the unprecedented speed with which Sequoyah's invention transformed Cherokee literacy. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: Even though Sequoyah was illiterate in English, he spent over a decade designing an 85-character syllabary for his people.
Invented by Sequoyah between 1809 and 1821, the Cherokee syllabary consists of 85 characters that represent distinct spoken syllables.
The Cherokee writing system relies on syllabic characters rather than phonetic letters, distinguishing it from European alphabets.
Sequoyah's syllabary transformed Cherokee from an exclusively spoken language into a written one whose community literacy rate soared past 90 percent within months.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'emphasize the unprecedented speed with which Sequoyah's invention transformed Cherokee literacy' (Sequoyah ixtirosi cheroki savodxonligini misli ko'rilmagan tezlikda o'zgartirganini ta'kidlash).
D variant aynan 'soared past 90 percent within months' (bir necha oy ichida 90 foizdan oshdi) degan muddat va natijani urg'ulaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Bo'g'inlar soni va yaratilgan yillari aytilgan, savodxonlik tezligi yo'q.
A) Sequoyahning ingliz tilini bilmagani aytilgan.
C) Yevropa alifbolaridan farqi tushuntirilgan.
strat: MAQSAD: 'unprecedented speed' -> 'within months' degan muddat ko'rsatilgan variant (D)!

pas:
While researching an architectural landmark, a student took the following notes:
- The Crystal Palace was built in London to house the Great Exhibition of 1851.
- Designed by greenhouse architect Joseph Paxton, it was constructed almost entirely of prefabricated cast iron and sheet glass.
- Its modular design allowed the immense 990,000-square-foot structure to be assembled in just nine months.
- Paxton's use of mass-produced modular components set a historic precedent for modern skyscraper construction.
q: The student wants to emphasize the architectural legacy of Joseph Paxton's design. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: Assembled in only nine months, London's Crystal Palace spanned an extraordinary 990,000 square feet to host the Great Exhibition of 1851.
Joseph Paxton, an experienced greenhouse architect, designed the Crystal Palace using prefabricated iron and sheets of glass.
The Great Exhibition of 1851 was held inside the Crystal Palace, an expansive London pavilion made of glass and iron.
By successfully utilizing mass-produced, modular cast-iron components at the Crystal Palace, Joseph Paxton pioneered assembly methods that laid the foundation for modern skyscrapers.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: D.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'emphasize the architectural legacy of Joseph Paxton's design' (Joseph Paxton dizaynining me'moriy merosini / tarixiy ta'sirini ta'kidlash).
D variant uning modulli qismlardan foydalanishi zamonaviy osmono'par binolar qurilishi uchun poydevor qo'yganini ('laid the foundation for modern skyscrapers') aniq ko'rsatib, uning me'moriy merosini urg'ulaydi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
A) 9 oyda qurilgani va maydoni aytilgan, uzoq muddatli meros haqida emas.
B) Paxtonning issiqxona me'mori bo'lganini aytadi.
C) 1851-yilgi ko'rgazma haqida umumiy ma'lumot beradi.
strat: MEROS (LEGACY): 'architectural legacy' -> 'laid the foundation for modern skyscrapers'.

pas:
While researching space agriculture, a student took the following notes:
- In 2015, astronauts aboard the International Space Station (ISS) harvested and consumed space-grown 'Outredgeous' red romaine lettuce.
- The crops were cultivated inside NASA's Veggie plant growth chamber under red, blue, and green LED lights.
- Microbiological assays confirmed that the space lettuce was as nutritious and microbe-safe as Earth-grown counterparts.
- Cultivating fresh produce provides essential micronutrients and psychological well-being for crews on multi-year interplanetary missions.
q: The student wants to introduce NASA's Veggie growth chamber to an audience unfamiliar with it. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: NASA's Veggie plant growth chamber is an LED-powered system aboard the International Space Station designed to cultivate safe, nutritious produce like red romaine lettuce for astronauts.
Consuming fresh crops cultivated in space provides vital micronutrients and psychological benefits for crews traveling on long-duration spaceflights.
In 2015, astronauts aboard the International Space Station made history by harvesting and dining on fresh red romaine lettuce.
Microbiological assays verified that space-grown lettuce possesses nutritional levels identical to crops harvested on Earth.
exp:
To'g'ri javob: A.

Maqsad tahlili:
Talabaning maqsadi: 'introduce NASA's Veggie growth chamber to an audience unfamiliar with it' (NASA ning Veggie o'simlik o'stirish kamerasini u bilan tanish bo'lmagan auditoriyaga tanishtirish).
A variant aynan 'NASA's Veggie plant growth chamber is...' deb boshlanib, uning nima ekanligini (ISS dagi LED tizimi) va maqsadi (astonavtlar uchun xavfsiz va to'yimli sabzavotlar yetishtirish)ni to'liq tushuntirib tanishtiradi.

Noto'g'ri variantlar:
B) Sabzavot iste'mol qilishning ruhiy va ozuqaviy foydalarini aytadi, apparatni tanishtirmaydi.
C) 2015-yilgi voqeani aytadi, lekin Veggie kamerasini tanishtirmaydi.
D) Mikrobiologik tahlil natijalarini bildiradi, apparat haqida umumiy tushuncha bermaydi.
strat: AUDITORIYAGA TANISHTIRISH: 'introduce ... to an audience unfamiliar' -> 'NASA's Veggie ... is an LED-powered system aboard ISS...'.

q: An environmental monitoring station uses a digital thermometer calibrated according to the formula T_\(c=0.85\cdot T\)_raw \(-4.2\), where T_raw is the sensor resistance signal and T_c is the temperature in degrees Celsius. If the recorded Celsius temperature is 34.05 degrees, what was the sensor resistance signal T_raw?
exp: Berilgan formulaga T_\(c=34.05\) qiymatini qo'yamiz: \(0.85\cdot T\)_raw \(-4.2=34.05\). Ikkala tomonga 4.2 qo'shamiz: \(0.85\cdot T\)_raw = 38.25. T_raw ni topish uchun 38.25 ni 0.85 ga bo'lamiz: T_raw = \(\frac{38.25}{0.85}=45\). D variant to'g'ri. C variant (38.25) bo'lishni unutish natijasidir.
strat: DESMOS HACK: 1-qator: \(y=0.85x-4.2\); 2-qator: \(y=34.05\). Kesishish nuqtasining \(x\) koordinatasi \(x=45\).

q: A community theater charges $14 per adult ticket and $9 per child ticket. For a Saturday matinee, a total of 320 tickets were sold, generating $3,630 in revenue. How many adult tickets were sold?
exp: Kattalar chiptasi soni a, bolalar chiptasi soni \(c\) bo'lsin. Sistema: \(a+c=320\) va \(14a+9c=3630\). Birinchi tenglamadan \(c=320-a\) ni ikkinchisiga qo'yamiz: \(14a+9(320-a)=3630\) ⇒ \(14a+2880-9a=3630\) ⇒ \(5a=3630-2880=750\) ⇒ \(a=150\) ta kattalar chiptasi sotilgan. Bolalar chiptasi: \(320-150=170\) ta (D variant chalg'ituvchi tuzoq).
strat: DESMOS HACK: Desmosga \(x+y=320\) va \(14x+9y=3630\) kiritiladi. Kesishish nuqtasi (150, 170). \(x=150\) darhol chiqadi.

skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
q: A venture capital fund allocated a total of $4,500,000 across early-stage biotech and clean-energy startups. The expected annual return on biotech investments is 12%, and the expected return on clean-energy investments is 7%. If the total anticipated return from both sectors combined is $410,000, how much capital was invested in clean-energy startups?
exp: Biotech investitsiyasi b, toza energiya investitsiyasi \(c\) bo'lsin. Sistema: \(b+c=4500000\) va \(0.12b+0.07c=410000\). Birinchi tenglamadan \(b=4500000-c\) ni ikkinchisiga qo'yamiz: \(0.12(4500000-c)+0.07c=410000\) ⇒ \(540000-0.05c=410000\) ⇒ \(0.05c=130000\) ⇒ \(c\) = $2,600,000. Biotech ulushi b = $1,900,000 (D variant tuzoq). A to'g'ri.
strat: DESMOS HACK: \(x+y=4500000\) va \(0.12x+0.07y=410000\) ni Desmosga kiritib, \(y\) koordinatasini qarang: \(y=2600000\).

q: Line L in the xy-plane passes through the points (\(-3\), 7) and (5, \(-9\)). Line M is perpendicular to line L and passes through the point (4, 1). What is the y-intercept of line M?
exp: L chiziqning burchak koeffitsiyenti (slope): m_\(L=\frac{-9-7}{5-(-3)}=-\frac{16}{8}=-2\). L chiziqqa perpendikulyar bo'lgan M chiziqning burchak koeffitsiyenti manfiy teskari (negative reciprocal) bo'ladi: m_\(M=-\frac{1}{-2}=\frac{1}{2}=0.5\). M chiziq tenglamasi: \(y-1=0.5(x-4)\) ⇒ \(y=0.5x-2+1\) ⇒ \(y=0.5x-1\). y-intercept qiymati \(b=-1\). C variant (2) x-intercept bilan adashtirish oqibatidir.
strat: DESMOS HACK: Desmosga \(m=\frac{-9-7}{5-(-3)}\) deb kiritib, so'ng \(y-1=(-\frac{1}{m})(x-4)\) chiziladi. (0, \(-1\)) nuqta ko'rinadi.

skill: Linear inequalities in one or two variables
q: A catering service prepares boxed lunches. Each deluxe lunch requires 12 minutes to assemble, and each standard lunch requires 8 minutes. The catering staff can spend at most 6 hours assembling lunches today, and they must produce at least 35 total lunches. If d represents deluxe lunches and s represents standard lunches, which system models this situation?
exp: Vaqt birliklarini tenglashtiramiz: 6 soat = \(6\cdot 60=360\) daqiqa. 'At most 6 hours' demak <= 360 daqiqa: \(12d+8s\le 360\). 'At least 35 lunches' demak \(d+s\ge 35\). C va D variantlarida soat va daqiqa birlashtirilmagan (6 deb olingan), A variantida esa tengsizlik ishoralari teskari.
strat: SAT STRATEGY: Birlik konversiyasiga doimo e'tibor bering: 6 soat = 360 minut. 'At most' = <=, 'at least' = >=.

q: The total cost C, in dollars, of renting a utility trailer for d days is given by the function \(C(d)=42d+35\), where 35 represents a mandatory reservation and insurance fee. What is the rental cost for a customer who uses the trailer for 5 days?
exp: Funksiyaga \(d=5\) ni qo'yamiz: \(C(5)=42(5)+35=210+35\) = $245. A variant ($210) faqat kunlik ijara haqini hisoblab, boshlang'ich $35 sug'urta to'lovini unutish natijasidir.
strat: DESMOS HACK: Desmosga \(C(d)=42d+35\) kiritib, \(C(5)\) deb yozilsa, darhol 245 qiymatini qaytaradi.

skill: Linear inequalities in one or two variables
q: A logistics warehouse uses heavy-duty forklifts that can carry at most 3,200 kilograms per load. Each crate of industrial machinery weighs 140 kilograms, and each pallet of steel fasteners weighs 85 kilograms. If a forklift operator loads 12 crates of machinery, what is the maximum number of full pallets of fasteners that can be loaded without exceeding the forklift weight limit?
exp: 12 ta uskuna qutisining umumiy og'irligi: \(12\cdot 140=1680\) kg. Qolgan ko'tarish quvvati: \(3200-1680=1520\) kg. Fastener palletlari soni \(p\): \(85\cdot p\le 1520\) ⇒ \(p\le \frac{1520}{85}=17.88\)... To'liq palletlar so'ralgani uchun maksimal butun son \(p=17\) bo'ladi. A variant to'g'ri. C variant (18) 1530 kg og'irlik hosil qilib limitdan oshadi.
strat: DESMOS HACK: \(\frac{3200-12\cdot 140}{85}\) hisoblansa 17.88 chiqadi. Pastga yaxlitlanadi: 17 ta.

q: The graph of the linear function f has an x-intercept at (8, 0) and a y-intercept at (0, \(-6\)). What is the slope of the graph of f?
exp: Burchak koeffitsiyenti formulasi: \(m=\frac{y_{2}-y_{1}}{x_{2}-x_{1}}\). Berilgan nuqtalar (\(x_{1}\), \(y_{1}\)) = (8, 0) va (\(x_{2}\), \(y_{2}\)) = (0, \(-6\)). \(m=\frac{-6-0}{0-8}=-\frac{6}{-8}=\frac{3}{4}\). C variant \((-\frac{3}{4})\) ishorada adashish, B variant \((\frac{4}{3})\) esa teskari nisbat (run over rise) xatosidir.
strat: DESMOS HACK: Desmos jadvaliga (8, 0) va (0, \(-6\)) kiritib, \(y_{1}\) ~ \(m\cdot x_{1}+b\) regressiya chaqirilsa, \(m=0.75=\frac{3}{4}\) chiqadi.

q: In the xy-plane, the vertices of a triangle are located at A(2, 3), B(8, 3), and C(5, 7). What is the area of triangle ABC?
exp: A(2, 3) va B(8, 3) nuqtalar \(y=3\) gorizontal to'g'ri chizig'ida yotadi. Demak, uchburchak asosi uzunligi: asos = \(8-2=6\) birlik. Balandlik esa C(5, 7) nuqtadan \(y=3\) to'g'ri chiziqqacha bo'lgan vertikal masofadir: balandlik = \(7-3=4\) birlik. Uchburchak yuzi formulasi: \(S=0.5\) * asos * balandlik = \(0.5\cdot 6\cdot 4=12\). B variant to'g'ri.
strat: DESMOS HACK: Desmosga polygon((2,3), (8,3), (5,7)) deb yozing, Desmos uning yuzini darhol 12 deb ko'rsatadi.

q: An agricultural agronomist models the yield Y, in bushels of wheat per acre, as a function of fertilizer application \(x\), in kilograms per hectare, using the quadratic function \(Y(x)=-0.05x^{2}+6x+80\). According to this model, what amount of fertilizer \(x\) maximizes the per-acre wheat yield?
exp: Kvadratik funksiya \(a=-0.05<0\) bo'lgani uchun o'zining cho'qqi (vertex) nuqtasida maksimal qiymatga erishadi. Cho'qqining \(x\) koordinatasi: \(x=-\frac{b}{2a}=-\frac{6}{2\cdot (-0.05)}=-\frac{6}{-0.10}=60\) kg/ga. Demak, \(x=60\) bo'lganda hosildorlik eng yuqori bo'ladi. C to'g'ri.
strat: DESMOS HACK: \(y=-0.05x^{2}+6x+80\) ni chizib, parabolaning cho'qqisini bosing: (60, 260). \(x=60\) darhol ko'rinadi.

q: A model rocket is launched vertically from a platform. Its height \(h\), in meters above the ground, \(t\) seconds after launch is modeled by the equation \(h(t)=-4.9t^{2}+39.2t+4\). At what time \(t\), in seconds, does the rocket reach its maximum height?
exp: Maksimal balandlikka erishish vaqti parabolaning cho'qqisiga to'g'ri keladi: \(t=-\frac{b}{2a}=-\frac{39.2}{2\cdot (-4.9)}=-\frac{39.2}{-9.8}=4.0\) soniya. B variant to'g'ri. D variant (8.0) raketaning yerga qaytib tushish vaqtiga yaqin bo'lib chalg'ituvchi tuzoqdir.
strat: DESMOS HACK: \(y=-4.9x^{2}+39.2x+4\) parabola cho'qqisi (4, 82.4) da joylashgan. Maksimal vaqt \(t=4\) soniya.

q: In quantum physics calculations, two state amplitudes are represented by complex numbers \(z_{1}=4-3i\) and \(z_{2}=2+5i\), where \(i=\sqrt{-1}\). What is the value of the complex product \(z_{1}\cdot z_{2}\)?
exp: Qavslarni ochamiz: \((4-3i)(2+5i)=4(2)+4(5i)-3i(2)-3i(5i)=8+20i-6i-15(i^{2})\). \(i^{2}=-1\) ekanini bilamiz, demak \(-15(-1)=+15\). Haqiqiy qismlarni qo'shamiz: \(8+15=23\). Mavhum qismlarni qo'shamiz: \(20i-6i=14i\). Yakuniy natija: \(23+14i\). C variant to'g'ri. D variant \(i^{2}=+1\) deb xato olish natijasidir.
strat: SAT COMPLEX NUMBERS RULE: \(i^{2}=-1\) qoidasini unutmang: \(-15i^{2}=-15(-1)=+15\). Natija: \(8+15+14i=23+14i\).

q: A sample of a radioactive isotope decays according to the model \(N(t)=480\cdot (0.85)^{\frac{t}{12}}\), where \(N(t)\) is the remaining mass in milligrams after \(t\) hours. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the number 12 in this context?
opts: The isotope completely decays after 12 hours.
The mass decreases by 15% every 12 hours.
The mass decreases by 85% every 12 hours.
exp: Eksponentsial ifodada 0.85 asos 1 - 0.15 ga teng, demak miqdor har bir siklda 15% ga kamayadi. Darajadagi \(\frac{t}{12}\) ifodasi ushbu 15% pasayish har 12 soatda bir marta sodir bo'lishini ko'rsatadi (\(t=12\) bo'lganda daraja 1 bo'ladi). Shuning uchun har 12 soatda massa 15% ga kamayadi.
strat: SAT STRATEGY: Ko'paytiruvchi \(0.85=(1-0.15)\) → 15% pasayish. Daraja maxraji (12) esa bu o'zgarishning davriyligini (har 12 soat) belgilaydi.

q: The rational function R is defined by \(R(x)=\frac{3x+12}{x^{2}-7x+10}\). For which of the following positive values of \(x\) is the function R undefined?
exp: Kasr funksiya maxraji nolga teng bo'lganda aniqlanmagan (undefined) bo'ladi: \(x^{2}-7x+10=0\). Ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: \((x-2)(x-5)=0\). Funksiya \(x=2\) va \(x=5\) da aniqlanmagan. Variantlar orasida \(x=2\) (D varianti) mavjud.
strat: DESMOS HACK: \(y=\frac{3x+12}{x^{2}-7x+10}\) ni kiritib, vertikal asimptotalarni qidiring: \(x=2\) va \(x=5\).

q: If \(\frac{x^{3}-2x^{2}-17x+10}{x-5}=ax^{2}+bx+c\) for all \(x\ne 5\), what is the value of \(a+b+c\)?
What is the positive solution to the equation \(\sqrt{3x+16}-x=2\)?
exp: Ildizni ajratamiz: \(\sqrt{3x+16}=x+2\). Ikkala tomonni kvadratga ko'taramiz: \(3x+16=(x+2)^{2}\) ⇒ \(3x+16=x^{2}+4x+4\). Tartiblaymiz: \(x^{2}+x-12=0\). Ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: \((x+4)(x-3)=0\). Ildizlar \(x=-4\) va \(x=3\). \(x=-4\) ni tekshiramiz: \(\sqrt{-12+16}-(-4)=2+4=6\ne 2\) (chet ildiz). \(x=3\) ni tekshiramiz: \(\sqrt{9+16}-3=5-3=2\) (to'g'ri). Musbat yechim \(x=3\).
strat: DESMOS HACK: \(y=\sqrt{3x+16}-x\) va \(y=2\) ni chizing. Kesishish nuqtasi \(x=3\) da aniq ko'rinadi.

q: A colony of marine bioluminescent algae has an initial population of 2,500 cells and quadruples every 6 hours. Which of the following functions P models the population of the algae colony \(t\) hours after observation begins?
exp: Boshlang'ich populyatsiya 2500 ga teng. 'Quadruples' so'zi har bir siklda 4 barobarga ko'payishini bildiradi (asos = 4). Ushbu to'rt baravar ortish har 6 soatda yuz berganligi sababli, daraja \(\frac{t}{6}\) bo'ladi. Funksiya: \(P(t)=2500\cdot (4)^{\frac{t}{6}}\). D variant to'g'ri. A variantida har soatda \(4^{6}\) ko'payish xatosi qilingan.
strat: SAT EXPONENTIAL MODEL: Boshlang'ich qiymat (2500) * (ko'payish koeffitsiyenti: 4)^(vaqt / davr: \(\frac{t}{6}\)).

q: The function \(h\) is defined by \(h(x)=(x-2)^{2}\cdot (x+4)\). For how many distinct real values of \(x\) does the graph of \(y=h(x)\) cross or touch the x-axis?
exp: Funksiyaning \(x\) o'qi bilan kesishishi yoki urinishi \(h(x)=0\) bo'lganda ro'y beradi: \((x-2)^{2}\cdot (x+4)=0\). Bu tenglamaning haqiqiy ildizlari \(x=2\) (karrali ildiz, grafik urinadi) va \(x=-4\) (oddiy ildiz, grafik kesib o'tadi). Jami 2 ta turlicha haqiqiy qiymat mavjud. D variant (3) darajalar soni (ildizlar karraligi) bilan adashtirishdir.
strat: DESMOS HACK: Desmosga \(y=(x-2)^{2}\cdot (x+4)\) kiritilsa, grafik \(x\) o'qini faqat (\(-4\), 0) va (2, 0) nuqtalarida kesishi/urinishi ko'rinadi (2 ta nuqta).

q: An online electronics retailer discounted the price of a tablet by 20%. During a holiday flash sale, the retailer applied an additional 15% discount to the already reduced price. The final sale price was $272. What was the original price of the tablet before any discounts?
exp: Dastlabki narx P bo'lsin. 20% chegirmadan so'ng narx: \(P\cdot (1-0.20)=0.80P\) bo'ldi. Ikkinchi 15% chegirmadan so'ng: \(0.80P\cdot (1-0.15)=0.80P\cdot 0.85=0.68P\) bo'ldi. Yakuniy narx \(0.68P=272\). Bundan \(P=\frac{272}{0.68}\) = $400 kelib chiqadi. 20% + 15% = 35% deb xato hisoblansa (\(\frac{272}{0.65}\) = $418.46) B varianti tuzog'iga tushiladi.
strat: DESMOS HACK: \(\frac{272}{0.80\cdot 0.85}\) hisoblansa to'g'ridan-to'g'ri 400 chiqadi. Ketma-ket chegirmalarni hech qachon shunchaki qo'shmang!

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: A commercial water pump discharges 45 gallons of water per minute. At this rate, how many hours will it take to pump out 8,100 gallons from a flooded reservoir?
exp: Dastlab umumiy sarflanadigan daqiqalarni topamiz: \(\frac{8100}{45}=180\) daqiqa. Daqiqalarni soatga aylantirish uchun 60 ga bo'lamiz: \(\frac{180}{60}=3.0\) soat. C variant to'g'ri.
strat: SAT STRATEGY: 8100 gallon / (45 gallon/min * 60 min/hour) = \(\frac{8100}{2700}=3\) soat.

q: The table categorizes 180 college seniors by their major and career path intention. If a student is chosen at random from those who intend to enter an industry job, what is the probability that the student is a STEM major?
exp: Shartli ehtimollik: tanlov 'from those who intend to enter an industry job' guruhidan qilinmoqda, demak namuna fazosi (maxraj) jami Industry Job tanlaganlar soni = 112. Ular orasidan STEM mutaxassisligi bo'lganlar (surat) = 54. Ehtimollik: \(\frac{54}{112}\) (qisqartirganda \(\frac{27}{56}\)). B variant \((\frac{54}{180})\) shartli ehtimollikni umumiy talabalar soniga bo'lish xatosidir.
strat: SAT STRATEGY: 'Given that' yoki 'from those who...' iborasidan keyingi guruh maxrajga qo'yiladi: maxraj = 112, surat = 54 → \(\frac{54}{112}\).

q: A dataset consists of 9 distinct positive integers with a median of 45 and a mean of 50. If the largest number in the dataset, which is 88, is increased to 124, which of the following statements must be true about the updated dataset?
opts: Both the median and the mean will increase.
Both the median and the mean will remain unchanged.
The median will increase, but the mean will remain unchanged.
The mean will increase, but the median will remain unchanged.
exp: To'plamda 9 ta son bor, mediana o'rtadagi \(5-o\)'rindagi sondir (45). Eng katta son (\(9-o\)'rindagi son) 88 dan 124 ga oshirilsa, o'rtadagi 5-son (mediana) o'zgarmay qoladi (chunki 124 hali ham medianadan ancha katta). Biroq elementlar yig'indisi oshgani sababli, o'rtacha arifmetik (mean) ortadi. Shuning uchun D to'g'ri.
strat: SAT STRATEGY: Ekstremal qiymat (outlier) o'zgarganda o'rtacha qiymat (mean) darhol sezadi, mediana esa tartiblangan o'rinda barqaror qoladi.

q: A random sample of 600 voters in a metropolitan district showed that 54% support a municipal public transit initiative, with an associated margin of error of 4% at a 95% confidence level. Which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion?
opts: The sample size was too small to draw any meaningful statistical inference.
If a new sample of 600 voters is surveyed, exactly 54% of them will support the initiative.
Exactly 54% of all voters in the district support the initiative.
It is plausible that between 50% and 58% of all voters in the district support the initiative.
exp: Ishonch oralig'i (confidence interval) = nuqtaviy baho +- xatolik chegarasi: 54% +\(-4\)% = [50%, 58%]. Bu butun tuman saylovchilarining haqiqiy qo'llab-quvvatlash ulushi 50% dan 58% gacha bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori (plausible) ekanini bildiradi. C va B variantlari deterministik ('exactly') noto'g'ri da'volardir.
strat: SAT STRATEGY: SAT statistikasida 'exactly' so'zi deyarli har doim xato bo'ladi. Ishonch oralig'i doimo oraliq ('between A% and B%') ifodasini talab qiladi.

q: A scatterplot displays the relationship between weekly advertising expenditure \(x\), in hundreds of dollars, and weekly customer foot traffic \(y\), in hundreds of visits. The line of best fit is given by \(y=1.45x+18.2\). According to this model, what is the predicted weekly foot traffic, in visits, when advertising expenditure is $1,200?
exp: Birliklarga e'tibor beramiz: \(x\) 'hundreds of dollars'da o'lchanadi. Reklama xarajati $1,200 bo'lsa, \(x=\frac{1200}{100}=12\) bo'ladi. Tenglamaga qo'yamiz: \(y=1.45(12)+18.2=17.4+18.2=35.6\). \(y\) ham 'hundreds of visits'da o'lchanganligi uchun tashriflar soni: \(35.6\cdot 100=3{,}560\) ta tashrif bo'ladi. D variant to'g'ri.
strat: SAT STRATEGY: Birlik masshtabi tuzog'i! $1,200 → \(x=12\); natija \(y=35.6\) → \(35.6\cdot 100=3{,}560\) visits.

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: An artisan ceramicist mixes two clay compounds. Compound A contains 18% kaolin by weight, and Compound B contains 42% kaolin by weight. The artisan wants to create a 60-kilogram mixture that contains exactly 34% kaolin by weight. How many kilograms of Compound B should be used?
exp: Compound B og'irligi \(x\) kg bo'lsin, shunda Compound A og'irligi \(60-x\) kg bo'ladi. Kaolin miqdori bo'yicha tenglama: \(0.18(60-x)+0.42x=0.34(60)\). Qavslarni ochamiz: \(10.8-0.18x+0.42x=20.4\) ⇒ \(0.24x=20.4-10.8=9.6\) ⇒ \(x=\frac{9.6}{0.24}=40\) kg. Demak, 40 kg Compound B va 20 kg Compound A kerak. C variant to'g'ri.
strat: DESMOS HACK: Desmosga \(0.18(60-x)+0.42x=0.34\cdot 60\) deb yozing. To'g'ri chiziq \(x=40\) da hosil bo'ladi.

q: In a municipal botanical greenhouse, the number of exotic orchid varieties increased from 160 to 208 over a three-year period. What was the percentage increase in the number of orchid varieties?
exp: Foiz oshishi formulasi: (Yangi - Eski) / Eski * 100% = \(\frac{208-160}{160}\cdot 100\)% = \(\frac{48}{160}\cdot 100\)% = \(0.30\cdot 100\)% = 30%. B variant (48%) mutlaq sonni (48 ta) foiz bilan adashtirish natijasidir.
strat: DESMOS HACK: \(\frac{208-160}{160}\) hisoblansa darhol \(0.30=30\)% chiqadi.

q: A surveyor stands 120 feet away from the base of a vertical communications tower on level ground. The angle of elevation from the surveyor's transit instrument, which is mounted 5 feet above ground level, to the top of the tower is 35 degrees. Which of the following expressions represents the total height of the tower, in feet?
exp: Asbob balandligidan minora cho'qqisigacha bo'lgan to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda: yondosh katet = 120 fut, burchak = 35°. Qarama-qarshi katet h_top bo'lsa: \(\tan(35^{\circ})=h\)_top / 120 ⇒ h_top = \(120\cdot \tan(35^{\circ})\). Minoraning umumiy balandligi yer sathidan hisoblangani uchun asbobning 5 fut balandligini qo'shamiz: \(H=120\cdot \tan(35^{\circ})+5\). A variant to'g'ri.
strat: SAT TRIGONOMETRY HACK: \(tan\)(theta) = qarshi / yondosh. h_top = \(120\cdot \tan(35^{\circ})\); yer sathiga nisbatan +5 fut qo'shiladi → A.

q: A circle in the xy-plane has its center at the origin (0, 0). A line segment with length 16 is a chord of the circle. If the distance from the origin to the midpoint of this chord is 6, what is the area of the circle?
exp: Markazdan vatarning o'rtasigacha bo'lgan masofa vatarga perpendikulyar bo'ladi va to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak hosil qiladi. Uchburchak katetlari: markazdan masofa \(d=6\) va vatar yarmi = \(\frac{16}{2}=8\). Gipotenuza aylananing radiusi \(r\) bo'ladi: \(r^{2}=6^{2}+8^{2}=36+64=100\). Aylana yuzi: \(S=\pi \cdot r^{2}=100\cdot \pi\). A variant to'g'ri.
strat: SAT GEOMETRY TRAP: 6-8-10 to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak! Radius \(r=10\) bo'ladi. Doira yuzi: \(\pi \cdot 10^{2}=100\cdot \pi\).

q: A circle has a radius of 18 centimeters. What is the area, in square centimeters, of a sector formed by a central angle measuring 80 degrees?
exp: Doira sektori yuzi formulasi: S = (theta / 360) * pi * \(r\)^2. Berilgan: theta = 80°, \(r=18\). \(S=(\frac{80}{360})\cdot \pi \cdot (18)^{2}=(\frac{2}{9})\cdot \pi \cdot 324=2\cdot 36\cdot \pi =72\cdot \pi\) sm^2. C variant \((36\cdot \pi )\) yoy uzunligi bilan aralashtirish xatosi.
strat: DESMOS HACK: \((\frac{80}{360})\cdot 18^{2}=72\). Natija darhol \(72\cdot \pi\) ekanligi ko'rinadi.

q: Two right circular cylinders, Cylinder X and Cylinder Y, are mathematically similar. The height of Cylinder Y is 3 times the height of Cylinder X. If the volume of Cylinder X is 24 cubic inches, what is the volume of Cylinder Y, in cubic inches?
exp: O'xshash uch o'lchamli geometrik jismlar uchun chiziqli o'lchamlar nisbati \(k\) bo'lsa, ularning hajmlari nisbati \(k^{3}\) bo'ladi. Bu yerda balandliklar nisbati \(k=3\). Shuning uchun hajmlar nisbati \(k^{3}=3^{3}=27\). Cylinder Y hajmi: V_\(Y=24\cdot 27=648\) kub dyuym. C variant (72) faqat \(24\cdot 3\) ni hisoblash (chiziqli nisbat xatosi) natijasidir.
strat: SAT GEOMETRY TRAP: Chiziqli nisbat = \(k\); Yuza nisbati = \(k^{2}\); Hajm nisbati = \(k^{3}\)! \(24\cdot 3^{3}=24\cdot 27=648\).

q: In triangle PQR, the measure of angle P is 48 degrees and the measure of angle Q is 74 degrees. What is the measure of the exterior angle at vertex R?
exp: Uchburchak tashqi burchagi xossasiga ko'ra, har qanday cho'qqidagi tashqi burchak o'ziga qo'shni bo'lmagan ikkita ichki burchak yig'indisiga teng: Ext_R = Angle_P + Angle_\(Q=48^{\circ}+74^{\circ}=122^{\circ}\). Shu bilan birga, ichki burchak \(R=180^{\circ}-(48^{\circ}+74^{\circ})=180^{\circ}-122^{\circ}=58^{\circ}\) (C varianti bu ichki burchak). Tashqi burchak: \(180^{\circ}-58^{\circ}=122^{\circ}\).
strat: SAT STRATEGY: Tashqi burchak teoremasi: Ext = \(P+Q=48+74=122^{\circ}\). Bir qadamda topiladi.

q: A 26-foot extension ladder leans against the vertical exterior wall of a building. The base of the ladder is placed 10 feet away from the wall on level ground. How many feet up the wall does the top of the ladder reach?
exp: Zina, devor va yer to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak hosil qiladi. Pifagor teoremasi bo'yicha: \(a^{2}+b^{2}=c^{2}\), bu yerda gipotenuza \(c=26\) fut, katet \(a=10\) fut. \(b^{2}=26^{2}-10^{2}=676-100=576\). \(b=\sqrt{576}=24\) fut. (Bu 5-12-13 Pifagor uchligining 2 ga ko'paytirilgan shakli: 10-24-26).
strat: DESMOS HACK: \(\sqrt{26^{2}-10^{2}}=24\). Pifagor uchliklarini eslab qoling: 5-12-13 → 10-24-26.

q: In right triangle DEF, angle F is the right angle, and \(\tan(D)=\frac{15}{8}\). What is the value of \(\sin(D)\)?
exp: \(\tan(D)\) = qarshisidagi katet / yondosh katet = \(\frac{15}{8}\). Gipotenuzani Pifagor teoremasi orqali topamiz: \(c=\sqrt{15^{2}+8^{2}}=\sqrt{225+64}=\sqrt{289}=17\). (8-15-17 mashhur Pifagor uchligi). \(\sin(D)\) = qarshisidagi katet / gipotenuza = \(\frac{15}{17}\). A variant \((\frac{8}{17})\cos(D)\) qiymatidir.
strat: SAT STRATEGY: 8-15-17 uchburchagini yodda saqlang. tan = \(\frac{15}{8}\) → gipotenuza = 17. sin = qarama-qarshi / gipotenuza = \(\frac{15}{17}\).

q: A solid rectangular storage container has a base with length 14 meters and width 8 meters. If the total volume of the container is 504 cubic meters, what is the height of the container, in meters?
exp: To'g'ri to'rtburchakli parallelepiped hajmi: \(V=l\cdot w\cdot h\). Berilgan: \(V=504\), \(l=14\), \(w=8\). Asos yuzi: \(14\cdot 8=112\) \(m^{2}\). Balandlik: \(h=\frac{504}{112}=4.5\) metr. A variant to'g'ri.
strat: DESMOS HACK: \(\frac{504}{14\cdot 8}\) hisoblansa 4.5 chiqadi.

pas: During the mid-nineteenth century, steam locomotives revolutionized transcontinental shipping. Prior methods relied on horse-drawn wagons, which were notoriously sluggish and vulnerable to seasonal weather disruptions. The emergence of railroad networks rapidly transformed the commercial landscape, rendering long-distance freight delivery remarkably efficient.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'sluggish' most nearly mean?
exp: Matnda ot aravalari (horse-drawn wagons) poyezdlar bilan taqqoslanmoqda. Poyezdlar yuk yetkazishni 'tez va samarali' qilgan bo'lsa, avvalgi aravalar juda sekin va ob-havoga bog'liq bo'lgan. Shu sababli 'sluggish' so'zi bu kontekstda 'sekin harakatlanuvchi' (slow-moving) ma'nosini bildiradi. B varianti (lazy) shaxsiyatga xos bo'lib transport vositalariga nisbatan noto'g'ri ko'chma ma'nodir.
strat: SAT READING HACK: Kontekstdagi qarama-qarshilikka qarang: 'sluggish' so'zi keyingi gapdagi 'efficient and rapid' so'zlariga ziddir.

pas: In her critical monograph on avant-garde sculpture, art historian Evelyn Vance asserts that modernist installations cannot be appraised using classical geometric standards. Because modern sculptors deliberate to disrupt conventional symmetry, traditional frameworks are fundamentally ill-suited to capture the emotional resonance of their works.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'appraised' most nearly mean?
exp: Matnda modern san'at asarlarini klassik geometrik standartlar yordamida baholash yoki o'rganish mumkin emasligi aytilmoqda ('cannot be appraised using classical standards'). Demak, 'appraised' so'zi 'baholamoq' (evaluated) ma'nosida kelmoqda. B varianti (purchased - sotib olmoq) tijoriy baholash bilan adashtiruvchi tuzoqdir.
strat: SAT VOCAB IN CONTEXT: 'Standards' (mezonlar) bilan bog'langan fe'l tahliliy baholashni (evaluate) talab qiladi.

pas: Physicist Clara Mendez notes that while quantum entanglement has been verified across microscopic distances, extrapolating these principles to macroscopic systems remains speculative. Any claims suggesting that everyday biological processes are governed by macro-entanglement must be regarded as _______, requiring rigorous experimental corroboration before gaining scientific consensus.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
exp: Matnda makroskopik tizimlarga kvant xossalarini tatbiq etish 'speculative' (taxminiy) ekani va jiddiy eksperimental isbot ('rigorous experimental corroboration') talab qilishi ta'kidlanmoqda. Demak, bunday da'volar tasdiqlanmagan, faraziy ya'ni 'conjectural' (taxminiy, farazga asoslangan) deb qaralishi lozim. B (shubhasiz) va C (o'zgarmas) mutlaqo teskari ma'noli variantlardir.
strat: SAT CONTEXT CLUE: 'Speculative' va 'requiring corroboration' kalit so'zlari bo'shliqqa aniq 'conjectural' so'zini joylashtirishni talab qiladi.

pas: Ecologist Dr. Liam Park argues that introducing apex predators into fragmented nature reserves can sometimes yield _______ outcomes. While wolves in Yellowstone successfully restored riparian foliage by curtailing elk grazing, similar rewilding initiatives in smaller, arid habitats inadvertently triggered steep declines in endangered ground-nesting birds.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
exp: Matnda ikki xil muhitdagi oqibatlar taqqoslanmoqda: Yellowstone'da muvaffaqiyatli tiklanish yuz bergan, biroq kichikroq qurg'oqchil hududlarda qushlar populyatsiyasi keskin kamayib ketgan. Bu natijalar bir xil emas, balki bir-biridan butunlay farqli ('disparate' - contrasting/different) ekanini bildiradi. C va D variantlari qarama-qarshilikka zid.
strat: SAT CONTRAST CLUE: 'While X succeeded, Y triggered steep declines' strukturasi turlicha oqibatlarni (disparate outcomes) bildiradi.

pas: Although the treaty was intended to foster enduring geopolitical stability, its ambiguous clauses regarding territorial boundaries actually _______ diplomatic friction. Rather than cementing peace, the disputed wording provoked repeated border skirmishes throughout the subsequent decade.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
exp: Matndagi 'Although' bog'lovchisi kutilgan maqsad (barqarorlik) bilan haqiqiy natija (kelishmovchiliklarning kuchayishi, 'border skirmishes') o'rtasidagi ziddiyatni bildiradi. Noaniq bandlar diplomatik nizoni yumshatmagan, aksincha yanada og'irlashtirgan ('exacerbated' - worsened). A (yumshatmoq) va B (oldini olmoq) kontekstga ziddir.
strat: SAT CLUE: 'provoked border skirmishes' natijasi bo'shliqda salbiy, vaziyatni yomonlashtiruvchi fe'l ('exacerbated') bo'lishini talab qiladi.

pas: Marine biologists discovered that deep-sea hydrothermal vents support remarkably robust ecosystems despite the extreme pressure and complete absence of sunlight. Bacteria thriving near the vents convert toxic sulfur compounds into usable metabolic energy, providing sustenance for complex organisms like giant tube worms.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'robust' most nearly mean?
exp: Chuqur dengizdagi haddan tashqari yuqori bosim va mutlaq qorong'ulik kabi og'ir sharoitlarga qaramay ('despite extreme pressure...'), ekotizimlar rivojlanmoqda va hayot davom etmoqda. Bunday chidamlilik va bardoshlilikni ifodalash uchun 'robust' so'zi 'resilient' (chidamliligi yuqori, yashovchan) ma'nosini bildiradi. B varianti (fragile - nozik) to'liq ziddir.
strat: SAT CONTEXT: 'Thriving despite extreme conditions' sharoitida ekotizim 'resilient' (bardoshli) bo'ladi.

pas: Urban planners initially anticipated that opening a secondary highway bypass would alleviate morning traffic congestion in the downtown core. However, transportation economists noted that the new route merely induced additional automobile demand, leaving overall commute times essentially _______.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
exp: 'However' bog'lovchisi kutilgan yengillik amalga oshmaganini ko'rsatadi. Yangi yo'l qo'shimcha talabni yuzaga keltirgani sababli, umumiy yo'l vaqti deyarli o'zgarishsiz qolgan ('unaltered' - unchanged). B (qisqargan) va D (yo'qolgan) kutilgan samara bo'lib, 'However' inkoriga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
strat: SAT LOGIC: 'merely induced additional demand' iborasi tiqilinch yechilmaganini, ya'ni vaqt o'zgarmay qolganini (unaltered) anglatadi.

pas: Historian Marcus Sterling contends that the prime minister's public persona of folksy simplicity was entirely _______; private archival diaries reveal a shrewd, calculating tactician who carefully orchestrated every public appearance to neutralize political rivals.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word?
exp: Matn bosh vazirning omma oldidagi sodda ko'rinishi (folksy simplicity) bilan shaxsiy kundaliklaridagi o'ta ayyor va hisob-kitobli taktikasi (calculating tactician) o'rtasidagi soxtalikni ochib beradi. Demak, uning sodda qiyofasi samimiy emas, balki ataylab to'qib chiqarilgan, sun'iy yaratilgan ('manufactured' - fabricated/contrived).
strat: SAT CONTRAST CLUE: 'carefully orchestrated' va 'calculating' so'zlari ochiq qiyofaning 'manufactured' (sun'iy yasalgan) ekanini isbotlaydi.

pas: In literary criticism, the term 'polyphonic' is often applied to novels where the narrator's perspective does not subordinate the viewpoints of other characters. Instead, diverse voices retain distinct autonomy, engaging in an open dialogue that remains unresolved by an authoritative narrative voice.
q: As used in the text, what does the word 'subordinate' most nearly mean?
exp: Matnda aytilishicha, polifonik asarda hikoyachi boshqa qahramonlarning qarashlarini o'ziga bo'ysundirmaydi yoki bosib qo'ymaydi ('does not subordinate... instead characters retain distinct autonomy'). Demak, 'subordinate' bu yerda 'ustun kelmoq, bosib olmoq' (overpower / make secondary) ma'nosida ishlatilgan.
strat: SAT OPPOSITE CONTEXT: 'Does not subordinate... instead retain distinct autonomy' qarama-qarshiligi 'subordinate' = overpower ekanini ko'rsatadi.

pas: For decades, behavioral economists maintained that humans make consumer choices primarily based on rational utility calculations. In 2002, Daniel Kahneman presented empirical evidence demonstrating that cognitive heuristics and loss aversion consistently steer decision-makers away from purely mathematical optimization. Today, contemporary financial analysts increasingly integrate psychological profiling into risk management algorithms.
q: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
opts: It criticizes traditional psychological models, highlights their methodological flaws, and advocates for strict laboratory testing.
It presents an economic dilemma, proposes two incompatible resolutions, and endorses the more mathematically rigorous model.
It traces the historical biography of an influential researcher and analyzes his most celebrated publication.
It outlines a longstanding theory, describes a pivotal empirical challenge to it, and explains its current disciplinary impact.
exp: Matn uch bosqichli tuzilishga ega: 1) Ko'p yillik klassik ratsional model bayon qilinadi ('For decades...'); 2) Kahneman tomonidan keltirilgan tajribaviy e'tiroz va xulq-atvor omillari ko'rsatiladi ('In 2002, presented evidence...'); 3) Hozirgi kunda bu o'zgarishlar moliya sohasida qanday qo'llanilayotgani tushuntiriladi ('Today, analysts integrate...'). Bu D variantiga to'liq mos keladi.
strat: SAT TEXT STRUCTURE: Uch bosqichli xronologiyani ajrating: Past (For decades) -> Turning point (In 2002) -> Present (Today).

pas: Botanist Sarah Jenkins explores how mycorrhizal fungi networks facilitate resource exchange among mature forest trees. While skeptics initially dismissed the concept of inter-plant collaboration as romanticized teleology, Jenkins utilizes isotopic carbon tracing to unequivocally demonstrate that shaded understory seedlings receive vital carbohydrates from sunlit canopy trees via subterranean fungal threads.
q: What is the primary purpose of the text?
opts: To introduce Jenkins's empirical findings as validation for an ecological hypothesis once met with skepticism
To argue that mature canopy trees prioritize their own survival over the nourishment of seedlings
To caution researchers against relying on isotopic tracing when studying subterranean ecosystems
To illustrate the chemical composition of carbohydrates generated through fungal photosynthesis
exp: Matn Jenkinsning tajribaviy tadqiqoti (izotopik uglerod tekshiruvi) ilgari skeptiklar tomonidan inkor etilgan 'o'simliklararo resurs almashinuvi' gipotezasini qat'iy isbotlab berganini yoritish uchun yozilgan. A varianti ushbu asosiy maqsadni eng to'liq va aniq ifodalaydi. C varianti metodni rad etishni aytib matnga zid, B esa daraxtlar ko'chatlarga yordam berayotganiga teskari.
strat: SAT PURPOSE HACK: Skeptiklarning dastlabki shubhasini yenguvchi ilmiy dalilni taqdim etish matnning markaziy niyatidir.

pas: Geologists categorize rocks into three foundational groups: igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic. Igneous rocks form directly from cooling molten magma or lava. Sedimentary rocks aggregate from compressed mineral particles and organic debris over millennia. Finally, metamorphic rocks result from pre-existing formations undergoing intense underground thermal and pressure transformations without completely melting.
q: Which choice best describes the function of the second sentence in the text?
opts: It summarizes the primary distinction between sedimentary and metamorphic specimens.
It challenges the conventional categorization presented by earlier mineralogists.
It explains why volcanic eruptions are necessary for sedimentary rock creation.
It provides a specific defining characteristic of one of the categories introduced in the opening sentence.
exp: Birinchi gapda tog' jinslarining 3 ta turi (igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic) aytiladi. Ikkinchi gap esa ulardan birinchisi - magma/lavaning sovishidan hosil bo'ladigan vulqon (igneous) jinslarining xususiyatini ta'riflab beradi. Shuning uchun D varianti eng to'g'ri tahlildir.
strat: SAT SENTENCE FUNCTION: 1-gap umumiy toifalarni sanaydi, 2-gap esa 1-toifaga (igneous) bevosita aniqlik kiritadi.

pas: In analyzing the sonnets of John Donne, literary critic Arthur Bloom notes that Donne's abrupt conversational openings simulate the immediacy of real-time speech. Rather than adopting the ornate, decorative phrasing characteristic of Elizabethan court poetry, Donne thrusts the reader into the midst of an intimate intellectual argument, thereby dismantling the polished facade traditionally expected in lyric verse.
q: Which choice best states the primary function of the underlined claim regarding Elizabethan court poetry?
opts: It demonstrates that Donne's contemporaries unanimously condemned his departures from tradition.
It establishes a conventional stylistic baseline against which Donne's innovative poetic technique is contrasted.
It proves that Elizabethan lyric verse was aesthetically superior to metaphysical poetry.
It provides historical evidence that Donne intended to mock the royal court's literary patrons.
exp: Muallif Yelizaveta davri saroy she'riyatini ('ornate, decorative phrasing') Donnening yangicha, suhbatdoshlikka asoslangan uslubini solishtirish va uning o'ziga xosligini bo'rtirib ko'rsatish uchun an'anaviy fon (stylistic baseline) sifatida keltirmoqda. A, C va D matnda aytilmagan asossiz xulosalardir.
strat: SAT RHETORICAL FUNCTION: An'anaviy uslubni keltirishdan maqsad - yangi muallifning innovatsiyasini kontrast orqali yaqqol ko'rsatishdir.

pas:
Text 1
Astronomer David Kuan argues that the detection of atmospheric phosphine on Venus provides compelling indirect evidence of microbial life suspended in the planet's sulfuric cloud decks, as non-biological abiotic synthesis of phosphine under Venusian conditions is thermodynamically unfeasible according to known chemical pathways.

Text 2
Atmospheric chemist Elena Rostova contends that invoking extraterrestrial biochemistry to explain Venusian phosphine is prematurely speculative. Rostova's laboratory models show that deep-mantle volcanic plumes could vent volatile phosphide minerals into the upper atmosphere, where photolytic oxidation produces phosphine without any biological intervention.
q: Based on the texts, how would Rostova (Text 2) most likely respond to Kuan's claim in Text 1 regarding phosphine synthesis?
opts: By demonstrating that phosphine decomposes too rapidly in sulfuric acid to ever be detected
By arguing that Kuan overlooked viable abiotic mechanisms involving volcanic mineral venting
By asserting that telescopic instruments completely misidentified the spectroscopic signature of phosphine
By conceding that microbial metabolism is the only plausible explanation for Venusian sulfur clouds
exp: Kuan (Text 1) nobiologik (abiotic) sintez imkonsiz deb hisoblaydi va shuning uchun fosfin mikrobial hayot dalili deydi. Rostova (Text 2) esa buni inkor etib, o'z laboratoriya modellarida vulqon minerallari (abiotic) orqali hech qanday biologiyasiz fosfin hosil bo'lishini ko'rsatgan. Shuning uchun Rostova Kuan nobiologik vulqon mexanizmlarini hisobga olmagan deb e'tiroz bildiradi. B to'g'ri.
strat: SAT PAIRED TEXTS: Kuan: 'abiotic synthesis is unfeasible' <-> Rostova: 'laboratory models show abiotic volcanic plumes produce it'. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri B varianti.

pas:
Text 1
Historian Thomas Bennett argues that the collapse of the Western Roman Empire was fundamentally driven by external shocks: unprecedented nomadic migrations from Central Asia pushed Germanic confederacies across the Rhine and Danube frontiers, overwhelming Roman border defenses faster than administrative legions could redeploy.

Text 2
Classicist Nadia Al-Mansoor maintains that external migrations merely administered the final blow to an empire already hollowed out by centuries of internal economic decay. Rampant currency debasement, severe labor shortages caused by agrarian plagues, and endemic tax evasion by the senatorial aristocracy had effectively crippled the imperial treasury long before the crossing of the Rhine.
q: Which choice best describes how Al-Mansoor (Text 2) views Bennett's central thesis in Text 1?
opts: As an accurate diagnosis that fully explains the collapse without needing economic factors
As fundamentally flawed because nomadic tribes were easily absorbed into Roman provincial governance
As mistaking an immediate catalytic event for the profound, underlying systemic causes of collapse
As an overestimation of the Roman imperial treasury's ability to finance frontier fortifications
exp: Bennett tashqi bosqinlarni asosiy sabab deb biladi. Al-Mansoor esa tashqi bosqinlar faqatgina 'so'nggi zarba' (final blow) bo'lganini, imperiyaning haqiqiy va chuqur sababi ichki iqtisodiy inqiroz va xazinaning bo'shab qolishi ekanini ta'kidlaydi. Demak, u Bennettning qarashini asosiy sababni yuzaki turtki (catalytic event) bilan adashtirish deb baholaydi. C to'g'ri.
strat: SAT PAIRED TEXT STRATEGY: 'merely administered the final blow to an empire already hollowed out' iborasi C variantidagi 'mistaking immediate catalytic event for underlying systemic causes' bilan to'liq ma'nodosh.

pas:
Text 1
Advocates of universal basic income (UBI) argue that unconditional cash transfers empower low-income workers by giving them the financial stability needed to pursue skill education, seek higher-quality employment, and exit exploitative workplace arrangements without fear of immediate destitution.

Text 2
Policy researcher Gregory Vance warns that unconditional transfer models risk triggering labor force withdrawal in vital low-wage service sectors. Vance points to pilot programs where recipients reduced their formal work hours, suggesting that targeted wage subsidies, such as earned income tax credits tied directly to employment, offer a more economically sustainable antipoverty mechanism.
q: Both texts address poverty-reduction strategies, but they disagree regarding which of the following?
opts: Whether technological automation will displace manufacturing jobs in coming decades
Whether unconditional cash transfers exert desirable effects on recipient workforce participation
Whether low-income households benefit from enhanced financial security
Whether governments should completely eliminate progressive income taxation
exp: Text 1 shartsiz pul o'tkazmalari (UBI) xodimlarga erkinlik beradi va yaxshiroq ish topishga yordam beradi deb ijobiy baholaydi. Text 2 esa bu ishchi kuchi taklifining kamayishiga (ish soatlarini qisqartirishga) olib keladi deb xavotir bildiradi. Demak, ularning asosiy kelishmovchiligi shartsiz to'lovlarning mehnat bozoridagi ishtirokiga (workforce participation) ta'siri ustidadir. B to'g'ri.
strat: SAT COMPARISON: Text 1 (UBI fosters career advancement) vs Text 2 (UBI risks labor force withdrawal). Munozara markazi: mehnat ishtiroki.

pas:
Text 1
Linguist Noam Chomsky posited that human language acquisition is enabled by an innate 'universal grammar' hardwired into human neural circuitry, arguing that children acquire complex syntactic rules far too rapidly for learning to depend solely on environmental exposure to spoken language.

Text 2
Cognitive scientist Michael Tomasello challenges universal grammar, proposing instead a usage-based construction model. Tomasello demonstrates that young children master language through general cognitive mechanisms—such as intention-reading and pattern-finding—gradually abstracting grammatical categories from the rich linguistic input provided by communicative interactions.
q: Based on the texts, how does Tomasello's model (Text 2) differ fundamentally from Chomsky's hypothesis (Text 1)?
opts: Tomasello attributes language acquisition to general cognitive pattern recognition rather than domain-specific innate grammar.
Tomasello contends that animal communication systems share the exact same grammatical recursion found in human speech.
Tomasello argues that speech sounds are processed entirely outside the cerebral cortex.
Tomasello denies that young children ever master complex syntactic structures during early childhood development.
exp: Chomsky (Text 1) tug'ma, faqat tilga xos 'universal grammar' (innate neural circuitry) mavjudligini aytadi. Tomasello (Text 2) esa maxsus til moduli o'rniga bolalar umumiy aqliy qobiliyatlar (general cognitive mechanisms: pattern-finding, intention-reading) va atrof-muhit bilan muloqot orqali tilni o'rganishini isbotlaydi. Shuning uchun A varianti ularning tub farqini to'liq ko'rsatadi.
strat: SAT CORE CONTRAST: Chomsky (innate domain-specific grammar) vs Tomasello (general pattern-finding cognition from input).

pas: Honeybees communicate the precise location of rich nectar sources through an elaborate series of movements known as the 'waggle dance.' Performed on vertical combs inside the hive, the angle of the dance relative to gravity communicates the solar direction of the flower patch, while the duration of the waggle run indicates the distance to the floral food source.
q: According to the text, which element of the honeybee's waggle dance conveys the distance to a food source?
opts: The frequency of wing vibrations during flight
The duration of the waggle run
The angle of the dance relative to vertical gravity
The temperature of the honeycomb wax
exp: Matnning so'nggi qismida aniq ta'kidlangan: 'the duration of the waggle run indicates the distance to the floral food source'. Demak, masofani tebranish yugurishining davomiyligi (duration) bildiradi. C varianti quyoshga nisbatan yo'nalishni ko'rsatadi.
strat: SAT DETAIL DIRECT MATCH: 'duration ... indicates the distance'. Matndagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri dalil bilan solishtiring.

pas: In nineteenth-century Britain, the widespread introduction of gas street lighting fundamentally reshaped urban social geography. Before gas illumination, city streets after dusk were enveloped in darkness, heavily deterring evening commercial activities and social mobility across social classes. By illuminating public avenues, municipal authorities stimulated a thriving nocturnal commercial economy, extending retail shopping hours and fostering new public leisure venues like theaters and late-night restaurants.
q: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
opts: The installation of municipal lighting encountered fierce resistance from shopkeepers who opposed evening operations.
Gas lamps proved far more cost-effective to maintain than earlier oil-burning lamps in British metropolises.
Nineteenth-century theatrical productions were primarily patronized by municipal gas utility executives.
Gas street lighting catalyzed significant economic and social shifts by rendering night-time city spaces safe and commercially active.
exp: Matn gaz yoritgichlari paydo bo'lishi bilan shaharlarda kechki payt xavfsizlik va erkin harakat ta'minlangani, savdo soatlari uzayib, tungi iqtisodiyot va ko'ngilochar maskanlar rivojlangani haqida. D varianti barcha keltirilgan faktlarni o'z ichiga olgan bosh g'oyadir.
strat: SAT MAIN IDEA HACK: 1-gapdagi 'fundamentally reshaped urban social geography' va oxirgi gapdagi 'stimulated nocturnal commercial economy' umumlashtirilib A hosil bo'ladi.

pas: Unlike typical bird feathers designed for aerodynamic lift and thermal insulation, the specialized wing feathers of barn owls feature serrated comb-like edges and velvety down surfaces. These microstructures break up sound-producing air turbulence into tiny vortices, absorbing high-frequency acoustic vibrations and enabling the owl to achieve virtually silent stealth flight when ambushing small rodents in total darkness.
q: According to the text, what primary acoustic function do the specialized microstructures of barn owl feathers serve?
opts: They dissipate air turbulence to suppress audible flight noise.
They reflect ambient moonlight to visually confuse ground predators.
They insulate the wing against freezing nighttime temperatures.
They amplify ultrasonic distress calls emitted by fleeing prey.
exp: Matnda boyqush patlarining tuzilishi havo turbulentligini kichik girdoblarga bo'lib yuborishi, tovush tebranishlarini yutishi va shu orqali parvoz paytida shovqin chiqarmaslikka ('suppress flight noise / virtually silent flight') xizmat qilishi aytilgan. A varianti matnga to'liq mos keladi.
strat: SAT PARAPHRASE: 'break up sound-producing turbulence ... achieving silent flight' = 'dissipate air turbulence to suppress audible noise'.

pas: Archaeological excavations at the ancient Indus Valley site of Mohenjo-daro have long puzzled anthropologists due to the conspicuous absence of monumental palaces, royal tombs, or grandiose religious temples typical of contemporaneous Mesopotamian and Egyptian civilizations. Instead, urban planning prioritized sophisticated hydraulic infrastructure, including uniform brick housing, standardized weights, and an elaborate municipal sewage drainage network, suggesting an egalitarian civic governance structure rather than autocratic royal rule.
q: Which choice best summarizes the central claim of the text?
opts: The lack of royal monuments and emphasis on advanced civic sanitation suggest Mohenjo-daro operated under a decentralized, egalitarian civic model.
Indus Valley engineers lacked the stone-cutting tools necessary to construct monumental religious edifices.
Mesopotamian conquerors intentionally demolished all royal residences and temples previously built in Mohenjo-daro.
Mohenjo-daro's drainage infrastructure was primarily designed to support massive agricultural irrigation rather than residential hygiene.
exp: Matn Mohenjo-daro shahrida saroylar va dabdabali qabrlarning yo'qligi hamda buning o'rniga barcha aholi uchun standart uylar, suv quvurlari va kanalizatsiya tizimiga ustuvorlik berilgani shahar yakka hokimlik emas, balki teng huquqli (egalitarian civic model) boshqaruvga tayanganini ko'rsatishini ta'kidlaydi. A to'g'ri.
strat: SAT CENTRAL CLAIM: 'suggesting an egalitarian civic governance structure rather than autocratic royal rule' matnning xulosa g'oyasidir.

pas: Chlorophyll is the primary pigment responsible for photosynthesis in green plants. Located inside cellular chloroplasts, chlorophyll molecules absorb light energy predominantly in the blue and red regions of the electromagnetic spectrum while reflecting green wavelengths, which gives foliage its characteristic emerald hue.
q: According to the text, why do green plants appear emerald in color?
opts: Chlorophyll absorbs blue and red wavelengths while reflecting green light.
Chloroplasts produce green mineral crystals during nutrient transport.
Infrared light damages plant cells, causing them to emit green fluorescence.
Cell walls reflect all wavelengths across the visible spectrum equally.
exp: Matn so'ngida aniq aytilgan: xlorofill ko'k va qizil nurlarni yutadi (absorb), yashil nurni esa qaytaradi (reflecting green wavelengths), shu sababli barglar yashil ko'rinadi. A varianti to'g'ridan-to'g'ri matnga asoslangan.
strat: SAT DIRECT FACT CHECK: 'reflecting green wavelengths, which gives foliage its characteristic emerald hue' = B.

pas: While twentieth-century literary historians often portrayed early modern women writers as isolated anomalies who worked in absolute domestic obscurity, recent archival discoveries challenge this narrative. Literary scholar Anita Rao has cataloged hundreds of manuscript poetry circles across seventeenth-century England where noble and gentry women actively circulated, annotated, and critiqued each other's verse, demonstrating that early modern women participated in vibrant, collaborative intellectual networks.
q: Which choice best describes the relationship between the two sentences in the text?
opts: The first sentence defines a literary genre, and the second sentence traces its evolution across multiple centuries.
The first sentence introduces an established scholarly assumption, and the second sentence presents recent archival evidence that refutes it.
The first sentence details a biographical narrative, and the second sentence explains why the author abandoned poetry altogether.
The first sentence presents an unverified historical rumor, and the second sentence provides documentary proof confirming its authenticity.
exp: 1-gapda avvalgi adabiyotshunoslarning an'anaviy qarashi (ayol yozuvchilar yolg'iz va noma'lum bo'lgan degan faraz) keltiriladi. 2-gapda esa Rao tomonidan topilgan yangi arxiv hujjatlari (qo'lyozma to'garaklari va hamkorlik tarmoqlari) bu qarashni rad etgani bayon qilinadi. B varianti ushbu munosabatni aniq tasvirlaydi.
strat: SAT SENTENCE RELATIONSHIP: 'While historians portrayed X ... recent archival discoveries challenge this narrative' = established assumption refuted by new evidence.

pas: Evolutionary biologist Dr. Teresa Gomez hypothesized that brightly colored poison dart frogs in the Amazonian rainforest do not synthesize neurotoxins endogenously, but rather sequester their chemical defenses from their dietary intake of specific arthropods. If Gomez's dietary sequestration hypothesis is correct, dart frogs raised in controlled laboratory environments without exposure to their wild diet should exhibit notable physiological differences.
q: Which finding, if true, would most directly support Gomez's hypothesis?
opts: Wild dart frogs exhibit identical skin pigmentation regardless of whether they inhabit lowland rainforests or high-altitude cloud forests.
Tadpoles in both laboratory and wild environments possess trace amounts of neurotoxins prior to metamorphosis.
Laboratory-reared frogs fed exclusively on non-toxic fruit flies fail to produce defensive skin alkaloids, but rapidly develop toxicity when fed native Amazonian mites.
Predators that consume lab-reared dart frogs experience severe gastrointestinal distress similar to that caused by wild specimens.
exp: Gomezning gipotezasi: zahar qurbaqaning o'zida emas, uning yeydigan hasharotlaridan to'planadi (dietary sequestration). Agar laboratoriyada oddiy meva pashshasi bilan boqilgan qurbaqalar zahar chiqara olmasa, lekin Amazonka kanalari bilan oziqlanganda darhol zaharga ega bo'lsa, bu zaharning bevosita ozuqadan kelib chiqishini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri isbotlaydi. C varianti gipotezani to'liq qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
strat: SAT EVIDENCE HACK: Gipotezani qo'llash: dietani o'zgartirish natijasida zahar paydo bo'lishi/yo'qolishi C variantida mukammal aks etgan.

pas: Psychologist Dr. Warren Chen contends that exposure to natural forest settings enhances executive cognitive attention by allowing the brain's directed attention mechanisms to rest, a process known as Attention Restoration Theory. Conversely, urban environments with flashing advertisements, unpredictable vehicular movement, and auditory clamor constantly demand active, energy-intensive attentional filtering.
q: Which finding from an experimental trial, if true, would most strongly reinforce Chen's contention?
opts: Participants displayed heightened galvanic skin conductance while viewing digital photographs of pristine mountain landscapes.
Participants listening to recorded city noise in a dark room scored identically on memory recall tests to those listening to classical orchestral music.
Individuals who frequently commute via underground subways report higher baseline satisfaction with their physical fitness than those who walk to work.

Participants who completed a 45-minute stroll through a coniferous arboretum made significantly fewer errors on a subsequent standardized proofreading task than participants who walked through a busy commercial downtown.
exp: Chenning nazariyasi: tabiatda yurish diqqatni tiklaydi (restores directed attention), shahardagi shovqin esa charchatadi. Agar o'rmonda 45 daqiqa sayr qilganlar gavjum shaharda yurganlarga qaraganda xatolarni sezilarli darajada kam qilsa (diqqat talab qiluvchi vazifada), bu tabiatning diqqatni tiklashini eksperimental tasdiqlaydi. D varianti to'g'ri.
strat: SAT EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT: Nazariyada aytilgan ta'sir (tabiat = yaxshi diqqat; shahar = toliqish) bevosita D variantidagi natijada o'lchangan.

pas: Agricultural scientists developing drought-resistant crop strains evaluate the stomatal conductance of mutated pearl millet varieties. Stomata are microscopic pores on leaf surfaces that regulate gas exchange; closing stomata conserves moisture during arid spells but simultaneously restricts the intake of atmospheric carbon dioxide necessary for photosynthetic biomass accumulation.
q: Which finding, if true, would pose the most substantial challenge to the scientists' goal of utilizing stomatal closure mutations to maintain crop yields during prolonged droughts?
opts: Wild pearl millet plants native to sub-Saharan Africa showed heightened resistance to invasive fungal blight.
Pearl millet roots grown in sandy soils reached depths exceeding three meters to access deep groundwater tables.
Millet varieties engineered for permanent stomatal constriction during droughts exhibited profound reductions in grain yield due to severe carbon starvation.
Stomatal density on upper leaf surfaces was found to be slightly higher than that on lower leaf surfaces.
