exp: Olimlarning maqsadi: qurg'oqchilikda hosildorlikni saqlab qolish. Biroq stomatalarni yopish karbonat angidrid kirishini to'xtatadi. Agar o'simlik qurg'oqchilikda stomatalarini yopib, karbonat angidrid yetishmovchiligi (carbon starvation) sababli don hosili keskin tushib ketsa, bu olimlarning hosilni saqlash maqsadiga eng katta to'siq (substantial challenge) bo'ladi. C to'g'ri.
strat: SAT WEAKEN/CHALLENGE EVIDENCE: Maqsad: hosildorlikni saqlash. Salbiy oqibat: karbonat yetishmasligi hosilni barbod qildi (C).

pas: In 1912, Alfred Wegener proposed the continental drift hypothesis, pointing to the jigsaw fit of Atlantic coastlines and matching fossil distributions across disparate continents. However, contemporary geophysicists rejected Wegener's model because he failed to identify a plausible physical mechanism capable of propelling massive granitic continental blocks across the dense basaltic oceanic crust.
q: Which subsequent scientific discovery provided the decisive physical evidence that validated Wegener's previously rejected hypothesis?
opts: The observation that lunar gravitational tidal pull causes minute measurable bulges in continental crust
The discovery of symmetrical paleomagnetic alternating stripes across mid-ocean ridges, proving seafloor spreading driven by mantle convection
The measurement of ambient ocean temperatures showing deep-sea water remains colder than surface water
The discovery of identical coal swamp plant fossils located in high-altitude Himalayan mountain valleys
exp: Vegenerning gipotezasi qit'alarni qaysi mexanizm harakatga keltirishini tushuntira olmagani uchun rad etilgan edi. 1960-yillarda okean o'rtasidagi tizmalarda paleomagnit qatlamlar va mantiya konveksiyasi orqali okean tubining kengayishi (seafloor spreading) kashf etilishi ushbu harakatlantiruvchi mexanizmni isbotlab berdi. Shuning uchun B to'g'ri.
strat: SAT HISTORICAL EVIDENCE: 'failed to identify physical mechanism' muammosini 'seafloor spreading driven by mantle convection' kashfiyoti to'liq yechdi.

pas: Linguists studying endangered indigenous languages have observed that languages with small speaker populations frequently demonstrate far greater morphological complexity—such as intricate verb conjugation systems with dozens of affixes—than globally spoken languages like English or Mandarin, which favor streamlined, analytical word orders.
q: Which of the following examples best illustrates the phenomenon described in the text?
opts: Mandarin Chinese employs lexical tones to distinguish word meanings among syllables with identical phonetic spellings.
Spanish and Portuguese share over 85% of their core lexical vocabulary due to common descent from Vulgar Latin.
English expanded its lexicon during the Renaissance by borrowing thousands of scientific roots from Classical Greek and Latin.
Inuit-Yupik languages, spoken by isolated Arctic communities, utilize polysynthetic verbs where a single word incorporates the subject, object, and temporal nuances of an entire sentence.
exp: Matnda aytilgan hodisa: kam sonli so'zlashuvchiga ega tillarda nihoyatda murakkab morfologiya (ko'plab affikslar, bitta fe'lga butun gap ma'nosini joylash) bo'ladi. D variantidagi Inuit-Yupik tillari (polysynthetic verbs where a single word incorporates subject, object, etc.) aynan shu xususiyatni mukammal ko'rsatadi.
strat: SAT EXEMPLIFICATION: 'intricate verb systems with dozens of affixes' misoli D variantidagi 'polysynthetic verbs' bilan 100% mos.

pas: In many bird species, singing requires substantial metabolic energy and exposes the vocalizer to opportunistic aerial predators. Consequently, biologists deduce that producing elaborate, high-volume mating songs operates as an honest signal of individual biological fitness: only males with abundant nutritional reserves and superior physiological vigor can afford to _______.
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: sustain prolonged vocal displays while coping with the associated predation risks
mimic the vocal calls of rival predatory species to deter competitors
suppress their metabolic energy consumption during the spring mating season
abandon breeding territories entirely to forage in distant predator-free habitats
exp: Matn boshida qushlarning sayrashi katta energiya talab qilishi va yirtqichlar xavfini oshirishi aytiladi. Shuning uchun murakkab va baland qo'shiq aytish qushning sog'lom va kuchli ekanini bildiradi ('honest signal of fitness'). Demak, faqat kuchi va resursi ko'p bo'lgan qushlargina bu xavf va energiya sarfiga bardosh bera oladi ('sustain prolonged vocal displays while coping with risks'). A to'g'ri.
strat: SAT LOGICAL COMPLETION: 'honest signal of fitness: only males with abundant reserves can afford to [do the costly behavior]' -> A.

pas: Under standard atmospheric conditions, water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius. However, when microscopic droplets of ultra-pure water devoid of mineral particulates or dust motes are suspended in clean air, the lack of foreign nucleation surfaces prevents ice crystal formation. Experiments demonstrate that such supercooled liquid water droplets can persist in liquid state down to nearly -40 degrees Celsius, suggesting that the freezing of water at 0 degrees Celsius in everyday natural environments is _______.
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: dependent upon the presence of microscopic particulate impurities that serve as ice nucleation sites
incompatible with the thermodynamic laws that govern atmospheric cloud condensation
an erroneous scientific observation that modern high-precision laboratory thermometers have disproven
prevented by the continuous evaporation of surface molecules into surrounding ambient vapor
exp: Matnda chang va zarrachalardan xoli toza suv -40 darajagacha muzlamasdan suyuq qolishi ko'rsatilgan, chunki muz kristali hosil bo'lishi uchun yadro (nucleation surface) kerak. Bundan xulosa kelib chiqadiki, oddiy tabiatda suvning 0 darajada muzlashi unda muzlash yadrosi bo'lib xizmat qiluvchi mikroskopik zarrachalar va kirlarning (particulate impurities) mavjudligiga bog'liq. A to'g'ri.
strat: SAT LOGICAL INFERENCE: 'lack of foreign nucleation surfaces prevents ice' -> 'freezing at 0 D requires foreign particulate impurities'.

pas: Economists studying retail pricing algorithms note that automated dynamic pricing tools adjust hotel room rates in real time based on incoming browser cookies, current inventory, and concurrent demand. When a major concert is announced in an urban center, automated software instantaneously multiplies room rates, demonstrating that algorithmic pricing _______.
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: responds rapidly to sudden localized shifts in consumer demand without requiring human intervention
guarantees that budget-conscious travelers always secure the lowest possible accommodations
consistently reduces average profit margins for hospitality establishments during major events
relies on quarterly retrospective financial audits to calculate future baseline costs
exp: Matnda konsert e'lon qilinishi bilan algoritm inson aralashuvisiz bir lahzada narxlarni oshirishi aytilgan. Bu algoritmik narxlashning talab o'zgarishlariga inson aralashuvisiz bir zumda tezkor javob berishini ('responds rapidly to shifts in demand without requiring human intervention') ko'rsatadi. A to'g'ri.
strat: SAT INFERENCE: 'instantaneously multiplies room rates upon concert announcement' -> 'responds rapidly to sudden shifts without human intervention'.

pas: In mammalian brain physiology, the blood-brain barrier comprises tightly packed endothelial cells that restrict circulating pathogens and polar molecules from entering neural tissue. While this protective envelope shields the central nervous system from systemic infections, it simultaneously presents a formidable therapeutic obstacle: pharmacological developers find that over 98% of small-molecule neurotherapeutic drugs administered intravenously are _______.
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: instantly recognized by red blood cells as essential nutrients for cellular respiration
unable to cross the protective endothelial barrier in concentrations sufficient to achieve clinical efficacy
rapidly metabolized into highly toxic compounds before reaching peripheral bloodstream vessels
capable of dissolving the endothelial cell lining and inducing acute cerebral hemorrhage
exp: Matnda gematoensefalik to'siq (blood-brain barrier) miyani infeksiyalardan himoya qilishi bilan birga, tibbiyot uchun to'siq ekani ta'kidlanadi. Sababi to'siq molekulalarni miyaga o'tkazmaydi. Demak, 98% dan ortiq dori vositalari bu to'siqdan klinik ta'sir ko'rsatadigan konsentratsiyada o'ta olmaydi ('unable to cross the barrier in sufficient concentrations'). B to'g'ri.
strat: SAT LOGICAL COMPLETION: 'formidable therapeutic obstacle' + 'restricts polar molecules' -> dori miyaga o'ta olmaydi (B).

pas: Paleontologists analyzing fossilized tooth enamel from Cretaceous theropod dinosaurs discovered that seasonal oxygen isotope ratios varied predictably between rainy and dry periods. Because oxygen isotope signatures in tooth enamel directly reflect the isotopic composition of ingested drinking water, the researchers inferred that _______.
q: Which choice most logically completes the text?
opts: the local precipitation and surface water sources experienced consistent cyclical seasonal fluctuations
theropod dinosaurs only ingested water during periods of total solar eclipse
prehistoric carnivores drank exclusively from subterranean geysers unaffected by weather
tooth enamel was completely permeable to mineral replacement after fossilization
exp: Tishdagi izotoplar ichilgan suvdan o'tadi va ular yomg'irli hamda quruq mavsumlarda o'zgaradi. Demak, o'sha davrdagi mahalliy yog'ingarchilik va yer usti suv manbalari davriy mavsumiy tebranishlarga ega bo'lgan ('experienced consistent cyclical seasonal fluctuations'). A to'g'ri.
strat: SAT INFERENCE: Izotoplar ichimlik suvidan olinadi + fasllar bo'yicha farq qiladi -> iqlim va suv manbalari mavsumiy o'zgargan.

pas: During the solar eclipse of 1919, British astrophysicist Arthur Eddington traveled to the island of Príncipe to photograph starlight passing near the sun. The resulting photographic plates confirmed Albert Einstein's general theory of _______ they provided the first empirical measurement of gravitational light deflection.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Matnda ikkita mustaqil gap (independent clauses) mavjud: 1) 'The resulting plates confirmed Einstein's theory of relativity'; 2) 'they provided the first empirical measurement...'. Ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lash uchun vergul + FANBOYS koordinatsion bog'lovchisi (bu yerda 'for' = chunki, sababi) qo'llaniladi: ', for'. Vergulsiz bog'lash (B) xato, D dagi nuqtali vergul bilan 'for' qo'shilmaydi, A esa ortiqcha 'and' qo'shgan.
strat: SAT GRAMMAR RULE: Vergul + FANBOYS (for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so) ikkita to'liq mustaqil gapni to'g'ri bog'laydi.

pas: Volcanologists monitoring Mount Rainier rely on an array of geophysical _______ broadband seismometers, tiltmeters, and satellite radar interferometry to detect minute magma movements deep beneath the volcanic cone.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: 'including' so'zidan keyin yoki oldin ikki nuqta (:) qo'yilmaydi, chunki 'including' o'zi misollarni kirituvchi predikativ so'z hisoblanadi. Vergul bilan 'instruments, including broadband seismometers...' deb davom etish grammatik jihatdan to'liq to'g'ri. C va A variantlari ikki nuqtani xato ishlatgan.
strat: SAT PUNCTUATION RULE: 'Including', 'such as' kabi so'zlardan keyin hech qachon ikki nuqta (colon) qo'yilmaydi!

pas: Architect Zaha Hadid was celebrated for her dynamic, fluid _______ her avant-garde structures rejected conventional right angles in favor of sweeping curves inspired by natural geological formations.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Bu yerda ikkita mustaqil gap bor: 1) 'Architect Zaha Hadid was celebrated for her dynamic, fluid designs'; 2) 'her avant-garde structures rejected conventional right angles...'. Hech qanday tinish belgisiz qoldirish (B) run-on sentence xatosidir; faqat vergul qo'yish (D) comma splice xatosidir; C varianti ikkinchi gapni to'liq bog'lay olmaydi. Nuqtali vergul (;) ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lashning eng ideal usulidir.
strat: SAT COMMA SPLICE TRAP: Ikkita mustaqil gap o'rtasiga faqat vergul qo'yish (comma splice) qat'iyan taqiqlanadi! Semicolon (;) kerak.

pas: In 1928, bacteriologist Alexander Fleming returned from vacation to discover a contaminated petri _______ Penicillium notatum mold had contaminated a colony of staphylococci bacteria, visibly inhibiting bacterial growth.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Birinchi qism mustaqil to'liq gap ('...returned from vacation to discover a contaminated petri dish'). Ikki nuqtadan (:) keyingi qism esa u idishda aynan nima sodir bo'lganini tushuntirib, oydinlashtirib beradi ('a stray Penicillium mold had contaminated...'). Ikki nuqta oldingi mustaqil gapda aytilgan narsani izohlash yoki batafsil bayon qilish uchun to'g'ri ishlatiladi. C varianti comma splice hosil qiladi.
strat: SAT COLON RULE: Mustaqil gapdan keyin kelgan ikki nuqta (:) oldingi fikrni batafsil izohlash, ta'riflash yoki ochib berish uchun xizmat qiladi.

pas: The restoration committee evaluated three candidate historic _______ the eighteenth-century textile mill, the municipal courthouse, and the clock tower erected by the town's founding blacksmith.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Ikki nuqta (:) to'liq mustaqil gapdan keyin keladigan ro'yxatni kiritish uchun ishlatiladi: 'The committee evaluated three candidate historic sites:' (to'liq gap) -> 1) tegirmon, 2) sud binosi, 3) soat minorasi. Nuqtali vergul (B) ro'yxat kiritish uchun ishlatilmaydi; oddiy vergul (D) noaniqlik tug'diradi.
strat: SAT LIST INTRODUCER: To'liq mustaqil gapdan keyin ro'yxat kiritishda ikki nuqta (:) qo'yiladi.

pas: Although deep-sea anglerfish live in complete oceanic _______ they generate their own bioluminescent light to lure curious prey toward their needle-sharp teeth.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Gap 'Although' (bog'lovchi) bilan boshlanuvchi tobe ergash gap (dependent clause) bilan boshlanmoqda: 'Although deep-sea anglerfish live in complete oceanic darkness...'. Qoida bo'yicha, tobe gap bosh gapdan oldin kelganda, ularning o'rtasiga faqat vergul (,) qo'yiladi. Nuqtali vergul (D) yoki ikki nuqta (C) tobe gapdan keyin qo'yilmaydi.
strat: SAT DEPENDENT CLAUSE: Dependent clause boshida kelsa: [Dependent Clause], [Independent Clause]. Faqat oddiy vergul kerak!

pas: The expedition leader warned that high-altitude atmospheric pressure can induce severe hypothermia _______ frostbite, oxygen deprivation, and pulmonary edema can also develop rapidly if climbers do not acclimatize.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: 'furthermore' - bu konjunktiv ravish (conjunctive adverb). U ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lash uchun ishlatilganda, uning oldiga nuqtali vergul (;), orqasiga esa vergul (,) qo'yilishi shart: '; furthermore,'. Vergul bilan bog'lash (D) xato (comma splice), A va C esa tinish belgisiz bo'lgani uchun run-on hosil qiladi.
strat: SAT CONJUNCTIVE ADVERB: However, furthermore, therefore, moreover kabi so'zlar ikkita gap orasida kelganda: [; furthermore, ] shaklida bo'ladi.

pas: Novelist Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie—whose works explore postcolonial Nigerian identity, gender politics, and cultural _______ has received widespread critical acclaim and numerous international literary honors.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Gapda kiritma izoh (parenthetical phrase) uzun tire (em-dash) bilan ochilgan: 'Adichie—whose works explore...'. Qoida bo'yicha, tire bilan ochilgan kiritma ibora xuddi shunday mos keluvchi ikkinchi tire bilan yopilishi shart: 'cultural displacement—'. Vergul (B) yoki nuqtali vergul (A) juft tire balansini buzadi.
strat: SAT DASH PAIRING: Agar kiritma tire (—) bilan boshlangan bo'lsa, u faqat ikkinchi tire (—) bilan yopilishi shart!

pas: A team of neurobiologists at the Max Planck Institute recently discovered that the synchronized firing of neurons in the hippocampus _______ crucial for consolidating short-term spatial navigation memories into long-term retention.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Ega-kesim moslashuvi (subject-verb agreement): Ega 'the synchronized firing' (otlashgan gerundiy - birlikda). Undan keyingi 'of neurons in the hippocampus' - oraliqdagi predlogli aniqlovchi ibora bo'lib, egaga ta'sir qilmaydi. Birlikdagi ega 'firing' uchun birlikdagi fe'l 'is' talab qilinadi. C, B, D variantlari ko'plikdagi fe'llardir.
strat: SAT SUBJECT-VERB TRAP: Oraliqdagi 'of neurons in the hippocampus' iborasini chizib tashlang! Ega: 'the firing' (singular) -> 'is'.

pas: Neither the senior research fellows nor the principal laboratory director _______ willing to sign the disputed bioethics compliance declaration until further safety testing had concluded.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: 'Neither ... nor' bog'lovchisida fe'l o'ziga eng yaqin turgan ega bilan moslashadi (Proximity Rule). Fe'lga eng yaqin turgan ega - 'the principal laboratory director' (birlikda). Shuning uchun o'tgan zamondagi birlik shakli 'was' to'g'ri bo'ladi. C varianti uzoqdagi 'fellows' ko'pligi bilan adashtiruvchi tuzoqdir.
strat: SAT PROXIMITY RULE: 'Neither A nor B' kelganda fe'l doimo nor dan keyingi C ga qarab moslashadi: director (singular) -> was.

pas: Renowned for its intricate subterranean irrigation canals known as qanats, ancient Persian engineers _______ arid desert valleys into flourishing agricultural oases centuries before the advent of mechanized water pumps.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Gapning to'liq kesimi (main finite verb) yetishmayapti. Boshidagi 'Renowned for...' - sifatdosh iborasi; ega - 'ancient Persian engineers'. Gap to'liq bo'lishi uchun o'tgan zamondagi mustaqil fe'l 'transformed' kerak. B, D, A variantlari noaniq shakllar (participle, infinitive) bo'lib, kesim bo'la olmaydi (fragment sentence hosil qiladi).
strat: SAT VERB VS FRAGMENT: Har bir gapda albatta son va zamonga ega bo'lgan mustaqil kesim (finite verb: transformed) bo'lishi shart!

pas: Having completed three grueling years of archival field research in rural Peru, _______.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
opts: Dr. Ramirez's doctoral dissertation was finally submitted to the university academic review committee.
submission of the doctoral dissertation by Dr. Ramirez finally took place.
Dr. Ramirez finally submitted her doctoral dissertation to the university academic review committee.
the doctoral dissertation was finally submitted by Dr. Ramirez to the university academic review committee.
exp: Osiluvchi aniqlovchi (Dangling modifier): 'Having completed three grueling years of field research...' harakatini dissertatsiya emas, inson bajargan. Shuning uchun verguldan keyin bevosita bu ishni bajargan shaxs - 'Dr. Ramirez' kelishi shart. A, D va B variantlarida ega 'dissertation' yoki 'submission' bo'lib, mantiqiy xato keltirib chiqaradi.
strat: SAT DANGLING MODIFIER HACK: 'Having completed...' harakatini kim bajardi? Dr. Ramirez! Demak verguldan keyingi 1-so'z 'Dr. Ramirez' bo'lishi shart (C).

pas: Each of the ninety-eight participating student volunteers _______ assigned a specific laboratory workstation before the chemistry competition commenced.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: 'Each of the...' konstruktsiyasida asosiy ega 'Each' so'zidir va u har doim birlikda bo'ladi. 'of the ninety-eight student volunteers' predlogli iborasi egaga ta'sir qilmaydi. Shuning uchun o'tgan zamondagi birlik fe'li 'was' to'g'ri. B, D va A ko'plikdagi fe'llardir.
strat: SAT RULE: 'Each', 'Every', 'Neither', 'Either' bilan boshlangan iboralar har doim BIRLIK (singular: was) fe'lini oladi.

pas: During the seventeenth century, astronomer Johannes Kepler published his three laws of planetary motion, which mathematically described how planets _______ in elliptical orbits around the sun.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Garchi Kepler o'tmishda (seventeenth century) yashagan bo'lsa ham, sayyoralarning ellips bo'ylab aylanishi - o'zgarmas tabiiy-ilmiy haqiqat (universal general truth / scientific fact) hisoblanadi. Ilmiy qonuniyatlar va umumiy haqiqatlar ingliz tili grammatikasida har doim Present Simple (revolve) zamonida beriladi. D varianti sayyoralar faqat o'tmishda aylangan degan noto'g'ri ma'no beradi.
strat: SAT SCIENTIFIC FACT: Doimiy o'zgarmas ilmiy qoidalar va tabiat qonunlari har doim hozirgi zamonda (Present Simple: revolve) yoziladi.

pas: The acoustic richness of Stradivarius violins has fascinated luthiers for centuries, with modern material scientists suggesting that the chemical varnish applied to the spruce wood contributed far more to _______ resonance than previously acknowledged.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Olmosh va uning o'rnini bosuvchi so'z moslashuvi (Pronoun-Antecedent Agreement): Bu yerda gap 'Stradivarius violins' (skripkalar - ko'plikdagi ot) haqida bormoqda. Ko'plikdagi otning egalik olmoshi 'their' bo'ladi. A varianti (its) birlikdagi otlar uchun, C (it's = it is) va B (they're = they are) qisqartmalardir.
strat: SAT PRONOUN-ANTECEDENT: 'violins' (plural) -> 'their resonance'. Ko'plikka nisbatan 'its' ishlatish asosiy tuzoqdir.

pas: In his political treatise, the philosopher argued that an effective legal system must not only enforce equitable contracts _______ citizen liberties against governmental encroachment.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Korrelyativ bog'lovchi va parallellik qoidasi: 'not only [fe'l] ... but also [fe'l]'. 'not only enforce' shakliga parallel ravishda 'but also safeguard' kelishi shart. B, C va A variantlari korrelyativ strukturani buzadi.
strat: SAT CORRELATIVE CONJUNCTION: 'Not only X ... but also Y'. Agar X fe'lning asosiy shakli (enforce) bo'lsa, Y ham asosiy shakl (safeguard) bo'lishi shart.

pas: To prepare for the demanding polar expedition, the explorers practiced setting up shelters in blizzard conditions, navigating across shifting ice sheets, and _______ emergency rations in subzero temperatures.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Paralellizm qoidasi: Ro'yxatdagi barcha fe'l shakllari bir xil grammatik shaklda bo'lishi kerak: 1) 'setting up shelters', 2) 'navigating across ice', va 3) 'cooking rations'. Gerundiy (-ing) shakli saqlanishi shart. D (to cook), B (cooked), A (cook) parallellikni buzadi.
strat: SAT PARALLELISM: setting up..., navigating..., and cooking... Har doim ketma-ketlikdagi -ing shakllarini tenglashtiring.

pas: Early twentieth-century aircraft engines relied almost entirely on lightweight aluminum alloys to maximize power-to-weight ratios. _______ modern aerospace engineers increasingly manufacture turbine blades from carbon-fiber composites and titanium alloys to withstand unprecedented combustion temperatures.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Matnda o'tgan zamon ('Early twentieth-century...') bilan hozirgi zamon muhandisligi ('modern aerospace engineers...') o'rtasidagi xronologik qarama-qarshilik ko'rsatilmoqda. 'Today,' o'tgan davrdan hozirgi davrga o'tishni eng mantiqiy tarzda ta'minlaydi. A misol keltirish, D sabab-oqibat, C qayta ta'riflash uchun bo'lib mos kelmaydi.
strat: SAT CHRONOLOGICAL TRANSITION: 'Early 20th century...' boshlanishi keyingi gapda 'Today,' yoki 'Now,' bilan davom etishini talab qiladi.

pas: Many terrestrial plants absorb nitrogen directly from chemical fertilizers dissolved in topsoil. Leguminous species like soybeans and clover, _______, form symbiotic root nodules with nitrogen-fixing bacteria, allowing them to thrive in nitrogen-deficient soils without synthetic amendments.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Birinchi gapda ko'plab o'simliklar azotni tayyor o'g'itdan olishi aytiladi. Ikkinchi gapda esa dukkakli o'simliklar aksincha (by contrast), o'g'itsiz ham ildizidagi bakteriyalar yordamida o'zi azot to'play olishi bayon qilinadi. Bu ikki xususiyat o'rtasidagi ziddiyatni 'by contrast' (aksincha) eng to'g'ri bog'laydi.
strat: SAT CONTRAST TRANSITION: 'Many plants need fertilizers <-> Legumes thrive without synthetic amendments' = By contrast.

pas: The archival records from the 1692 Salem witch trials were poorly preserved in humid courthouse cellars, resulting in extensive fungal decay across hundreds of parchment pages. _______, modern forensic historians must utilize hyperspectral multispectral imaging to reconstruct faded ink strokes.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Sabab-oqibat aloqasi: Hujjatlar mog'orlab chirib ketgani (sabab) tufayli, tarixchilar yozuvlarni tiklash uchun maxsus multispektral skanerlardan foydalanishga majbur bo'lishmoqda (oqibat). 'Accordingly' (shunga muvofiq / shu sababli) sababdan oqibatga o'tishni to'g'ri ifodalaydi. C va A ziddiyat bog'lovchilari.
strat: SAT CAUSE-EFFECT: Hujjatlar chirigan (sabab) -> Accordingly (shu sababli) maxsus texnologiya kerak (oqibat).

pas: Urban rooftop gardens reduce stormwater runoff by absorbing rainwater into soil substrates. _______, the vegetative canopy lowers urban surface temperatures through evapotranspiration, mitigating the metropolitan heat island effect.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Qo'shimcha ijobiy xususiyat kiritilmoqda (Addition): 1) Yomg'ir suvini yutadi; 2) Qo'shimcha ravishda (Additionally), shahar haroratini pasaytiradi. A va C ziddiyat bildiradi, bu yerda esa ikkita ijobiy samara bir-birini to'ldirmoqda.
strat: SAT ADDITION TRANSITION: Benefit 1 (absorbs runoff) + Benefit 2 (lowers temperature) -> 'Additionally,'.

pas: Archaeological excavators at the Neolithic settlement uncovered thousands of obsidian blades, initially suggesting a local tool-making workshop. Geochemical trace-element spectrometry, _______, demonstrated that the volcanic glass originated from quarries over four hundred miles away, proving the existence of extensive transcontinental trade networks.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Ziddiyat va kutilmagan haqiqat: Dastlab pichoqlar shu yerning o'zida yasalgan deb o'ylashgan ('initially suggesting local workshop'). Biroq kimyoviy tahlil buning aksini - toshlar 400 mil uzoqdan keltirilganini isbotladi. 'however' dastlabki taxmin bilan haqiqiy kashfiyot o'rtasidagi ziddiyatni ochib beradi.
strat: SAT CONTRAST: 'initially thought X <-> spectrometry however revealed Y'. Har doim dastlabki taxminga 'however' qarshi qo'yiladi.

pas: Cellular mitosis produces two genetically identical diploid daughter cells for tissue growth and cellular repair. _______, meiosis involves two successive nuclear divisions to generate four genetically diverse haploid gametes for sexual reproduction.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Mitoz va meyoz jarayonlari taqqoslanmoqda: mitoz 2 ta bir xil hujayra hosil qilsa, meyoz aksincha (In contrast) 4 ta turlicha jinsiy hujayra hosil qiladi. Bu aniq biologik qarama-qarshilikdir.
strat: SAT CONTRAST: Mitosis (2 identical) vs Meiosis (4 diverse) -> 'In contrast,'.

pas: Some desert organisms evade daytime heat through physiological dormancy. The spadefoot toad, _______, burrows deep underground into moist sand and remains inactive in a protective cocoon for up to ten months until monsoon rains return.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Birinchi gapda umumiy qoida (ba'zi sahro hayvonlari issiqdan qochib uyquga ketadi) aytiladi. Ikkinchi gapda esa ushbu qoidaga aniq misol sifatida 'spadefoot toad' qurbaqasi keltirilmoqda. Shuning uchun 'for example' (masalan) eng to'g'ri bog'lovchidir.
strat: SAT EXEMPLIFICATION: General claim (desert organisms evade heat) -> Specific animal (spadefoot toad) = 'for example'.

pas: Proponents of open-source software argue that public repositories enhance algorithmic security by enabling thousands of independent developers to audit code for potential vulnerabilities. Many proprietary software corporations, _______, contend that publicizing source code provides malicious hackers with an exact blueprint to exploit zero-day flaws.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
exp: Ochiq kod tarafdorlari (kodni ommaga ochish xavfsizlikni oshiradi deydi) bilan xususiy dastur korporatsiyalari (kodni ochish xakerlarga yo'l ochadi deydi) o'rtasidagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qarama-qarshi pozitsiya bayon qilinmoqda. 'conversely' (aksincha) bu ikki qarashni mukammal bog'laydi.
strat: SAT DIRECT OPPOSITION: Open-source advocates (public code is safer) vs Proprietary corporations (public code aids hackers) -> 'conversely'.

pas:
While researching an architectural presentation, a student took the following notes:
- Maya Lin designed the Vietnam Veterans Memorial in Washington, D.C.
- Lin was an undergraduate architecture student at Yale University when she entered the national design competition in 1981.
- Her minimalist design consists of two 246-foot black granite walls sunk into the earth, engraved with the names of over 58,000 fallen soldiers.
- The memorial received initial criticism for lacking traditional heroic statues, but it is now one of the most visited and emotionally revered monuments in the nation.
q: The student wants to emphasize the contrast between the initial reception of Lin's memorial and its contemporary standing. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: Although Maya Lin's Vietnam Veterans Memorial was initially criticized for lacking traditional heroic statues, it is now celebrated as one of the nation's most revered monuments.
Maya Lin was an undergraduate at Yale when she submitted her design for the Vietnam Veterans Memorial in 1981.
Consisting of two 246-foot black granite walls engraved with 58,000 names, the memorial was designed by Maya Lin.
Lin's minimalist memorial, which features two granite walls sunk into the earth, was selected through a national competition.
exp: Talabaning maqsadi: Lin yodgorligining dastlabki tanqid qilinishi bilan hozirgi yuksak e'tirofi o'rtasidagi ziddiyatni (contrast between initial reception and contemporary standing) ko'rsatish. A varianti 'Although initially criticized... it is now celebrated as one of the most revered monuments' jumlasi bilan aynan shu maqsadni 100% bajaradi.
strat: SAT RHETORICAL SYNTHESIS HACK: Maqsadga qarang: 'contrast initial reception and contemporary standing'. Kalit: 'Although initially criticized ... now celebrated' (A).

pas:
While conducting biology research, a student took the following notes:
- Tardigrades, commonly called water bears, are microscopic eight-legged invertebrates.
- They can enter a suspended metabolic state called cryptobiosis when confronted with environmental extremes.
- In cryptobiosis, their body water content drops to below 1% of normal levels.
- They can withstand ionizing radiation, temperatures from -328°F to 300°F, and the vacuum of outer space.
q: The student wants to introduce tardigrades to an audience unfamiliar with the organism. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: Withstanding temperatures up to 300°F, tardigrades enter cryptobiosis during environmental stress.
Ionizing radiation and outer space vacuum can be endured by water bears in metabolic stasis.
During cryptobiosis, tardigrades lose almost all cellular water, dropping to under 1% of normal levels.
Tardigrades, commonly known as water bears, are microscopic eight-legged invertebrates famous for surviving extreme conditions like radiation and space vacuum.
exp: Talabaning maqsadi: organizm bilan mutlaqo tanish bo'lmagan auditoriyaga tardigradalarni tanishtirish (introduce to unfamiliar audience). D varianti ularning nima ekani (microscopic eight-legged invertebrates), xalq orasidagi nomi (water bears) va asosiy xususiyatini sodda va tushunarli tarzda tanishtiradi.
strat: SAT GOAL MATCH: 'Introduce to unfamiliar audience' -> nima ekanini ta'riflab beruvchi D varianti eng mukammal kirish.

pas:
While researching historic treaties, a student took the following notes:
- The Svalbard Treaty was signed in Paris in 1920.
- It granted Norway full sovereignty over the Arctic archipelago of Svalbard.
- However, citizens of all signatory nations (now over 40 countries) retain equal rights to engage in commercial fishing, hunting, and mining there.
- The archipelago was also designated a demilitarized zone where no naval bases or fortifications may ever be established.
q: The student wants to emphasize Svalbard's unique international commercial status. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: Under the 1920 Svalbard Treaty, Norway holds sovereignty over the archipelago, yet citizens of over 40 signatory nations enjoy equal commercial rights to fish, hunt, and mine.
The Arctic territory of Svalbard is governed under a treaty established in 1920 by forty participating countries.
Norway gained sovereignty over Svalbard in 1920, establishing strict demilitarization rules across the islands.
Signed in Paris in 1920, the Svalbard Treaty designated the Arctic archipelago a demilitarized zone forbidding naval bases.
exp: Talabaning maqsadi: Svalbardning o'ziga xos xalqaro tijoriy maqomini (unique international commercial status) ta'kidlash. A varianti Norvegiyaning suvereniteti ostida 40 dan ortiq mamlakat fuqarolari bir xil baliq ovlash, ov va konchilik kabi tijoriy huquqlarga egaligini aniq ko'rsatadi. D va C harbiy jihatlarga qaratilgan.
strat: SAT GOAL FOCUS: Maqsad 'commercial status'. Faqat A variantida 'equal commercial rights to fish, hunt, and mine' aks etgan.

pas:
While preparing a botany poster, a student took the following notes:
- The Corpse Flower (Amorphophallus titanum) produces the largest unbranched inflorescence in the plant kingdom, reaching heights over ten feet.
- It is native to the equatorial rainforests of western Sumatra, Indonesia.
- It blooms irregularly, often requiring seven to ten years between flowering cycles.
- When in bloom, it emits a pungent odor resembling rotting flesh to attract carrion beetle and flesh fly pollinators.
q: The student wants to explain how the Corpse Flower's distinctive odor facilitates its reproduction. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: Native to the rainforests of Sumatra, the Corpse Flower produces an inflorescence reaching over ten feet in height.
The Corpse Flower is known for its rare blooms and its massive unbranched floral structure.
Reaching ten feet in height, the Corpse Flower blooms only once every seven to ten years in western Indonesia.
The Corpse Flower emits a foul odor resembling rotting flesh to lure carrion beetles and flesh flies that pollinate the plant.
exp: Talabaning maqsadi: gulning o'ziga xos hidi uning ko'payishiga (reproduction / pollination) qanday xizmat qilishini tushuntirish. D varianti chiriyotgan go'sht hidi o'simlikni changlatuvchi qo'ng'iz va pashshalarni jalb qilishini aniq bog'lab beradi.
strat: SAT SYNTHESIS GOAL: 'odor facilitates reproduction' -> D variantidagi 'emits odor to lure flies that pollinate' to'liq mos keladi.

pas:
While researching aviation history, a student took the following notes:
- In 1930, British engineer Frank Whittle patented the first turbojet aircraft engine.
- Whittle's design compressed incoming air with a centrifugal compressor, ignited it with fuel in a combustion chamber, and expelled high-velocity exhaust gas to create thrust.
- The British Air Ministry initially declined to fund the prototype, dismissing jet propulsion as unfeasible for practical flight.
- Whittle persevered with private backing, successfully conducting the maiden flight of the Gloster E.28/39 jet aircraft in May 1941.
q: The student wants to emphasize Whittle's perseverance in the face of institutional skepticism. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: The Gloster E.28/39, powered by a turbojet engine, flew for the first time in May 1941 under the supervision of Frank Whittle.
Even though the British Air Ministry dismissed jet propulsion and refused funding, Whittle persevered with private backing to successfully fly the first British jet aircraft in 1941.
Frank Whittle patented the first turbojet engine design in 1930, using compressed air and combustion to generate forward thrust.
Whittle's turbojet engine design relied on a centrifugal compressor and high-velocity exhaust gas expulsion.
exp: Talabaning maqsadi: davlat/institut skeptitsizmiga qaramay Whittle'ning matonati va tirishqoqligini (perseverance in the face of skepticism) ko'rsatish. B varianti 'Even though the Ministry dismissed it and refused funding, Whittle persevered...' degan ziddiyat orqali maqsadga aniq javob beradi.
strat: SAT GOAL: 'perseverance in the face of skepticism' -> B: 'Even though Ministry dismissed... Whittle persevered with private backing'.

pas:
While preparing an environmental science presentation, a student took the following notes:
- Mangrove forests inhabit tropical and subtropical tidal coastlines.
- Their dense, tangled stilt root systems dissipate wave energy and stabilize coastal sediments.
- Mangroves prevent shoreline erosion caused by severe storm surges and hurricanes.
- Additionally, mangrove root networks sequester carbon in marine sediment up to four times faster than terrestrial forests.
q: The student wants to emphasize the dual ecological benefits of mangrove root systems. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: Tangled stilt root systems allow mangrove trees to survive in saline coastal sediments.
Mangrove root systems provide dual benefits: they stabilize coastlines by dissipating storm wave energy and sequester carbon four times faster than land forests.
Mangrove forests are predominantly found along tropical and subtropical coastlines subjected to frequent storm surges.
Carbon sequestration in marine sediments is an important focus of modern environmental scientists.
exp: Talabaning maqsadi: ildiz tizimining ikkita asosiy ekologik foydasini (dual ecological benefits) ta'kidlash. B varianti 1) to'lqinlarni to'xtatib qirg'oqni himoya qilish va 2) quruqlikdagi o'rmonlardan 4 barobar tezroq uglerod yutish kabi 2 ta foydani birdek ifodalaydi.
strat: SAT SYNTHESIS GOAL: 'dual benefits' -> B: 'dissipating wave energy AND sequestering carbon'. Ikkala foyda ham qamrab olingan.

pas:
While researching medieval manuscripts, a student took the following notes:
- The Book of Kells is an illuminated manuscript Gospel book in Latin.
- It was created by Celtic monks around 800 CE in a monastery in Ireland or Scotland.
- It contains intricate, interlaced spiral designs, animal motifs, and vibrant mineral pigments.
- It is widely regarded as one of the finest surviving masterworks of medieval European calligraphy.
q: The student wants to describe the artistic content of the Book of Kells. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: The Book of Kells features intricate, interlaced spiral designs, vibrant mineral pigments, and stylized animal motifs throughout its pages.
The Book of Kells is preserved as a celebrated masterwork of medieval European scribal tradition.
Created around 800 CE, the Book of Kells is a Latin Gospel book produced by Celtic monastic scribes.
Celtic monks created the Book of Kells in a medieval monastery located in either Ireland or Scotland.
exp: Talabaning maqsadi: kitobning badiiy bezaklari va tasviriy mazmunini (artistic content) tasvirlash. A varianti kitobdagi naqshlar, spirallar, yorqin mineral pigmentlar va hayvonlar tasvirini keltirib, badiiy tomonni to'liq aks ettiradi.
strat: SAT SYNTHESIS GOAL: 'artistic content' -> naqshlar, ranglar va tasvirlarni ochib beruvchi A varianti yagona to'g'ri tanlovdir.

pas:
While researching agricultural innovation, a student took the following notes:
- Norman Borlaug was an American agronomist who led the Green Revolution.
- In the 1940s and 1950s, Borlaug bred semi-dwarf, disease-resistant wheat varieties in Mexico.
- Traditional tall wheat varieties collapsed under the weight of heavy seed heads when fertilized.
- Borlaug's shorter, sturdier wheat varieties supported massive grain yields without falling over, saving an estimated one billion people from starvation.
q: The student wants to explain the physical advantage of Borlaug's semi-dwarf wheat compared to traditional varieties. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
opts: Unlike traditional tall wheat varieties that collapsed under heavy grain heads, Borlaug's shorter, sturdier stalks supported massive yields without falling over.
Norman Borlaug developed wheat varieties in Mexico during the 1940s and 1950s, earning him recognition as the father of the Green Revolution.
The Green Revolution, led by agronomist Norman Borlaug, is credited with saving an estimated one billion lives globally.
Borlaug's agricultural experiments in Mexico revolutionized international crop yields through chemical fertilizer usage.
exp: Talabaning maqsadi: kalta (semi-dwarf) bug'doyning oddiy baland bug'doyga nisbatan jismoniy ustunligini (physical advantage) tushuntirish. A varianti baland bug'doy don og'irligidan yiqilib tushgani, kalta bug'doy esa poyasi baquvvat bo'lib yiqilmasdan katta hosilni ko'tara olganini taqqoslab beradi.
strat: SAT SYNTHESIS GOAL: 'physical advantage compared to traditional varieties' -> A variantidagi 'Unlike traditional tall wheat that collapsed, shorter sturdier stalks supported yields' aynan shu ustunlikni tushuntiradi.

q: If \(5(2x-3)-4=3(x+7)+2\), what is the value of \(x\)?
strat: Desmosga \(5(2x-3)-4=3(x+7)+2\) ni kiriting; vertikal chiziq \(x=6\) da kesishadi.

skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
q:
Consider the system of equations:
\(4x+3y=31\)
\(2x-y=3\)
What is the value of \(x+y\)?
exp: Multiply the second equation by 3: \(6x-3y=9\). Add to first equation: \((4x+3y)+(6x-3y)=31+9\) ⇒ \(10x=40\) ⇒ \(x=4\). Substitute into \(2(4)-y=3\) ⇒ \(8-y=3\) ⇒ \(y=5\). Therefore, \(x+y=4+5=9\).
strat: Desmosga ikkala tenglamani yozing va kesishish nuqtasini bosing: (4, 5). So'ralgan \(x+y=4+5=9\).

skill: Linear inequalities in one or two variables
q: A catering service charges a flat equipment fee of $120 plus $18.50 per guest. If an event planner has a maximum budget of $850 for catering, what is the greatest number of guests that can attend?
exp: Let g be the number of guests. The inequality is \(120+18.50g\le 850\). Subtract 120: \(18.50g\le 730\). Divide by 18.50: \(g\le 39.459\). Since the number of guests must be a whole integer, the maximum number is 39.
strat: \(\frac{730}{18.50}=39.45\). Hech qachon yuqoriga yaxlitlamang (40 ta 860$ bo'lib byudjetdan oshib ketadi).

skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
q:
In the system of linear equations below, \(k\) is a constant:
\(6x-9y=14\)
\(2x-ky=8\)
If the system has no solution, what is the value of \(k\)?
exp: A linear system has no solution if the lines are parallel (identical slopes) but have different y-intercepts. The ratio of coefficients of \(x\) and \(y\) must be equal: \(\frac{6}{2}=-\frac{9}{-k}\) ⇒ \(3=\frac{9}{k}\) ⇒ \(k=3\). Checking intercepts: \(\frac{14}{8}\ne 3\), confirming the lines never intersect.
strat: Tenglamalarni parallel qilish qoidasi: \(\frac{a_{1}}{a_{2}}=\frac{b_{1}}{b_{2}}\ne \frac{c_{1}}{c_{2}}\). \(\frac{6}{2}=-\frac{9}{-k}\) ⇒ \(3=\frac{9}{k}\) ⇒ \(k=3\).

q: The elevation \(E(m)\), in meters above sea level, of a drone \(m\) minutes after beginning its descent is modeled by \(E(m)=480-16m\). Which statement is the best interpretation of 480 in this context?
opts: The elevation lost by the drone every minute
The speed of the drone during descent
The total number of minutes the drone takes to land
The initial elevation of the drone before beginning descent
exp: When \(m=0\) (the moment descent starts), \(E(0)=480-16(0)=480\) meters. Thus, 480 represents the initial elevation of the drone.
strat: \(y=mx+b\) da b har doim boshlang'ich qiymat (initial value, at \(m=0\)).

q: What is the positive solution to the equation \(|3x-5|=2x+10\)?
exp: Case 1: \(3x-5=2x+10\) ⇒ \(x=15\). Check: \(|3(15)-5|=|40|=40\); \(2(15)+10=40\) (Valid positive solution!). Case 2: \(3x-5=-(2x+10)\) ⇒ \(5x=-5\) ⇒ \(x=-1\) (Negative). Thus, the positive solution is 15.
strat: Desmosga \(y_{1}=|3x-5|\) va \(y_{2}=2x+10\) yozing, musbat kesishish nuqtasi \(x=15\) da joylashgan.

skill: Linear inequalities in one or two variables
q: Which of the following ordered pairs (\(x\), \(y\)) satisfies the system of inequalities \(y>-2x+5\) and \(3x-4y\ge 12\)?
exp: Test point (5, 0): Inequality 1: \(0>-2(5)+5\) ⇒ \(0>-5\) (True). Inequality 2: \(3(5)-4(0)=15\ge 12\) (True). Both inequalities are satisfied.
strat: Variantlarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tengsizliklarga qo'yib tekshiring (Plugging in choices).

q: In the xy-plane, a line with slope \(-\frac{3}{4}\) passes through the points (2, 7) and (10, \(k\)). What is the value of \(k\)?
exp: The slope formula is \(m=\frac{y_{2}-y_{1}}{x_{2}-x_{1}}\). Here, \(-\frac{3}{4}=\frac{k-7}{10-2}\) ⇒ \(-\frac{3}{4}=\frac{k-7}{8}\). Multiply both sides by 8: \(-6=k-7\) ⇒ \(k=1\).
strat: \(x\) 8 birlik o'ngga surilganda, \(y\) har 4 qadamda 3 ga kamayadi. 8 qadamda 6 ga kamayadi: \(7-6=1\).

q: Line L in the xy-plane is perpendicular to the line \(3x+6y=19\) and passes through the point (4, \(-2\)). What is the y-intercept of line L?
exp: Rewrite \(3x+6y=19\) in slope-intercept form: \(6y=-3x+19\) ⇒ \(y=-\frac{1}{2}\) \(x+\frac{19}{6}\). The slope is \(-\frac{1}{2}\). Perpendicular line L has slope \(m=-\frac{1}{-\frac{1}{2}}=2\). Using point-slope form with (4, \(-2\)): \(y-(-2)=2(x-4)\) ⇒ \(y+2=2x-8\) ⇒ \(y=2x-10\). The y-intercept is \(-10\).
strat: Perpendikulyar burchak koeffitsiyenti: \(-\frac{1}{m}\)_original. \(-\frac{1}{2}\) ning teskari qarama-qarshisi +2. \(y=2(0)-10=-10\).

q: During a chemistry lab, a student pours \(\frac{2}{5}\) of a beaker's contents into flask A, and \(\frac{1}{3}\) of the remaining liquid into flask B. If 160 milliliters remain in the beaker, what was the initial volume of liquid in the beaker, in milliliters?
exp: Let V be the total initial volume. After pouring \(\frac{2}{5}\) V, remaining liquid is \(\frac{3}{5}\) V. Pouring \(\frac{1}{3}\) of this leaves \(\frac{2}{3}\) * (3/5 V) = 2/5 V. We are given \(\frac{2}{5}\) \(V=160\) ⇒ \(V=160\cdot \frac{5}{2}=400\) milliliters.
strat: Qolgan qism: \((1-\frac{2}{5})\cdot (1-\frac{1}{3})=\frac{3}{5}\cdot \frac{2}{3}=\frac{2}{5}\). \(\frac{2}{5}\) qismi 160 bo'lsa, to'liq hajm = \(160\cdot 2.5=400\) ml.

skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
q:
The system of equations below has infinitely many solutions:
\(px-6y=18\)
\(5x-2y=q\)
What is the value of \(p\cdot q\)?
exp: For infinitely many solutions, the two linear equations must represent identical lines. Multiply the second equation by 3: \(15x-6y=3q\). Comparing with \(px-6y=18\) gives \(p=15\) and \(3q=18\) ⇒ \(q=6\). Thus, \(p\cdot q=15\cdot 6=90\).
strat: Cheksiz yechim: Tenglamalar bir-birining karralisi bo'lishi shart (\(-\frac{6}{-2}=3\) marta). \(p=5\cdot 3=15\), \(q=\frac{18}{3}=6\). Ko'paytma: \(15\cdot 6=90\).

q: A high-speed optical scanner processes 420 documents in 3.5 minutes. At this constant rate, how many documents will the scanner process in 12 minutes?
exp: The rate is \(\frac{420}{3.5}=120\) documents per minute. In 12 minutes, the total processed is \(120\cdot 12=1{,}440\) documents.
strat: Tezlikni toping: \(\frac{420}{3.5}=120\) ta/daq. Keyin \(120\cdot 12=1440\).

skill: Linear inequalities in one or two variables
q: Which inequality describes the region in the xy-plane that lies strictly below the line passing through (0, \(-4\)) and (3, 2)?
exp: Slope \(m=\frac{2-(-4)}{3-0}=\frac{6}{3}=2\). The y-intercept is \(b=-4\). The boundary line is \(y=2x-4\). Strictly below means \(y<2x-4\).
strat: Strictly below = qat'iy kichik \((<)\). \(m=\frac{2-(-4)}{3}=2\), \(b=-4\). Demak \(y<2x-4\).

q: The function f is defined by \(f(x)=3x^{2}-24x+55\). What is the minimum value of \(f(x)\)?
exp: The x-coordinate of the vertex of \(ax^{2}+bx+c\) is \(x=-\frac{b}{2a}=-\frac{-24}{2\cdot 3}=\frac{24}{6}=4\). The minimum value is \(f(4)=3(4)^{2}-24(4)+55=3(16)-96+55=48-96+55=7\).
strat: Desmosga \(y=3x^{2}-24x+55\) yozing va eng pastki vertex nuqtasini bosing: (4, 7). Minimum qiymat \(y=7\).

q: In the equation \(4x^{2}+kx+49=0\), \(k\) is a positive constant. If the equation has exactly one real solution, what is the value of \(k\)?
exp: A quadratic equation \(ax^{2}+bx+c=0\) has exactly one real solution when its discriminant \(D=b^{2}-4ac=0\). Here, \(k^{2}-4(4)(49)=0\) ⇒ \(k^{2}-784=0\) ⇒ \(k^{2}=784\). Since \(k>0\), \(k=\sqrt{784}=28\).
strat: To'la kvadrat qoidasi: \((2x+7)^{2}=4x^{2}+28x+49\). O'rta had \(2\cdot 2x\cdot 7=28x\) bo'lishi kerak ⇒ \(k=28\).

q: What is the set of all real solutions to \(\sqrt{2x+9}=x-3\)?
exp: Square both sides: \(2x+9=(x-3)^{2}\) ⇒ \(2x+9=x^{2}-6x+9\) ⇒ \(x^{2}-8x=0\) ⇒ \(x(x-8)=0\) ⇒ \(x=0\) or \(x=8\). Testing \(x=0\): \(\sqrt{9}=-3\) (False, extraneous root). Testing \(x=8\): \(\sqrt{25}=5\) (True!). Thus, the only real solution is 8.
strat: Ildizli tenglamani yechgandan so'ng ildizlarni tekshiring: \(x=0\) da \(\sqrt{9}=-3\) bo'la olmaydi. Faqat \(x=8\) to'g'ri.

q: A colony of bacteria begins with 350 cells and triples every 4 hours. Which function \(B(t)\) models the number of bacteria cells \(t\) hours after the observation begins?
exp: The standard form for periodic growth is \(y=a\cdot b^{\frac{t}{k}}\), where a is the initial quantity (350), b is the growth factor (3), and \(k\) is the cycle duration (4 hours). Thus, \(B(t)=350(3)^{\frac{t}{4}}\).
strat: Tekshirish: \(t=4\) da bir marta 3 ga ko'payishi kerak \((350\cdot 3=1050)\). \(B(4)=350(3)^{\frac{4}{4}}=350\cdot 3=1050\) (Faqat B to'g'ri).

q: Which of the following is equivalent to \(\frac{2x^{2}-x-15}{x^{2}-9}\) for all \(x>3\)?
exp: Factor numerator: \(2x^{2}-x-15=(2x+5)(x-3)\). Factor denominator: \(x^{2}-9=(x-3)(x+3)\). Cancel common factor \((x-3)\): \(\frac{2x+5}{x+3}\).
strat: Suratni ko'paytuvchilarga ajrating: \((2x+5)(x-3)\). Maxraj: \((x-3)(x+3)\). \((x-3)\) qisqarib \(\frac{2x+5}{x+3}\) qoladi.

q: The polynomial \(P(x)=x^{3}-5x^{2}+kx-18\) has \((x-3)\) as a factor. What is the value of \(k\)?
strat: Ildiz \(x=3\) ni funksiyaga qo'ying va 0 ga tenglang: \(27-45+3k-18=0\) ⇒ \(3k=36\) ⇒ \(k=12\).

q:
In the system of equations below:
\(y=x^{2}-6x+11\)
\(y=2x-c\)
For which value of \(c\) does the system have exactly one distinct real solution (\(x\), \(y\))?
exp: Set the equations equal: \(x^{2}-6x+11=2x-c\) ⇒ \(x^{2}-8x+(11+c)=0\). For exactly one solution, discriminant \(D=(-8)^{2}-4(1)(11+c)=0\) ⇒ \(64-44-4c=0\) ⇒ \(20-4c=0\) ⇒ \(c=5\).

q: Which expression is equivalent to \((64x^{6}\cdot y^{-3})^{\frac{2}{3}}\) for all positive values of \(x\) and \(y\)?
strat: \(64^{\frac{2}{3}}=(4^{3})^{\frac{2}{3}}=4^{2}=16\). Faqat C yoki A bo'lishi mumkin. \(x\) darajasi \(6\cdot \frac{2}{3}=4\) bo'ladi ⇒ C.

q: The graph of \(y=g(x)\) is obtained by shifting the graph of \(y=x^{2}\) horizontally 5 units to the right and vertically 3 units down. Which formula defines \(g(x)\)?
exp: A horizontal shift \(c\) units to the right replaces \(x\) with \((x-c)\), giving \((x-5)^{2}\). A vertical shift d units down subtracts d from the function, giving \((x-5)^{2}-3\).

q: If \(r\) and s are the distinct solutions to the quadratic equation \(3x^{2}-15x+7=0\), what is the value of \(\frac{1}{r}+\frac{1}{s}\)?
exp: Using Vieta's formulas: \(r+s=-\frac{-15}{3}=5\), and \(r\cdot s=\frac{7}{3}\). Note that \(\frac{1}{r}+\frac{1}{s}=\frac{r+s}{r\cdot s}=\frac{5}{\frac{7}{3}}=5\cdot \frac{3}{7}=\frac{15}{7}\).
strat: \(\frac{1}{r}+\frac{1}{s}=\frac{r+s}{r\cdot s}\). Ildizlar yig'indisi 5, ko'paytmasi \(\frac{7}{3}\). \(\frac{5}{\frac{7}{3}}=\frac{15}{7}\).

q: A radioactive sample decays according to the model \(M(t)=800(0.88)^{t}\), where \(t\) is measured in years. By what annual percentage does the mass of the sample decrease?
exp: In an exponential decay model \(y=a(1-r)^{t}\), the base is \(1-r\). Here, \(1-r=0.88\) ⇒ \(r=1-0.88=0.12\), which represents an annual decrease of 12%.
strat: Asos 0.88 bo'lsa, 100% \(-88\)% = 12% ga kamayish demakdir.

q: The height \(h(t)\), in feet, of a baseball \(t\) seconds after being struck is given by \(h(t)=-16t^{2}+64t+80\). How many seconds after impact does the ball strike the ground?
exp: The ball strikes the ground when \(h(t)=0\): \(-16t^{2}+64t+80=0\). Divide both sides by \(-16\): \(t^{2}-4t-5=0\). Factor: \((t-5)(t+1)=0\). Since time \(t\ge 0\), \(t=5\) seconds.

q: If \((x-2)^{\frac{3}{2}}=27\), what is the value of \(x\)?
strat: 27 ning kub ildizi 3, kvadrati 9. \(x-2=9\) ⇒ \(x=11\).

q: In the xy-plane, the equation \(x^{2}+y^{2}-10x+6y=47\) represents a circle. What is the radius of the circle?

The population of an endangered bird species increased by 25% from 2020 to 2022, but then decreased by 20% from 2022 to 2024. If the population in 2024 was 1,200 birds, what was the population in 2020?
exp: Let P be the 2020 population. In 2022, it was 1.25P. In 2024, after a 20% decrease, it was \((1-0.20)(1.25P)=0.80\cdot 1.25P=1.00P\). Since P_\(2024=1{,}200\), the 2020 population was exactly 1,200.
strat: \(1.25\cdot 0.80=1.00\)! Ya'ni +25% va \(-20\)% bir-birini to'liq neytrallaydi. Boshlang'ich son 1,200 bo'lgan.

q: A student scored 82, 88, 91, and 79 on the first four physics exams. What score must the student earn on the fifth exam to achieve an overall mean score of 86?
exp: Total sum required for 5 exams with a mean of 86 is \(5\cdot 86=430\). The sum of the first 4 exams is \(82+88+91+79=340\). The fifth exam score must be \(430-340=90\).
strat: Jami kerakli ball: \(5\cdot 86=430\). Mavjud: 340. Kerak: \(430-340=90\).

q: A random sample of 600 voters in a municipality found that 54% support a proposed environmental ordinance, with an associated margin of error of 4% at a 95% confidence level. Which of the following conclusions is best supported by the survey results?
opts: The ordinance is guaranteed to pass with more than 50% of the vote.
Exactly 54% of all municipal voters support the ordinance.
Every random sample of 600 voters will yield exactly between 50% and 58% support.
It is plausible that the true proportion of all municipal voters who support the ordinance is between 50% and 58%.
exp: The margin of error gives a plausible interval for the population parameter: 54% +/\(-4\)% = [50%, 58%]. It does not guarantee certainty ('exactly' or 'guaranteed'). Hence, D is the only statistically sound interpretation.
strat: Statistika qoidasi: 'Guaranteed' yoki 'Exactly' so'zlari noto'g'ri. Har doim 'plausible' (ehtimoliy oraliq) to'g'ri bo'ladi.

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: A rectangular ceramic tile has an area of 54 square inches. Given that 1 foot = 12 inches, what is the area of the tile in square feet?
exp: Since 1 foot = 12 inches, 1 square foot = \(12^{2}=144\) square inches. Convert the area: 54 sq in * (1 sq ft / 144 sq in) = \(\frac{54}{144}=\frac{3}{8}=0.375\) square feet.
strat: Kvadrat birliklar tuzog'i! 12 ga emas, \(12^{2}=144\) ga bo'linadi: \(\frac{54}{144}=0.375\).

q: In a clinical study of 250 patients, 160 received Treatment A and 90 received a Placebo. Of those who received Treatment A, 128 reported symptom relief. Of those who received the Placebo, 36 reported symptom relief. If a patient is selected at random from those who reported symptom relief, what is the probability that the patient received Treatment A?
exp: The condition specifies selecting 'from those who reported symptom relief'. Total patients reporting relief = 128 (Treatment A) + 36 (Placebo) = 164. The favorable count from Treatment A is 128. Therefore, \(P=\frac{128}{164}\).
strat: Shartli ehtimollik: Maxrajda faqat shart qanoatlantirganlar (yengillik sezganlar): \(128+36=164\). Ehtimollik: \(\frac{128}{164}\).

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: A bronze alloy consists of copper, tin, and zinc in the ratio 14 : 3 : 1 by weight. If a foundry casts a sculpture weighing 72 kilograms from this alloy, how many kilograms of tin are required?
exp: Total parts = \(14+3+1=18\) parts. Weight of 1 part = 72 kg / \(18=4\) kg. Tin represents 3 parts: \(3\cdot 4\) kg = 12 kg.
strat: Jami qismlar: \(14+3+1=18\). Bitta qism = \(\frac{72}{18}=4\) kg. Qalay (tin) = \(3\cdot 4=12\) kg.

q: Dataset X consists of the numbers {12, 14, 15, 18, 21}. Dataset Y is formed by adding 6 to each number in Dataset X. Which statement correctly compares the standard deviation and median of the two datasets?
opts: The median remains unchanged, and the standard deviation increases by 6.
The median increases by 6, and the standard deviation remains unchanged.
Both the median and the standard deviation remain unchanged.
The median increases by 6, and the standard deviation increases by 6.
exp: Adding a constant \(c\) to every value in a dataset shifts the entire distribution rightward by \(c\) (so the median increases by \(c=6\)), but the distances between points remain completely identical, meaning the spread (standard deviation) is unchanged.
strat: Har bir elementga son qo'shilganda: Median o'zgaradi \((+6)\), lekin dispersiya/standart og'ish o'zgarmaydi.

q: A line of best fit for a scatterplot relating weekly study hours \(x\) to exam score \(y\) is modeled by \(y=4.2x+48\). If a student studies 9.5 hours in a week, what is the student's predicted exam score, to the nearest whole point?
exp: Substitute \(x=9.5\) into the equation: \(y=4.2(9.5)+48=39.9+48=87.9\). Rounding to the nearest whole point gives 88.

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: Two commuter trains leave the same station at 08:00 AM traveling in opposite directions along a straight track. Train A travels at an average speed of 65 miles per hour, and Train B travels at 85 miles per hour. At what time will the two trains be 450 miles apart?
exp: Because they travel in opposite directions, their separation speed is the sum: \(65+85=150\) miles per hour. Time needed to separate 450 miles = \(\frac{450}{150}=3\) hours. Adding 3 hours to 08:00 AM gives 11:00 AM.
strat: Qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda tezliklar qo'shiladi: \(65+85=150\) mph. Vaqt = \(\frac{450}{150}=3\) soat. 08:\(00+3\):\(00=11\):00 AM.

q: An online retailer sold 480 smartphones in November and 600 smartphones in December. What was the percentage increase in smartphone sales from November to December?
strat: Oshish foizi: (Oshgan miqdor / Boshlang'ich) * \(100=\frac{120}{480}=0.25\) (25%).

q: A quality inspector tests components from an automated assembly line. The probability that any individual component has a manufacturing defect is 0.04, independently of other components. What is the probability that in a random sample of 2 components, at least one component has a defect?
exp: P(at least one defect) = \(1-P\)(no defects). The probability that a component has no defect is \(1-0.04=0.96\). For 2 independent components: P(no defects) = \(0.96\cdot 0.96=0.9216\). Thus, P(at least one defect) = \(1-0.9216=0.0784\).

skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
q: A solid rectangular prism made of titanium has dimensions 8 cm by 5 cm by 4 cm. If the density of titanium is 4.5 grams per cubic centimeter, what is the mass of the prism in grams?
exp: Volume of prism = length * width * height = \(8\cdot 5\cdot 4=160\) cm^3. Mass = density * volume = 4.5 g/cm^\(3\cdot 160\) cm^\(3=720\) grams.
strat: Hajm \(V=8\cdot 5\cdot 4=160\) sm^3. Massa = \(160\cdot 4.5=720\) gramm.

q: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle. If \(\sin(A)=\frac{5}{13}\), what is the value of \(\cos(B)\)?
exp: In any right triangle where angles A and B are complementary acute angles (\(A+B=90\) degrees), the co-function identity holds: \(\sin(A)=\cos(90-A)=\cos(B)\). Therefore, \(\cos(B)=\frac{5}{13}\).
strat: O'zaro to'ldiruvchi burchaklar qoidasi: \(\sin(A)=\cos(B)\). Sinus berilgan bo'lsa, ikkinchi burchak kosinusi unga teng: \(\frac{5}{13}\).

q: A circle has a radius of 18 centimeters. What is the length, in centimeters, of an arc intercepted by a central angle measuring \(5\cdot \frac{\pi }{6}\) radians?
exp: Arc length s is given by \(s=r\) * theta when theta is in radians. Here, \(s=18\cdot (5\cdot \frac{\pi }{6})=3\cdot 5\cdot \pi =15\cdot \pi\) centimeters.
strat: Yoy uzunligi formulasi (radianda): \(s=r\) * theta. \(18\cdot (5\cdot \frac{\pi }{6})=15\cdot \pi\).

q: In the xy-plane, the circle with equation \((x+7)^{2}+(y-4)^{2}=144\) has its center at point (\(h\), \(k\)) and radius \(r\). What is the value of \(h+k+r\)?
exp: Standard form is \((x-h)^{2}+(y-k)^{2}=r^{2}\). Comparing gives \(h=-7\), \(k=4\), and \(r=\sqrt{144}=12\). Therefore, \(h+k+r=-7+4+12=9\).

q: Cylinder P has radius \(r\) and height \(h\). Cylinder Q has twice the radius and half the height of Cylinder P. If the volume of Cylinder P is \(45\cdot \pi\) cubic inches, what is the volume of Cylinder Q, in cubic inches?
exp: Volume of a cylinder is \(V=\pi \cdot r^{2}\cdot h\). For Cylinder Q, V_\(Q=\pi \cdot (2r)^{2}\cdot (\frac{h}{2})=\pi \cdot (4r^{2})\cdot (\frac{h}{2})=2\cdot (\pi \cdot r^{2}\cdot h)=2\cdot V\)_P. Thus, V_\(Q=2\cdot 45\cdot \pi =90\cdot \pi\) cubic inches.
strat: Radius kvadratik ta'sir qiladi \((2^{2}=4)\), balandlik esa chiziqli \((\frac{1}{2})\). Umumiy hajm \(4\cdot \frac{1}{2}=2\) barobar oshadi: \(45\cdot \pi \cdot 2=90\cdot \pi\).

q: In triangle DEF, angle \(D=30\) degrees, angle \(E=60\) degrees, and angle \(F=90\) degrees. If the hypotenuse DE has length 16 units, what is the length of the side opposite angle E?
exp: In a 30-60-90 special right triangle with hypotenuse 2x, the side opposite the 30-degree angle is \(x\), and the side opposite the 60-degree angle is \(x\cdot \sqrt{3}\). Here, hypotenuse = 16 ⇒ \(x=8\). Side opposite 60 degrees is \(8\cdot \sqrt{3}\).
strat: Gipotenuza 16 bo'lsa, 30° qarshisi 8, 60° qarshisi esa \(8\cdot \sqrt{3}\).

q: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF, where vertices A, B, and C correspond to D, E, and F respectively. The length of side AB is 15 cm and the length of corresponding side DE is 25 cm. If the area of triangle ABC is 72 square centimeters, what is the area of triangle DEF, in square centimeters?
exp: The ratio of corresponding side lengths is \(k=\frac{25}{15}=\frac{5}{3}\). The ratio of their areas is \(k^{2}=\left(\frac{5}{3}\right)^{2}=\frac{25}{9}\). Thus, Area(DEF) = \(72\cdot (\frac{25}{9})=8\cdot 25=200\) square centimeters.
strat: Yuzalar nisbati chiziqli nisbatning kvadrati: \(\left(\frac{25}{15}\right)^{2}=\left(\frac{5}{3}\right)^{2}=\frac{25}{9}\). \(72\cdot \frac{25}{9}=200\) sm^2.

q: In a circle with center O, the measure of central angle AOB is 72 degrees. If the area of sector AOB is \(20\cdot \pi\) square centimeters, what is the circumference of circle O, in centimeters?
exp: Sector area formula: Area = (theta / 360) * pi * \(r\)^2. Here, \((\frac{72}{360})\cdot \pi \cdot r^{2}=20\cdot \pi\) ⇒ \(\frac{1}{5}\cdot r^{2}=20\) ⇒ \(r^{2}=100\) ⇒ \(r=10\). The circumference is \(C=2\cdot \pi \cdot r=2\cdot \pi \cdot (10)=20\cdot \pi\) centimeters.
strat: Sektor yuzi: \((\frac{72}{360})\cdot \pi \cdot r^{2}=20\cdot \pi\) ⇒ \(r^{2}=100\) ⇒ \(r=10\). Aylana uzunligi \(C=2\cdot \pi \cdot r=20\cdot \pi\).

q: In the xy-plane, the line \(y=8\) is tangent to a circle at point (5, 8). If the circle also passes through the point (5, 0), what is the equation of the circle?
exp: Since \(y=8\) is a horizontal tangent line at (5, 8), the radius at this point is vertical, so the x-coordinate of the center is 5. The circle passes through (5, 8) and (5, 0), so the diameter endpoints along \(x=5\) are (5, 8) and (5, 0). The diameter is \(8-0=8\), meaning radius \(r=4\) and center is at (5, 4). The equation is \((x-5)^{2}+(y-4)^{2}=16\).
strat: Diametr \(x=5\) bo'ylab (5,8) dan (5,0) gacha ⇒ uzunligi 8 ⇒ radius \(r=4\), \(r^{2}=16\), markaz (5, 4).

q: In triangle PQR, side QR is extended past R to point S. If angle \(P=58\) degrees and angle \(Q=64\) degrees, what is the measure of the exterior angle PRS?
exp: By the Exterior Angle Theorem, the measure of an exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the measures of the two non-adjacent interior angles: angle PRS = angle P + angle \(Q=58+64=122\) degrees.
strat: Tashqi burchak xossasi: Tashqi burchak o'ziga qo'shni bo'lmagan ikki ichki burchak yig'indisiga teng: \(58+64=122^{\circ}\).

q: In the xy-plane, what is the distance between the points (\(-3\), 2) and (5, \(-4\))?
strat: Pifagor uchligi: Delta_\(x=8\), Delta_\(y=6\) ⇒ 6-8-10 uchburchagi! Masofa 10.

q: For acute angle theta, \(cos\)(theta) = \(\frac{24}{25}\). What is the value of \(tan\)(theta)?
exp: Using the Pythagorean triple 7-24-25, if the adjacent side is 24 and the hypotenuse is 25, the opposite side is \(\sqrt{25^{2}-24^{2}}=\sqrt{625-576}=\sqrt{49}=7\). Therefore, \(tan\)(theta) = opposite / adjacent = \(\frac{7}{24}\).
strat: 7-24-25 Pifagor uchligi. cos = \(\frac{24}{25}\) bo'lsa, sin = \(\frac{7}{25}\). tan = sin/cos = \(\frac{\frac{7}{25}}{\frac{24}{25}}=\frac{7}{24}\).

pas: Although the archival documents were fragile and severely degraded by humidity, the conservator handled each manuscript with exceptional care, taking pains not to compromise the ______ integrity of the centuries-old parchment.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp: The text discusses fragile manuscripts degraded by humidity that need to be preserved without damaging the parchment itself. 'Physical' correctly describes the material condition and structure of the parchment.
strat: Kontekst kaliti: 'fragile', 'degraded by humidity', 'parchment' (moddiy ashyo). Faqat 'physical' mos keladi.

pas: During the late nineteenth century, public health officials encountered widespread resistance when attempting to mandate municipal water chlorination. Far from being embraced as a life-saving innovation, the chemical treatment was initially regarded with deep ______ by citizens who suspected hidden corporate motives.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp: 'Far from being embraced' and 'suspected hidden corporate motives' signal strong distrust and doubt. 'Skepticism' precisely matches this attitude of doubt and suspicion.
strat: Ziddiyat kaliti: 'Far from being embraced' + 'suspected hidden motives' => shubha va ishonchsizlik (skepticism).

pas: Contemporary cognitive scientists often criticize early computational models of human memory for being overly rigid; human recollection, modern studies suggest, is not an exact retrieval of static files but rather an inherently ______ process that reconstructs past events anew with each remembering.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp: The contrast set up by 'not an exact retrieval of static files but rather...' requires a word opposite to rigid and static. 'Malleable' (easily influenced, adaptable, flexible) accurately characterizes a process that reconstructs events anew each time.
strat: Qarama-qarshilik: 'rigid/static' ga zid so'z kerak. 'Malleable' (o'zgaruvchan, egiluvchan) to'liq mos keladi.

pas: To verify the authenticity of the Renaissance painting, the museum curator sought to ______ the findings of the pigment analysis with independent historical provenance records.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp: To verify authenticity, a researcher wants independent evidence to confirm and support the initial scientific findings. 'Corroborate' means to confirm or give support to a statement or finding.
strat: 'Verify authenticity' uchun dalillarni bir-biri bilan tasdiqlash (corroborate) talab etiladi.

pas: Despite his reputation for writing dense and convoluted philosophical treatises, Professor Alvarez was remarkably ______ in his public lectures, distilling intricate metaphysical doctrines into clear, accessible prose.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp: 'Despite his reputation for dense and convoluted... distilling intricate doctrines into clear, accessible prose' indicates that in public lectures he was exceptionally clear and easy to understand. 'Lucid' means expressed clearly; easy to understand.
strat: Ziddiyat: 'dense and convoluted' ga qarama-qarshi so'z 'clear, accessible' => 'lucid' (ravshan, tushunarli).

pas: The engineer noted that the bridge’s steel suspension cables had begun to ______ under the relentless coastal winds and salty marine air, exhibiting significant rust and structural weakness.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp: Contextual clues 'exhibiting significant rust and structural weakness' directly point to physical degradation and worsening condition. 'Deteriorate' means to become progressively worse.
strat: Kalit so'zlar: 'rust', 'structural weakness' => yemirilish, yomonlashish (deteriorate).

pas: Because the urban planning committee was composed of representatives with conflicting political agendas, reaching a consensus on the new zoning laws proved to be an exceptionally ______ endeavor.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp: The presence of 'conflicting political agendas' making agreement difficult indicates an endeavor marked by dispute and argument. 'Contentious' means causing or likely to cause an argument; controversial.
strat: 'Conflicting agendas' sababli jarayon munozarali va nizoli (contentious) bo'ladi.

pas: Rather than attempting to eliminate all ambient noise in recording studios, acoustic engineers often deploy low-level white noise to ______ minor acoustical imperfections, rendering sudden extraneous sounds imperceptible to listeners.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp: The text explains that white noise makes minor imperfections and sudden sounds 'imperceptible' (unable to be noticed). 'Mask' means to conceal, disguise, or cover up auditory stimuli.
strat: Natija: 'imperceptible' qilish uchun shovqinni 'mask' qilish (yopish, bildirmaslik) kerak.

pas: In her comprehensive biography of Ada Lovelace, historian Miranda Chen cautions against the temptation to ______ Lovelace’s mathematical accomplishments, arguing that exaggeration diminishes the genuine significance of her pioneering insights into mechanical computing.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp: The following clause clarifies: 'arguing that exaggeration diminishes the genuine significance...'. 'Hyperbolize' means to exaggerate, directly mirroring the context.
strat: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri sinonim kalit: 'exaggeration' => 'hyperbolize' (bo'rttirib yubormoq).

pas: While some critics dismissed the avant-garde novelist's fragmented chronology as mere stylistic posturing, more perceptive literary scholars recognized that the disjointed timeline was ______ to the protagonist's fractured psychological state.
q: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
exp: The sentence contrasts superficial critics with perceptive scholars who see that the technique is fundamentally tied and essential to portraying the protagonist's psychology. 'Integral' means necessary to make a whole complete; essential.
strat: Qarama-qarshilik: 'mere posturing' ga qarshi o'laroq, bu uslub qahramon ruhiyatiga uzviy bog'liq ('integral').

pas: For decades, evolutionary biologists assumed that bioluminescence in marine organisms evolved primarily for predatory lure or mate recognition. However, recent deep-sea submersibles equipped with hypersensitive photometers revealed that over seventy percent of abyssal bioluminescent flashes occur in response to mechanical touch. This empirical discovery suggests that illumination primarily serves as a startle mechanism against approaching grazers rather than as an offensive weapon.
q: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
opts: It outlines a longstanding scientific assumption, presents new empirical observations, and proposes a revised explanation.
It defines a biological phenomenon, identifies its cellular mechanisms, and evaluates its ecological disadvantages.
It describes an experimental apparatus, details its operational limitations, and suggests alternative technological solutions.
It summarizes an ongoing debate among biologists, introduces experimental data supporting both sides, and calls for further research.
exp: Sentence 1 introduces the longstanding assumption. Sentence 2 introduces recent empirical findings ('However, recent deep-sea...'). Sentence 3 synthesizes these findings to propose a revised functional explanation. Choice A accurately captures this three-part structural progression.
strat: Tuzilish qolipi: 1) Eski qarash ('For decades assumed') -> 2) Yangi kashfiyot ('However, recent discovery') -> 3) Yangilangan xulosa ('This suggests').

pas: In his 1928 critique of modernist architecture, Lewis Mumford observed that glass and steel skyscrapers, while celebrating industrial triumphs, severed city dwellers from natural diurnal rhythms. By replacing masonry with curtain walls, architects intended to flood interiors with sunlight; in practice, excessive glare necessitated heavy blinds, paradoxically encasing workers in artificial illumination. For Mumford, the tower was less a beacon of liberation than a monument to technical overconfidence.
q: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
opts: To contrast the aesthetic philosophies of Lewis Mumford with those of contemporary industrial architects.
To argue that modern building codes should mandate the use of traditional masonry materials.
To highlight an architectural critic’s analysis of how an intended design benefit produced an unexpected drawback.
To celebrate the engineering innovations that enabled skyscraper construction in early twentieth-century cities.
exp: The text focuses on Mumford's critique: architects intended to bring sunlight inside (intended benefit), but glare forced the use of blinds and artificial lights (unexpected drawback). Choice C directly summarizes this purpose.
strat: Matnning asosiy maqsadi: Mumfordning kutilgan maqsad (quyosh nuri) va kutilmagan salbiy natija (sun'iy yorug'lik) haqidagi tahlilini yoritish.

pas: Photosynthesis is often summarized simply as the conversion of carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. Yet this overarching equation conceals a complex sequence of sub-reactions divided into two interdependent phases: the light-dependent reactions that harvest solar photon energy, and the Calvin cycle, which fixes gaseous carbon into organic molecules.
q: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the overall text?
opts: It refutes an obsolete historical theory regarding the role of oxygen in plant physiology.
It introduces a controversial scientific hypothesis that lacks empirical confirmation.
It provides a simplified baseline description of a process before revealing its underlying intricacy.
It illustrates a common experimental mistake made by introductory biology students.
exp: The first sentence presents the basic, simplified overview ('is often summarized simply as...'), allowing the second sentence to contrast it with the true two-stage intricacy. Thus, it establishes a simplified baseline.
strat: Funktsiya: Sodda umumiy formulani berish, so'ngra jarayonning asl murakkabligini ochib berish.

pas: Standard economic models frequently operate under the assumption of 'rational actors' who dispassionately maximize personal utility. Behavioral economists, however, have documented consistent cognitive anomalies, such as loss aversion—the psychological tendency to experience the pain of losing $100 far more acutely than the joy of gaining $100. By integrating psychological realism into economic equations, researchers have developed predictive models that far better mirror actual market behavior.
q: Which choice best describes the primary purpose of the text?
opts: To condemn the mathematical methods used by twentieth-century economic theorists.
To prove that financial markets are entirely chaotic and cannot be reliably modeled.
To compare the personal monetary decisions of behavioral economists with ordinary consumers.
To demonstrate how empirical psychological insights have refined traditional economic assumptions.
exp: The text explains how behavioral economics incorporated psychological realism (like loss aversion) to improve the unrealistic 'rational actor' assumption and create models that better mirror real behavior.
strat: Asosiy g'oya: Psixologik tushunchalar an'anaviy iqtisodiy modellarni qanday takomillashtirgani.

pas: In literary criticism, the concept of the 'unreliable narrator' is often treated as a modern narrative invention popularized by early twentieth-century psychological novels. However, Geoffrey Chaucer’s fourteenth-century *Canterbury Tales* features speakers whose self-aggrandizing exaggerations and moral contradictions explicitly invite reader skepticism. Acknowledging these pre-modern antecedents challenges the teleological narrative that narrative complexity arose solely with literary modernism.
q: Which choice best states the primary claim of the author?
opts: Chaucer was the first European author to intentionally deceive his readers through first-person narration.
Modern psychological novels lack the genuine narrative sophistication found in Chaucer’s poetry.
Literary modernism should be defined primarily by its rejection of medieval storytelling devices.
Narrative unreliability existed well before modernism, demonstrating that narrative complexity has a deeper historical lineage.
exp: The author points out that Chaucer used unreliable narrators in the 14th century, which challenges the idea that complexity is strictly a modern invention, thereby establishing that it has a deeper history.
