pas: The rapid proliferation of microscopic plastic fragments in global freshwater systems ______ a severe ecotoxicological hazard for benthic macroinvertebrates.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: The grammatical subject is the singular noun 'proliferation' (not the plural 'fragments' or 'systems'). A singular subject requires the singular verb 'poses'.
strat: Ega-kesim moslashuvi: Ega - 'proliferation' (birlik). Oraliqdagi 'of microscopic plastic fragments' chalg'ituvchi bo'lib, kesim 'poses' birlikda bo'lishi shart.

pas: Concealed beneath Antarctica's thick ice sheet ______ hundreds of interconnected subglacial lakes that harbor microbial ecosystems isolated for millennia.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: This sentence uses inverted syntax: the subject follows the verb. The true subject is the plural noun phrase 'hundreds of interconnected subglacial lakes', requiring the plural verb 'lie'.
strat: Inversiya (Inverted order): Gap o'rni almashgan: 'Beneath the ice lie hundreds of lakes'. Ega 'lakes' (ko'plikda), demak kesim 'lie' bo'ladi.

pas: In 1928, Scottish bacteriologist Alexander Fleming ______ that an accidental penicillium mold contaminant in a petri dish inhibited the growth of staphylococcal bacteria.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: The specific past-time indicator 'In 1928' requires simple past tense ('observed').
strat: Aniq o'tgan zamon belgisi: 'In 1928' ko'rsatilgani uchun fe'l faqat Simple Past ('observed') bo'lishi lozim.

pas: When specialized plasma cells detect circulating antigens, they immediately ______ antibody proteins designed to neutralize the invasive pathogen.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: The dependent clause uses present tense ('detect') to describe a general biological process; the main clause must maintain consistent present tense ('synthesize') to agree with plural 'they'.
strat: Zamonlar muvofiqligi (General factual present): 'When cells detect..., they synthesize...' umumiy ilmiy haqiqat hozirgi zamonda bo'ladi.

pas: Analyzing the geochemical composition of ancient lake sediments, ______ anomalous concentrations of iridium consistent with a major meteoritic impact.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
opts: the discovery was made by geologists of
exp: The introductory participial phrase 'Analyzing...' must modify the logical agent performing the analysis. Sediments or discoveries cannot analyze sediments; only 'geologists' can.
strat: Dangling modifier tuzog'i: 'Analyzing...' harakatini faqat geologlar bajara oladi, shuning uchun verguldan keyin 'geologists' kelishi shart.

pas: Originally constructed to defend against naval incursions, ______ now houses a celebrated maritime history museum visited by thousands of tourists annually.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
opts: tourists can visit the fortress, which
naval officers designed the fortress that
exp: The introductory modifier 'Originally constructed...' must logically describe the subject that follows the comma. Only 'the coastal stone fortress' was constructed to defend against incursions.
strat: Modifier mosligi: 'Originally constructed...' faqat qal'aga ('fortress') tegishli bo'lishi mumkin, odamlar yoki kengashga emas.

pas: After conducting rigorous clinical trials across multiple testing facilities, the biomedical research team announced that ______ had formulated a stable synthetic vaccine.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: 'The biomedical research team' is a singular collective noun acting as a single entity, requiring the singular pronoun 'it'.
strat: Kollektiv ot va olmosh: 'team' birlikdagi bitta guruh sifatida qaralganda 'it' olmoshi talab etiladi.

pas: Environmental regulators issued citations to industrial plant operators ______ had repeatedly discharged untreated wastewater into municipal drainage canals.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: 'Who' serves as the subject pronoun of the relative clause ('who had repeatedly discharged...'). 'Whom' is objective and cannot function as the subject.
strat: Who vs Whom: Nisbiy gapning egasi sifatida ('who had discharged...') faqat 'who' ishlatiladi ('whom' to'ldiruvchi o'rnida keladi).

pas: To survive harsh winters in the subarctic tundra, willow ptarmigans molt into white plumage, burrow beneath snowpacks for insulation, and ______ their diet to nutrient-poor woody twigs.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: The sentence presents a parallel series of base-form verbs: 'molt...', 'burrow...', and 'restrict...'.
strat: Parallel struktura: 'molt...', 'burrow...', and 'restrict...' - barcha fe'llar bir xil boshlang'ich zamonda bo'lishi shart.

pas: The innovative acoustic hall was designed not only to amplify subtle violin harmonics ______ background HVAC vibrations from neighboring subway tunnels.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Correlative conjunctions require parallel structures: 'not only to amplify... but also to dampen...'.
strat: Correlative Conjunctions: 'not only [to infinitive] ... but also [to infinitive]' juftligi parallel grammatik shaklni talab qiladi.

pas: Agronomists found that the root tensile strength of drought-tolerant sorghum hybrids was significantly greater than ______ conventional corn varieties under water stress.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: The comparison is between the 'tensile strength' (singular) of sorghum and the 'tensile strength' of corn varieties. The singular demonstrative pronoun 'that of' correctly maintains logical comparison.
strat: Mantiqiy taqqoslash (Logical Comparison): 'tensile strength' (birlik) bilan taqqoslashda 'that of' ishlatiladi ('those of' ko'plikka ketadi).

pas: Cognitive psychologists noted that participants' reaction times in spatial recognition trials were remarkably consistent ______ previous theoretical projections.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: The standard English idiomatic collocation is 'consistent with'.
strat: Idiomatik predlog: Ingliz tilida har doim 'consistent with' iborasi to'g'ri hisoblanadi.

pas: Urban planners noted that the thermal absorption characteristics of asphalt parking surfaces differ dramatically from ______ pervious concrete pavements.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: The subject being compared is plural ('the thermal absorption characteristics'). Plural comparisons require 'those of'.
strat: Ko'plikdagi taqqoslash: 'characteristics' (ko'plikda bo'lgani uchun) 'those of' bilan to'g'ri solishtiriladi.

pas: Climatologists warn that if atmospheric methane emissions ______ to rise unabated over the coming decades, feedback loops in thawing Arctic permafrost could accelerate global warming.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
exp: Hypothetical future conditional statements using subjunctive mood require 'were' ('if emissions were to rise...').
strat: Subjunctive mood (Gipotetik shart): 'if ... were to rise' gipotetik kelajak taxmini uchun 'were' to'g'ri shakldir.

pas: An elusive nocturnal inhabitant of the high-altitude Andean cloud forests, ______ spends daytime hours resting in concealed canopy nests constructed of twigs and leaves.
q: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
opts: the habitat of the spectacled bear
biologists have tracked the spectacled bear, which
dense foliage protects the spectacled bear, which
exp: The introductory descriptive modifier 'An elusive nocturnal inhabitant...' must logically modify the animal itself ('the spectacled bear'), not foliage or biologists or habitat.
strat: Kirish iborasiga mos ega: 'An elusive nocturnal inhabitant...' ta'rifi faqat ayiqqa ('the spectacled bear') mos keladi.
